en.title: PT Vale Indonesia Wins Two HR Asia Awards, Reinforcing Commitment to a People-Centered Workplace
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or “the Company”), an integrated and sustainable nickel mining company, has received two awards at the HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Awards: HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026 and the HR Asia People Transformation Award 2026.
en.body:
Jakarta, June 5, 2026 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or “the Company”), an integrated and sustainable nickel mining company, has received two awards at the HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Awards: HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026 and the HR Asia People Transformation Award 2026.

The awards were accepted in Jakarta by Ranty Astari Rachman, Corporate Secretary, and Gandi Husodo, Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition, Performance Management & EVP, on behalf of the Company. 

Organized by Business Media International (BMI), the HR Asia Awards apply the proprietary Total Engagement Assessment Model (TEAM) methodology, which measures employee engagement, attitudes, motivation, and overall workplace experience. The standardized framework enables benchmarking across industries and countries, making it a credible measure of organizational excellence across Asia.

Previously, in September 2025, PT Vale was certified as a Great Place to Work.

For PT Vale, these recognitions reflect its long-term investment in building a safe, inclusive workplace that fosters talent development and supports sustainable business growth. With more than 3,000 employees across multiple operational sites, the Company continues to strengthen its human capital strategy as a core element of Indonesia’s critical minerals downstreaming and transformation agenda.

This commitment is demonstrated through various talent development programs. One example is the Cooperative Education Program (Co-ops), developed in collaboration with Hasanuddin University to bridge academia and industry. In the 2025 intake, 16 students were selected from 48 candidates to participate in a six-month full-time internship within PT Vale’s operations.

Internally, the Company continues to invest in employee growth. In 2024, a total of 370 employees were promoted, while 143 non-staff employees obtained national professional certifications through Indonesia’s Professional Certification Institute (LSP). All employees also undergo formal performance evaluations as part of a structured career development framework.

PT Vale’s commitment to people extends to local community empowerment. Since commencing operations, the Company has engaged more than 11,000 local community members as employees and business partners, 87% of whom are from East Luwu and South Sulawesi. To further strengthen workforce readiness, PT Vale runs competency-building initiatives such as the Vocational Short-Term Training (VST) program in collaboration with the East Luwu Regency Government and Sorowako Polytechnic.

In parallel, the Company continues to foster a more inclusive work environment. Women currently represent 11.6% of the workforce, including 17 in managerial positions. PT Vale also employs 70 persons with disabilities across various organizational functions and maintains equal pay for equal work regardless of gender. Its Wellness Program, involving 623 employees and contractors, has delivered measurable benefits, with 98% of active participants reporting improved health and energy levels.

Commenting on the achievement, Bernardus Irmanto, President Director and Chief Executive Officer of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, emphasized that building an outstanding workplace is inseparable from long-term investment in people.

“Through discipline and integrity, we aim to ensure PT Vale’s meaningful contribution to energy sovereignty and sustainable development in Indonesia. Our employees are central to that commitment, and this recognition affirms that how we treat our workforce is integral to how we operate as a business,” he said.

The HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026 award adds to PT Vale’s growing list of recognitions in sustainability, governance, and environmental stewardship. For the Company, sustainability is not only defined by responsible resource management, but also by how people are empowered and developed.

Aligned with its commitment to supporting Indonesia’s downstream minerals strategy and the global energy transition, PT Vale will continue to prioritize investments in talent, workplace culture, and employee well-being as the foundation for building a more responsible, inclusive, and sustainable mining company.

id.title: Raih Dua Penghargaan HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Awards, PT Vale Indonesia Tegaskan Komitmen Membangun Tempat Kerja yang Berpusat pada Manusia
id.subtitle: Jakarta, 5 Juni 2026 — Perusahaan tambang nikel terintegrasi dan berkelanjutan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perseroan”), meraih dua penghargaan pada ajang HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Awards, ‘HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026’ dan ‘HR ASIA People Transformation Award 2026’.
id.body:
Jakarta, 5 Juni 2026 — Perusahaan tambang nikel terintegrasi dan berkelanjutan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perseroan”), meraih dua penghargaan pada ajang HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Awards, ‘HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026’ dan ‘HR ASIA People Transformation Award 2026’. 

Penghargaan tersebut diterima oleh Ranty Astari Rachman, Corporate Secretary dan Gandi Husodo, Senior Manager Talent Acquisition, Performance Management & EVP PT Vale, yang hadir mewakili Perseroan dalam malam penganugerahan di Jakarta. Diselenggarakan oleh Business Media International (BMI), HR Asia Awards menggunakan metodologi penilaian ‘TEAM Assessment,’ instrumen proprietary HR Asia yang mengukur keterlibatan, sikap, motivasi, dan pengalaman kerja karyawan secara langsung. Hasilnya dapat dibandingkan lintas industri dan negara, sehingga menjadikan penghargaan ini tolok ukur yang sahih bagi para pelaku bisnis di Asia. 

Sebelumnya pada September 2025, PT Vale telah tersertifikasi Great Place To Work. 

Bagi PT Vale, penghargaan ini merupakan pengakuan atas investasi jangka panjang Perseroan dalam membangun lingkungan kerja yang aman, inklusif, dan mampu mengembangkan talenta untuk mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis yang berkelanjutan. Dengan lebih dari 3.000 karyawan yang tersebar di berbagai wilayah operasional, Perseroan terus memperkuat strategi pengembangan sumber daya manusia sebagai bagian integral dari agenda transformasi dan hilirisasi mineral kritis Indonesia. 

Komitmen tersebut diwujudkan melalui berbagai program pengembangan talenta. Salah satunya adalah Cooperative Education Program (Co-Ops) yang dijalankan bersama Universitas Hasanuddin untuk menjembatani dunia akademik dan industri. Pada penerimaan terakhir tahun 2025, sebanyak 16 mahasiswa terpilih dari 48 kandidat untuk menjalani program magang penuh waktu selama enam bulan di lingkungan operasional PT Vale. 

Di internal perusahaan, investasi pada pengembangan karyawan juga terus diperkuat. Sepanjang tahun 2024, sebanyak 370 karyawan memperoleh promosi jabatan, sementara 143 karyawan non-staf berhasil memperoleh sertifikasi profesi nasional melalui Lembaga Sertifikasi Profesi (LSP). Seluruh karyawan juga menjalani proses penilaian kinerja formal sebagai bagian dari pengembangan karier yang terstruktur. 

Komitmen PT Vale terhadap pengembangan manusia juga tercermin melalui pendekatan yang mengutamakan pemberdayaan masyarakat lokal. Sejak beroperasi, Perseroan telah melibatkan lebih dari 11.000 masyarakat lokal sebagai karyawan maupun mitra kerja, dengan 87% di antaranya berasal dari Luwu Timur dan Sulawesi Selatan. Untuk memperkuat kesiapan tenaga kerja lokal, PT Vale juga menjalankan berbagai program peningkatan kompetensi, termasuk Vocational Short-Term Training (VST) yang dikembangkan bersama Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Timur dan Politeknik Sorowako. 

Selain pengembangan talenta, PT Vale terus mendorong terciptanya lingkungan kerja yang lebih inklusif. Saat ini, perempuan mencakup 11,6% dari total tenaga kerja Perseroan, termasuk 17 perempuan yang menduduki posisi manajerial. PT Vale juga mempekerjakan 70 penyandang disabilitas di berbagai fungsi organisasi serta menerapkan prinsip kesetaraan remunerasi untuk pekerjaan yang setara tanpa memandang gender. Perseroan juga menjalankan Program Wellness yang melibatkan 623 karyawan dan kontraktor, dengan 98% peserta aktif melaporkan peningkatan kesehatan dan tingkat energi setelah mengikuti program tersebut. 

Menanggapi penghargaan tersebut, Bernardus Irmanto, Presiden Direktur dan Chief Executive Officer PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, menyampaikan bahwa keberhasilan perusahaan dalam membangun tempat kerja yang unggul tidak dapat dipisahkan dari komitmen jangka panjang untuk mengembangkan manusia. “Melalui disiplin dan integritas, kami ingin memastikan kontribusi nyata PT Vale terhadap kedaulatan energi dan pembangunan berkelanjutan Indonesia. Karyawan kami adalah inti dari janji tersebut dan penghargaan ini menegaskan bahwa cara kami memperlakukan tenaga kerja kami tidak terpisahkan dari cara kami menjalankan bisnis.” 

Penghargaan HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026 melengkapi berbagai pengakuan yang diterima PT Vale dalam bidang keberlanjutan, tata kelola, dan pengelolaan lingkungan. Bagi Perseroan, keberlanjutan tidak hanya diukur dari bagaimana sumber daya alam dikelola, tetapi juga dari bagaimana manusia yang menjalankan bisnis diberdayakan dan dikembangkan.

Sejalan dengan komitmen Perseroan untuk mendukung agenda hilirisasi nasional dan transisi energi global, investasi pada talenta, budaya kerja, dan kesejahteraan karyawan akan terus menjadi fondasi utama dalam membangun perusahaan pertambangan yang lebih bertanggung jawab, inklusif, dan berkelanjutan bagi Indonesia.

en.title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk Announces 2026 AGMS Results: Strengthening Fundamentals, Distributing 60% Dividend, and Advancing Sustainable Business Transformation
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk announced the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, highlighting resilient 2025 performance, a 60% dividend payout, and continued progress on strategic growth projects. The Company reported strong profitability, maintained cost discipline, and advanced key developments including HPAL partnerships and new mining operations. Governance was strengthened through Board changes, reinforcing PT Vale’s commitment to sustainable growth and long-term value creation.
en.body:
Sorowako, June 2, 2026 – PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“the Company”) today held its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGMS) for 2026, which approved the Company’s Annual Report and Financial Statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, and resolved a number of strategic decisions reflecting the Company’s solid performance and continued commitment to strengthening long-term growth.

The AGMS also granted full release and discharge of responsibility (volledig acquit et de charge) to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for their management and supervisory actions during the 2025 financial year, as reflected in the Annual Report and the audited Financial Statements examined by Public Accounting Firm Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC).

2025 Performance: Resilient Amid Industry Challenges
Throughout 2025, PT Vale demonstrated strong operational resilience, delivering a 32% increase in net profit to US$76 million, supported by 4% revenue growth to US$990 million, EBITDA of US$228 million, and relatively stable unit cash cost of sales for nickel matte.

This improvement in profitability was driven by:

  • Enhanced margin quality through improved payability and pricing premiums
  • Diversification of revenue streams, including the commercialization of saprolite ore sales
  • Cost discipline through capital expenditure optimization

The Company also maintained a competitive cost position, with unit cash cost (UCC) of nickel matte at US$9,339 per ton, the lowest level in the past four years.

From an operational standpoint, nickel in matte production reached 72,027 tons, representing a 1% increase year-on-year, reflecting the stability of the Company’s core operations. Total nickel matte sales volume reached 73,093 tons, while saprolite ore sales exceeded 2.3 million wet metric tons (wmt), marking an important initial contribution from this new revenue stream.

Progress on Strategic Projects and Business Diversification
In 2025, the Company accelerated the development of strategic projects as part of its transformation toward a more diversified business platform, including:

  • Progress of the HPAL project in partnership with GEM and EcoPro
  • Development of the Bahodopi and Pomalaa mining projects
  • Commencement of production at the new Bahodopi mine, with output of approximately 2 million WMT

The Company also secured the 2025 RKAB approval, providing a solid foundation for the commencement of new mining operations and strengthening its future growth pipeline.

Amid various operational challenges, including technical incidents and smelter rebuild activities, the Company successfully maintained operational continuity while upholding high safety standards.

Dividend Policy: Balancing Returns and Growth
Reflecting this performance, shareholders approved a total cash dividend of US$45,638,211, representing a 60% payout ratio of the Company’s net profit for the 2025 financial year. The dividend will be distributed to shareholders registered on June 12, 2026 (record date), with payment scheduled for June 26, 2026.

The remaining net profit will be allocated as retained earnings to support the Company’s business expansion and development.

Sustainability Performance: Beyond Compliance
As part of its commitment to responsible mining practices, the Company delivered significant improvements in ESG performance, including:

  • GHG emissions intensity (ALL): 21.70 tCO₂e/ton Ni, well below the target of 29.76
  • SO₂ intensity: 0.68, outperforming the target of 0.80

These sustainability efforts received broad recognition, including:

  • Asia ESG Positive Impact Award 2025 (Gold) for biodiversity conservation programs
  • Subroto Award 2025 from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
  • National awards in CSR and SDGs

In addition, the Company improved its Sustainalytics ESG risk rating from 27.5 to 23.7 (Medium Risk), reflecting strengthened governance and sustainability practices.

 

Strengthening Governance and Management Structure
From a governance perspective, the AGMS accepted the resignations of Emily Olson as Vice President Commissioner and Christopher McCleave as Commissioner and expressed appreciation for their valuable contributions during their tenure. As their successors, shareholders approved the appointment of: Kristina Gauthier as Vice President Commissioner, Patricia Renee Pegues as Commissioner and Adam MacMillan as Commissioner.

These changes reflect PT Vale’s commitment to strengthening an adaptive, high-integrity leadership foundation capable of addressing the evolving dynamics of the critical minerals industry, while ensuring the continuity of the Company’s transformation and strategic project development.

Following these appointments, the composition of the Company’s Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners is as follows:

Board of Directors

  • President Director & Chief Executive Officer: Bernardus Irmanto
  • Vice President Director & Chief Operation Officer: Abu Ashar
  • Director & Chief Human Capital Officer: Heriyanto Agung Putra
  • Director & Chief Sustainability and Corporate Affairs Officer: Budiawansyah
  • Director & Chief Financial Officer: Rizky Andhika Putra
  • Director & Chief Project Officer: Muhammad Asril
  • Director & Chief Strategy and Technical Officer: Slamet Sugiharto

Board of Commissioners

  • President Commissioner: F.S. Multhazar
  • Vice President Commissioner: Kristina Gauthier
  • Commissioner: Patricia Renee Pegues
  • Commissioner: Adam MacMillan
  • Commissioner: M. Jasman Panjaitan
  • Commissioner: Katherina Anggela Oendun
  • Commissioner: Shiro Imai
  • Independent Commissioner: Rudiantara
  • Independent Commissioner: Retno Marsudi
  • Independent Commissioner: Marita Alisjahbana

The Company will comply with all applicable regulations concerning the changes in the composition of its Board of Commissioners.

In addition, in line with past practices, the Company proposed to grant authority to the Board of Commissioners, subject to prior recommendation from the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, to determine the honorarium for the Board of Commissioners for fiscal year 2026, policies on other remuneration components, as well as salary and allowances for the Board of Directors.

The AGMS also approved the appointment of Mr. Yusron Fauzan and Public Accounting Firm Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC), registered with the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK), as the independent auditor to audit the Company’s Financial Statements for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, and other financial statements as required.

Strategic Direction: Strengthening Position as a Global Player
The Board of Commissioners assessed that the Board of Directors successfully maintained a balance between project acceleration, operational discipline, regulatory compliance, and robust risk management.

Going forward, the Company will continue to focus on:

  • Advancing nickel downstream projects to enhance value creation
  • Improving operational efficiency and cost optimization
  • Strengthening sustainability and governance practices
  • Expanding strategic partnerships to broaden its value chain

Concluding the AGMS, President Director and Chief Executive Officer of PT Vale, Bernardus Irmanto, stated:

“Amid global industry challenges, PT Vale has maintained strong operational performance, strengthened profitability, and continued its transformation toward a more integrated and sustainable critical minerals company. The dividend we approved today and the progress of our HPAL projects reflect our confidence in Indonesia’s long-term position as a responsible and low-carbon nickel supplier for the global energy transition. We will continue to focus on best mining practices, responsible downstreaming, and long-term value creation for the nation and all stakeholders.”

About PT Vale Indonesia Tbk
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk is an integrated nickel mining company operating in Indonesia, committed to sustainable mining practices, safety, and delivering long-term value for its stakeholders, while contributing positively to communities and the environment.

id.title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk Umumkan Hasil RUPST 2026: Perkuat Fundamental, Distribusikan Dividen 60%, dan Lanjutkan Transformasi Bisnis Berkelanjutan
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk mengumumkan hasil Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham Tahunan (RUPST) 2026, dengan menyoroti kinerja tangguh sepanjang 2025, pembagian dividen sebesar 60%, serta kemajuan proyek-proyek strategis. Perseroan mencatatkan profitabilitas yang kuat, disiplin biaya yang terjaga, serta progres penting pada kemitraan HPAL dan pengembangan tambang baru. Penguatan tata kelola melalui perubahan Dewan turut menegaskan komitmen terhadap pertumbuhan berkelanjutan dan penciptaan nilai jangka panjang.
id.body:
Sorowako, 2 juni 2026 – PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“Perseroan”) hari ini menyelenggarakan Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham Tahunan (RUPST) Tahun 2026, yang menyetujui Laporan Tahunan serta Laporan Keuangan Perseroan untuk tahun buku yang berakhir pada 31 Desember 2025, sekaligus menetapkan sejumlah keputusan strategis yang mencerminkan kinerja yang solid serta komitmen Perseroan dalam memperkuat pertumbuhan jangka panjang.

RUPST juga memberikan pembebasan dan pelunasan tanggung jawab sepenuhnya kepada Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris atas tindakan pengurusan dan pengawasan selama tahun buku 2025, sebagaimana tercermin dalam laporan tahunan dan laporan keuangan yang telah diaudit oleh Kantor Akuntan Publik Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC). 

Kinerja 2025: Resilien di Tengah Tantangan Industri
Sepanjang tahun 2025, PT Vale menunjukkan ketahanan operasional yang solid dengan berhasil membukukan peningkatan laba bersih sebesar 32% menjadi AS$76 juta, didukung  oleh pertumbuhan pendapatan sebesar 4% menjadi AS$990 juta, EBITDA sebesar AS$228  juta, dan unit cash cost of sales nikel matte yang relatif terjaga.   

Peningkatan profitabilitas ini didukung oleh:

  • Perbaikan kualitas margin melalui peningkatan payability dan pricing premium
  • Diversifikasi sumber pendapatan, termasuk mulai komersialisasi penjualan bijih saprolite
  • Disiplin pengendalian biaya melalui optimalisasi capital expenditure

Perseroan juga berhasil mempertahankan posisi biaya kompetitif, dengan unit cash cost (UCC) nickel matte sebesar US$9.339/ton, terendah dalam empat tahun terakhir. 

Dari sisi operasional, produksi nikel dalam matte mencapai 72.027 ton, naik 1% dibanding tahun sebelumnya, mencerminkan stabilitas operasi inti Perseroan. Selain itu, total penjualan nikel matte mencapai 73.093 ton, sementara penjualan bijih saprolite mencapai lebih dari 2,3 juta wet metric ton (wmt) sebagai kontribusi awal dari lini bisnis baru. 

Kemajuan Proyek Strategis dan Diversifikasi Bisnis
Selama 2025, Perseroan terus mempercepat pengembangan proyek strategis sebagai bagian dari transformasi menuju platform bisnis yang lebih terdiversifikasi, di antaranya:

  • Progres proyek HPAL melalui kemitraan dengan GEM dan EcoPro
  • Pengembangan proyek pertambangan Bahodopi dan Pomalaa
  • Dimulainya produksi tambang baru Bahodopi dengan output sekitar 2 juta WMT 

Perseroan juga berhasil mendapatkan persetujuan RKAB 2025, yang menjadi landasan bagi dimulainya operasi tambang baru serta penguatan pipeline pertumbuhan ke depan.

Di tengah berbagai tantangan operasional, termasuk insiden teknis dan pekerjaan rebuild fasilitas smelter, Perseroan tetap mampu menjaga kesinambungan operasi dengan standar keselamatan yang tinggi. 

Kebijakan Dividen: Seimbang antara Return dan Pertumbuhan
Sebagai bentuk apresiasi atas kinerja tersebut, para pemegang saham menyetujui total dividen tunai sebesar AS$45.638.211, mewakili rasio pembayaran sebesar 60% dari laba  bersih tahun buku 2025 yang akan didistribusikan kepada pemegang saham yang terdaftar pada tanggal pencatatan 12 Juni 2026, dengan tanggal pembayaran 26 Juni 2026. Sisa laba bersih akan dialokasikan sebagai laba ditahan untuk mendukung ekspansi dan pengembangan bisnis Perseroan.

Kinerja Keberlanjutan: Beyond Compliance
Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap praktik pertambangan berkelanjutan, Perseroan mencatatkan peningkatan kinerja ESG yang signifikan, antara lain:

  • Intensitas emisi GRK (ALL): 21,70 tCO₂e/ton Ni, jauh di bawah target 29,76
  • Intensitas SO₂: 0,68, melampaui target 0,80 

Upaya keberlanjutan ini mendapatkan pengakuan luas, termasuk:

  • Asia ESG Positive Impact Award 2025 (Gold) untuk program konservasi biodiversitas
  • Subroto Award 2025 dari Kementerian ESDM
  • Penghargaan nasional dalam bidang CSR dan SDGs 

Selain itu, rating risiko ESG Sustainalytics Perseroan membaik dari 27,5 menjadi 23,7 (Medium Risk), mencerminkan penguatan praktik tata kelola dan keberlanjutan.
 

Penguatan Tata Kelola dan Struktur Manajemen
Dari sisi tata kelola, RUPST menerima pengunduran diri Emily Olson sebagai Wakil Presiden Komisaris dan Christopher McCleave sebagai Komisaris, serta  menyampaikan apresiasi atas kontribusi keduanya selama masa jabatan masing-masing. 

Sebagai penggantinya, para pemegang saham menyetujui pengangkatan Kristina Gauthier  sebagai Wakil Presiden Komisaris, Patricia Renee Pegues sebagai Komisaris, dan Adam  MacMillan sebagai Komisaris. Perubahan komposisi pengurus ini mencerminkan komitmen  PT Vale untuk memperkuat fondasi kepemimpinan yang adaptif, berintegritas, dan mampu  menjawab tantangan industri mineral kritis yang semakin dinamis, sekaligus memastikan  kesinambungan transformasi dan pengembangan proyek-proyek strategis Perseroan. 

Dengan pengangkatan ini, susunan lengkap Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris PT Vale adalah sebagai berikut: 

Direksi:

  • Presiden Direktur dan Chief Executive Officer: Bernardus Irmanto 
  • Wakil Presiden Direktur dan Chief Operation and Officer: Abu Ashar 
  • Direktur dan Chief Human Capital Officer: Heriyanto Agung Putra 
  • Direktur dan Chief Sustainability and Corporate Affairs Officer: Budiawansyah 
  • Direktur dan Chief Financial Officer: Rizky Andhika Putra 
  • Direktur dan Chief Project Officer: Muhammad Asril 
  • Direktur dan Chief Strategy and Technical Officer: Slamet Sugiharto 

Dewan Komisaris: 

  • Presiden Komisaris : F.S. Multhazar 
  • Wakil Presiden Komisaris : Kristina Gauthier 
  • Komisaris : Patricia Renee Pegues 
  • Komisaris : Adam MacMillan 
  • Komisaris : M. Jasman Panjaitan 
  • Komisaris : Katherina Anggela Oendun 
  • Komisaris : Shiro Imai 
  • Komisaris Independen : Rudiantara 
  • Komisaris Independen : Retno Marsudi 
  • Komisaris Independen : Marita Alisjahbana 

PT Vale akan mematuhi seluruh ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku terkait perubahan susunan Dewan Komisaris. 

Selain itu, sesuai dengan praktik Perseroan di masa lalu, Perseroan mengusulkan menyetujui  pemberian wewenang kepada Dewan Komisaris, dengan terlebih dahulu mendapatkan rekomendasi dari Komite Tata Kelola, Nominasi dan Remunerasi Perseroan, untuk menetapkan honorarium Tahun Buku 2026 dan kebijakan terkait penghasilan lain selain  honorarium Tahun Buku 2025, bagi anggota Dewan Komisaris Perseroan; serta gaji dan tunjangan Tahun Buku 2026 bagi anggota Direksi. 

Terakhir, RUPST menyetujui penunjukan Bapak Yusron Fauzan dan Kantor Akuntan Publik Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (anggota PricewaterhouseCoopers) yang terdaftar di Otoritas  Jasa Keuangan sebagai auditor independen untuk mengaudit Laporan Keuangan Perseroan tahun buku yang berakhir 31 Desember 2026 serta audit laporan keuangan lainnya jika diperlukan. 

Arah Strategis: Memperkuat Posisi sebagai Pemain Global
Dewan Komisaris menilai Direksi telah berhasil menjaga keseimbangan antara percepatan pembangunan proyek, disiplin operasional, kepatuhan, serta manajemen risiko yang kuat. 

Ke depan, Perseroan akan terus fokus pada:

  • Penyelesaian proyek hilirisasi nikel untuk meningkatkan nilai tambah
  • Peningkatan efisiensi operasional dan optimalisasi biaya
  • Penguatan praktik keberlanjutan dan tata kelola perusahaan
  • Pengembangan kemitraan strategis untuk memperluas rantai nilai

Menutup RUPST hari ini, Presiden Direktur dan Chief Executive Officer PT Vale, Bernardus Irmanto, menyampaikan bahwa di tengah tantangan industri global, PT Vale mampu menjaga kinerja operasional yang solid, memperkuat profitabilitas, dan melanjutkan transformasi menuju perusahaan tambang mineral kritis yang lebih terintegrasi dan berkelanjutan. “Dividen yang kami tetapkan hari ini dan kemajuan proyek-proyek HPAL kami mencerminkan  keyakinan kami terhadap posisi jangka panjang Indonesia sebagai sumber nikel rendah karbon dan bertanggung jawab bagi transisi energi global. Kami akan terus berfokus pada praktik pertambangan terbaik, hilirisasi yang bertanggung jawab, serta penciptaan nilai jangka panjang bagi negara dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan.” 

Tentang PT Vale Indonesia Tbk
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk adalah perusahaan pertambangan nikel terintegrasi yang beroperasi di Indonesia, dengan komitmen pada praktik pertambangan berkelanjutan, keselamatan kerja, dan kontribusi positif bagi masyarakat serta lingkungan.

en.title: Holiday Train night trips return in July, with tickets on sale from May 17
en.subtitle: Holiday Train on the Vitória a Minas Railway: Night Trips Return in July — Tickets on Sale from May 17
en.body:
School holidays haven't even started yet, but families can already start planning their trip. From May 17, tickets will go on sale for the Holiday Train (Trem de Férias), a special service offering night journeys along the Vitória a Minas Railway throughout July.

The stops remain the same as those adopted at the start of operations in January, including the connection between Itabira and Nova Era during nighttime hours.
Departure times at the first stations will be maintained: trains leave at 6 PM from Pedro Nolasco Station in Cariacica (ES) and at 7 PM from the Belo Horizonte station (MG) between July 1 and 31. Along the route, stop times will be slightly adjusted due to railway operations.

"The Holiday Train operation is constantly being improved. Listening to passengers and drawing on the team's hands-on experience have allowed for important operational adjustments, raising the standard of safety and comfort. The stops have been maintained, with ongoing attention to operations throughout the route, reinforcing our commitment to the continuous improvement of passenger rail transport," said João Falcão.

The Holiday Train is part of the commitments made by Vale upon renewing its railway concession, in partnership with the National Land Transportation Agency (ANTT), expanding travel options during one of the busiest periods of the year (January, July, and December).

To ensure passenger safety, tickets will not be sold at stations during nighttime hours. Purchases can be made during regular ticket office hours or online, available 24 hours a day, at vale.com/tremdepassageiros.

The trains offer executive and economy classes, are equipped with a wheelchair lift, and include dedicated space for passengers with reduced mobility. Stations served during the night operation are fully prepared to receive passengers, with adequate infrastructure and enhanced lighting to ensure comfort and safety.

During the journey, passengers can purchase snacks and meals at the onboard snack bar. Ticket prices are the same as those charged for daytime trips, which continue to run year-round.

  • Ticket sales: From May 17 at ticket offices (check operating hours on the website) or online at vale.com/tremdepassageiros
  • Operating period: July 1–31
  • Ticket prices: R$ 87 (economy class) and R$ 125 (executive class) for the full route (Belo Horizonte/MG ↔ Cariacica/ES)
  • Passenger support line: 0800 285 7000

en.title: Vale Named 2nd Best Company for Career Development in Brazil by LinkedIn Top Companies 2026
en.subtitle: The annual ranking from the world's largest professional platform highlights Vale as the sole representative of the industrial sector among national leaders, recognizing real opportunities for growth and professional development.
en.body:
Vale has just climbed one more position in LinkedIn Top Companies 2026, securing 2nd place in the ranking that annually selects the best companies for career development in Brazil. The distinction, awarded by the world's largest professional network, reinforces the company's commitment to the growth of its employees and establishes mining as a reference sector for those seeking professional advancement opportunities with global impact.

What is LinkedIn Top Companies?
LinkedIn Top Companies is built from behavioral data of more than 1 billion professionals on the platform. The ranking evaluates criteria such as career growth, skill development, diversity, company influence, and stability — with no application process or payment required. It is a genuine recognition, based on how professionals interact with each organization.

Where there is a future, Vale is there
More than a badge, building a career at Vale means having access to projects with global impact, robust training programs, and an environment that values each individual journey. The company continuously invests in learning pathways, internal mobility, and leaders who believe in people development as a driver of the business.

Diversity and inclusion as pillars
The recognition also reflects progress in diversity, equity, and inclusion. Vale reinforces its commitment to being a place for everyone, ensuring that growth goes hand in hand with valuing each person's story — regardless of background, gender, or professional profile.

en.title: Vale achieves ISO 37001 certification and reinforces global commitment to integrity
en.subtitle: ISO 37001:2016 certification, granted following an independent audit, attests to the compliance of Vale's Anti-Bribery Management System across operations, administrative units, and corporate areas of Vale S.A. in Brazil.
en.body:
Vale has obtained ISO 37001:2016 certification — the international benchmark standard for bribery prevention — recognizing the compliance of its Ethics & Compliance Program and the robustness of its Anti-Bribery Management System.

The certification was granted following an independent audit conducted by QMS Certification, which attests that Vale's anti-bribery controls are in conformity with internationally recognized criteria. The achievement comes at a particularly significant milestone: in March 2026, Vale's Ethics & Compliance Program completed five years.

Comprehensive scope across operations
The certification scope covers operations, administrative units, and corporate areas of Vale S.A. in Brazil, including:

  • Contract and procurement management
  • Third-party relationships
  • Interactions with public authorities
  • Sponsorships, donations, and contributions
  • Communication and training
  • Governance, audit, and monitoring


What Vale's leaders have to say
"ISO 37001 materializes a collective and ongoing effort, which depends on the engagement of every person who is part of Vale. Ethics is a practice embedded in decisions, processes, and relationships."
Denis Cuenca — Audit and Compliance Director

"Bribery prevention goes beyond formal rules: it depends on culture, on a systemic and consistent approach, with a focus on behavior and governance."
Camilla Reis — Corporate Integrity Director

Learn more about Vale's ethics and transparency initiatives. Access the 2025 Annual Report of the Ethics & Compliance Program and discover the advances in prevention, detection, and correction of misconduct.

Access the 2025 Annual Report of the Ethics & Compliance Program

en.title: Employability Project Expands Job and Professional Training Opportunities in Brumadinho
en.subtitle: The Municipality of Brumadinho and Vale created an initiative focused on job creation and professional training
en.body:
Through an agreement established between the Public Prosecutor’s Office of Minas Gerais (MPMG), the Municipality of Brumadinho, and Vale, the Employability Project was created — an initiative focused on job creation, professional training, and strengthening the local labor market. In total, 600 openings will be offered through vocational training programs aimed at supporting both the entry and reentry of residents into the workforce, while also promoting the municipality’s economic diversification beyond the mining sector.

 

The project includes a set of strategic actions, such as assessing the local labor market, offering targeted professional training programs, improving job placement mechanisms, and encouraging the hiring of Brumadinho residents, thereby contributing to the sustainable development of the region.

“Signing this agreement on behalf of our company is highly significant. We are making a renewed effort to prepare people to work according to the specific demands of suppliers that will establish operations in Brumadinho,” says Gleuza Jesué, Director of Reparation and Territory Management for the South/Southeast region.

First Phase: 300 Professional Training Opportunities

In the project’s first phase, 300 openings will be offered in professional qualification programs. Of these, 150 positions will focus on roles with the highest demand in Reparation works and through Brumadinho’s public employment service (SINE). The remaining 150 openings will have their focus areas defined jointly with the Municipality of Brumadinho, considering the city’s specific workforce needs.

Employability Studies to Guide Future Phases

To ensure the initiative remains aligned with the territory’s real demands, the Employability Project includes an annual employability study over the next four years. The study will analyze local economic dynamics, identify growing occupations, map market trends, and highlight challenges faced by the population in accessing employment opportunities. The first study is scheduled for April 2026.

“We will conduct a socioeconomic assessment to map the availability of professionals and local potentialities. We will then cross-reference this data with the available job opportunities,” Gleuza highlights.

Based on the results of these studies, the training areas for the additional 300 openings planned for the project’s second phase will be defined. After course completion, participants’ integration into the labor market will also be monitored, reinforcing the commitment to delivering concrete and long-lasting results for Brumadinho.

id.subtitle: The Municipality of Brumadinho and Vale created an initiative focused on job creation and professional training
id.body:
Through an agreement established between the Public Prosecutor’s Office of Minas Gerais (MPMG), the Municipality of Brumadinho, and Vale, the Employability Project was created — an initiative focused on job creation, professional training, and strengthening the local labor market. In total, 600 openings will be offered through vocational training programs aimed at supporting both the entry and reentry of residents into the workforce, while also promoting the municipality’s economic diversification beyond the mining sector.

 

The project includes a set of strategic actions, such as assessing the local labor market, offering targeted professional training programs, improving job placement mechanisms, and encouraging the hiring of Brumadinho residents, thereby contributing to the sustainable development of the region.

“Signing this agreement on behalf of our company is highly significant. We are making a renewed effort to prepare people to work according to the specific demands of suppliers that will establish operations in Brumadinho,” says Gleuza Jesué, Director of Reparation and Territory Management for the South/Southeast region.

First Phase: 300 Professional Training Opportunities

In the project’s first phase, 300 openings will be offered in professional qualification programs. Of these, 150 positions will focus on roles with the highest demand in Reparation works and through Brumadinho’s public employment service (SINE). The remaining 150 openings will have their focus areas defined jointly with the Municipality of Brumadinho, considering the city’s specific workforce needs.

Employability Studies to Guide Future Phases

To ensure the initiative remains aligned with the territory’s real demands, the Employability Project includes an annual employability study over the next four years. The study will analyze local economic dynamics, identify growing occupations, map market trends, and highlight challenges faced by the population in accessing employment opportunities. The first study is scheduled for April 2026.

“We will conduct a socioeconomic assessment to map the availability of professionals and local potentialities. We will then cross-reference this data with the available job opportunities,” Gleuza highlights.

Based on the results of these studies, the training areas for the additional 300 openings planned for the project’s second phase will be defined. After course completion, participants’ integration into the labor market will also be monitored, reinforcing the commitment to delivering concrete and long-lasting results for Brumadinho.

en.title: East Luwu Steps Up Anti-Drug Efforts with PT Vale–BNN School Initiative
en.subtitle: The Drug-Free School initiative (Sekolah Bersinar) was introduced by PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) in response to drug abuse concerns shared by local authorities. In collaboration with the South Sulawesi BNN and the Youth Planning Forum (GenRe), the program aims to strengthen awareness among adolescents while building resilience within schools and communities against drug-related threats.
en.body:
Pengedaran dan penyalahgunaan narkoba masih menjadi ancaman serius di Sulawesi Selatan (Sulsel). Data Badan Narkotika Nasional (BNN) 2023-2025 menunjukkan, Sulsel menepati posisi keempat sebagai provinsi dengan tingkat penyalahgunaan dan kasus narkoba tertinggi di Indonesia. Demikian menjadi perhatian Bupati Luwu Timur (Lutim), Irwan Bachri Syam melihat wilayah ini sangat strategis sebagai kawasan industri dan jalur perlintasan yang cukup terbuka.

“Di Lutim, saya bisa bilang dengan garis merah karena area perlintasan, dan industri. Cukup ‘seksi’ untuk aliran pengedaran narkobanya,” ungkap Bachri Syam saat memberikan sambutan di acara Deklarasi Sekolah Bersinar: Bersih dari Narkoba, Kamis (7/5/2/2026).

Sekolah Bersinar adalah program yang diinisiasi oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) untuk menjawab keresahan sama yang dirasakan oleh Bachri Syam. Menggaet BNN Provinsi Sulsel, dan Forum Generasi Berencana (GenRe), program ini bertujuan memberikan edukasi yang kuat kepada remaja sekaligus membangun ketahanan lingkungan sekolah dan masyarakat terhadap ancaman narkoba.

Sebanyak 37 Sekolah Menengah Atas (SMA) se-Luwu Timur terlibat dalam realisasi program ini. Selain memberikan apresiasi kepada sekolah-sekolah yang giat menyuarakan anti narkoba, terdapat pula pemilihan Duta Pelajar Anti Narkoba Tingkat SMA se-Lutim untuk kategori putra dan putri.

Deklarasi yang berlangsung di Aula Dinas Pendidikan Lutim ini, menjadi tonggak awal gerakan bersama lintas sektor dalam menciptakan lingkungan pendidikan yang sehat, aman, dan bebas narkoba. Isi deklarasi anti narkoba pun dibacakan oleh para siswa yang kemudian ditandatangani oleh sejumlah pihak, yaitu PT Vale, Kepala BNN Sulsel, Bupati Lutim, dan sekolah-sekolah di Lutim.

Kepala BNN Sulsel, Agung Prabowo menegaskan dalam sambutannya bahwa deklarasi ini menjadi langkah penting dalam memperkuat gerakan pencegahan berbasis pelajar.

Ia menekankan bahwa narkoba kini hadir dalam berbagai bentuk, termasuk jenis baru seperti zat berbahaya yang disalahgunakan melalui media seperti vape. Oleh karena itu, upaya pencegahan harus semakin adaptif dan menyasar kelompok usia rentan, khususnya 15 hingga 64 tahun.

“Ini adalah tantangan besar. Jika tidak kita hadapi bersama, maka akan merusak generasi penerus bangsa. Sekolah Bersinar membutuhkan penggiat, dan penggiat itu adalah para siswa sendiri,” ujarnya.

Melalui program ini, siswa didorong menjadi agen perubahan sekaligus pelopor gerakan hidup sehat tanpa narkoba. Selain itu, integrasi edukasi anti narkoba melalui program seperti Ananda (Aksi Nasional Anti Narkoba Dimulai dari Anak) dan IKAN (Integrasi Kurikulum Anti Narkoba) diharapkan mampu memperkuat karakter pelajar sejak dini. BNN juga menegaskan bahwa pendekatan penanganan kini tidak hanya berfokus pada penindakan, tetapi juga pemulihan dan pencegahan melalui edukasi serta pendampingan.

Dari sisi pemerintah daerah, Bachri Syam menyebut Lutim telah membentuk berbagai langkah strategis, termasuk pembentukan satuan tugas anti narkoba dan penerbitan kebijakan terpadu pencegahan dan pemberantasan penyalahgunaan serta peredaran gelap narkoba (P4GN). Ia berharap ke depan Lutim dapat memiliki BNN Kabupaten sendiri guna memperkuat koordinasi dan efektivitas program.

“Sekolah Bersinar ini adalah awal. Yang terpenting adalah implementasinya. Kami meminta seluruh pihak, terutama guru dan sekolah, untuk terlibat aktif dalam satgas. Lingkungan sekolah harus benar-benar bersih dari indikasi penyalahgunaan narkoba,” tegasnya. Ia juga mengingatkan para pelajar untuk tidak ragu melaporkan jika menemukan indikasi penyalahgunaan di lingkungan sekitar.

Sekolah Bersinar telah terlaksana sejak tahun lalu, dimulai dari menyeleksi para peserta duta pelajar dan penilaian sejumlah sekolah di Lutim. Dari sekitar 100 peserta yang mengikuti proses seleksi, maka di acara deklarasi ini pula diumumkan Putu Adyana dari SMAN 6 Lutim sebagai Duta Pelajar Anti Narkoba kategori putra, dan Kahirunnisa Mukhtar dari SMAN 1 Lutim untuk kategori putri. Selain itu, terpilih juga tiga kategori lain yaitu best influencer, best personality, dan best advocacy.

Para Duta Pelajar Anti Narkoba terpilih menyampaikan rasa bangga dan komitmen mereka untuk menjalankan program edukasi di sekolah. Mereka merancang berbagai inisiatif kreatif, mulai dari kampanye digital, sosialisasi interaktif, hingga festival edukasi untuk memperluas jangkauan pesan anti narkoba di kalangan generasi muda.

Adapun untuk sekolah-sekolah yang mendapat apreasi sebagai sekolah bersinar, di antaranya SMAN 1 Lutim, SMAN 3 Lutim, SMAN 6 Lutim, SMAN 10 Lutim, dan SMA YPS Sorowako.

“Gerakan ini tidak hanya berhenti di deklarasi dan pemilihan duta. Ini baru awal perjalanan Sekolah Bersinar. Hingga saat ini, tercatat 37 sekolah di Luwu Timur telah membentuk satgas anti narkoba sebagai bagian dari gerakan ini. Ke depan, Perusahaan akan menyasar tingkat SMP,” kata Senior Coordinator PPM Health PT Vale, Baso Haris.

Ia menambahkan bahwa program ini merupakan bagian dari upaya perusahaan dalam menciptakan generasi emas yang sehat secara fisik dan mental. Perusahaan berkomitmen mewujudkan anak-anak tumbuh dalam lingkungan yang berkomitmen terhadap pencegahan narkoba, baik di sekolah, keluarga, maupun masyarakat.

Dengan semangat “Gerak Bersama Bersih dari Narkoba untuk Luwu Timur Juara”, deklarasi ini diharapkan menjadi titik awal penguatan kolaborasi antara pemerintah, dunia usaha, sekolah, dan masyarakat. Lebih dari sekadar seremoni, Sekolah Bersinar diharapkan menjadi budaya yang tumbuh di lingkungan pendidikan, menciptakan generasi muda yang sehat, berkarakter, dan bebas dari narkoba menuju Indonesia Bersinar.

Komitmen ini juga sejalan dengan program Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM) PT Vale yang mencakup sektor pendidikan, kesehatan, ekonomi, dan sosial. Melalui pendekatan kolaboratif, perusahaan terus mendorong terciptanya lingkungan yang mendukung gaya hidup sehat sekaligus membangun ketahanan generasi muda terhadap berbagai risiko sosial.

Hingga Triwulan I 2026, sejumlah investasi sosial telah digelontorkan untuk mendukung berbagai program sektor strategis seperti pendidikan, kesehatan, ekonomi, lingkungan, serta sosial budaya.

Di sektor pendidikan, perusahaan menjalankan beragam program seperti penyediaan transportasi sekolah, pemberian beasiswa jenjang S2 dan S3, serta penguatan pendidikan usia dini. Sementara di bidang kesehatan, PT Vale aktif mendukung layanan kesehatan masyarakat, pencegahan stunting, serta kampanye hidup sehat berbasis promotif dan preventif, termasuk melalui implementasi Sekolah Bersinar sebagai bagian dari edukasi pola hidup sehat sejak usia dini.

Selain itu, perusahaan juga mendorong pemberdayaan ekonomi masyarakat melalui pengembangan UMKM, agribisnis, serta program kemandirian desa, sekaligus memperkuat aspek sosial budaya dan lingkungan. Hingga kini, sekitar 80 persen karyawan PT Vale berasal dari talenta lokal Luwu Timur, menunjukkan komitmen perusahaan dalam mendorong kemandirian dan kesejahteraan masyarakat setempat.

Melalui integrasi program Sekolah Bersinar dalam kerangka besar PPM, PT Vale menegaskan bahwa pembangunan berkelanjutan tidak hanya bertumpu pada aspek ekonomi, tetapi juga investasi sosial jangka panjang untuk menciptakan generasi muda yang sehat, tangguh, dan bebas dari narkoba.

en.title: Public Hearing – Baixo João Pereira Dam
en.subtitle: Vale holds public hearing in Congonhas, Minas Gerais on May 7 to present the reconformation project for the Baixo João Pereira dam at the Fábrica mine, Paraopeba Complex.
en.body:
Vale will hold a public hearing at 7 PM on May 7 in Congonhas to present the reconformation project for the Baixo João Pereira dam, located at the Fábrica mine, within the Paraopeba Complex. The meeting will take place at the Escola Municipal Senhor Odorico Martinho da Silva school, in the Pires neighborhood, and the company will offer free transportation to the community.

The public hearing is an open space for listening and social participation. During the event, project details and environmental studies will be presented, along with clarification of questions and recording of suggestions and statements from participants. The event is part of the formal steps of the environmental licensing process, currently under review by the state environmental authority.

The Baixo João Pereira dam underwent a readjustment process to comply with the National Dam Safety Policy. Previously built using the upstream method — now prohibited by law — the structure was reconformed in 2024 to the single-stage method, which offers greater stability and safety. The dam retained its sediment containment function, essential for the environmental protection of the region.

"This structure retains sediments from the operation and prevents material from being carried into nature. The readjustment, with new engineering and without the risks associated with the old model, contributes to the responsible continuation of Fábrica mine's activities and reinforces our commitment to the safety and sustainability of our operation in Congonhas," says Eder Leite, director of Vale's Paraopeba Complex.

Following the change in the structure's construction method, the area was revegetated and integrated into the landscape. The current dam is in compliance with environmental and safety legislation, with more efficient sediment control mechanisms, ensuring greater environmental protection.

Last year, Vale's operations in Minas Gerais generated approximately BRL 3.5 billion in taxes and levies, including CFEM, ICMS, TRFM, and ISS. In Congonhas, the Fábrica mine operation collected more than BRL 33.4 million in Financial Compensation for Mineral Resource Exploitation (CFEM) and approximately BRL 16.5 million in Service Tax (ISS) for the municipality in 2025.

Event Details
Public Hearing – Baixo João Pereira Dam Readjustment Project
Date: May 7 (Thursday)
Time: 7:00 PM
Venue: Escola Municipal Senhor Odorico Martinho da Silva – Rua Anastácio Dantas, 37 – Pires neighborhood, Congonhas
More information: vale.com/audienciabaixojoaopereira
Public contact: Alô Vale – 0800 285 7000

en.title: From Crisis to Relief: PT Vale Responds Swiftly to Severe Windstorms and Flooding Impact in Pomalaa
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, has reaffirmed its commitment to local communities by swiftly delivering assistance to residents affected by a recent windstorm and flooding in Pomalaa District, Kolaka Regency.
en.body:
Pomalaa, May 5, 2026 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, has reaffirmed its commitment to local communities by swiftly delivering assistance to residents affected by a recent windstorm and flooding in Pomalaa District, Kolaka Regency.

On Sunday, May 3, 2026, PT Vale provided direct support to six households impacted by the tornado in Huko-Huko Village. Each family received essential relief packages valued at approximately IDR 1.6 million (around USD 100), comprising 50 kilograms of rice, eggs, tea, cooking oil, and five sarongs. In addition, the Company has allocated building materials assistance worth IDR 5 million (around USD 300) per household, which is currently in the procurement process.

The distribution of aid was witnessed by Huko-Huko Village Head, Sahabuddin, who expressed his appreciation for PT Vale’s prompt response and continued support for the affected community.

“We sincerely appreciate the assistance extended by PT Vale. Their swift response has been invaluable for our residents during this challenging time,” said Sahabuddin.

 

PT Vale’s rapid response also extended to a separate incident when flooding struck Pesouha Village on the evening of Monday, May 4, 2026. Through its Emergency Response team, the Company deployed fire trucks to assist residents in clearing mud from homes, yards, and drainage systems.

Iswan, a resident of Pesouha Village, commended the Company’s immediate action, noting its tangible impact in helping the community navigate the emergency.

“PT Vale responded quickly to support residents affected by the disaster. We truly felt the benefits of their presence,” said Iswan, who also serves as Chairman of the Tamalaki Nibandera community organization.

Adam Chalid, Senior Coordinator for Stakeholder Relations at PT Vale Pomalaa, emphasized that the rapid response reflects the Company’s ongoing commitment to supporting communities, particularly in times of emergency.

“At PT Vale, we remain committed to responding swiftly to the needs of communities around our operational areas. Our engagement extends beyond long-term development initiatives—we also ensure timely support during emergencies as part of our social responsibility and care,” he stated.

This emergency response underscores PT Vale IGP Pomalaa’s continued dedication to supporting surrounding communities, not only through sustainable, long-term development programs, but also through prompt and effective action in times of crisis.

id.title: PT Vale IGP Pomalaa Gercep Bantu Korban Puting Beliung dan Banjir di Pomalaa
id.subtitle: Kepedulian terhadap masyarakat kembali ditunjukkan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI) melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa. Perusahaan bergerak cepat menyalurkan bantuan kepada warga terdampak bencana angin puting beliung dan banjir yang terjadi di wilayah Kecamatan Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka.
id.body:
Pomalaa, 5 Mei 2026 , Kepedulian terhadap masyarakat kembali ditunjukkan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI) melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa. Perusahaan bergerak cepat menyalurkan bantuan kepada warga terdampak bencana angin puting beliung dan banjir yang terjadi di wilayah Kecamatan Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka.

Pada Minggu, 3 Mei 2026, PTVI hadir langsung memberikan bantuan kepada enam kepala keluarga korban angin puting beliung di Desa Huko-Huko. Bantuan yang disalurkan berupa paket sembako senilai Rp1,6 juta per keluarga, terdiri dari beras 50 kilogram, telur, teh, minyak goreng, serta sarung sebanyak lima lembar. Selain itu, perusahaan juga menyiapkan bantuan material bangunan senilai Rp5 juta per rumah yang saat ini sedang dalam proses pengadaan.
Penyaluran bantuan tersebut turut disaksikan oleh Kepala Desa Huko-Huko, Sahabuddin. Ia menyampaikan apresiasi dan terima kasih atas kepedulian serta respons cepat PTVI dalam membantu warganya yang terdampak bencana.

“Kami sangat berterima kasih atas perhatian dan bantuan dari PTVI. Kehadiran mereka sangat berarti bagi warga kami yang sedang mengalami musibah,” ujar Sahabuddin.

Tak hanya itu, respons cepat juga ditunjukkan Perusahaan saat banjir melanda Desa Pesouha pada Senin malam, 4 Mei 2026. Melalui tim Emergency Response, perusahaan langsung menurunkan armada mobil pemadam untuk membantu warga membersihkan lumpur yang menggenangi rumah, pekarangan, hingga gorong-gorong.

Salah seorang warga Desa Pesouha, Iswan, mengapresiasi langkah cepat tersebut. Ia menyebut kehadiran PTVI sangat membantu masyarakat di tengah situasi darurat.

“PTVI sangat cepat membantu warga yang tertimpa musibah. Kami benar-benar merasakan manfaatnya,” ungkap Iswan, yang juga merupakan Ketua Ormas Tamalaki Nibandera.

Sementara itu, Senior Coordinator Stakeholder Relation Pomalaa PTVI, Adam Chalid, menegaskan bahwa langkah cepat ini merupakan bagian dari komitmen perusahaan untuk selalu hadir di tengah masyarakat, terutama dalam situasi darurat.

“Kami di PTVI berkomitmen untuk selalu responsif terhadap kondisi yang dihadapi masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasi. Kehadiran kami bukan hanya dalam program pengembangan, tetapi juga memastikan masyarakat mendapatkan dukungan cepat saat terjadi bencana. Ini adalah bagian dari tanggung jawab sosial dan kepedulian kami,” jelasnya.

Aksi tanggap darurat ini menjadi bukti nyata komitmen PTVI IGP Pomalaa dalam mendukung masyarakat sekitar, tidak hanya melalui program pengembangan jangka panjang, tetapi juga melalui respons cepat saat terjadi bencana.

en.title: PT Vale Indonesia Strengthens Performance and Lays a Solid Foundation for Sustainable Growth in 2025
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk delivered solid operational and financial performance throughout 2025 amid continued pressure in the global nickel market and evolving domestic regulatory dynamics. Through strengthened operational discipline, robust corporate governance, and a firm commitment to sustainability, the Company successfully reinforced its long‑term growth foundation. Read our 2025 Annual Report.
en.body:
Jakarta, April 30, 2026 – PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”) delivered solid operational and financial performance throughout 2025 amid continued pressure in the global nickel market and evolving domestic regulatory dynamics. Through strengthened operational discipline, robust corporate governance, and a firm commitment to sustainability, the Company successfully reinforced its long‑term growth foundation.


 

During 2025, PT Vale recorded nickel in matte production of 72,027 tonnes, an increase compared with the previous year. From a financial perspective, the Company reported revenue of US$990.2 million, representing a 4% year‑on‑year increase, while net profit rose 32% to US$76.1 million compared with 2024. These results were underpinned by disciplined cost control, optimized sales volumes, and revenue diversification through saprolite nickel ore sales from the Bahodopi and Pomalaa blocks. EBITDA for 2025 stood at US$228.2 million.

To support its growth strategy, PT Vale continued to make significant progress across the strategic projects under the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP). The Bahodopi mine entered its operational phase in 2025, opening a new revenue stream and enhancing the Company’s commercial flexibility. Meanwhile, the Pomalaa IGP and Sorowako Limonite (Sorlim) IGP projects recorded construction progress of approximately 50% and 37%, respectively, while the Morowali IGP approached completion of its initial construction phase. All IGP projects are designed to support downstream nickel processing through High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) technology, positioning the Company within the nickel supply chain for the energy transition and electric vehicle ecosystem.

In the area of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, PT Vale continued to strengthen its position as a sustainable mining company. The Company targets a 33% reduction in Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 2030, using 2017 as the baseline year. Throughout 2025, PT Vale completed land reclamation covering 158.09 hectares, replanted 72,296 trees, and continued biodiversity conservation programs. These efforts were reflected in an improvement in the Company’s Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating to 23.7, positioning PT Vale as the mining company with the lowest ESG risk in Indonesia.

From a governance perspective, the Company achieved a score of 99.53 in the 2025 ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS), demonstrating consistent application of transparency, accountability, and effective risk management principles. The handling of an oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti, South Sulawesi, in 2025 also served as an important lesson in strengthening emergency response systems, information transparency, and collaboration with communities and stakeholders.

Entering 2026, PT Vale is better positioned with a stronger operational foundation, a growing portfolio of growth projects, and a focused diversification strategy aimed at delivering long‑term value for shareholders and all stakeholders.

About PT Vale Indonesia Tbk
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk is one of Indonesia’s leading nickel mining companies, committed to responsible, sustainable mining practices and long‑term value creation. The Company focuses on occupational safety, environmental protection, community development, and strong corporate governance to support the global energy transition.

id.title: PT Vale Indonesia Perkuat Kinerja dan Fondasi Pertumbuhan Berkelanjutan di 2025
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk mencatatkan kinerja operasional dan keuangan yang solid sepanjang tahun 2025 di tengah tantangan pasar nikel global yang masih tertekan serta dinamika regulasi nasional. Melalui penguatan disiplin operasional, tata kelola yang solid, dan komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan, Perseroan berhasil memperkokoh fondasi pertumbuhan jangka panjang. Baca Laporan Tahunan 2025 kami.
id.body:
Jakarta, 29 April 2026 – PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perseroan”) mencatatkan kinerja operasional dan keuangan yang solid sepanjang tahun 2025 di tengah tantangan pasar nikel global yang masih tertekan serta dinamika regulasi nasional. Melalui penguatan disiplin operasional, tata kelola yang solid, dan komitmen terhadap keberlanjutan, Perseroan berhasil memperkokoh fondasi pertumbuhan jangka panjang.


 

Sepanjang 2025, PT Vale mencatatkan produksi nikel dalam matte sebesar 72.027 ton, meningkat dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Dari sisi keuangan, Perseroan membukukan pendapatan sebesar US$990,2 juta, tumbuh 4% secara tahunan, serta laba bersih sebesar US$76,1 juta, meningkat 32% dibandingkan 2024. Capaian ini didukung oleh pengendalian biaya yang disiplin, optimalisasi volume penjualan, serta diversifikasi sumber pendapatan melalui penjualan bijih nikel saprolit dari Blok Bahodopi dan Pomalaa. EBITDA Perseroan pada 2025 tercatat sebesar US$228,2 juta.

Dalam mendukung strategi pertumbuhan, PT Vale terus mencatat kemajuan signifikan pada proyek-proyek strategis Indonesia Growth Project (IGP). Tambang Bahodopi mulai memasuki fase operasional pada 2025, membuka sumber pendapatan baru dan meningkatkan fleksibilitas komersial. Sementara itu, IGP Pomalaa dan IGP Sorowako Limonite (Sorlim) masing-masing mencatatkan progres konstruksi sekitar 50% dan 37%, serta IGP Morowali mendekati penyelesaian fase awal konstruksi. Seluruh proyek IGP dirancang untuk mendukung hilirisasi nikel melalui teknologi High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) sebagai bagian dari rantai pasok nikel untuk transisi energi dan kendaraan listrik.

Di bidang lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (ESG), PT Vale terus memperkuat posisinya sebagai pelaku pertambangan berkelanjutan. Perseroan menargetkan penurunan emisi gas rumah kaca Lingkup 1 dan 2 sebesar 33% pada 2030 dengan baseline 2017. Selama 2025, PT Vale berhasil melakukan reklamasi lahan seluas 158,09 hektare, menanam kembali 72.296 pohon, serta melanjutkan program konservasi keanekaragaman hayati. Upaya tersebut tercermin dari peningkatan Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating ke skor 23,7, menjadikan PT Vale sebagai perusahaan pertambangan dengan risiko ESG terendah di Indonesia.

Pada aspek tata kelola, Perseroan meraih skor 99,53 dalam ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) 2025, mencerminkan konsistensi penerapan prinsip transparansi, akuntabilitas, dan manajemen risiko. Penanganan insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Towuti, Sulawesi Selatan, pada 2025 juga menjadi pembelajaran penting dalam memperkuat sistem respons darurat, keterbukaan informasi, serta kolaborasi dengan masyarakat dan pemangku kepentingan.

Memasuki 2026, PT Vale berada pada posisi yang lebih siap dengan fondasi operasional yang semakin kuat, portofolio proyek pertumbuhan yang berkembang, serta strategi diversifikasi yang terarah untuk menciptakan nilai jangka panjang bagi pemegang saham dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

Tentang PT Vale Indonesia Tbk
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk merupakan salah satu perusahaan pertambangan nikel terkemuka di Indonesia yang berkomitmen menjalankan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, berkelanjutan, dan berorientasi pada penciptaan nilai jangka panjang. Perseroan berfokus pada keselamatan kerja, perlindungan lingkungan, pengembangan masyarakat, serta penerapan tata kelola perusahaan yang baik dalam mendukung transisi energi global.

en.title: Navigating Challenges, Delivering Impact: PT Vale’s ESG Journey Strengthens in 2025
en.subtitle: 2025 marked a pivotal year for PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“the Company”) as it navigated the complexities of the mining industry while reinforcing sustainability as the foundation of its long-term business strategy. Amid rising global expectations for responsible mining practices, the Company successfully transformed challenges into measurable progress by embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles not as a standalone agenda, but as a core driver of long-term value creation.
en.body:
Jakarta, 30 April 2026 – 2025 marked a pivotal year for PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“the Company”) as it navigated the complexities of the mining industry while reinforcing sustainability as the foundation of its long-term business strategy. Amid rising global expectations for responsible mining practices, the Company successfully transformed challenges into measurable progress by embedding Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles not as a standalone agenda, but as a core driver of long-term value creation.

This commitment is clearly reflected in the Company’s 2025 Sustainability Report and 2025 Annual Report, which have been officially submitted to the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK). Far more than mere performance reporting, these publications underscore PT Vale’s ongoing transformation toward more resilient, efficient, and sustainable operations.


 

Throughout 2025, PT Vale increased its environmental investment by 54.3% to US$43.79 million, reflecting an accelerated push toward decarbonization and operational efficiency. These efforts delivered tangible results, including improved energy performance marked by a reduction in energy intensity, further strengthening the Company’s pathway toward low-carbon operations.

The Company’s environmental commitment was demonstrated through its landscape-based rehabilitation initiatives. In 2025, PT Vale rehabilitated 156.67 hectares of post-mining land in Sorowako and extended its positive impact beyond operational areas by restoring 2,988 hectares of watershed areas across five provinces. This approach highlights a strategic focus that goes beyond mine-site restoration to strengthen broader ecosystem resilience—affirming that environmental stewardship is an integral part of PT Vale’s long-term value creation.

On the social front, PT Vale advanced its inclusive growth agenda through community development investments totaling US$4.73 million, an increase of 18.3% from the previous year. These programs focused on education, local economic empowerment, and basic infrastructure development. The Company also maintained a strong commitment to local inclusion, with 83.3% of its workforce recruited from surrounding communities and female representation across the organization rising to 12.1%.

Governance performance also continued to strengthen. PT Vale’s ESG Risk Rating from Sustainalytics improved to 23.7, reflecting a 19.4% reduction in risk exposure and positioning the Company among globally competitive mining players in ESG performance. This achievement is further reinforced by an ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) score of 99.53, which reflects best-in-class transparency and accountability practices at the regional level.

President Director and CEO of PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, said: “2025 was a defining year for us—not only in confronting challenges, but also in strengthening sustainability as a key business driver. At PT Vale, ESG is embedded in every decision we make, shaping how we operate, create value, and contribute to Indonesia’s future. We firmly believe that long-term success can only be achieved when growth and sustainability go hand in hand.”

Looking ahead, PT Vale will continue to deepen ESG integration across its strategic growth projects in Sorowako, Pomalaa, and Morowali. These initiatives are expected to further enhance the Company’s contribution to Indonesia’s downstreaming agenda while supporting the global energy transition.

With an increasingly solid foundation, PT Vale remains committed to delivering responsible mining practices and creating sustainable long-term value for Indonesia and the world.

id.title: Menavigasi Tantangan, Menghadirkan Dampak: Perjalanan ESG PT Vale Menguat pada 2025
id.subtitle: Tahun 2025 menjadi babak penting bagi PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“Perseroan”) dalam menghadapi kompleksitas industri sekaligus memperkuat keberlanjutan sebagai fondasi strategi bisnis jangka panjang. Di tengah meningkatnya ekspektasi global terhadap praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, Perseroan berhasil mengubah tantangan menjadi kemajuan terukur dengan menempatkan aspek Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (ESG) bukan sebagai agenda terpisah, melainkan sebagai pendorong utama penciptaan nilai jangka panjang.
id.body:
Jakarta, 30 April 2026 – Tahun 2025 menjadi babak penting bagi PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“Perseroan”) dalam menghadapi kompleksitas industri sekaligus memperkuat keberlanjutan sebagai fondasi strategi bisnis jangka panjang. Di tengah meningkatnya ekspektasi global terhadap praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, Perseroan berhasil mengubah tantangan menjadi kemajuan terukur dengan menempatkan aspek Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (ESG) bukan sebagai agenda terpisah, melainkan sebagai pendorong utama penciptaan nilai jangka panjang.

Komitmen ini tercermin dalam Laporan Keberlanjutan 2025 dan Laporan Tahunan 2025 Perseroan yang telah disampaikan secara resmi melalui Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK). Lebih dari sekadar pelaporan kinerja, kedua publikasi ini menegaskan transformasi berkelanjutan Perseroan menuju operasi yang lebih tangguh, efisien, dan berkelanjutan.


Sepanjang 2025, PT Vale meningkatkan investasi lingkungan sebesar 54,3% menjadi US$43,79 juta, mencerminkan percepatan agenda dekarbonisasi dan inisiatif efisiensi operasional. Upaya ini menghasilkan capaian nyata, termasuk peningkatan kinerja energi yang ditandai dengan penurunan intensitas energi, sehingga memperkuat jalur transisi Perseroan menuju operasi rendah karbon.

Komitmen lingkungan Perseroan diwujudkan melalui upaya rehabilitasi berbasis lanskap. Pada 2025, PT Vale merehabilitasi 156,67 hektare lahan pascatambang di Sorowako, serta memperluas dampaknya melampaui wilayah operasional melalui program pemulihan daerah aliran sungai seluas 2.988 hektare di lima provinsi. Upaya ini mencerminkan pendekatan strategis yang tidak hanya berfokus pada pemulihan area tambang, tetapi juga memperkuat ketahanan ekosistem secara lebih luas—menegaskan bahwa pengelolaan lingkungan merupakan bagian integral dari penciptaan nilai jangka panjang Perseroan.

Di bidang sosial, PT Vale memperkuat agenda pertumbuhan inklusif melalui investasi pengembangan masyarakat sebesar US$4,73 juta, meningkat 18,3% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Program-program ini berfokus pada pendidikan, pemberdayaan ekonomi lokal, serta pembangunan infrastruktur dasar. Perseroan juga mempertahankan komitmen kuat terhadap inklusi lokal, dengan 83,3% tenaga kerja berasal dari masyarakat setempat, serta peningkatan representasi perempuan menjadi 12,1% di seluruh organisasi.

Kinerja tata kelola juga terus menunjukkan penguatan. Peringkat Risiko ESG Perseroan dari Sustainalytics membaik menjadi 23,7, mencerminkan penurunan eksposur risiko sebesar 19,4% dan menempatkan PT Vale di antara perusahaan pertambangan dengan kinerja ESG yang kompetitif secara global. Pencapaian ini semakin diperkuat dengan skor ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) sebesar 99,53, yang mencerminkan praktik transparansi dan akuntabilitas terbaik di tingkat regional.

Presiden Direktur dan CEO PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, menyampaikan: “Tahun 2025 merupakan tahun yang menentukan bagi kami, tidak hanya dalam menghadapi tantangan, tetapi juga dalam memperkuat peran keberlanjutan sebagai penggerak bisnis. Di PT Vale, ESG tertanam dalam setiap keputusan yang kami ambil, membentuk cara kami beroperasi, menciptakan nilai, dan berkontribusi bagi masa depan Indonesia. Kami meyakini bahwa keberhasilan jangka panjang hanya dapat dicapai ketika pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan berjalan beriringan.”

Ke depan, PT Vale akan terus memperdalam integrasi ESG dalam berbagai proyek pertumbuhan strategis di Sorowako, Pomalaa, dan Morowali. Inisiatif ini diharapkan semakin memperkuat kontribusi Perseroan terhadap agenda hilirisasi Indonesia sekaligus mendukung transisi energi global.

Dengan fondasi yang semakin kokoh, PT Vale tetap berkomitmen untuk menghadirkan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab serta menciptakan nilai berkelanjutan jangka panjang bagi Indonesia dan dunia.

en.title: New siren testing schedule in Nova Lima defined by Civil Defense and Vale
en.subtitle: Civil Defense and Vale announce unified 2026 siren testing schedule in Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, with bi-monthly drills near mining dams.
en.body:
The Civil Defense of Nova Lima, in partnership with Vale, has announced a new unified schedule for safety siren tests in the municipality of Nova Lima. The measure is part of the preventive actions of the Emergency Action Plan for Mining Dams (PAEBM) and aims to strengthen community preparedness in case of potential emergencies.

📅 2026 Testing Schedule

The tests will be carried out every two months, always in odd-numbered months, at 10 a.m. Check the confirmed dates:

•    May 6 (Wednesday) 
•    July 8 (Wednesday) 
•    September 2 (Wednesday) 
•    November 11 (Wednesday) 

🔊 How the tests work
During the tests, a specific sound will be emitted, different from the signal used in real emergency situations. This distinction allows residents to recognize that it is only a drill, preventing panic or confusion.

📞 Contact channels
In case of questions or for more information, residents can contact:
•    Civil Defense of Nova Lima: +55 (31) 3180-5879 / +55 (31) 98699-1190 
•    Alô Vale: 0800-285-7000 
More information about the PAEBM is available on the official website: www.vale.com/paebm

🛑 Dam safety
According to Vale, there has been no change in the safety conditions of the structures. The dams continue to be monitored 24 hours a day and regularly inspected to ensure stability and the safety of surrounding communities.
