en.title: Strengthening Its Sustainable Finance Strategy, PT Vale Secures US$750 Million ESG-Linked Syndicated Loan Facility
en.subtitle: Amid growing global demand for critical minerals to support the energy transition, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”) has reaffirmed its strategic commitment to integrating sustainability into its financing strategy through the successful securing of a US$750 million Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) facility, with an additional US$250 million greenshoe option.
en.body:
Jakarta, 23 April 2026 — Amid growing global demand for critical minerals to support the energy transition, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”) has reaffirmed its strategic commitment to integrating sustainability into its financing strategy through the successful securing of a US$750 million Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) facility, with an additional US$250 million greenshoe option.

This syndicated loan facility marks PT Vale’s inaugural entry into the syndicated loan market and represents a significant milestone in strengthening the Company’s financial resilience, supporting the development of strategic projects, and advancing responsible mining practices in line with evolving global market expectations. The facility was supported by a syndicate of 14 international banks and was 1.7 times oversubscribed, reflecting strong market confidence in PT Vale’s business fundamentals and sustainability-driven strategy.

As global investment in electrification and renewable energy accelerates, demand for nickel—an essential component in electric vehicle (EV) batteries and energy storage systems—continues to rise. According to projections by the International Energy Agency, global battery storage capacity is expected to increase fourteenfold to meet 2030 climate targets, while EV battery demand is projected to grow sevenfold over the same period.

In this context, PT Vale is strategically positioned as a relatively low-carbon nickel producer, supported by its integrated operations powered by three hydropower plants. The Company is also undertaking enhancements to the capacity and reliability of its hydropower infrastructure to progressively support greater electrification across its operations.


 

The SLL facility has been structured in accordance with the Company’s Sustainability-Linked Financing Framework, aligned with international best practices in sustainable finance. The facility incorporates two key performance indicators (KPIs): a measurable reduction in carbon emissions intensity and an increase in renewable energy consumption.

Both KPIs have received a “strong” rating from an independent Second Party Opinion provider, reflecting their alignment with the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C pathway, as referenced in independent assessments, as well as their contribution to Indonesia’s Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) targets. The assessment also confirms that the targets represent a meaningful improvement beyond business-as-usual performance.

This sustainability-linked syndicated loan represents a significant milestone for PT Vale and marks its formal entry into the syndicated loan market. The transaction aligns with the Company’s robust growth trajectory, underpinned by disciplined and strategically managed project expansion across Indonesia. President Director and Chief Executive Officer of PT Vale, Bernardus Irmanto, stated: “This facility marks an important step in our journey to align our financing strategy with our decarbonisation agenda and long-term growth ambitions. We remain committed to delivering high-quality nickel with a lower carbon footprint, while supporting Indonesia’s downstreaming agenda and contributing meaningfully to the global energy transition.”

In terms of proceeds utilisation, the facility will support the development of the Company’s strategic projects. In 2026, approximately 50% of the funds will be allocated to the IGP Pomalaa project, around 30% to the IGP Morowali project, and approximately 20% to the IGP Sorowako Limonite project. In 2027, the facility will continue to support the advancement of these projects, as well as the Company’s participation rights in joint venture developments.

As part of its commitment to creating shared value, PT Vale will also channel financial benefits arising from sustainability-linked margin adjustments into community development programmes. This approach ensures that the benefits of achieving ESG targets extend beyond operational performance, contributing directly to improved community welfare in the Company’s areas of operation.

This approach is further supported by the Company’s banking partners, who recognise the importance of integrating sustainability into financing structures. Harapman Kasan, Wholesale Banking Director, UOB Indonesia, stated: “As Southeast Asia’s nickel sector continues to evolve, the role of well-structured transition financing becomes increasingly critical. This transaction reflects our commitment to aligning financing structures with measurable sustainability objectives, while supporting Indonesia’s broader industrial and energy transition priorities.”

Mike Zhang, Global Head of Metals & Mining, Institutional Banking at DBS Bank, added that the metals and mining sector plays a pivotal role in enabling the energy transition and must demonstrate credible and measurable progress in sustainability.

Meanwhile, Ken Matsuo, President Director of PT Bank Mizuho Indonesia, commented:
“The energy sector is a cornerstone of Indonesia’s economy, and we are pleased to support PT Vale’s inaugural syndicated loan. Despite market volatility, the strong participation and oversubscription underscore confidence in PT Vale’s business model. We see ESG integration in financing structures such as this as a critical enabler of a sustainable energy transition.”

Through this achievement, PT Vale further strengthens its position as a mining company that not only prioritises business growth, but also upholds strong commitments to environmental sustainability, social responsibility, and sound governance (ESG), in line with its vision of supporting a cleaner and more sustainable energy future.

id.title: Perkuat Strategi Keuangan Berkelanjutan, PT Vale Raih Fasilitas Pinjaman Sindikasi Berbasis ESG Senilai US$750 Juta
id.subtitle: Di tengah meningkatnya kebutuhan global terhadap mineral kritis untuk mendukung transisi energi, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menegaskan langkah strategisnya dalam mengintegrasikan keberlanjutan ke dalam strategi pembiayaan melalui perolehan fasilitas Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) senilai US$750 juta, dengan opsi greenshoe tambahan sebesar US$250 juta. Penandatanganan kesepakatan pembiayaan dilakukan di Jakarta, 23 April 2026.
id.body:
Jakarta, 23 April 2026 — Di tengah meningkatnya kebutuhan global terhadap mineral kritis untuk mendukung transisi energi, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menegaskan langkah strategisnya dalam mengintegrasikan keberlanjutan ke dalam strategi pembiayaan melalui perolehan fasilitas Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) senilai US$750 juta, dengan opsi greenshoe tambahan sebesar US$250 juta. Penandatanganan kesepakatan pembiayaan dilakukan di Jakarta, 23 April 2026.

Fasilitas pinjaman sindikasi ini merupakan yang pertama bagi PT Vale sekaligus menjadi tonggak penting dalam memperkuat ketahanan finansial perusahaan, mendukung pengembangan proyek strategis, serta memastikan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab sejalan dengan tuntutan pasar global. Fasilitas ini didukung oleh sindikasi 14 bank internasional dan mengalami kelebihan permintaan (oversubscribed) hingga 1,7 kali, mencerminkan tingkat kepercayaan yang tinggi terhadap fundamental bisnis dan arah strategis keberlanjutan PT Vale.

Seiring dengan percepatan elektrifikasi dan pengembangan energi terbarukan secara global, permintaan terhadap nikel sebagai komponen utama baterai kendaraan listrik (EV) dan penyimpanan energi terus meningkat. Berdasarkan proyeksi International Energy Agency, kapasitas penyimpanan baterai global diperkirakan perlu meningkat hingga 14 kali lipat, sementara permintaan baterai EV diproyeksikan meningkat 7 kali lipat hingga tahun 2030.

Dalam konteks tersebut, PT Vale berada pada posisi strategis sebagai produsen nikel dengan intensitas karbon yang relatif lebih rendah, didukung oleh penggunaan energi terbarukan dari tiga pembangkit listrik tenaga air (PLTA) yang terintegrasi dalam operasionalnya. Perusahaan juga tengah meningkatkan kapasitas dan keandalan infrastruktur PLTA untuk mendukung proses elektrifikasi operasional secara bertahap.
 


 

Fasilitas SLL ini disusun mengacu pada Sustainability-Linked Financing Framework, yang selaras dengan praktik internasional dalam pembiayaan berbasis keberlanjutan. Indikator kinerja utama (Key Performance Indicators/KPI) yang digunakan mencakup penurunan intensitas emisi karbon dan peningkatan penggunaan energi terbarukan.

Kedua KPI tersebut telah mendapatkan penilaian “strong” dari Second Party Opinion independen, yang menilai keselarasan dengan target global untuk membatasi kenaikan suhu sesuai Paris Agreement 1.5°C pathway, sebagaimana dirujuk dalam kajian independen, serta kontribusinya terhadap target Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) Indonesia. Penilaian ini juga memastikan adanya peningkatan kinerja yang signifikan dibandingkan skenario business-as-usual.

Pinjaman sindikasi berbasis keberlanjutan ini merupakan tonggak penting bagi PT Vale, sekaligus menandai langkah perdana Perseroan dalam memasuki pasar pinjaman sindikasi. Langkah ini sejalan dengan trajektori pertumbuhan Perseroan yang semakin kuat, didorong oleh ekspansi proyek-proyek strategis di Indonesia yang dijalankan secara disiplin, terukur, dan berlandaskan prinsip keberlanjutan. Presiden Direktur dan CEO PT Vale, Bernardus Irmanto, menyampaikan bahwa fasilitas ini mencerminkan komitmen perusahaan dalam mengintegrasikan aspek keberlanjutan ke dalam pengambilan keputusan strategis. “Fasilitas ini menandai langkah penting dalam perjalanan kami untuk menyelaraskan strategi pembiayaan dengan agenda dekarbonisasi dan pertumbuhan jangka panjang perusahaan. Kami berkomitmen untuk terus menghadirkan nikel berkualitas tinggi dengan jejak karbon yang lebih rendah, sekaligus mendukung pengembangan industri hilirisasi nasional dan transisi energi global,” ujarnya.

Dari sisi pemanfaatan dana, fasilitas ini akan digunakan untuk mendukung pengembangan proyek strategis perusahaan. Pada tahun 2026, sekitar 50% dana akan dialokasikan untuk pengembangan proyek IGP Pomalaa, sekitar 30% untuk proyek IGP Morowali, dan sekitar 20% untuk pengembangan IGP Sorowako Limonite. Sementara pada tahun 2027, pendanaan akan difokuskan pada kelanjutan proyek-proyek tersebut serta pemenuhan hak partisipasi (participating right) dalam proyek joint venture.

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap penciptaan nilai bersama, PT Vale juga akan menyalurkan manfaat finansial yang diperoleh dari penyesuaian margin berbasis kinerja keberlanjutan ke dalam program pengembangan masyarakat. Pendekatan ini memastikan bahwa keberhasilan pencapaian target ESG tidak hanya berdampak pada operasional perusahaan, tetapi juga memberikan kontribusi nyata bagi peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional.

Pendekatan ini turut didukung oleh para mitra perbankan yang melihat pentingnya integrasi keberlanjutan dalam struktur pembiayaan. Direktur Wholesale Banking UOB Indonesia, Harapman Kasan, menyampaikan bahwa pembiayaan berbasis keberlanjutan menjadi semakin relevan dalam mendukung transformasi sektor industri. “Transaksi ini mencerminkan pendekatan kami dalam mendukung nasabah melalui struktur pembiayaan yang selaras dengan target keberlanjutan yang terukur, sekaligus memperkuat peran Indonesia dalam agenda transisi energi global,” ujarnya.

Mike Zhang, Global Head Metals & Mining, Institutional Banking DBS, menambahkan bahwa sektor pertambangan memiliki peran penting dalam memastikan transisi energi berjalan secara bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan.

Sementara itu, Ken Matsuo, Presiden Direktur PT Bank Mizuho Indonesia, menyampaikan: “Energi merupakan tulang punggung perekonomian Indonesia, dan kami bangga dapat mendukung fasilitas pinjaman sindikasi perdana PT Vale. Di tengah volatilitas pasar, tingginya minat dari para bank peserta serta oversubscription menunjukkan kuatnya kepercayaan terhadap model bisnis PT Vale. Kami melihat integrasi ESG dalam struktur pembiayaan seperti ini sebagai langkah penting dalam mendukung transisi energi secara berkelanjutan.”

Melalui pencapaian ini, PT Vale semakin memperkuat posisinya sebagai pelaku industri pertambangan yang tidak hanya berfokus pada pertumbuhan bisnis, tetapi juga pada keberlanjutan lingkungan, tanggung jawab sosial, dan tata kelola yang baik (ESG), sejalan dengan visi untuk mendukung masa depan energi yang lebih bersih dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: Brumadinho Tourism Program wins international award at WTM Latin America
en.subtitle: Two Vale-backed initiatives win the 6th WTM Latin America Responsible Tourism Award, strengthening sustainable tourism and community leadership in Brumadinho, Minas Gerais
en.body:
Two initiatives from the program, supported by Vale, win the 6th WTM Latin America Responsible Tourism Award, consolidating the strategy of economic diversification and local leadership in the region.
                                                                                                                                                                    
Two strategic projects for promoting sustainable tourism in Brumadinho, developed within the city's Tourism Program — a Vale initiative in partnership with Rede Terra — have won the 6th WTM Latin America Responsible Tourism Award, one of the most prestigious recognitions in the sector. The projects were the only Brazilian entries selected in these categories for the final stage of the award.

Dina Braga, a leader from Quilombo de Rodrigues, dances at the center wearing colorful traditional attire during a cultural performance of the Brumadinho Quilombo Circuit. In the background, group members with instruments and visitors watch the celebration surrounded by vegetation.


The project "Brumadinho Sustainable Tourism Network – Innovation and Sustainability Journey" won the silver medal in the category "Best networking initiatives to promote responsible tourism in destinations." The "Quilombo Circuit," led by the Associação Céu de Montanhas, received the bronze medal in the category "Best initiatives for indigenous tourism and/or Traditional Communities".

"Brumadinho's recognition at an international award like WTM Latin America represents the municipality's visibility on the global stage, highlighting its tourism, cultural and sustainable potential. These initiatives strengthen the role of local communities by generating opportunities, valuing traditional knowledge and encouraging practices that respect the environment, contributing to fairer and more sustainable development," says Dina Braga, one of the leaders of Quilombo de Rodrigues.

Community foundation

The Sustainable Tourism Network already connects more than 45 local businesses through an innovative methodology — the "Teia do Turismo Sustentável" (Sustainable Tourism Web) — which translates ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) concepts into practical actions. The first phase of the project, involving 15 accommodation businesses, already shows results such as a projected reduction of 5.4 tonnes of CO2 emissions per year and the strengthening of female leadership, which runs 82% of the network's businesses.

The Quilombo Circuit is part of the Catálogo Céu de Montanhas, a collection of 38 tourist experiences in Brumadinho, and is one of the initiatives of the Brumadinho Tourism Program. The Circuit brings together the communities of Marinhos, Sapé and Ribeirão, promoting income generation and the appreciation of the Afro-Brazilian historical and cultural heritage of the region through experiential routes that connect visitors to ancestry, gastronomy and local knowledge.

"An award of this significance validates our vision that tourism can generate a concrete and sustainable legacy for Brumadinho, placing communities and local entrepreneurs as the leading players", says Daniele Teixeira, Sustainability Analyst at Vale.

The WTM Latin America award ceremony took place on Wednesday evening (15/04) in São Paulo.

Recognition
The Sustainable Tourism Web methodology has recently been shared at key industry events, including the State Meeting of Tourism Managers of Paraná, Festuris Gramado — at the invitation of the Brazilian Association of Tour Operators (Braztoa) — and the Sebrae-ES convention.

en.title: Reinforcing Green Commitment in Morowali Operations, PT Vale Marks Earth Day 2026 with Tree Planting and Energy Conservation Campaigns
en.subtitle: PT Vale reaffirmed its environmental commitment by conducting tree‑planting activities and coastal clean‑up actions at the Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali to commemorate teh Earth Day 2026. The initiative involved employees and partner contractors, reflecting a spirit of collaboration in environmental stewardship while reinforcing a culture of sustainability across the Company’s operational areas.
en.body:
Morowali, 22 April 2026 — Amid growing global challenges related to climate change and environmental degradation, the observance of Earth Day serves as an important reminder that safeguarding the planet requires concrete action from all stakeholders, including the industrial sector.

In response, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”), part of MIND ID, through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali, reaffirmed its environmental commitment by conducting tree‑planting activities and coastal clean‑up actions at the Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali.
The initiative involved employees and partner contractors, reflecting a spirit of collaboration in environmental stewardship while reinforcing a culture of sustainability across the Company’s operational areas.

Protecting Coastal Ecosystems and Biodiversity
As part of the initiative, hundreds of trees were planted, including mangroves, kayu angin, tropical almond (ketapang), and coconut trees—species with high ecological value and well‑suited to coastal environments. Beyond strengthening coastlines and preventing abrasion, the planting programme supports biodiversity conservation and enhances environmental quality in the surrounding operational areas.

Mangroves, in particular, play a critical role as natural coastal barriers and as effective carbon sinks, contributing directly to climate change mitigation efforts.

The programme also included beach and port‑area clean‑up activities, during which waste with the potential to pollute marine ecosystems was collected and sorted as part of responsible environmental management practices.

Promoting Responsible Resource Use
Beyond on‑site environmental actions, PT Vale’s sustainability commitment is further demonstrated through internal water and energy conservation campaigns, consistently promoted among employees and contractors. These initiatives encourage simple yet impactful behavioural changes, such as:

  • responsible water use,
  • improved electricity efficiency in work areas, and
  • reducing unnecessary energy consumption in daily operational activities.

These efforts form part of the Company’s systematic approach to improving resource efficiency while reducing its environmental footprint.


 

Integrating Sustainability into Long‑Term Strategy
Wafir, Head of Bahodopi Operations at PT Vale, emphasized that these activities are embedded within the Company’s long‑term strategy to integrate sustainability principles across all business processes.

“Earth Day is a meaningful moment for us to reaffirm that environmental sustainability is not merely a commitment, but must be delivered through concrete and consistent action. Tree planting, coastal clean‑ups, and water and energy conservation campaigns reflect our efforts to balance operational activities with environmental protection,” he stated.

He further highlighted the strategic importance of active participation from employees and contractors in building collective awareness.

“Sustainability cannot be achieved in isolation. Through the active engagement of all stakeholders, we aim to ensure that environmental responsibility becomes an integral part of our everyday work culture,” he added.

Aligned with ESG Principles
These initiatives are aligned with the Company’s implementation of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles, which form a core foundation of PT Vale Indonesia’s corporate strategy. The Company continues to implement programmes aimed at minimizing environmental impacts, improving resource efficiency, and creating shared value for communities surrounding its operational areas.

The tree‑planting and coastal clean‑up activities at the IGP Morowali Jetty Port are expected to deliver long‑term benefits, including healthier coastal ecosystems and a cleaner, safer working environment. More broadly, the initiative serves as a reminder that protecting the planet begins with consistent, practical actions.

A Commitment Beyond Earth Day
Through the momentum of Earth Day 2026, PT Vale Indonesia reaffirms its commitment to continuously advancing sustainability programmes, strengthening collaboration with stakeholders, and delivering responsible mining practices that are aligned with nature and generate positive impact for future generations.

id.title: Perkuat Komitmen Hijau di Area Operasi Morowali, PT Vale Tanam Pohon dan Gaungkan Hemat Energi di Hari Bumi 2026
id.subtitle: PT Vale melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali mempertegas komitmennya dengan menggelar kegiatan penanaman pohon dan aksi bersih pantai di kawasan Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali. Kegiatan ini melibatkan karyawan serta kontraktor mitra kerja, mencerminkan semangat kolaborasi dalam menjaga lingkungan sekaligus memperkuat budaya keberlanjutan di lingkungan operasional perusahaan.
id.body:
Morowali, 22 April 2026 — Di tengah meningkatnya tantangan perubahan iklim dan degradasi lingkungan, peringatan Hari Bumi Sedunia menjadi pengingat penting bahwa upaya menjaga kelestarian bumi membutuhkan aksi nyata dari seluruh pihak, termasuk sektor industri. Menjawab hal tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) bagian dari MIND ID melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali mempertegas komitmennya dengan menggelar kegiatan penanaman pohon dan aksi bersih pantai di kawasan Jetty Port Bahomotefe, Morowali.

Kegiatan ini melibatkan karyawan serta kontraktor mitra kerja, mencerminkan semangat kolaborasi dalam menjaga lingkungan sekaligus memperkuat budaya keberlanjutan di lingkungan operasional perusahaan.

Dalam aksi tersebut, ratusan pohon ditanam, terdiri dari jenis mangrove, kayu angin, ketapang, dan kelapa yang memiliki nilai ekologis tinggi dan sesuai dengan karakteristik wilayah pesisir. Penanaman ini tidak hanya bertujuan memperkuat garis pantai dan mencegah abrasi, tetapi juga mendukung keanekaragaman hayati serta meningkatkan kualitas lingkungan di sekitar area operasional. Mangrove secara khusus berperan sebagai pelindung alami pesisir sekaligus penyerap karbon yang efektif dalam mendukung mitigasi perubahan iklim.

Selain itu, kegiatan ini juga dirangkaikan dengan aksi pembersihan sampah di area pantai dan sekitar Jetty Port. Sampah yang berpotensi mencemari laut dikumpulkan dan dipilah sebagai bagian dari upaya pengelolaan lingkungan yang bertanggung jawab.

Lebih dari sekadar kegiatan lapangan, komitmen keberlanjutan PT Vale Indonesia juga diwujudkan melalui kampanye internal hemat air dan energi yang secara konsisten digalakkan kepada seluruh karyawan dan kontraktor. Melalui kampanye ini, perusahaan mendorong perubahan perilaku sederhana namun berdampak besar, seperti penggunaan air secara bijak, efisiensi listrik di area kerja, serta pengurangan pemborosan energi dalam aktivitas operasional sehari-hari. Inisiatif ini menjadi bagian dari upaya sistematis perusahaan dalam meningkatkan efisiensi sumber daya sekaligus menekan jejak lingkungan.


 

Head of Bahodopi Operation PT Vale, Wafir, menegaskan bahwa rangkaian kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari strategi jangka panjang perusahaan dalam mengintegrasikan prinsip keberlanjutan ke dalam seluruh proses bisnis.

“Hari Bumi menjadi momentum penting bagi kami untuk menegaskan bahwa keberlanjutan lingkungan bukan sekadar komitmen, tetapi harus diwujudkan melalui aksi nyata dan konsisten. Penanaman pohon, aksi bersih pantai, hingga kampanye hemat air dan energi adalah bagian dari upaya kami dalam menyeimbangkan kegiatan operasional dengan perlindungan lingkungan,” ujarnya.

Lebih lanjut disampaikan bahwa keterlibatan aktif karyawan dan mitra kerja memiliki peran strategis dalam membangun kesadaran kolektif.

“Keberhasilan upaya keberlanjutan tidak dapat dicapai secara parsial. Melalui partisipasi aktif seluruh elemen, kami ingin memastikan bahwa nilai kepedulian terhadap lingkungan menjadi bagian dari budaya kerja sehari-hari,” tambahnya.

Inisiatif ini sejalan dengan penerapan prinsip Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) yang menjadi landasan utama strategi perusahaan. PT Vale Indonesia terus menjalankan berbagai program untuk meminimalkan dampak lingkungan, meningkatkan efisiensi sumber daya, serta menciptakan nilai tambah bagi masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional.

Aksi penanaman pohon dan bersih pantai di area Jetty Port IGP Morowali diharapkan memberikan manfaat jangka panjang, mulai dari peningkatan kualitas ekosistem pesisir hingga terciptanya lingkungan kerja yang lebih bersih dan sehat. Lebih dari itu, kegiatan ini menjadi pengingat bahwa menjaga bumi dimulai dari langkah sederhana yang dilakukan secara konsisten.

Melalui momentum Hari Bumi Sedunia 2026, PT Vale Indonesia menegaskan komitmennya untuk terus mengembangkan program keberlanjutan secara berkelanjutan, memperkuat kolaborasi dengan para pemangku kepentingan, serta menghadirkan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab, selaras dengan alam, dan memberikan dampak positif bagi generasi masa depan.

en.title: Advancing Stunting Reduction Interventions in Kolaka, PT Vale Indonesia Supports the National Stunting Reduction Strategy and Health‑Related SDGs
en.subtitle: Since 2024, PT Vale's initiatives have delivered tangible impact, reaching approximately 5,000 households identified as being at risk of stunting through the sustained provision of basic food supplies and supplementary nutrition packages. In recognition of this contribution, the Government of Kolaka Regency has expressed its strong appreciation for PT Vale’s proactive role in supporting the acceleration of stunting reduction in the region.
en.body:
Kolaka, 20 April 2026 — As part of MIND ID and a strategic partner to the Government of Indonesia in advancing sustainable development, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or the “Company”) continues to strengthen its contribution to improving community health outcomes. 

Since 2024, the Company’s initiatives have delivered tangible impact, reaching approximately 5,000 households identified as being at risk of stunting through the sustained provision of basic food supplies and supplementary nutrition packages. These efforts have directly supported the improvement of household nutritional intake.

In recognition of this contribution, the Government of Kolaka Regency has expressed its strong appreciation for PT Vale’s proactive role in supporting the acceleration of stunting reduction in the region. This commitment is reflected in the implementation of a strengthened stunting reduction intervention programme in Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi.

The programme launch, held at the Regional Development Planning Agency (Bappeda) Hall of Kolaka Regency, was acknowledged by the local government as a concrete example of effective collaboration between the private sector and local authorities to address stunting in an integrated and sustainable manner.

The initiative is implemented in collaboration with the Population Control and Family Planning Agency (PP&KB) of Kolaka Regency, along with other relevant stakeholders. It forms part of the Company’s Social and Environmental Responsibility commitment to supporting the development of healthy and competitive human capital.

Stunting as a Strategic Development Priority
For PT Vale, preventing and addressing stunting goes beyond a social programme—it represents a long‑term investment in human development, shaping the quality of future generations and regional competitiveness.

Hasmir, Manager of External Relations at PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, Pomalaa Block, stated:

“Sustainability is not only about responsible operations, but also about making tangible contributions to improving people’s quality of life. Stunting prevention programmes represent a long‑term investment in building a healthy, resilient, and competitive generation.”

In line with Indonesia’s National Strategy for the Acceleration of Stunting Prevention (Stranas Stunting), the programme integrates two complementary approaches: nutrition‑specific interventions and nutrition‑sensitive interventions.

Nutrition‑specific interventions focus on the most vulnerable groups—pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers, and young children—through measures that directly influence nutritional status and health outcomes. Nutrition‑sensitive interventions, meanwhile, are aimed at strengthening enabling systems and environments, ensuring a supportive ecosystem for optimal child growth and development.


 

Integrated, Long‑Term Impact
In practice, PT Vale supports a range of integrated activities, including:

  • the provision of supplementary food to improve nutritional intake,
  • basic nutrition education for families to strengthen awareness and daily practices, and
  • enhanced child growth monitoring to ensure targeted and sustained interventions.

This comprehensive approach ensures that stunting reduction efforts extend beyond short‑term assistance and contribute to the long‑term foundations of public health and human development.

At the global level, these efforts directly contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 2: Zero Hunger, which aims to eliminate all forms of malnutrition, including stunting among children.

Synergy with Local Government
Programme planning and implementation are fully aligned with the policies and priorities of the Kolaka Regency Government and are carried out in close coordination with PP&KB as the designated technical agency. This alignment ensures that interventions are needs‑based, locally relevant, well‑targeted, and sustainable.

The Kolaka Regency Government views PT Vale’s involvement as a strong example of effective public–private collaboration in advancing both national and regional development agendas, particularly in improving public health outcomes.

From Kolaka, for Future Generations
Through this initiative, PT Vale reaffirms its commitment as a strategic partner to local government in promoting sustainable human development and improving quality of life for communities.

The strengthened stunting reduction interventions in Kolaka Regency form part of the Company’s ongoing efforts to deliver measurable and meaningful social impact.

By working collaboratively with government, communities, and other stakeholders, PT Vale believes that inclusive and sustainable development can only be achieved through strong partnerships.

These efforts not only support the health and wellbeing of today’s children, but also help lay a solid foundation for a healthier, more resilient, and higher‑quality future generation.

id.title: Perkuat Intervensi Penurunan Stunting di Kolaka, PT Vale Indonesia Dukung Stranas Stunting dan SDGs Kesehatan
id.subtitle: Program ini telah menunjukkan dampak nyata, antara lain menjangkau sekitar 5.000 keluarga berisiko stunting sejak 2024 melalui pemberian paket sembako dan nutrisi tambahan secara berkelanjutan.
id.body:
Kolaka, 20 April 2026 — Sebagai bagian dari MIND ID dan mitra strategis pemerintah dalam mendorong pembangunan berkelanjutan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perseroan”) terus memperkuat kontribusinya dalam peningkatan kualitas kesehatan masyarakat. 

Program ini telah menunjukkan dampak nyata, antara lain menjangkau sekitar 5.000 keluarga berisiko stunting sejak 2024 melalui pemberian paket sembako dan nutrisi tambahan secara berkelanjutan, yang terbukti membantu pemenuhan gizi dasar masyarakat. Atas intervensi tersebut, Pemerintah Kabupaten Kolaka menyampaikan apresiasi tinggi kepada PT Vale Indonesia atas peran aktifnya dalam mendukung upaya percepatan penurunan stunting di daerah. Hal ini diwujudkan melalui pelaksanaan program penguatan intervensi percepatan penurunan stunting di Kabupaten Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara.

Kegiatan yang berlangsung di Aula Kantor Badan Perencanaan Pembangunan Daerah (Bappeda) Kabupaten Kolaka ini mendapat apresiasi dari Pemerintah Kabupaten Kolaka sebagai bentuk sinergi nyata antara dunia usaha dan pemerintah daerah dalam mempercepat penanganan stunting secara terintegrasi dan berkelanjutan.

Program ini dilaksanakan melalui kolaborasi dengan Dinas Pengendalian Penduduk dan Keluarga Berencana (PP&KB) Kabupaten Kolaka serta pemangku kepentingan terkait, sebagai bagian dari komitmen Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan (TJSL) perusahaan dalam mendukung pembangunan sumber daya manusia yang sehat dan berdaya saing.

Stunting sebagai Prioritas Strategis Pembangunan

Bagi PT Vale, pencegahan dan penanganan stunting bukan sekadar program sosial, melainkan investasi jangka panjang yang menentukan kualitas generasi masa depan sekaligus daya saing daerah. Dalam keterangannya, Manager External Relations PT Vale Indonesia Tbk Blok Pomalaa Hasmir menyampaikan: “Keberlanjutan tidak hanya dimaknai sebagai operasional yang bertanggung jawab, tetapi juga kontribusi nyata dalam meningkatkan kualitas hidup masyarakat. Program pencegahan stunting merupakan investasi jangka panjang untuk menciptakan generasi yang sehat dan berdaya saing.”

Sejalan dengan Strategi Nasional Percepatan Pencegahan Stunting (Stranas Stunting), program ini dirancang dengan mengintegrasikan dua pendekatan utama, yaitu intervensi gizi spesifik dan intervensi gizi sensitif. Intervensi gizi spesifik difokuskan pada kelompok paling rentan, ibu hamil, ibu menyusui, dan balita, melalui upaya yang secara langsung mempengaruhi status gizi dan kesehatan. Sementara itu, intervensi gizi sensitif diarahkan pada penguatan sistem dan lingkungan pendukung, sehingga tercipta ekosistem yang kondusif bagi tumbuh kembang anak secara optimal.

Dalam implementasinya, PT Vale mendorong berbagai kegiatan yang terintegrasi, mulai dari pemberian makanan tambahan (PMT) untuk meningkatkan asupan gizi, edukasi gizi dasar bagi keluarga untuk memperkuat pemahaman dan praktik sehari-hari, hingga penguatan pemantauan tumbuh kembang anak guna memastikan intervensi yang tepat dan berkelanjutan. Pendekatan ini memastikan bahwa upaya penurunan stunting tidak hanya bersifat intervensi jangka pendek, tetapi juga membangun fondasi kesehatan masyarakat dalam jangka panjang.

Upaya ini sekaligus berkontribusi langsung terhadap Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan, khususnya ‘Tujuan 2: Tanpa Kelaparan’, yang menargetkan penghapusan segala bentuk malnutrisi, termasuk stunting pada anak.


 

Sinergi dengan Pemerintah Daerah

Seluruh perencanaan dan pelaksanaan program dilakukan secara selaras dengan kebijakan Pemerintah Kabupaten Kolaka, serta dilaksanakan bersama PP&KB sebagai instansi teknis, guna memastikan pendekatan yang tepat sasaran, berbasis kebutuhan lokal, dan berkelanjutan.

Pemerintah Kabupaten Kolaka menilai keterlibatan PT Vale sebagai contoh praktik kolaborasi yang efektif antara sektor swasta dan pemerintah dalam mendukung agenda pembangunan nasional dan daerah, khususnya dalam peningkatan kualitas kesehatan masyarakat.

Dari Kolaka untuk Generasi Masa Depan

Melalui inisiatif ini, PT Vale menegaskan komitmennya sebagai mitra strategis pemerintah daerah dalam mendorong pembangunan manusia yang berkelanjutan, sejalan dengan peningkatan kualitas hidup masyarakat.

Penguatan intervensi penurunan stunting di Kabupaten Kolaka merupakan bagian dari upaya berkelanjutan Perseroan dalam menghadirkan dampak sosial yang nyata dan terukur.

Dengan pendekatan kolaboratif bersama pemerintah, masyarakat, dan pemangku kepentingan lainnya, PT Vale meyakini bahwa pembangunan inklusif hanya dapat dicapai melalui sinergi yang kuat.

Upaya ini tidak hanya berkontribusi pada kesehatan generasi saat ini, tetapi juga membangun fondasi bagi masa depan yang lebih sehat dan berkualitas.

en.title: Projeto Rio Tanque: mais água, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida para Itabira (MG)
en.subtitle: Vale invests in water infrastructure in Itabira (MG): the Rio Tanque Project will expand the city's water supply capacity to up to 600 liters per second, benefiting communities and driving regional development.
en.body:
Water is an essential resource for life, development, and the future of cities. In Itabira, the Rio Tanque Project moves forward as a structural initiative to expand water security and contribute to the quality of life of the population.

Families like that of Iris Gomes Cláudio will directly benefit from the arrival of more water at their home taps. A community leader from the Gomes community, Iris closely follows the implementation of the Rio Tanque Project and the transformations the initiative has been promoting, not only in her community, but also in the other localities served.

With more water available and a robust system, Itabira will be prepared for new opportunities and development cycles. The initiative reinforces Vale's commitment to long-term solutions that integrate infrastructure, local development, and social well-being.

About the Rio Tanque Project
The Rio Tanque Project works are in their second year of execution and include the implementation of a new water intake and treatment system, with a capacity of up to 600 liters per second — higher than the municipality's current demand, estimated at around 400 liters per second. The structure includes a pipeline of approximately 25 kilometers, pumping stations, and a new Water Treatment Plant (WTP), which will be operated by the Itabira Autonomous Water and Sewage Service (SAAE) after the completion of the works.
 



The Rio Tanque Project is part of an agreement signed between Vale, the Minas Gerais State Public Prosecutor's Office, the Municipality of Itabira, and SAAE, with independent audit oversight.

Click here and download a special edition of the Na Obra newsletter, with more information about the Rio Tanque Project.

en.title: From Community Bonds to Collaboration: PTVI and East Luwu Regional Leadership Reinforce Commitment to Accelerating Regional Development
en.subtitle: Amid the evolving dynamics of regional development—marked by growing expectations for transparent, inclusive, and sustainable governance—collaboration between the private sector and local stakeholders has become increasingly critical. Responding to this context, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the state-owned MIND ID Group, together with the Regional Leadership Coordination Forum (Forkopimda) of East Luwu Regency, South Sulawesi Province, leveraged the post-Eid Halalbihalal gathering—a traditional occasion for strengthening social ties—as a strategic platform to deepen synergy and align respective roles.
en.body:
Amid the evolving dynamics of regional development—marked by growing expectations for transparent, inclusive, and sustainable governance—collaboration between the private sector and local stakeholders has become increasingly critical. Responding to this context, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the state-owned MIND ID Group, together with the Regional Leadership Coordination Forum (Forkopimda) of East Luwu Regency, South Sulawesi Province, leveraged the post-Eid Halalbihalal gathering—a traditional occasion for strengthening social ties—as a strategic platform to deepen synergy and align respective roles.

This collaboration is not only essential for maintaining operational stability and effectiveness, but also serves as a shared foundation for accelerating competitive and sustainable regional development. The Halalbihalal event was attended by PT Vale Indonesia’s management and employees, East Luwu Regent Ir. H. Irwan Bachri Syam, members of the East Luwu Regional House of Representatives (DPRD), representatives of the Indonesian National Police (Polri) and Armed Forces (TNI), the District Prosecutor’s Office, the Religious Court of Malili, and other members of the Forkopimda in Sorowako on Friday (April 17, 2026).

On this occasion, Budiawansyah, Director and Chief Sustainability and Corporate Affairs Officer of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, emphasized that the company’s strong performance over 57 years of operation has been made possible by continuous support from government stakeholders and local communities.

Support from the Regent, DPRD, TNI, and Polri plays a vital role in ensuring that strategic projects are delivered on target. This synergy also creates a stronger enabling environment for long-term investments, which directly contribute to increased regional revenue and economic stability.

Budiawansyah noted that PT Vale’s presence is ultimately about building a shared future. The company’s investments will continue to serve as a catalyst for East Luwu’s transformation—strengthening regional income while empowering local communities.
During the same event, the Regent of East Luwu expressed his appreciation for the company’s consistent efforts to maintain close engagement with both government and society.

Irwan Bachri Syam highlighted that for more than five decades, PT Vale has delivered significant and tangible benefits to regional development.

“Our region effectively holds a 2.5% stake in PT Vale. Every year, the dividends flow into regional revenue. That is why community aspirations should not always be expressed through protests. The government stands ready to mediate between community interests and PT Vale’s management,” he stated in his remarks.

The Regent also shared that, thanks to strong collaboration between the company, government, and local communities, the long-standing Old Camp land dispute in Sorowako was successfully resolved this year through a mutually beneficial agreement.

He closed his remarks by reaffirming the local government’s full support for PT Vale’s future plans—particularly those focused on environmental stewardship and community empowerment across four priority areas: Sorowako, Wawondula, Wasuponda, and Malili.

 
 

Operational Resilience Driving Broader Regional Contribution
Despite ongoing global market challenges, PT Vale has demonstrated strong operational resilience, recording a net profit of US$76.1 million in 2025, representing a 32% increase year-on-year. This positive performance provides the company with strategic capacity to contribute more actively and be part of the solution in accelerating regional progress.

Among the initiatives undertaken are certified skills training programs aimed at strengthening the local workforce, ensuring that local talent becomes the primary driver of industrial operations, as well as the distribution of scholarships to more than 1,000 students.

Beyond contributing to increased Regional Own-Source Revenue (PAD), PT Vale also plays an active role in promoting inclusive economic empowerment by strengthening micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and enhancing the social and ecological resilience of communities surrounding its operational areas. These efforts are aligned with Indonesia’s Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources Regulation No. 1824 K/30/MEM/2018, which governs community development and empowerment programs.

This approach reflects a strategic vision in which industrial growth advances in parallel with environmental restoration—ensuring that East Luwu’s ecological heritage is preserved for future generations.

Through strengthened and harmonious relationships with local government and communities, PT Vale remains confident in its ability to navigate future global challenges. This collaboration is not merely about sustaining current operations, but about building a long-term, inclusive, and environmentally responsible development legacy that delivers enduring value for the entire East Luwu community.

id.title: Dari Silaturahmi ke Kolaborasi, PTVI dan Forkopimda Luwu Timur Teguhkan Komitmen untuk Akselerasi Kemajuan Daerah
id.subtitle: Di tengah dinamika pembangunan daerah dengan tuntutan tata kelola yang transparan, inklusif, dan berkelanjutan, kolaborasi antara dunia usaha dan pemangku kepentingan daerah menjadi sangat krusial. Menjawab konteks tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, bersama jajaran Forum Koordinasi Pimpinan Daerah (Forkopimda) Kabupaten Luwu Timur, Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan, memanfaatkan momentum Halalbihalal sebagai ruang strategis untuk memperkuat sinergi dan menyelaraskan peran.
id.body:
Di tengah dinamika pembangunan daerah dengan tuntutan tata kelola yang transparan, inklusif, dan berkelanjutan, kolaborasi antara dunia usaha dan pemangku kepentingan daerah menjadi sangat krusial. Menjawab konteks tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, bersama jajaran Forum Koordinasi Pimpinan Daerah (Forkopimda) Kabupaten Luwu Timur, Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan, memanfaatkan momentum Halalbihalal sebagai ruang strategis untuk memperkuat sinergi dan menyelaraskan peran. 

Kolaborasi ini tidak hanya penting dalam menjaga stabilitas dan efektivitas operasional perusahaan, tetapi juga menjadi fondasi bersama dalam mendorong percepatan pembangunan daerah yang berdaya saing dan berkelanjutan. Kegiatan Halalbihalal dihadiri oleh anajemen dan Karyawan PT Vale Indonesia, Bupati Luwu Timur Ir. H. Irwan Bachri Syam, ST, M.T., IPM, Anggota DPRD Luwu Timur Aripin S.Ag, Wakapolres Luwu Timur Kompol Hajriadi, Ns., S.Kep., S.H., M.H., Dandim 1403 Sawerigading Palopo Letkol Inf Windra Sukma Prihantoro, Kepala Kejaksaan Negeri Luwu Timur  Berthy Oktavianes Zakarias Huliselan, S.H., M.H., Ketua Pengadilan Agama Malili Rajiman S.Hi, M.H., serta jajaran Forum Koordinasi Pimpinan Daerah (Forkopimda) di Sorowako, Jumat (17/4/2026).

Direktur dan Chief Sustainability and Corporate Affairs Officer PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, Budiawansyah pada kesempatan tersebut, menyampaikan bahwa selama 57 tahun beroperasi PT Vale bisa memiliki kinerja baik berkat doa dan dukung dari para stakeholder pemerintah dan masyarakat. 

Dukungan dari Bupati, DPRD, TNI, dan Polri menjadi faktor krusial dalam memastikan proyek strategis berjalan sesuai target. Sinergi ini  akan membuka ruang lebih besar bagi realisasi investasi jangka panjang, yang secara langsung berdampak pada peningkatan Pendapatan Asli Daerah (PAD) dan stabilitas ekonomi wilayah. 

Budiawansyah mengatakan kehadiran PT Vale adalah tentang membangun masa depan bersama. Investasi perusahaan akan terus menjadi motor penggerak transformasi Luwu Timur melalui peningkatan pendapatan daerah dan pemberdayaan masyarakat. 

Di momen ini juga, Bupati Luwu Timur menyampaikan rasa syukurnya karena perusahaan terus berusaha menjalin silaturahmi bersama pemerintah dan masyarakat. 

Irwan Bachri Syam mengatakan  lebih dari lima dekade PT Vale memberi banyak sekali manfaat bagi perkembangan daerah. 

"Daerah kita ini seperti ikut memiliki saham 2,5% dari PT Vale. Setiap tahun keuntungannya mengalir untuk pendapatan daerah. Maka dari itu, jika ada aspirasi jangan sedikit-sedikit demo. Pemerintah siap menjembatani kepentingan masyarakat bersama manajemen PT Vale," ucapnya saat sambutan. 

Bupati Luwu Timur juga menceritakan berkat kerjasama dengan baik antar perusahaan, pemerintah dan masyarakat akhirnya tahun ini kasus sengketa lahan Old Camp di Sorowako bisa selesai dengan kesepakatan yang baik untuk semua pihak. 

Ia menutup sambutannya dengan pernyataan dukungan untuk segala perencanaan dari PT Vale demi kelestarian lingkungan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat di Luwu Timur khususnya empat area pemberdayaan di Sorowako, Wawondula, Wasuponda dan Malili. 
 

 
 

Kinerja Tangguh untuk Kontribusi Daerah yang Lebih Luas
Di tengah dinamika pasar global, PT Vale membuktikan ketangguhan operasionalnya dengan mencatatkan laba bersih sebesar US$76,1 juta pada tahun 2025, meningkat 32% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Pertumbuhan positif ini menjadi modal strategis bagi perusahaan untuk berkontribusi lebih dan menjadi bagian dari solusi dalam mengakselerasi kemajuan daerah.

Beberapa program yang diinisiasi oleh perusahaan seperti pelatihan keterampilan bersertifikat untuk meningkatkan kapasitas angkatan tenaga kerja lokal guna memastikan putra-putri daerah menjadi aktor utama dalam operasional industri. Serta penyaluran beasiswa kepada lebih dari 1.000 pelajar.

Tidak hanya berkontribusi pada peningkatan Pendapatan Asli Daerah (PAD), PT Vale juga turut aktif mendorong pemberdayaan ekonomi inklusif melalui penguatan kapasitas UMKM dan resiliensi sosial-ekologi masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional sesuai standar Kepmen ESDM Nomor 1824 K/30/MEM/2018 tentang Pedoman Pelaksanaan Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM).

Langkah ini mencerminkan visi strategis bahwa pertumbuhan industri harus berjalan selaras dengan pemulihan lingkungan, memastikan bahwa warisan ekologi Luwu Timur tetap terjaga bagi generasi mendatang.

Melalui penguatan hubungan yang harmonis dengan Pemerintah Daerah dan masyarakat, PT Vale optimis mampu menghadapi tantangan global di masa depan. Kolaborasi ini bukan hanya tentang menjaga operasional saat ini, tetapi tentang membangun legacy pembangunan yang inklusif, ramah lingkungan, dan memberikan manfaat jangka panjang bagi seluruh masyarakat Luwu Timur.

en.title: Driving National Development and Value Creation, PT Vale Recognized by the Governor of Central Sulawesi
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of MIND ID, has received a formal recognition from the Government of Central Sulawesi Province for its consistent fiscal compliance and meaningful contribution to regional revenue, reinforcing its role as a long-term partner in regional development.
en.body:
Palu, Indonesia — April 13, 2026 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of MIND ID, has received a formal recognition from the Government of Central Sulawesi Province for its consistent fiscal compliance and meaningful contribution to regional revenue, reinforcing its role as a long-term partner in regional development.

The award was presented by Governor Anwar Hafid during the official ceremony commemorating the 62nd anniversary of Central Sulawesi Province, held in Palu.

The recognition reflects the provincial government’s emphasis on cross-sector collaboration as a driver of sustainable economic growth. In this context, PT Vale was acknowledged as a strategic partner for its disciplined and transparent tax practices, including the timely and sustained payment of heavy equipment taxes, which directly support local government revenue.

Endra Kusuma, Head of External Regional & Growth at PT Vale, stated that the recognition underscores the company’s long-term commitment to value creation.

“This recognition reflects our ongoing responsibility to contribute to regional and national development through strong governance and consistent fiscal compliance across all our operating areas,” he said.

Beyond fiscal contributions, PT Vale continues to support inclusive local economic growth through community development and empowerment initiatives. As part of the anniversary celebrations, the company participated in Sulteng Expo 2026, showcasing products from micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) supported by PT Vale in Morowali.

The company also used the platform to highlight its broader social investment programs in the region, including organic rice cultivation initiatives and other community development programs implemented in the IGP Morowali area.

By aligning strong governance, fiscal responsibility, and community empowerment, PT Vale continues to strengthen its role as a trusted partner to government and local stakeholders, supporting sustainable regional development while maintaining the operational discipline fundamental to long-term business resilience.

id.title: Tegaskan Peran Strategis dalam Mendorong Pembangunan dan Nilai bagi Negara, PT Vale Raih Penghargaan dari Gubernur Sulawesi Tengah
id.subtitle: Komitmen terhadap tata kelola yang baik serta kontribusi nyata bagi pembangunan daerah kembali mendapatkan pengakuan. PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari MIND ID, menerima penghargaan dari Pemerintah Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah atas kepatuhan dan konsistensinya sebagai wajib pajak yang berkontribusi signifikan terhadap peningkatan Pendapatan Asli Daerah (PAD).
id.body:
Palu, 13 April 2026 — Komitmen terhadap tata kelola yang baik serta kontribusi nyata bagi pembangunan daerah kembali mendapatkan pengakuan. PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari MIND ID, menerima penghargaan dari Pemerintah Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah atas kepatuhan dan konsistensinya sebagai wajib pajak yang berkontribusi signifikan terhadap peningkatan Pendapatan Asli Daerah (PAD).

Penghargaan tersebut diserahkan langsung oleh Gubernur Sulawesi Tengah, Anwar Hafid, dalam upacara peringatan Hari Ulang Tahun ke-62 Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah di Palu.

Momentum penghargaan ini sejalan dengan arah strategis Pemerintah Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah yang menekankan bahwa peringatan HUT bukan sekadar seremoni, melainkan katalisator pertumbuhan ekonomi daerah melalui kolaborasi lintas sektor. “Peringatan ini bukan sekadar seremonial, tetapi momentum untuk menggerakkan ekonomi masyarakat,” tegas Gubernur Anwar Hafid. 

Sejalan dengan itu, PT Vale dinilai sebagai salah satu mitra strategis pemerintah dalam mendorong pembangunan daerah melalui kepatuhan fiskal yang konsisten, termasuk pembayaran pajak alat berat secara tepat waktu dan berkelanjutan.

Head of External Regional & Growth PT Vale, Endra Kusuma, menyampaikan bahwa penghargaan ini mencerminkan komitmen jangka panjang perusahaan dalam menciptakan nilai bersama bagi pemerintah, masyarakat, dan pemegang saham. “Alhamdulillah. Ini bagian dari komitmen kami untuk terus berkontribusi kepada pemerintah, tidak hanya di Sulawesi Tengah, tetapi juga di wilayah lain tempat kami beroperasi. Pembayaran pajak yang tepat waktu dan berkelanjutan merupakan kontribusi nyata kami dalam mendukung pembangunan daerah maupun nasional,” ujar Endra.

Lebih lanjut, Endra menekankan bahwa sinergi multipihak menjadi fondasi utama dalam memperkuat pertumbuhan ekonomi daerah yang inklusif dan berkelanjutan. “Harapan kami, Sulawesi Tengah terus maju dan semakin sejahtera. Sinergi antara pemerintah, swasta, dan masyarakat harus terus diperkuat untuk bersama-sama mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi sekaligus melestarikan nilai budaya, sejalan dengan semangat ‘Sulteng Nambaso’,” tambahnya.

Sebagai bagian dari dukungan terhadap agenda Pemerintah Daerah dalam menggerakkan ekonomi rakyat, PT Vale juga turut berpartisipasi dalam Sulteng Expo 2026 dengan menghadirkan booth UMKM binaan dari Morowali.

Inisiatif ini mencerminkan pendekatan holistik perusahaan, tidak hanya berkontribusi melalui pajak, tetapi juga melalui pemberdayaan ekonomi lokal yang berdampak langsung pada masyarakat. “Kami menghadirkan produk UMKM binaan, khususnya dari Morowali, sebagai bentuk komitmen kami dalam mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi lokal. UMKM adalah tulang punggung ekonomi nasional, sehingga sudah menjadi tanggung jawab kami untuk ikut memperkuat daya saing mereka,” jelas Endra.

Selain itu, PT Vale juga memanfaatkan momentum ini untuk mensosialisasikan berbagai program sosial yang telah dijalankan, termasuk pengembangan padi organik serta program CSR lainnya di wilayah IGP Morowali.

Dengan menampilkan produk-produk unggulan yang telah siap secara kualitas dan keberlanjutan pasokan, PT Vale menegaskan komitmennya dalam menciptakan dampak jangka panjang yang terukur bagi masyarakat sekitar.

Penghargaan ini semakin memperkuat posisi PT Vale sebagai mitra strategis pemerintah dalam mendorong pembangunan daerah, sekaligus mencerminkan disiplin operasional dan tata kelola perusahaan yang solid, sebagai fondasi utama dalam mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis berkelanjutan.

en.title: Celebrating and living Capixaba traditions, Vale sponsors the 2026 Festa da Penha
en.subtitle: With over 20 years of partnership, the company takes part in one of Brazil's largest cultural events with immersive experiences, music, and innovation.
en.body:
The 2026 Festa da Penha — one of Brazil's largest and oldest cultural and religious celebrations — is bringing millions of people together in Espírito Santo, with Vale once again as a proud sponsor.

Held for over 450 years, the festival is recognized as a cultural heritage of Espírito Santo and is now also acknowledged as a national cultural event, drawing around 2 million participants and establishing itself as one of the country's most significant celebrations.

Vale has supported the initiative for more than two decades, reinforcing its ongoing commitment to the cultural, social, and economic development of the communities where it operates.

Join the Vale activations.
The program includes mapped projection, Vale Music, and scarf distribution. Still this year, Vale brings the drone show on April 11th.



Tradition in lines and colors
The 2026 edition also highlights the encouragement of the creative economy. The festival's visual identity was developed by artist Climacio Charille, a collaboration that celebrates local talent and offers fresh perspectives on traditional culture.

The initiative is part of Vale's broader effort to foster creative industries and generate opportunities for artists and suppliers in the region.

Caption: Capixaba artist Climacio Charille created the work Caminho das Sete Alegrias (Path of the Seven Joys), depicting the historic climb to the Convent and the energy of a celebration that has been passed down through generations.

For those who want to take this art with them, the illustration is available for download. Click here to download the image.

Learn more
Check out the full program on the official website: www.festadapenhaoficial.com.br

en.title: Vale Launches the Essentiality Campaign, Reinforcing Mining's Role in the Energy Transition
en.subtitle: Minerals such as nickel, copper, and iron ore underpin everyday life and accelerate global decarbonization — discover how Vale connects mining, innovation, and a sustainable future.
en.body:
Vale has launched the Essentiality campaign, an institutional positioning that connects mining to people's everyday lives and the future of society. Created in partnership with the agency Africa Creative, the initiative reinforces the company's strategic role in the global energy transition and industrial decarbonization.

Built around the concept "If it's essential to you, it has to do with Vale," the campaign demonstrates how minerals such as nickel, copper, and iron ore are present in technologies that are already part of daily life — from electric vehicle batteries to artificial intelligence systems, to the digital infrastructure connecting people around the world.

Mining as the Foundation of the Future
The campaign starts from a concrete premise: minerals are found in nearly everything that sustains modern life, from cookware to smartphones, from goalposts on a soccer field to the structures spanning entire cities. And these same materials enable the technologies driving the energy transition.
Nickel is indispensable for the batteries that store renewable energy and power electric vehicles. Copper is the backbone of the digital infrastructure connecting people, data, and systems on a global scale, with demand growing as artificial intelligence advances. Iron ore, in turn, is at the heart of briquette development — a Vale solution that can reduce CO₂ emissions in steel production by up to 10%, without the use of water.

Innovation and Responsibility in Operations
The campaign film features Vale employees highlighting practices already transforming operations: autonomous trucks and robots that enhance safety; ships powered by rotor sails that harness wind energy to reduce emissions; and, since 2024, 100% of the electrical energy consumed in mining operations in Brazil sourced from renewable sources — a concrete step toward the goal of carbon neutrality by 2050.

Vale also helps protect an area equivalent to one million soccer fields of forest, and advances circular mining through the Waste to Value program, which in 2024 recovered more than 12 million metric tons of iron ore from tailings.

Multi-Channel Presence Throughout 2026
The campaign launched nationally, with airtime during the Jornal Nacional news broadcast. It will be distributed broadly throughout the year across multiple channels: free-to-air and pay TV, streaming platforms, digital media, Out of Home (OOH), and social media.

The strategy is structured across four phases in 2026, ensuring message consistency and progressive deepening of themes with audiences.

Visit vale.com/essencial to explore the full campaign.

en.title: On Forest Day, Vale highlights the protection of more than 64,000 hectares in Minas Gerais
en.subtitle: On International Day of Forests, the company highlights environmental preservation and initiatives that balance mining and sustainability.
en.body:
On March 21, celebrated as the International Day of Forests and Trees, Vale reinforces its commitment to environmental preservation by highlighting the protection of more than 64,000 hectares of green areas in Minas Gerais — equivalent to approximately twice the size of Belo Horizonte.

This initiative demonstrates that it is possible to align economic development with nature conservation, one of today’s main global challenges.

Watch the institutional video

▶️ The video visually presents the main protected areas and environmental actions carried out by the company in the state:


The video was specially produced by the South/Southeast Corridor Licensing Management,
                                    part of the Licensing and Regulatory Directorate.


Protected areas and environmental conservation in Minas Gerais

The set of areas preserved by Vale includes different types of environmental protection. Among them are:

•    13 Private Natural Heritage Reserves (RPPNs), totaling around 6,000 hectares
•    Approximately 8,000 hectares in the process of becoming new protected areas
•    More than 29,000 hectares allocated for environmental compensation
•    Around 21,000 hectares of Legal Reserve

In addition, Vale has also directly contributed to the creation of important conservation units by donating approximately 28,000 hectares.

Partnerships and biodiversity protection
Another highlight is the voluntary partnership with ICMBio, which contributes to the protection of more than 50,000 hectares of the Mata Escura Biological Reserve, located in the Jequitinhonha Valley. These initiatives reinforce the company’s strategic role in conserving Brazilian biodiversity, especially in regions of high ecological importance.
The proposal is clear: to demonstrate that mining can coexist with sustainable and responsible practices.

Commitment to future generations
By marking the International Day of Forests, Vale reinforces a central message: preserving the environment means investing in the future.
The protection of green areas in Minas Gerais represents not only an environmental effort but also a legacy for future generations.

en.title: Strengthening Healthcare Resilience in Kolaka, PT Vale Donates Ambulance to Support Red Cross Operations
en.subtitle: Amid the growing demand for healthcare services driven by increasing economic activity in Kolaka Regency, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, through the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, has donated an ambulance unit to support the operations of the Indonesian Red Cross (PMI) in Kolaka Regency.
en.body:
KOLAKA, 18 March 2026 - Amid the growing demand for healthcare services driven by increasing economic activity in Kolaka Regency, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, through the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, has donated an ambulance unit to support the operations of the Indonesian Red Cross (PMI) in Kolaka Regency. This contribution is expected to strengthen the region’s emergency response capacity, which continues to face challenges due to limited fleet availability.

The handover ceremony took place on Wednesday, March 17, 2026, at the Kolaka Regency Health Office, as part of PT Vale’s ongoing commitment to supporting improvements in public services, particularly within the health sector.

This initiative is part of the company’s 2024 Community Development and Empowerment Program (PPM), which is designed to address priority needs within the communities surrounding its operational areas.

As the IGP Pomalaa strategic project continues to expand, Kolaka Regency has experienced a significant rise in economic activity and population mobility. This development directly increases the demand for public services, including healthcare and emergency response. In this context, PT Vale positions itself not only as an industrial operator but also as a development partner contributing to the strengthening of social infrastructure and essential public services.
Hasmir, Manager of External Relations Pomalaa, emphasized that the support reflects the company’s long‑term approach to creating sustainable positive impact.

“Strengthening healthcare services is a crucial element in improving community well‑being, especially in rapidly growing regions. Through this support, we hope to enhance emergency preparedness while reinforcing the healthcare service system in Kolaka,” he said.

The ambulance will be used to support patient transfers and evacuations—including emergency care, disaster response, and other public health needs—through PMI’s operational services in Kolaka Regency.

The Chair of PMI Kolaka Regency, Hj. Andi Wahida, S.Pd., MM, expressed appreciation for the assistance. According to her, the support aligns closely with PMI’s current operational needs. “We are truly grateful for PT Vale’s support. Previously, we faced limitations due to aging and less reliable vehicles. With this new ambulance, we are optimistic about improving our emergency response services for the community,” she said.

She added that the ambulance will serve multiple purposes, from patient evacuation and accident response to disaster relief operations.

Through this initiative, PT Vale reaffirms its commitment to delivering sustainable value to communities within its operational areas. The company believes that industrial growth must go hand in hand with strengthened social capacity and public services to ensure that the benefits of development are shared inclusively and sustainably.

id.title: Perkuat Ketahanan Layanan Kesehatan Kolaka, PT Vale Serahkan Ambulans untuk Dukung Operasional PMI
id.subtitle: Di tengah meningkatnya kebutuhan layanan kesehatan seiring pertumbuhan aktivitas ekonomi di Kabupaten Kolaka, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa menyerahkan satu unit ambulans untuk mendukung operasional Palang Merah Indonesia (PMI) Kabupaten Kolaka. Bantuan ini diharapkan dapat memperkuat kapasitas layanan kegawatdaruratan yang masih menghadapi keterbatasan armada di wilayah tersebut.
id.body:
KOLAKA, 18 Maret 2026 — Di tengah meningkatnya kebutuhan layanan kesehatan seiring pertumbuhan aktivitas ekonomi di Kabupaten Kolaka, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa menyerahkan satu unit ambulans untuk mendukung operasional Palang Merah Indonesia (PMI) Kabupaten Kolaka. Bantuan ini diharapkan dapat memperkuat kapasitas layanan kegawatdaruratan yang masih menghadapi keterbatasan armada di wilayah tersebut.

Penyerahan dilakukan pada Rabu, 17 Maret 2026, di Kantor Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Kolaka, sebagai bagian dari komitmen berkelanjutan PT Vale dalam mendukung peningkatan kualitas layanan publik, khususnya di sektor kesehatan.

Bantuan ini merupakan realisasi Program Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM) Tahun Anggaran 2024, yang dirancang untuk menjawab kebutuhan prioritas masyarakat di wilayah operasi perusahaan.

Seiring dengan berkembangnya proyek strategis IGP Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka mengalami pertumbuhan aktivitas ekonomi dan mobilitas masyarakat yang signifikan. Kondisi ini secara langsung mendorong peningkatan kebutuhan terhadap layanan publik, termasuk layanan kesehatan dan kegawatdaruratan. Dalam konteks tersebut, PT Vale menempatkan perannya tidak hanya sebagai pelaku industri, tetapi juga sebagai mitra pembangunan daerah yang berkontribusi dalam memperkuat fondasi sosial dan layanan dasar masyarakat.

Manager External Relations Pomalaa, Hasmir, menegaskan bahwa dukungan ini merupakan bagian dari pendekatan jangka panjang perusahaan dalam menciptakan dampak yang berkelanjutan. “Penguatan layanan kesehatan merupakan elemen penting dalam mendukung kualitas hidup masyarakat, terlebih di wilayah yang sedang berkembang pesat. Melalui dukungan ini, kami berharap dapat berkontribusi dalam meningkatkan kesiapsiagaan layanan darurat sekaligus memperkuat sistem pelayanan kesehatan di Kolaka,” ujarnya.

Ambulans tersebut akan digunakan untuk mendukung rujukan dan evakuasi pasien, termasuk penanganan kegawatdaruratan, layanan bencana, serta kebutuhan kesehatan masyarakat lainnya melalui operasional PMI Kabupaten Kolaka.

Ketua PMI Kabupaten Kolaka, Hj. Andi Wahida, S.Pd., MM, menyampaikan apresiasi atas dukungan yang diberikan. Menurutnya, bantuan ini sangat relevan dengan kondisi operasional PMI saat ini. "Alhamdulillah, kami sangat bersyukur atas dukungan dari PT Vale. Sebelumnya kami menghadapi keterbatasan armada akibat kondisi kendaraan yang tidak lagi optimal. Dengan adanya ambulans baru ini, kami optimistis dapat meningkatkan respons layanan kegawatdaruratan kepada masyarakat,” ujarnya.

Ia menambahkan bahwa ambulans tersebut akan dimanfaatkan untuk berbagai kebutuhan, mulai dari evakuasi pasien, penanganan kecelakaan, hingga respons terhadap bencana.

Melalui inisiatif ini, PT Vale kembali menegaskan komitmennya untuk menghadirkan nilai tambah yang berkelanjutan bagi masyarakat sekitar wilayah operasional. Perusahaan percaya bahwa pertumbuhan industri harus berjalan seiring dengan penguatan kapasitas sosial dan layanan publik, guna memastikan manfaat pembangunan dapat dirasakan secara inklusif dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: Vale publishes its Ethics & Compliance Program 2025 Report
en.subtitle: Vale celebrates five years of its Ethics & Compliance Program, reinforcing corporate integrity and corporate responsibility in Brazil and on the global stage.
en.body:
This month, Vale's Ethics & Compliance Program celebrates its fifth anniversary, consolidating a trajectory of evolution that goes beyond controls and is strengthened by an approach based on ethics and integrity.

The Ethics & Compliance Program 2025 Report presents the main advances in the prevention, detection, and correction of misconduct. The document also compiles data and indicators from the Whistleblower Channel, as well as information on the consequences applied to confirmed cases.

"Over the past five years, Vale’s Ethics & Compliance Program has evolved consistently and significantly. Beyond strengthening processes, controls, and guidelines, we have advanced in building a fundamentally behavioural dimension grounded in integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and the ability to make ethical decisions in everyday situations," says Denis Cuenca, Vale's Chief Audit and Compliance Officer.

Access the full report, available in portuguese and english.

en.title: Maravilhas III Dam: February Updates
en.subtitle: Engineer of Record report confirms the structure remains stable, performing within normal conditions and under continuous 24/7 monitoring.
en.body:
The Maravilhas III Dam, located in Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, maintained adequate conservation conditions throughout February 2026.

To monitor the geotechnical performance of the structure, the operation is supported by an external company acting as the Engineer of Record (EoR). The Geotechnical Performance Evaluation Report prepared by the EoR for February indicates that, based on monitoring data and visual inspections, the dam is performing within normal conditions. Additionally, geotechnical instruments are operating within the expected parameters according to the hydrological cycle, and the safety factors obtained from stability analyses continue to meet the minimum requirements established by current legislation.

Construction works for the second stage of the dam embankment were suspended in October and are expected to resume in April, after the rainy season. During the rainy months, the structure maintains a minimum set of equipment to ensure operational support if needed. Activities related to the adjustment of surface drainage systems and maintenance access routes were maintained during the month of January.

The Maravilhas III Dam maintains a positive Stability Condition Declaration (SCD), and the structure remains with no alert or emergency level. The dam continues to be monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, by the Geotechnical Monitoring Center (GMC).

Additionally, geotechnical instruments are operating within the expected parameters according to the hydrological cycle, and the safety factors obtained from stability analyses continue to meet the minimum requirements established by current legislation.

Construction works for the second stage of the dam embankment were suspended in October and are expected to resume in April, after the rainy season. During the rainy months, the structure maintains a minimum set of equipment to ensure operational support if needed. Activities related to the adjustment of surface drainage systems and maintenance access routes were maintained during the month of January.

The Maravilhas III Dam maintains a positive Stability Condition Declaration (SCD), and the structure remains with no alert or emergency level. The dam continues to be monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, by the Geotechnical Monitoring Center (GMC).

en.title: Vale S.A. announces R$225 million investment in healthcare and culture in Congonhas
en.subtitle: Donation will fund the construction of the new Bom Jesus Hospital and the expansion of the Congonhas Museum, strengthening healthcare, culture and tourism.
en.body:
Donation will enable construction of a new hospital and expansion of a museum

Vale S.A. announced on Friday (March 13) a voluntary donation of R$225 million to strengthen healthcare and cultural services in Congonhas, in Minas Gerais, Brazil. The funds will be used to build the new Bom Jesus Hospital and expand the Congonhas Museum, two projects considered priorities by the municipality.

The donation agreement was signed during an event organized by the Congonhas city government at the site where the new hospital will be built.

“This investment is the result of actively listening to the municipality and our commitment to the development of the regions where we operate. It is very rewarding to contribute to structural projects defined by the city that improve the population’s quality of life,” said Kennedy Alencar, Vale’s Institutional Relations Director.

Of the total amount announced, R$200 million will be donated by Vale for the construction, equipment and modernization of the new Bom Jesus Hospital, expanding healthcare capacity and strengthening the region’s public health network. The Congonhas city government will be responsible for executing the project, managing the funds and providing accountability.

Historic heritage

Another R$25 million will be invested in the Congonhas Museum through cultural incentive programs focused on preserving historical heritage, promoting culture and encouraging tourism. This will be Vale’s fourth investment through incentive-based resources aimed at maintaining and improving the museum and the Congonhas Memorial.

According to Rodrigo Silveira, Operations Director of Vale S.A.’s Paraopeba Complex, the company has a long history of partnership with the municipality.

“We have been present in the region for several decades, employing more than 5,000 people—most of them local residents—and we remain committed to responsible operations, supporting the economic and social development of Congonhas while promoting initiatives that value the culture and history of our region.”

The Congonhas Museum is dedicated to interpreting and promoting the Sanctuary of Bom Jesus de Matosinhos, recognized by UNESCO as a World Cultural Heritage Site since 1985. The complex houses one of the world’s most complete Baroque sculptural ensembles, including the Twelve Prophets carved in soapstone and the Stations of the Passion, masterpieces by Antônio Francisco Lisboa.

The museum hosts interactive exhibitions and educational programs, enriching visitors’ experiences and contributing to the preservation of Aleijadinho’s work and the Baroque heritage of Minas Gerais.

The Congonhas Memorial complements this work by bringing together research, documentation and studies focused on the conservation of Baroque art and soapstone sculpture, strengthening the protection of historical heritage and reinforcing Congonhas as a reference in safeguarding cultural assets.
