en.title: Vale anuncia parceria para ampliar limpeza urbana em Barão de Cocais
en.subtitle: Iniciativa abrange quase 28 quilômetros de vias públicas no município
en.body:
A Vale, Prefeitura de Barão de Cocais e a Associação Comercial, Industrial e Agropecuária (ACIABAC) do município firmaram, nessa terça-feira (13/1), uma parceria para fortalecer a limpeza urbana e conservação de vias públicas. A iniciativa busca contribuir para a manutenção dos espaços públicos, bem como atender às solicitações dos cidadãos cocaienses. “Trata-se de um projeto de grande relevância para melhorar a qualidade de vida da população, contribuindo para a saúde pública, segurança viária e valorização dos espaços públicos e comércio local”, declara Luiz Fernando Martins, gerente de Relacionamento Institucional da Vale.

 Contrato foi assinado ontem, em evento promovido pela Prefeitura de Barão de Cocais. Divulgação Vale
 

O acordo, que também conta com a participação de outras seis mineradoras que atuam na região, abrange a limpeza e conservação de nove vias municipais e um trecho da rodovia MG-436, na altura do trevo de acesso à cidade. A Vale é a principal patrocinadora da iniciativa, sendo responsável pela doação voluntária de cerca de 60% do montante.

O contrato tem vigência de um ano e prevê varrição mecanizada e manual, lavagem e umidificação das vias com caminhão-pipa, poda, capina, limpeza de placas de sinalização e do sistema de drenagem. As atividades serão realizadas com sinalização adequada e acompanhamento técnico.

A ACIABAC será responsável pela contratação, acompanhamento e gestão da empresa que executará o serviço. A fiscalização ficará sob responsabilidade da Prefeitura.

Programa de reciclagem

A Vale realiza, desde 2022, o projeto Reciclo Agora no município, fortalecendo a gestão, infraestrutura e capacitação da Associação de Catadores de Materiais Recicláveis de Barão de Cocais (Aserbac), contemplando 32 pessoas, entre trabalhadores e seus familiares.

Nos últimos quatro anos, a associação passou por reestruturação, incluindo investimentos em melhorias de infraestrutura e aquisição de equipamentos, além de capacitações e assessorias técnicas.

Como resultados, a Aserbac passou de dois para oito associados e registrou aumento da renda média em 45%. No ano passado, a associação processou e comercializou 451 toneladas de materiais recicláveis, reduzindo o impacto em aterro sanitário e gerando uma economia de custo evitado para aterramento de cerca de R$ 100 mil. O Projeto Reciclo Agora é executado no município dentro do Plano de Compensação de Barão de Cocais e fomenta a economia circular e o desenvolvimento socioeconômico.

O acordo, que também conta com a participação de outras seis mineradoras que atuam na região, abrange a limpeza e conservação de nove vias municipais e um trecho da rodovia MG-436, na altura do trevo de acesso à cidade. A Vale é a principal patrocinadora da iniciativa, sendo responsável pela doação voluntária de cerca de 60% do montante.

O contrato tem vigência de um ano e prevê varrição mecanizada e manual, lavagem e umidificação das vias com caminhão-pipa, poda, capina, limpeza de placas de sinalização e do sistema de drenagem. As atividades serão realizadas com sinalização adequada e acompanhamento técnico.

A ACIABAC será responsável pela contratação, acompanhamento e gestão da empresa que executará o serviço. A fiscalização ficará sob responsabilidade da Prefeitura.

Programa de reciclagem

A Vale realiza, desde 2022, o projeto Reciclo Agora no município, fortalecendo a gestão, infraestrutura e capacitação da Associação de Catadores de Materiais Recicláveis de Barão de Cocais (Aserbac), contemplando 32 pessoas, entre trabalhadores e seus familiares.

Nos últimos quatro anos, a associação passou por reestruturação, incluindo investimentos em melhorias de infraestrutura e aquisição de equipamentos, além de capacitações e assessorias técnicas.

Como resultados, a Aserbac passou de dois para oito associados e registrou aumento da renda média em 45%. No ano passado, a associação processou e comercializou 451 toneladas de materiais recicláveis, reduzindo o impacto em aterro sanitário e gerando uma economia de custo evitado para aterramento de cerca de R$ 100 mil. O Projeto Reciclo Agora é executado no município dentro do Plano de Compensação de Barão de Cocais e fomenta a economia circular e o desenvolvimento socioeconômico.

en.title: Maravilhas II Dam, in Itabirito (MG), has emergency level removed
en.subtitle: The removal of the emergency level follows the completion of reinforcement work in October 2025, which improved stability conditions and met the standards required by legislation.
en.body:
The Maravilhas II dam, in Itabirito, had the emergency level removed by the National Mining Agency (ANM), last Friday, January 09. The structure was at level 1 and has now received a positive Stability Condition Statement (DCE), the technical document attesting to the structure’s safety.

The removal of the emergency level follows the completion of reinforcement work in October 2025, which improved stability conditions and met the standards required by legislation.

 
                                              Maravilhas II Dam, in Itabirito (MG), had its emergency level removed by the ANM. Source: Vale.

Advances in Dam Safety

Maravilhas II is the 23rd Vale-operated structure to exit an emergency level since 2022. In 2025 alone, five structures in Minas Gerais had their emergency levels removed: Grupo, B6 of MAC, Dicão Leste, Doutor, and Vargem Grande. Additionally, two dams had their emergency levels reduced: Xingu, downgraded to Level 1, and Forquilha III, downgraded to Level 2—both of which are also located in Minas Gerais.

“We have fulfilled our commitment to have no dams at the maximum emergency level by 2025 and continue to strengthen people’s safety and environmental protection. Today, all of our tailings structures comply with the Global Industry Standard on Tailings Management (GISTM), which is an international benchmark for best practices. Additionally, we will advance the Upstream Dam Decharacterization Program this year, reaffirming our commitment to ensuring increasingly safe and sustainable structures,” said Rafael Bittar, Vale’s Technical Vice President.

Vale permanently maintains control and monitoring measures for its geotechnical structures 24/7 through its Geotechnical Monitoring Centers.

en.title: Maravilhas III Dam: December Updates
en.subtitle: Positive Stability Declaration and Continuous 24/7 Monitoring Ensure Safety at Maravilhas III Dam
en.body:
Maravilhas III Dam, located in Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, maintained its proper conservation status in December 2025.  
To monitor the geotechnical performance of the structure, we rely on the support of an external company, the Engineer of Record (EdR). The Geotechnical Performance Assessment Report prepared by the EdR for December indicates that, based on data obtained through monitoring and visual inspections, the dam is performing within normal conditions. In addition, the geotechnical instruments are operating within the expected parameters, and the safety factors obtained in the stability analyses continue to meet the minimum requirements established by current legislation.

The works of the second stage of the dam’s embankment were halted in October, with plans to resume in April, after the rainy season. During the rainy months, the structure will maintain a minimum set of equipment to ensure support if needed. In December, adjustments were made to surface drainage and access routes to preserve the conservation status.

Maravilhas III Dam maintains a positive Stability Condition Declaration (DCE), with no alert or emergency level. The dam continues to be monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by the Geotechnical Monitoring Center (CMG).

en.title: Barragem Maravilhas II, em Itabirito, tem nível de emergência encerrado
en.subtitle: Obras de reforço elevaram a segurança da estrutura
en.body:
A barragem Maravilhas II, localizada na Mina do Pico, em Itabirito (MG), teve o nível de emergência encerrado pela Agência Nacional de Mineração (ANM) na última sexta-feira, 9 de janeiro. A estrutura estava em nível 1 e agora recebeu a Declaração de Condição de Estabilidade (DCE) positiva, documento técnico que atesta a segurança da estrutura.

O encerramento do nível de emergência é resultado das obras de reforço concluídas em outubro de 2025, que aprimoraram as condições de estabilidade em conformidade com os requisitos normativos previstos na legislação.

Barragem Maravilhas ll, em Itabirito (MG), teve seu nível de emergência encerrado pela ANM. Divulgação Vale
 

Avanços na segurança de barragens

A barragem Maravilhas II é a 23ª estrutura da empresa a sair do nível de emergência desde 2022. Somente no ano passado, cinco estruturas tiveram o nível encerrado em Minas Gerais: barragens Grupo, B6 da MAC, Dicão Leste, Doutor e Vargem Grande. Além disso, duas barragens tiveram redução de nível: Xingu passou para nível 1 e Forquilha III para nível 2, ambas no Estado.

“Cumprimos nosso compromisso de não ter mais nenhuma barragem em nível máximo de emergência em 2025 e seguimos reforçando a segurança das pessoas e a proteção do meio ambiente. Hoje, todas as nossas estruturas de rejeitos estão aderentes ao Padrão Global da Indústria para Gestão de Rejeitos (GISTM), referência internacional em boas práticas. Além disso, continuaremos avançando, neste ano, no Programa de Descaracterização de Barragens a Montante, reafirmando nossa prioridade absoluta: garantir estruturas cada vez mais seguras e sustentáveis”, destaca Rafael Bittar, vice-presidente Técnico da Vale.

A Vale mantém, de forma permanente, medidas de controle e monitoramento das estruturas geotécnicas, 24 horas por dia, sete dias por semana, por meio dos Centros de Monitoramento Geotécnico.

en.title: National K3 Month 2026 Officially Kicks Off: PT Vale Reinforces Safety as a Top Priority and Shared Responsibility
en.subtitle: Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) is more than a legal requirement—it’s a culture that must be embedded in every aspect of the mining industry. For PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) group, OHS stands as the cornerstone of its operations. This commitment aligns with the company’s core values, CARES, particularly the principle of Accountability—taking full responsibility to ensure the safety of every individual.
en.body:
Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) is more than a legal requirement—it’s a culture that must be embedded in every aspect of the mining industry. For PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) group, OHS stands as the cornerstone of its operations. This commitment aligns with the company’s core values, CARES, particularly the principle of Accountability—taking full responsibility to ensure the safety of every individual.

As a tangible expression of this commitment, PT Vale has once again celebrated the Occupational Health and Safety (K3) Month. As in previous years, the program officially began with an opening ceremony at the Main Office in Plant Site, Sorowako on Monday, January 12, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. local time. The event was organized by the Health, Safety, Operational Risk, Environment, and Sustainability Operations (HSSER) Department and forms part of the implementation of regulations set by Indonesia’s Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM).

According to the ESDM circular, the theme for the 2026 National Safety Month is: “Building a Professional, Reliable, and Collaborative OHS Management Ecosystem.” This theme underscores that effective OHS management requires competency-based professionalism, robust systems, and strong collaboration among all stakeholders.

The Regent of East Luwu, Irwan Bachri Syam, who served as the ceremony’s inspector, emphasized that K3 Month is not merely ceremonial—it is a moment to strengthen collective commitment to creating safe, healthy, and productive workplaces.

“Occupational health and safety is the foundation of business continuity, worker protection, and corporate competitiveness,” Irwan stated.

He reminded attendees that every workplace accident is not just a statistic—it impacts human lives and families. Accidents, he said, are signals to continuously improve systems, behaviors, and workplace culture.

Closing his remarks, Irwan stressed that OHS must become a value and a culture, not just compliance with regulations.

“Safety is a shared responsibility—management, workers, partners, and all stakeholders,” he added.

Strengthening Safety Culture Through Action

National K3 Month will run for a full month, from January 12 to February 12, 2026. As highlighted by Yung Fajar Riyadi, Senior Coordinator for EHS Improvement, PT Vale has prepared a series of activities to reinforce safety culture, including:

  • Safety Talks and OHS outreach at four schools in PT Vale’s community development areas
  • Volleyball tournaments to foster teamwork
  • Health campaigns to raise wellness awareness
  • Safety Dojo Challenge to test safety skills
  • Open Water Exhibition at Lake Matano for water safety education
  • Fun Walk promoting a healthy lifestyle

All activities comply with regulations, including:

  • Ministerial Regulation No. 26/2018 on Good Mining Practices
  • Ministerial Decree No. 1827K/30/MEM/2018 on Technical Mining Guidelines
  • Directorate General Decree No. 185.K/37.04/DJB/2019 on Mining Safety Management Systems

Workplace safety is not just about today—it’s about ensuring every worker arrives healthy, works enthusiastically, and returns home safely. National K3 Month 2026 is a key moment to strengthen safety culture in East Luwu, particularly across PT Vale’s operations, for the sustainability of the company and the well-being of the community.

Productivity and safety must go hand in hand—just as PT Vale’s slogan says: Safety Yes, Production Yes, Productivity Yes.

id.title: Bulan K3 Nasional Pertambangan 2026 Resmi Dimulai: PT Vale Tegaskan Keselamatan sebagai Prioritas Utama dan Tanggung Jawab Bersama
id.subtitle: Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) bukan sekadar kewajiban, melainkan budaya yang harus tertanam dalam setiap aktivitas industri pertambangan. Bagi PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup Mining Industry (MIND ID), K3 adalah prioritas utama yang menjadi landasan operasional perusahaan. Komitmen ini sejalan dengan nilai perusahaan, CARES, khususnya prinsip Accountability—tanggung jawab penuh untuk memastikan keselamatan setiap insan.
id.body:
Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) bukan sekadar kewajiban, melainkan budaya yang harus tertanam dalam setiap aktivitas industri pertambangan. Bagi PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup Mining Industry (MIND ID), K3 adalah prioritas utama yang menjadi landasan operasional perusahaan. Komitmen ini sejalan dengan nilai perusahaan, CARES, khususnya prinsip Accountability—tanggung jawab penuh untuk memastikan keselamatan setiap insan.

Sebagai wujud nyata komitmen tersebut, PT Vale kembali menggelar Bulan K3 Nasional Pertambangan. Seperti tahun-tahun sebelumnya, rangkaian kegiatan resmi dimulai dengan upacara pembukaan di Main Office Plant Site, Sorowako, pada Senin (12/1/2026) pukul 08.00 WITA. Acara ini diselengarakan oleh Departemen Health, Safety, Operational Risk, Environment, and Sustainability Operations (HSSER) dan menjadi bagian dari implementasi regulasi Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM).

Mengacu pada edaran Kementerian ESDM, tema Bulan K3 Nasional 2026 adalah: “Membangun Ekosistem Pengelolaan K3 yang Profesional, Andal, dan Kolaboratif.” Tema ini menegaskan bahwa pengelolaan K3 membutuhkan profesionalisme berbasis kompetensi, sistem yang andal, serta kolaborasi kuat antara seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

Bupati Luwu Timur, Irwan Bachri Syam, yang bertindak sebagai pembina upacara, menekankan bahwa Bulan K3 bukan hanya seremonial, melainkan momentum untuk memperkuat komitmen bersama menciptakan tempat kerja yang aman, sehat, dan produktif.

“Keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja adalah fondasi utama keberlangsungan usaha, perlindungan pekerja, serta daya saing perusahaan,” ujar Irwan.

Ia juga mengingatkan bahwa setiap kecelakaan kerja bukan sekadar angka statistik, tetapi menyangkut keselamatan manusia dan keberlangsungan keluarga. Menurutnya, kecelakaan kerja adalah sinyal untuk terus memperbaiki sistem, perilaku, dan budaya kerja.

Menutup sambutannya, Irwan menegaskan bahwa penerapan K3 harus menjadi nilai dan budaya, bukan sekadar kepatuhan terhadap aturan.

“K3 adalah tanggung jawab bersama—manajemen, pekerja, mitra kerja, dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan,” tambahnya.

Menguatkan Budaya K3 Lewat Berbagai Aktivitas
Bulan K3 Nasional Pertambangan akan berlangsung selama satu bulan penuh, mulai 12 Januari hingga 12 Februari 2026. Seperti disampaikan oleh Senior Coordinator EHS Improvement, Yung Fajar Riyadi dalam upacara pembukaan, PT Vale telah merancang berbagai kegiatan untuk memperkuat budaya K3, antara lain:

  • Safety Talk dan Sosialisasi K3L di empat sekolah di wilayah pemberdayaan PT Vale
  • Pertandingan Bola Voli untuk mempererat kebersamaan
  • Health Campaign guna meningkatkan kesadaran kesehatan
  • Safety Dojo Challenge untuk menguji keterampilan keselamatan
  • Open Water Exhibition di Danau Matano sebagai edukasi keselamatan di perairan
  • Fun Walk untuk mempromosikan gaya hidup sehat

Seluruh rangkaian ini dilaksanakan sesuai amanat regulasi, yaitu: Peraturan Menteri ESDM Nomor 26 Tahun 2018 tentang Pelaksanaan Kaidah Pertambangan yang Baik dan Pengawasan Pertambangan Mineral dan Batubara, Lampiran III Keputusan Menteri ESDM Nomor 1827K/30/MEM/2018 tentang Pedoman Pelaksanaan Kaidah Teknik Pertambangan yang Baik, serta Keputusan Dirjen Minerba Nomor 185.K/37.04/DJB/2019 tentang Petunjuk Teknis Pelaksanaan Keselamatan Pertambangan dan Pelaksanaan, Penilaian, dan Pelaporan Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Pertambangan Mineral dan Batubara.

Keselamatan kerja bukan hanya tentang hari ini, tetapi selalu memastikan setiap pekerja datang sehat, bekerja semangat, dan pulang selamat. Bulan K3 Nasional 2026 adalah momentum untuk memperkuat budaya K3 di Luwu Timur, khususnya di area operasi PT Vale, demi keberlanjutan perusahaan dan kesejahteraan masyarakat. 

Produktivitas dan keselamatan harus berjalan beriringan, seperti slogan perusahaan: Safety Yes, Production Yes, Productivity Yes.

en.title: Advancing Sustainable Food Security: PT Vale-Supported Farmers Harvest Feed Corn in Tondowolio
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID), continues to demonstrate its commitment to sustainable development and community empowerment through its Community Development and Empowerment Program (PPM) in operational areas. A tangible result of this commitment is the successful harvest of feed corn by PT Vale-supported farmers in Tondowolio Village, Kolaka Regency.
en.body:
Kolaka, Southeast Sulawesi, January 8, 2026 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID), continues to demonstrate its commitment to sustainable development and community empowerment through its Community Development and Empowerment Program (PPM) in operational areas. A tangible result of this commitment is the successful harvest of feed corn by PT Vale-supported farmers in Tondowolio Village, Kolaka Regency.

The harvest, carried out by the Padaidi Farmers Group in Tondowolio Village, Tanggetada District, marks a significant step in boosting local agricultural productivity and strengthening community-based food security. This program is designed to promote farmers’ economic independence through sustainable agriculture, leveraging untapped local potential.

This achievement also reflects the transformation of idle land into productive farmland. Land that had been unused for years now generates economic value for the community, thanks to continuous support and collaboration between the company, village authorities, and local farmer groups.

Tondowolio Village Head, Asmanuddin, explained that the farmland currently managed by the Padaidi Farmers Group was initially opened in 2015 with an area of about 27 hectares but was later abandoned.

 
 

"Thankfully, since last year, this land’s potential has been revitalized. Of the total 27 hectares spread across four hamlets, about 5 hectares have been planted with feed corn. Today’s harvest is proof of the revival of farmer group-based agriculture in our village," he said.

Meanwhile, Baharuddin, Chairman of the Padaidi Farmers Group, shared that the harvest shows promising productivity—around 6 to 7 tons per hectare. Formed in November 2023, the group consists of 22 members and continues to expand its planting area.

"In addition to good yields, feed corn prices in Kolaka are quite competitive, ranging from IDR 5,000 to IDR 6,000 per kilogram. This is a strong motivation for us to keep developing sustainable agriculture," he added.

Endra Kusuma, Head of External Regional and Growth at PT Vale, emphasized that this success is part of PT Vale’s PPM implementation, focusing on strengthening the economic capacity of communities around its operational areas.

"This program is a concrete manifestation of PT Vale’s support for empowering farmers by utilizing local potential. We believe that community economic independence is a critical foundation for sustainable development," Endra stated.

He added that PT Vale remains committed to working closely with village governments and community groups to develop agriculture as a pillar of local economic resilience, aligned with the company’s principles of sustainability and inclusivity.

Through the PPM program under PT Vale Indonesia Tbk’s IGP Pomalaa project, the company aims to create long-term impacts for communities—not only by improving agricultural productivity but also by revitalizing idle land as a new economic resource. Multi-stakeholder collaboration is key to achieving inclusive, resilient, and sustainable development in Kolaka.

id.title: Wujudkan Ketahanan Pangan Berkelanjutan, Petani Binaan PT Vale Panen Jagung Pakan di Tondowolio
id.subtitle: Komitmen terhadap pembangunan berkelanjutan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat terus diwujudkan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari Mining Industrt (MINDID), melalui pelaksanaan Program Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM) di wilayah operasionalnya. Salah satu hasil nyata dari komitmen tersebut ditunjukkan melalui keberhasilan panen jagung pakan oleh petani binaan di Desa Tondowolio, Kabupaten Kolaka.
id.body:
Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara, 8 Januari 2026 — Komitmen terhadap pembangunan berkelanjutan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat terus diwujudkan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari Mining Industrt (MINDID), melalui pelaksanaan Program Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM) di wilayah operasionalnya. Salah satu hasil nyata dari komitmen tersebut ditunjukkan melalui keberhasilan panen jagung pakan oleh petani binaan di Desa Tondowolio, Kabupaten Kolaka.

Panen jagung pakan yang dilaksanakan oleh Kelompok Tani Padaidi di Desa Tondowolio, Kecamatan Tanggetada, menandai peningkatan produktivitas pertanian lokal sekaligus penguatan ketahanan pangan berbasis komunitas. Program ini dirancang untuk mendorong kemandirian ekonomi petani melalui pertanian berkelanjutan, dengan memanfaatkan potensi lokal yang sebelumnya belum tergarap secara optimal.

Keberhasilan panen ini juga mencerminkan transformasi lahan tidur menjadi lahan produktif. Lahan yang selama bertahun-tahun tidak dimanfaatkan kini kembali menghasilkan nilai ekonomi bagi masyarakat, berkat pendampingan berkelanjutan dan kolaborasi antara perusahaan, pemerintah desa, serta kelompok tani setempat.

Kepala Desa Tondowolio, Asmanuddin, menjelaskan bahwa lahan pertanian yang saat ini dikelola Kelompok Tani Padaidi sebelumnya sempat dibuka pada 2015 dengan luas sekitar 27 hektare, namun tidak berlanjut dan terbengkalai. “Alhamdulillah, sejak tahun lalu potensi lahan ini kembali dimanfaatkan. Dari total 27 hektare yang tersebar di empat dusun, sekitar 5 hektare telah ditanami jagung pakan. Panen hari ini menjadi bukti kebangkitan pertanian berbasis kelompok tani di desa kami,” ujarnya.

Sementara itu, Ketua Kelompok Tani Padaidi, Baharuddin, menyampaikan bahwa hasil panen menunjukkan produktivitas yang menjanjikan, yakni sekitar 6 hingga 7 ton per hektare. Kelompok tani yang terbentuk pada November 2023 ini beranggotakan 22 orang dan terus didorong untuk memperluas area tanam.
“Selain hasil panen yang baik, harga jagung pakan di Kolaka juga cukup kompetitif, berkisar antara Rp5.000 hingga Rp6.000 per kilogram. Ini menjadi motivasi kuat bagi kami untuk terus mengembangkan pertanian secara berkelanjutan,” jelasnya.
 

 
 

Head of External Regional and Growth PT Vale, Endra Kusuma, menegaskan bahwa keberhasilan ini merupakan bagian dari implementasi Program PPM PT Vale yang berfokus pada penguatan kapasitas ekonomi masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasional perusahaan.

“Program ini merupakan wujud dukungan nyata PT Vale dalam mendorong pemberdayaan petani melalui pemanfaatan potensi lokal. Kami percaya bahwa kemandirian ekonomi masyarakat adalah fondasi penting bagi pembangunan yang berkelanjutan,” ujar Endra.

Ia menambahkan bahwa PT Vale berkomitmen untuk terus bersinergi dengan pemerintah desa dan kelompok masyarakat dalam mengembangkan sektor pertanian sebagai salah satu pilar penguatan ekonomi lokal, sejalan dengan prinsip keberlanjutan dan inklusivitas yang menjadi bagian dari strategi perusahaan.

Melalui Program PPM PT Vale Indonesia Tbk IGP Pomalaa, perusahaan menargetkan terciptanya dampak jangka panjang bagi masyarakat, tidak hanya melalui peningkatan produktivitas pertanian, tetapi juga melalui penghidupan kembali lahan-lahan tidur sebagai sumber ekonomi baru. Kolaborasi lintas pemangku kepentingan menjadi kunci dalam mewujudkan pembangunan yang inklusif, tangguh, dan berkelanjutan di wilayah Kolaka.

en.title: Solidarity for Sumatra: PT Vale Indonesia and Luwu Timur Government Stand Together to Support Disaster-Affected Communities
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) group, together with the Luwu Timur Regency Government, acted swiftly to deliver humanitarian aid to communities impacted by flash floods in Aceh Tamiang Regency. Through cross-regional collaboration and a spirit of national solidarity, relief was distributed to three affected villages—Menanggini, Alur Jambu, and Kebun Tanjung Seumantoh—each receiving a truckload of essential family supplies, hygiene kits, and emergency response equipment to support recovery and environmental cleanup. This initiative reflects the tangible commitment of business and local government to ensure that no community faces hardship alone.
en.body:
Aceh, January 5, 2026 — When hydrometeorological disasters strike Sumatra, disrupting the lives of thousands of families, what matters most is presence and compassion. PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) group, together with the Luwu Timur Regency Government, acted swiftly to deliver humanitarian aid to communities impacted by flash floods in Aceh Tamiang Regency. Through cross-regional collaboration and a spirit of national solidarity, relief was distributed to three affected villages—Menanggini, Alur Jambu, and Kebun Tanjung Seumantoh—each receiving a truckload of essential family supplies, hygiene kits, and emergency response equipment to support recovery and environmental cleanup. This initiative reflects the tangible commitment of business and local government to ensure that no community faces hardship alone.

Disasters leave more than physical damage—they pose immediate risks to health, sanitation, and safety. Responding to these urgent needs, the aid included Family Hygiene Kits and essential household items, along with bedding, cooking utensils, health protection supplies, and critical equipment such as fogging machines, chainsaws, and water sprayers to assist in cleaning affected areas. This support is designed to help communities restore basic living conditions quickly and with dignity.

Yusri Yunus, Head of External Relations for Sorowako & Outer Area at PT Vale Indonesia, emphasized that this humanitarian effort is part of the company’s commitment to strengthening social resilience. “The disaster in Sumatra is a shared sorrow. In these challenging times, we want to ensure that affected communities do not struggle alone. Our presence and care represent solidarity and a humanitarian commitment to stand together,” said Yusri. He added that this action aligns with PT Vale’s core CARES values, which underpin its responsible and sustainable business practices.

The aid was personally delivered by Luwu Timur Regent Ir. H. Irwan Bachri Syam, accompanied by the Chair of the Luwu Timur Family Welfare Movement (TP PKK) and member of the South Sulawesi Provincial Parliament, Dr. Ani Nurbani, to residents in Aceh Tamiang on Sunday, January 4, 2026. In addition to logistics, the Luwu Timur Government deployed medical teams to provide health checks and free treatment for affected communities. “From day one, we responded by sending medical personnel and volunteers to Aceh Tamiang. This is an expression of empathy from the people of Luwu Timur for our brothers and sisters in need,” said Regent Irwan.

This humanitarian initiative aligns with the government’s agenda to strengthen national disaster resilience, enhance social protection, and ensure the presence of the state and all stakeholders during crises. PT Vale views collaboration with local governments as a vital part of a coordinated, inclusive, and sustainable disaster response, reinforcing public trust in the synergy between government, business, and society.

Looking ahead, PT Vale remains committed to working hand-in-hand with government and stakeholders to deliver long-term benefits for communities—not only in times of emergency but also in building stronger, healthier, and more empowered societies. With humility and a spirit of solidarity, PT Vale believes that from every challenge, Indonesia can rise stronger and move forward together toward a more inclusive and sustainable future.

id.title: Solidaritas untuk Sumatra: PT Vale Indonesia dan Pemkab Luwu Timur Hadir, Bergerak, dan Menguatkan Masyarakat Terdampak Bencana
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup Mining Industry (MIND ID), bersama Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Timur bergerak cepat menyalurkan bantuan kemanusiaan bagi masyarakat terdampak banjir bandang di Kabupaten Aceh Tamiang. Melalui kolaborasi lintas daerah dan semangat gotong royong nasional, bantuan disalurkan ke tiga desa terdampak; Desa Menanggini, Desa Alur Jambu, dan Desa Kebun Tanjung Seumantoh, masing-masing dengan satu truk bantuan berisi paket kebutuhan dasar keluarga, perlengkapan kebersihan, serta peralatan pendukung tanggap darurat dan pemulihan lingkungan. Aksi ini merupakan wujud nyata kehadiran dunia usaha dan pemerintah daerah dalam memastikan masyarakat tidak menghadapi masa sulit ini sendirian.
id.body:
Aceh, 05 Januari 2026 — Ketika bencana hidrometeorologi melanda Sumatra dan mengguncang kehidupan ribuan keluarga, kepedulian dan kehadiran menjadi hal yang paling dibutuhkan. PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup Mining Industry (MIND ID), bersama Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Timur bergerak cepat menyalurkan bantuan kemanusiaan bagi masyarakat terdampak banjir bandang di Kabupaten Aceh Tamiang. Melalui kolaborasi lintas daerah dan semangat gotong royong nasional, bantuan disalurkan ke tiga desa terdampak; Desa Menanggini, Desa Alur Jambu, dan Desa Kebun Tanjung Seumantoh, masing-masing dengan satu truk bantuan berisi paket kebutuhan dasar keluarga, perlengkapan kebersihan, serta peralatan pendukung tanggap darurat dan pemulihan lingkungan. Aksi ini merupakan wujud nyata kehadiran dunia usaha dan pemerintah daerah dalam memastikan masyarakat tidak menghadapi masa sulit ini sendirian.

Bencana tidak hanya meninggalkan kerusakan fisik, tetapi juga risiko kesehatan, sanitasi, dan keselamatan yang harus segera ditangani. Menjawab kebutuhan tersebut, bantuan yang disalurkan mencakup paket Family Hygiene Kit dan kebutuhan rumah tangga esensial, dilengkapi perlengkapan tidur, alat makan dan masak, perlindungan kesehatan, serta peralatan pendukung seperti alat fogging, mesin chainsaw, dan mesin penyemprot air untuk membantu pembersihan wilayah terdampak. Dukungan ini dirancang untuk membantu masyarakat memulihkan kembali kondisi dasar kehidupan sehari-hari secara cepat dan bermartabat.

Head of External Relation Sorowako & Outer Area PT Vale Indonesia, Yusri Yunus, menegaskan bahwa dukungan kemanusiaan ini merupakan bagian dari komitmen perusahaan untuk berperan aktif dalam memperkuat ketahanan sosial masyarakat. “Bencana yang terjadi di Sumatra merupakan duka kita bersama. Di tengah situasi sulit ini, kami ingin memastikan bahwa masyarakat terdampak tidak berjuang sendiri. Kehadiran dan kepedulian kami adalah wujud solidaritas dan komitmen kemanusiaan untuk saling menguatkan,” ujar Yusri. Ia menambahkan bahwa aksi ini sejalan dengan nilai-nilai CARES yang menjadi fondasi PT Vale dalam menjalankan bisnis yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan.

Penyaluran bantuan dilakukan langsung oleh Bupati Luwu Timur, Ir. H. Irwan Bachri Syam, bersama Ketua TP PKK Luwu Timur sekaligus anggota DPRD Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan, dr. Ani Nurbani, kepada warga terdampak di Aceh Tamiang pada Minggu, 4 Januari 2026. Selain logistik, Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Timur juga mengerahkan tim medis untuk pemeriksaan kesehatan dan pengobatan gratis bagi masyarakat. “Sejak hari pertama bencana, kami langsung merespons dengan mengirimkan tenaga medis dan relawan ke Aceh Tamiang. Ini adalah bentuk empati masyarakat Luwu Timur atas musibah yang dialami saudara-saudara kita,” ungkap Bupati Irwan.

Aksi kemanusiaan ini selaras dengan agenda pemerintah dalam memperkuat ketahanan bencana nasional, meningkatkan perlindungan sosial, serta memastikan kehadiran negara dan seluruh elemen bangsa di tengah krisis. PT Vale memandang kolaborasi dengan pemerintah daerah sebagai bagian penting dari upaya bersama untuk mendukung penanganan bencana yang terkoordinasi, inklusif, dan berkelanjutan, sekaligus memperkuat kepercayaan publik terhadap sinergi antara negara, dunia usaha, dan masyarakat.

Ke depan, PT Vale berkomitmen untuk terus berjalan bersama pemerintah dan para pemangku kepentingan dalam menghadirkan manfaat jangka panjang bagi masyarakat. Tidak hanya dalam situasi darurat, tetapi juga dalam membangun komunitas yang lebih tangguh, sehat, dan berdaya. Dengan semangat gotong royong dan kerendahan hati, PT Vale percaya bahwa dari setiap ujian, bangsa ini dapat bangkit lebih kuat dan melangkah bersama menuju masa depan Indonesia yang lebih inklusif dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: MIND ID Director Commends PT Vale’s Nickel Downstream Project Management in Pomalaa as HPAL Progress Accelerates
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) continues to demonstrate its strong commitment to sustainable development of Indonesia’s nickel downstream industry through disciplined, measured, and long-term governance practices at the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) in Pomalaa. During an on-site visit to the Indonesia Pomalaa Industrial Park (IPIP), the Director of Downstream Strategy and Minerals at Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) praised PT Vale’s tangible progress in building its downstream facilities, as well as the company’s prudent approach to managing this national strategic project in alignment with safety, environmental protection, and investment continuity principles.
en.body:
Pomalaa, January 2, 2025 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) continues to demonstrate its strong commitment to sustainable development of Indonesia’s nickel downstream industry through disciplined, measured, and long-term governance practices at the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) in Pomalaa. During an on-site visit to the Indonesia Pomalaa Industrial Park (IPIP), the Director of Downstream Strategy and Minerals at Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) praised PT Vale’s tangible progress in building its downstream facilities, as well as the company’s prudent approach to managing this national strategic project in alignment with safety, environmental protection, and investment continuity principles.

The visit included inspections of the Kolaka Nickel Indonesia (KNI) port and the construction site of the High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) plant in Pomalaa. Key facilities and supporting infrastructure are already in place, including initial process structures, utility systems, and integrated logistics connected to the port. These milestones reflect the project’s technical readiness to advance to the next development phase responsibly.

Tedy Badrujaman, MIND ID’s Director of Downstream Strategy and Minerals, expressed appreciation for the accelerated progress of PT Vale’s HPAL facility, noting significant achievements within a relatively short timeframe. “I’m quite impressed by the development of the HPAL plant. A few months ago, progress was minimal, but now several major components are already installed. In less than a year, the project is nearly halfway complete,” said Tedy.

He emphasized the strategic importance of PT Vale’s HPAL project in optimizing the use of limonite nickel ore, which has historically been underutilized. From equipment readiness to the quality of partnerships, the project reflects well-structured and comprehensive planning. “PT Vale has substantial nickel reserves, especially limonite. From what I’ve seen, the preparation in terms of equipment and partners is excellent. I’m confident this project will be completed on target,” he added.

Beyond physical progress, Tedy also commended PT Vale’s consistency in applying good mining practices and strict compliance with regulations. The company’s cautious approach, including measured administrative processes, was recognized as a hallmark of strong and responsible governance. “PT Vale is known for its commitment to good mining practices. Its adherence to regulations, including halting activities when permits are incomplete, is a commendable demonstration of responsibility,” he noted.

The Pomalaa downstream project represents a long-term strategic investment designed to create national added value, strengthen the nickel-based industrial supply chain, and drive sustainable economic growth at both regional and national levels. Every stage of development is aligned with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles and international safety and governance standards.

Looking ahead, PT Vale remains committed to balancing project acceleration, regulatory compliance, and disciplined risk management as part of its mission to build a globally competitive and sustainable nickel industry in Indonesia.

id.title: Direktur MIND ID Apresiasi Pengelolaan Proyek Hilirisasi PT Vale di Pomalaa, Progres HPAL Terus Menguat
id.subtitle: Komitmen PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) dalam menjaga keberlanjutan pengembangan proyek hilirisasi nikel di Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa ditunjukkan melalui penerapan tata kelola yang disiplin, terukur, dan berorientasi jangka panjang. Dalam kunjungan langsung ke kawasan Indonesia Pomalaa Industrial Park (IPIP), Direktur Strategi Hilirisasi dan Mineral Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) mengapresiasi kemajuan nyata pembangunan fasilitas hilirisasi PT Vale, sekaligus pendekatan kehati-hatian Perseroan dalam mengelola proyek strategis nasional agar tetap selaras dengan prinsip keselamatan, perlindungan lingkungan, dan kesinambungan investasi.
id.body:
Pomalaa, 2 Januari 2025 — Komitmen PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) dalam menjaga keberlanjutan pengembangan proyek hilirisasi nikel di Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa ditunjukkan melalui penerapan tata kelola yang disiplin, terukur, dan berorientasi jangka panjang. Dalam kunjungan langsung ke kawasan Indonesia Pomalaa Industrial Park (IPIP), Direktur Strategi Hilirisasi dan Mineral Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID) mengapresiasi kemajuan nyata pembangunan fasilitas hilirisasi PT Vale, sekaligus pendekatan kehati-hatian Perseroan dalam mengelola proyek strategis nasional agar tetap selaras dengan prinsip keselamatan, perlindungan lingkungan, dan kesinambungan investasi.

Kunjungan tersebut dilakukan dengan meninjau Port Kolaka Nickel Indonesia (KNI) dan area pembangunan pabrik High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) di Pomalaa. Hingga saat ini, sejumlah fasilitas utama dan infrastruktur pendukung telah berdiri dan terpasang, termasuk struktur awal proses, utilitas pendukung, serta sistem logistik yang terintegrasi dengan pelabuhan. Capaian ini mencerminkan kesiapan teknis proyek untuk melanjutkan tahapan pengembangan berikutnya secara bertanggung jawab.

Direktur Strategi Hilirisasi dan Mineral MIND ID, Tedy Badrujaman, menyampaikan apresiasi atas percepatan pembangunan fasilitas HPAL PT Vale yang dinilainya menunjukkan kemajuan signifikan dalam waktu relatif singkat. “Saya cukup surprise melihat perkembangan pembangunan pabrik HPAL ini. Beberapa bulan lalu belum terlihat signifikan, sekarang sudah berdiri beberapa peralatan. Dalam waktu kurang dari setahun, progresnya sudah mendekati setengah,” ujar Tedy.

Menurutnya, proyek HPAL PT Vale di Pomalaa memiliki arti strategis bagi Indonesia, khususnya dalam mengoptimalkan pemanfaatan bijih nikel limonite yang selama ini belum dimanfaatkan secara maksimal. Dari sisi kesiapan peralatan dan kualitas kemitraan yang dibangun, proyek ini dinilai menunjukkan perencanaan yang matang dan terstruktur. “PT Vale memiliki cadangan nikel yang sangat besar, terutama limonite. Dari sisi peralatan dan mitra, saya melihat persiapannya sangat baik. Saya optimistis proyek ini dapat diselesaikan sesuai target,” tambahnya.

Selain meninjau progres fisik proyek, Tedy juga mengapresiasi konsistensi PT Vale dalam menerapkan praktik pertambangan yang baik (good mining practices) serta disiplin kepatuhan terhadap ketentuan yang berlaku. Pendekatan kehati-hatian yang diterapkan Perseroan termasuk pengelolaan aktivitas secara terukur dalam fase administratif dinilai sebagai cerminan tata kelola yang kuat dan bertanggung jawab.
“PT Vale dikenal konsisten menerapkan praktik pertambangan yang baik. Kepatuhan terhadap aturan, termasuk penghentian sementara kegiatan saat perizinan belum lengkap, merupakan bentuk tanggung jawab yang patut diapresiasi,” ujarnya.

Proyek hilirisasi di IGP Pomalaa merupakan investasi strategis jangka panjang yang dirancang untuk menciptakan nilai tambah nasional, memperkuat rantai pasok industri berbasis nikel, serta mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi yang berkelanjutan di tingkat regional dan nasional. Seluruh tahapan pengembangan proyek dijalankan selaras dengan prinsip Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), serta standar keselamatan dan tata kelola yang berlaku secara internasional.

Ke depan, PT Vale akan terus menjaga keseimbangan antara percepatan pembangunan proyek, kepatuhan administratif, dan disiplin manajemen risiko, sebagai bagian dari komitmen PT Vale dalam membangun industri nikel Indonesia yang berdaya saing global dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: Empowering Local Agriculture: PT Vale’s Fertilizer Program Boosts Productivity and Resilience
en.subtitle: Ensuring sustainable agriculture and food security at the village level requires more than just hard work—it demands reliable access to essential resources. Among these, fertilizer plays a critical role in improving crop productivity and reducing production costs. Recognizing this need, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the MIND ID group, has distributed 617 sacks of Phonska Plus fertilizer to farmers in Huko-Huko Village.
en.body:
Kolaka, December 29, 2025 — Ensuring sustainable agriculture and food security at the village level requires more than just hard work—it demands reliable access to essential resources. Among these, fertilizer plays a critical role in improving crop productivity and reducing production costs. Recognizing this need, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the MIND ID group, has distributed 617 sacks of Phonska Plus fertilizer to farmers in Huko-Huko Village, Pomalaa.

This initiative is part of PT Vale’s broader commitment to supporting sustainable farming practices and strengthening local food security. By providing timely and appropriate fertilizer support, the program aims to help farmers increase yields, maintain crop quality, and reduce operational challenges.
The fertilizer allocation will cover 213 hectares of rice fields, which serve as the primary source of livelihood for the local community. This effort reflects PT Vale’s dedication to advancing sustainable development and improving rural resilience.

Sahabuddin, Head of Huko-Huko Village, expressed his appreciation for PT Vale’s contribution: “This fertilizer assistance is a huge help for our farmers, especially given the size of our rice fields. It motivates them to keep improving harvests and sustain agricultural productivity in the village,” he said.

Mohammad Rifai, Head of the Pomalaa Project, emphasized that supporting agriculture is part of PT Vale’s long-term vision to create lasting benefits for communities near its operational areas.

“We believe strong agriculture is a cornerstone of food security and community well-being. Through this program, PT Vale stands alongside farmers to ensure optimal and sustainable production,” Rifai stated.

The Acting Head of Kolaka’s Food Crops and Horticulture Agency, Deddy, also praised the initiative: “This program is highly impactful because it addresses one of the main challenges farmers face—fertilizer availability. With support like this, we expect agricultural productivity in Huko-Huko to rise and strengthen regional food security. We encourage continued collaboration to achieve sustainable farming,” he noted.

The distribution of Phonska Plus fertilizer forms part of PT Vale’s ongoing Community Development and Empowerment Program (PPM), implemented in partnership with local governments and farmer groups. This program aligns with efforts to promote rural economic independence and reinforce food security in areas surrounding PT Vale’s operations.

By supporting farmers in Huko-Huko, PT Vale reaffirms its role as a strategic partner to local governments in driving inclusive and sustainable economic growth.

id.title: Ketahanan Pangan Berkelanjutan Melalui Pemberian Pupuk: Strategi PT Vale Tingkat Produktivitas Pertanian dan Kesejahteraan Petani Huko-Huko
id.subtitle: Upaya menjaga keberlanjutan sektor pertanian dan ketahanan pangan desa dengan memastikan peningkatan  produktivitas  melalui ketersediaan pupuk menjadi hal penting. Keberadaan pupuk ditingkat petani tentunya harus senantiasa tersedia, sehingga tidak lagi ditemukan ada isu kelangkaan.  Menjawab kebutuhan tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) sebagai bagian dari MIND ID menyalurkan 617 sak pupuk Phonska Plus kepada petani di Desa Huko-Huko.
id.body:
Kolaka, 29 Desember 2025 — Upaya menjaga keberlanjutan sektor pertanian dan ketahanan pangan desa dengan memastikan peningkatan  produktivitas  melalui ketersediaan pupuk menjadi hal penting. Keberadaan pupuk ditingkat petani tentunya harus senantiasa tersedia, sehingga tidak lagi ditemukan ada isu kelangkaan.  Menjawab kebutuhan tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) sebagai bagian dari MIND ID menyalurkan 617 sak pupuk Phonska Plus kepada petani di Desa Huko-Huko.

Program ini dirancang sebagai bagian dari upaya PT Vale dalam mendukung pertanian berkelanjutan dan memperkuat ketahanan pangan lokal. Dengan dukungan pupuk yang tepat dan tepat waktu, petani diharapkan dapat meningkatkan produktivitas, menjaga kualitas hasil panen, serta menekan biaya produksi

Bantuan ini diperuntukkan bagi pengelolaan 213 hektare lahan persawahan, yang menjadi sumber penghidupan utama masyarakat desa setempat. Langkah ini mencerminkan komitmen perusahaan untuk mendukung pembangunan berkelanjutan dan memperkuat ketahanan pangan lokal.

Kepala Desa Huko-Huko Sahabuddin menyampaikan apresiasi atas perhatian dan dukungan yang diberikan PT Vale kepada para petani.
“Bantuan pupuk ini sangat membantu petani kami, terutama dalam memenuhi kebutuhan pupuk untuk lahan persawahan yang cukup luas. Dukungan ini memberikan semangat bagi petani untuk terus meningkatkan hasil panen dan menjaga keberlanjutan pertanian desa,” ujarnya.

Sementara itu, Mohammad Rifai, Head of Pomalaa Project menegaskan  dukungan terhadap sektor pertanian merupakan bagian dari komitmen perusahaan dalam menciptakan manfaat berkelanjutan bagi masyarakat sekitar wilayah operasional.

“Kami percaya bahwa pertanian yang kuat merupakan fondasi penting bagi ketahanan pangan dan kesejahteraan masyarakat. Melalui bantuan pupuk ini, PT Vale ingin hadir mendampingi petani agar dapat berproduksi secara optimal dan berkelanjutan,” ujar Rifai.

Plt Kepala Dinas Tanaman Pangan dan Hortikultura Kabupaten Kolaka, Deddy, turut memberikan apresiasi atas langkah PT Vale dalam mendukung sektor pertanian desa. “Program ini sangat positif karena membantu petani memenuhi kebutuhan pupuk yang selama ini menjadi kendala utama. Dengan adanya dukungan seperti ini, kami berharap produktivitas pertanian di Huko-Huko semakin meningkat dan mampu menjaga ketahanan pangan daerah. Kami juga mengajak seluruh pihak untuk terus berkolaborasi dalam mewujudkan pertanian yang berkelanjutan,” ungkapnya.

Penyaluran pupuk Phonska Plus ini merupakan bagian dari program Pengembangan dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat (PPM) yang dijalankan PT Vale secara berkelanjutan melalui kolaborasi dengan pemerintah desa dan kelompok tani. Program ini sejalan dengan upaya mendorong kemandirian ekonomi desa serta memperkuat ketahanan pangan di wilayah sekitar operasional perusahaan.

Dukungan kepada petani Desa Huko-Huko ini menjadikan peran PT Vale sebagai mitra strategis pemerintah daerah dalam mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi lokal yang inklusif dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: Promoting Sustainability Through Responsible Mining Operations: Morowali Regent and Police Chief Appreciate PT Vale’s Presence in Morowali
en.subtitle: Amid the rapid growth of the mining industry in Morowali Regency, environmental management remains a key issue that continues to receive significant attention. In this context, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the MIND ID group, through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali, has demonstrated real-world sustainable environmental management practices. This was directly observed by Morowali Regent Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf during a working visit to several operational areas of PT Vale in Morowali on Tuesday, 23 December 2025.
en.body:
Morowali, 24 December 2025 – Amid the rapid growth of the mining industry in Morowali Regency, environmental management remains a key issue that continues to receive significant attention. In this context, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the MIND ID group, through its Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali, has demonstrated real-world sustainable environmental management practices. This was directly observed by Morowali Regent Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf during a working visit to several operational areas of PT Vale in Morowali on Tuesday, 23 December 2025.

During the visit, the Regent, accompanied by local government officials, inspected the port and jetty areas, the operations control room, and the Rasyidah reclamation zone. The tour provided a comprehensive overview of PT Vale’s presence in Morowali, covering logistics activities through to environmental management in post-mining areas.

Morowali Regent Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf expressed appreciation for PT Vale’s environmental management efforts in Morowali. Field conditions reflect the company’s genuine commitment to preserving the environment, beyond mere administrative compliance.

“Alhamdulillah, we were able to witness barging activities at PT Vale’s port firsthand, with no signs of pollution. I saw for myself how PT Vale pays great attention to environmental aspects. To date, the barging process has proceeded without any visible red water in the port area. In addition, in the reclamation zone, we participated in tree planting and observed preparations for planting with local Morowali species. Moving forward, we hope for greater variety in plant species, including fruit trees,” he said.

 
 

The sustainability efforts witnessed by the Regent in PT Vale’s operational areas include mine water management through a well-designed sediment pond system. This initiative could serve as a benchmark for other mining companies operating in Morowali.

“PT Vale has prepared sediment ponds and an excellent water management system. The water discharging from the pond outlet appears clear. This is an indicator of serious environmental management and worthy of serving as an example for other companies. Today, I am truly impressed and proud of PT Vale,” he emphasised.

The local government delegation also inspected the operations control room, which monitors barging and mining activities in real time. This monitoring system is seen as reflecting the company’s transparency and accountability in managing operations, while serving as an important tool to ensure all activities comply with applicable environmental standards.

Head of Bahodopi Project for PT Vale IGP Morowali, Wafir, affirmed that sustainability is the core foundation of all company operational activities. “As a company that upholds the principles of sustainability, environmental protection is the basis for every activity we undertake. We believe that sustainability is the key to modern mining. Therefore, we not only strive to meet but also exceed the established environmental standards, so that today’s operations do not compromise the future,” said Wafir.

He added that PT Vale is committed to further strengthening collaboration with the Morowali Regency Government. “We want to ensure that industrial growth aligns with regional development, environmental protection, and community welfare. For us, Morowali is not just an operational location but a shared home that must be preserved and developed sustainably,” he continued.

This commitment was further reinforced on Wednesday, 24 December 2025, through a visit by Morowali Police Chief AKBP Zulkarnain to the port, jetty, and mining areas of PT Vale IGP Morowali. During the visit, the Police Chief stated that PT Vale’s operational and environmental management practices could serve as a reference for other companies.

“After our visit, we see that PT Vale should serve as an example for other companies, particularly in maintaining environmental preservation and balance. I also observed that PT Vale has good long-term planning and hope it can provide greater equity for the community,” he said.
These two days of visits underscore that good environmental management is not merely a regulatory obligation but a long-term investment in the sustainability of the industry and community welfare. PT Vale demonstrates that sustainability principles are implemented concretely, from mine water management and land reclamation using native Sulawesi plants to the use of technology for transparent operational monitoring.

PT Vale believes that the success of the mining industry is not measured solely by production achievements but also by the positive impacts it brings to the environment and surrounding communities. Through ongoing innovation and close collaboration with local government, PT Vale is committed to continuing its contribution to industrial growth that aligns with regional development, environmental preservation, and the welfare of the people of Morowali.

id.title: Merawat Keberlanjutan Lewat Operasi Tambang Bertanggung Jawab, Bupati dan Kapolres Apresiasi Kehadiran PT Vale di Morowali
id.subtitle: Di tengah pesatnya pertumbuhan industri pertambangan di Kabupaten Morowali, pengelolaan lingkungan menjadi isu penting yang terus mendapat perhatian. Dalam konteks tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) bagian dari group MIND ID melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali menunjukkan praktik nyata pengelolaan lingkungan berkelanjutan, sebagaimana disaksikan langsung oleh Bupati Morowali, Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf, dalam kunjungan kerja ke sejumlah area operasional PT Vale di Morowali pada Selasa, 23 Desember 2025.
id.body:
Morowali, 24 Desember 2025 - Di tengah pesatnya pertumbuhan industri pertambangan di Kabupaten Morowali, pengelolaan lingkungan menjadi isu penting yang terus mendapat perhatian. Dalam konteks tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) bagian dari group MIND ID melalui Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali menunjukkan praktik nyata pengelolaan lingkungan berkelanjutan, sebagaimana disaksikan langsung oleh Bupati Morowali, Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf, dalam kunjungan kerja ke sejumlah area operasional PT Vale di Morowali pada Selasa, 23 Desember 2025.

Dalam kunjungan tersebut, Bupati Morowali bersama jajaran pejabat pemerintah daerah meninjau langsung area port dan jetty, ruang kontrol operasi, serta kawasan reklamasi Rasyidah. Peninjauan ini memberikan gambaran menyeluruh kehadiran PT Vale di Morowali, mulai dari aktivitas logistik hingga pengelolaan lingkungan di area pascatambang.

Bupati Morowali, Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf menyampaikan apresiasi atas upaya pengelolaan lingkungan yang diterapkan PT Vale di tanah Morowali. Kondisi lapangan mencerminkan komitmen nyata perusahaan dalam menjaga kelestarian lingkungan, bukan sekadar pemenuhan kewajiban administratif. 

“Alhamdulillah, kami dapat menyaksikan langsung aktivitas barging di pelabuhan PT Vale tanpa adanya indikasi pencemaran. Saya melihat sendiri bagaimana PT Vale sangat memperhatikan aspek lingkungan. Hingga saat ini, proses barging berlangsung tanpa terlihat adanya air berwarna merah di area pelabuhan. Selain itu, di area reklamasi kami turut menanam pohon dan juga melihat persiapan penanaman dengan tanaman khas lokal Morowali. Ke depan, kami berharap ada lebih banyak variasi tanaman, termasuk tanaman buah-buahan,” ujarnya.

 

 
 

Upaya merawat keberlanjutan yang turut disaksikan Bupati di area operasional PT Vale adalah pengelolaan air tambang melalui sistem pond sediment yang dirancang dengan baik. Menjadi inisiatif yang dapat menjadi tolok ukur bagi perusahaan tambang lain yang beroperasi di Morowali.

“PT Vale telah mempersiapkan pond sediment dan sistem pengelolaan air yang sangat baik. Air yang keluar dari ujung pond terlihat jernih. Ini merupakan indikator pengelolaan lingkungan yang serius dan layak menjadi contoh bagi perusahaan lain. Hari ini saya sangat salut dan bangga kepada PT Vale,” tegasnya.

Rombongan pemerintah daerah turut meninjau ruang kontrol operasi yang memantau aktivitas barging dan kegiatan tambang secara real-time. Sistem pemantauan ini dinilai mencerminkan transparansi dan akuntabilitas perusahaan dalam mengelola operasional, sekaligus menjadi instrumen penting untuk memastikan seluruh kegiatan berjalan sesuai standar lingkungan yang berlaku.

Head of Bahodopi Project PT Vale IGP Morowali, Wafir, menegaskan bahwa keberlanjutan merupakan fondasi utama dalam setiap kegiatan operasional perusahaan. “Sebagai perusahaan yang menjunjung tinggi prinsip keberlanjutan, perlindungan lingkungan menjadi landasan dalam setiap aktivitas kami. Kami percaya bahwa keberlanjutan adalah kunci bagi industri pertambangan modern. Karena itu, kami tidak hanya berupaya memenuhi, tetapi juga melampaui standar lingkungan yang ditetapkan, agar operasional hari ini tidak mengorbankan masa depan,” ujar Wafir.

Ia menambahkan bahwa PT Vale berkomitmen untuk terus memperkuat kolaborasi dengan Pemerintah Kabupaten Morowali. “Kami ingin memastikan bahwa pertumbuhan industri berjalan selaras dengan pembangunan daerah, perlindungan lingkungan, dan kesejahteraan masyarakat. Bagi kami, Morowali bukan sekadar lokasi operasi, tetapi rumah bersama yang harus dijaga dan dibangun secara berkelanjutan,” tambahnya.

Komitmen tersebut kembali diperkuat pada Rabu, 24 Desember 2025 melalui kunjungan Kapolres Morowali, AKBP Zulkarnain, ke area port, jetty, dan kawasan tambang PT Vale IGP Morowali. Dalam kunjungan tersebut, Kapolres menyampaikan bahwa pengelolaan operasional dan lingkungan yang diterapkan PT Vale dapat menjadi rujukan bagi perusahaan lain. 

“Setelah kami melakukan kunjungan, kami melihat PT Vale seharusnya menjadi contoh bagi perusahaan lain, terutama dalam menjaga kelestarian dan keseimbangan lingkungan. Saya juga melihat PT Vale memiliki perencanaan jangka panjang yang baik dan semoga dapat memberikan kesetaraan yang lebih bagi masyarakat,” ujarnya.

Kunjungan dua hari ini menegaskan bahwa pengelolaan lingkungan yang baik bukan sekadar kewajiban regulasi, melainkan investasi jangka panjang bagi keberlanjutan industri dan kesejahteraan masyarakat. PT Vale menunjukkan bahwa prinsip keberlanjutan diwujudkan secara konkret, mulai dari pengelolaan air tambang, reklamasi lahan dengan tanaman lokal khas Sulawesi, hingga pemanfaatan teknologi untuk pemantauan operasional secara transparan.

PT Vale meyakini bahwa keberhasilan industri pertambangan tidak hanya diukur dari capaian produksi, tetapi juga dari dampak positif yang dihadirkan bagi lingkungan dan masyarakat sekitar. Melalui inovasi berkelanjutan dan kolaborasi erat dengan pemerintah daerah, PT Vale berkomitmen untuk terus berkontribusi dalam mewujudkan pertumbuhan industri yang selaras dengan pembangunan daerah, pelestarian lingkungan, dan kesejahteraan masyarakat Morowali.

en.title: Strengthening Regional Resilience: PT Vale Indonesia and North Luwu Government Drive Integrated Flood Risk Mitigation Solutions
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the MIND ID Group, has taken strategic steps in collaboration with the North Luwu Regency Government through the donation of an excavator unit, technical study documents, 10,000 liters of operational fuel, and a tree-planting initiative as part of watershed rehabilitation efforts.
en.body:
Masamba, December 23, 2025 — As rainfall intensity rises and certain areas face growing vulnerability to floods and landslides, strengthening regional resilience has become an urgent necessity. Responding to this challenge, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the MIND ID Group, has taken strategic steps in collaboration with the North Luwu Regency Government through the donation of an excavator unit, technical study documents, 10,000 liters of operational fuel, and a tree-planting initiative as part of watershed rehabilitation efforts.

The excavator donation is expected to support local government activities in dredging rivers and waterways that have become silted. This measure aims to increase water flow capacity, reduce flood risks—especially during the rainy season—and promote sustainable maintenance of water resource infrastructure.

Complementing these technical solutions, tree planting serves as a strategic effort to address the impacts of climate change that trigger extreme weather. Watershed rehabilitation is expected to strengthen environmental carrying capacity, reduce surface runoff, and create regions that are more resilient to future disasters.

Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations Regional & Growth at PT Vale Indonesia, emphasized that the donation and tree-planting initiative reflect the company’s long-term commitment to grow and progress alongside local governments and communities.

“More than just physical assistance, the excavator donation and tree-planting movement represent our commitment to strengthening regional resilience in disaster mitigation while building quality water infrastructure for a safer, more resilient future,” Endra stated during the handover ceremony in Masamba.

River normalization is a critical effort to prevent flood risks that directly impact the social and economic life of communities. Restoring river functionality minimizes overflow potential, allowing residents to carry out daily activities more safely and confidently. This initiative also forms part of a long-term strategy to enhance regional resilience against disasters while optimizing local food production potential.

 
 

Support for this initiative was also expressed by Andi Sudirman Sulaiman, Governor of South Sulawesi:
“We are here out of love for the people of North Luwu, and we see great potential in this region. Please make the best use of this support,” said the Governor.

Meanwhile, Andi Abdullah Rahim, Regent of North Luwu, conveyed appreciation for the synergy between provincial government, local government, and the private sector: “With this assistance, we will continue striving to provide the best services for our community in North Luwu,” said the Regent.

Through the donation of heavy equipment and watershed rehabilitation as concrete disaster mitigation measures, PT Vale reaffirms its role not only as a development partner but also as part of a long-term solution to strengthen regional resilience.

By supporting sustainable, collaborative mitigation efforts, PT Vale remains committed to enhancing regional resilience while improving community quality of life. This initiative aligns with the company’s core values of care, sustainability, and strong partnerships—paving the way for a safer, more resilient future for North Luwu.

id.title: Bersama Memperkuat Ketahanan Daerah, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk dan Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Utara Dorong Solusi Terpadu Mitigasi Risiko Banjir
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, mengambil langkah strategis bersama Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Utara melalui hibah satu unit alat berat excavator, dokumen kajian teknis, bahan bakar operasional 10 ribu liter, serta aksi penanaman bibit pohon sebagai bagian dari rehabilitasi daerah aliran sungai (DAS).
id.body:
Masamba, 23 Desember 2025 — Di tengah meningkatnya intensitas curah hujan dan kerentanan sejumlah wilayah terhadap banjir serta longsor, penguatan ketahanan daerah menjadi kebutuhan mendesak yang tidak bisa ditunda. Menjawab tantangan tersebut, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, mengambil langkah strategis bersama Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Utara melalui hibah satu unit alat berat excavator, dokumen kajian teknis, bahan bakar operasional 10 ribu liter, serta aksi penanaman bibit pohon sebagai bagian dari rehabilitasi daerah aliran sungai (DAS).

Hibah alat berat excavator ini diharapkan dapat dimanfaatkan oleh pemerintah daerah untuk kegiatan pengerukan sungai dan saluran air yang mengalami pendangkalan. Langkah ini bertujuan meningkatkan kapasitas aliran air, mengurangi risiko banjir terutama pada musim hujan, sekaligus mendukung pemeliharaan infrastruktur sumber daya air secara berkelanjutan.

Sebagai pelengkap solusi teknis tersebut, penanaman bibit pohon dilakukan sebagai upaya strategis menghadapi dampak perubahan iklim yang memicu cuaca ekstrem. Rehabilitasi DAS diharapkan mampu memperkuat daya dukung lingkungan, mengurangi laju limpasan air, serta menciptakan wilayah yang lebih tangguh terhadap bencana di masa depan.

Head of External Relation Regional & Growth PT Vale Indonesia, Endra Kusuma, menegaskan bahwa penyerahan hibah alat berat yang dirangkaikan dengan penanaman bibit pohon merupakan wujud komitmen jangka panjang perusahaan untuk tumbuh dan maju bersama pemerintah daerah dan masyarakat. “Lebih dari sekadar bantuan fisik, hibah alat berat dan gerakan menanam pohon mencerminkan komitmen untuk memperkuat ketahanan daerah dalam upaya mitigasi bencana sekaligus membangun infrastruktur air yang berkualitas untuk masa depan yang lebih aman dan tangguh,” ungkap Endra usai menghadiri acara seremoni penyerahan hibah di Masamba.

Normalisasi sungai menjadi salah satu upaya krusial dalam mencegah risiko banjir yang berdampak langsung pada kehidupan sosial dan ekonomi masyarakat. Dengan fungsi sungai yang kembali optimal, potensi luapan air dapat diminimalkan, sehingga masyarakat dapat menjalani aktivitas sehari-hari dengan lebih aman dan tenang. Upaya ini sekaligus menjadi bagian dari strategi jangka panjang penguatan ketahanan daerah menghadapi risiko bencana maupun optimalisasi potensi pangan daerah.
 

 
 

Dukungan terhadap inisiatif ini juga disampaikan oleh Andi Sudirman Sulaiman, Gubernur Sulawesi Selatan. “Kehadiran kami ini karna kecintaan terhadap masyarakat Luwu Utara dan kami melihat potensi yang besar di Luwu Utara oleh karna itu mohon di manfaatkan dengan baik,” ungkap Gubernur.

Sementara itu, Andi Abdullah Rahim, Bupati Luwu Utara, menyampaikan apresiasi atas sinergi yang terbangun antara pemerintah provinsi, pemerintah kabupaten, dan dunia usaha. “Tentunya dengan bantuan ini kami akan terus berusaha memberikan pelayanan yang terbaik bagi masyarakat kami di Kabupaten Luwu Utara,” kata Bupati.

Melalui penyerahan hibah alat berat dan rehabilitasi DAS sebagai langkah konkret mitigasi bencana, PT Vale kembali menegaskan perannya untuk hadir di tengah masyarakat, bukan hanya sebagai mitra pembangunan, tetapi juga sebagai bagian dari solusi jangka panjang dalam memperkuat ketahanan daerah.

Dengan mendukung upaya mitigasi yang berkelanjutan dan berbasis kolaborasi, PT Vale berkomitmen memperkuat ketahanan wilayah sekaligus meningkatkan kualitas hidup masyarakat. Inisiatif ini sejalan dengan nilai-nilai perusahaan yang mengedepankan kepedulian, keberlanjutan, dan kemitraan erat demi masa depan Luwu Utara yang lebih aman dan tangguh.

en.title: Strengthening Village Information Governance: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk Partners with Indonesian Journalists Association in Kolaka to Promote Media Literacy Among Village Officials
en.subtitle: Aligned with Kolaka Regency’s agenda to strengthen village governance, ensure transparency in public services, and build social resilience in the digital era, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale)—part of the MIND ID group—has partnered with the Indonesian Journalists Association (PWI) Kolaka Chapter to launch the “Media Literacy Awareness” campaign for village officials across Kolaka Regency.
en.body:
Kolaka, December 23, 2025 — As digital transformation accelerates to the village level, the challenge of managing information has become increasingly critical. The rapid and massive flow of unverified information can lead to misunderstandings, erode public trust, and hinder the effectiveness of village governance. This situation calls for enhanced capacity among village officials to act as guardians of accurate, ethical, and responsible information.

Aligned with Kolaka Regency’s agenda to strengthen village governance, ensure transparency in public services, and build social resilience in the digital era, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale)—part of the MIND ID group—has partnered with the Indonesian Journalists Association (PWI) Kolaka Chapter to launch the “Media Literacy Awareness” campaign for village officials across Kolaka Regency.

This program responds to real needs on the ground, where village officials are not only tasked with administrative duties but also serve as key sources of information for their communities. With adequate media literacy, villages can prevent the spread of hoaxes, manage issues constructively, and foster transparent and accountable public communication—supporting Kolaka’s vision of villages as the foundation of sustainable development.

Through this collaboration, PT Vale and PWI Kolaka aim to strengthen the capacity of village officials to navigate public communication dynamics confidently and professionally, while reinforcing synergy between village governments, media, and the community.

Program activities include:

  • Media Literacy Training: Enhancing skills to filter information, identify hoaxes, and use social media responsibly.
  • Public Communication Workshop: Building the ability to deliver clear, transparent, and accountable information to the public.
  • Interactive Discussions: Exploring the strategic role of media and village governments in fostering and maintaining public trust.

As part of a long-term commitment to creating a healthy communication ecosystem at the village level, the program also includes the signing of an Assistance and Press Complaint Agreement between PWI Kolaka and village officials across the regency. This agreement provides an official support channel for villages facing media-related issues and ensures complaint mechanisms follow proper procedures and journalistic ethics.

PWI Kolaka Chairman Abdul Saban expressed his appreciation for the collaboration:
“This synergy not only strengthens the capacity of village officials but also represents a concrete step toward creating a more informed society,” he said.

Support for this initiative also came from the Press Council, emphasizing that media literacy is a cornerstone of democracy and sound governance: “Media literacy is fundamental to safeguarding the quality of democracy. We fully support PT Vale and PWI Kolaka’s efforts because the more people understand journalistic ethics, the lower the risk of misinformation. The Press Council protects public rights—not just journalists. If there is an ethical violation by the media, the public has the right to report it to us,” a representative stated.

On a national scale, the Press Council recorded over 1,600 complaints of alleged journalistic ethics violations in 2025, with around 70% of reports coming from the general public. This data underscores the urgent need for media literacy so communities—including village officials—understand their rights and complaint mechanisms correctly.

As part of MIND ID, PT Vale remains committed to supporting sustainable development through community empowerment and human resource development programs. This media literacy collaboration reinforces PT Vale’s role as a strategic partner to local governments in strengthening village governance, building public trust, and creating a resilient, well-informed Kolaka community ready to face future challenges.

id.title: Perkuat Tata Kelola Informasi Desa, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk Kolaborasi dengan Persatuan Wartawan Indonesia Kolaka Dorong Aparat Desa Melek Literasi Media
id.subtitle: Sejalan dengan agenda Pemerintah Kabupaten Kolaka dalam memperkuat tata kelola pemerintahan desa, transparansi layanan publik, serta ketahanan sosial masyarakat di era digital, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, berkolaborasi dengan Persatuan Wartawan Indonesia (PWI) Kabupaten Kolaka menggelar kampanye “Melek Literasi Media” bagi aparat pemerintah desa se-Kabupaten Kolaka.
id.body:
Kolaka, 23 Desember 2025 — Di tengah percepatan transformasi digital hingga ke tingkat desa, tantangan tata kelola informasi menjadi semakin nyata. Arus informasi yang cepat, masif, dan sering kali tidak terverifikasi berpotensi memicu kesalahpahaman, menurunkan kepercayaan publik, hingga menghambat efektivitas pelayanan pemerintah desa. Kondisi ini menuntut peningkatan kapasitas aparat desa agar mampu berperan sebagai penjaga informasi yang akurat, etis, dan bertanggung jawab. Sejalan dengan agenda Pemerintah Kabupaten Kolaka dalam memperkuat tata kelola pemerintahan desa, transparansi layanan publik, serta ketahanan sosial masyarakat di era digital, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, berkolaborasi dengan Persatuan Wartawan Indonesia (PWI) Kabupaten Kolaka menggelar kampanye “Melek Literasi Media” bagi aparat pemerintah desa se-Kabupaten Kolaka.

Program ini dirancang sebagai respon atas kebutuhan nyata di lapangan, di mana aparat desa tidak hanya dituntut menjalankan fungsi administratif, tetapi juga menjadi rujukan informasi bagi masyarakat. Dengan literasi media yang memadai, desa diharapkan mampu mencegah penyebaran hoaks, mengelola isu secara konstruktif, serta membangun komunikasi publik yang transparan dan akuntabel, selaras dengan arah pembangunan daerah Kolaka yang menempatkan desa sebagai fondasi utama pembangunan berkelanjutan.

Melalui kolaborasi ini, PT Vale dan PWI Kolaka mendorong penguatan kapasitas aparat desa agar mampu menghadapi dinamika komunikasi publik secara lebih percaya diri dan profesional, sekaligus memperkuat sinergi antara pemerintah desa, media, dan masyarakat.

Rangkaian kegiatan dalam program ini meliputi:

  • Pelatihan Literasi Media, untuk meningkatkan kemampuan memilah informasi, mengenali hoaks, serta menggunakan media sosial secara bijak;
  • Workshop Komunikasi Publik, guna memperkuat kemampuan aparat desa dalam menyampaikan informasi secara terbuka, jelas, dan bertanggung jawab kepada masyarakat;
  • Diskusi Interaktif, yang membahas peran strategis media dan pemerintah desa dalam membangun serta menjaga kepercayaan publik.

Sebagai bentuk komitmen jangka panjang dalam menciptakan ekosistem komunikasi yang sehat di tingkat desa, kegiatan ini juga dirangkaikan dengan penandatanganan Berita Acara Pendampingan dan Pengaduan Kasus Pers antara PWI Kabupaten Kolaka dan aparat pemerintah desa se-Kabupaten Kolaka. Kesepakatan ini memberikan jalur resmi pendampingan bagi desa dalam menghadapi persoalan pemberitaan, sekaligus memastikan mekanisme pengaduan dapat berjalan sesuai prosedur dan kode etik jurnalistik.

Ketua PWI Kolaka, Abdul Saban, menyampaikan apresiasinya terhadap kolaborasi tersebut, “Sinergi ini bukan hanya memperkuat kapasitas aparat desa, tetapi juga menjadi langkah nyata dalam menciptakan masyarakat yang lebih melek informasi,” ujarnya.

Dukungan terhadap inisiatif ini juga disampaikan oleh perwakilan Dewan Pers, yang menekankan bahwa literasi media merupakan fondasi penting bagi demokrasi dan tata kelola pemerintahan yang sehat. “Literasi media adalah fondasi untuk menjaga kualitas demokrasi. Kami mendukung langkah PT Vale dan PWI Kolaka karena semakin banyak masyarakat memahami etika jurnalistik, semakin kecil peluang terjadinya misinformasi. Dewan Pers memiliki fungsi melindungi hak-hak publik, tidak hanya jurnalis. Jika ada pelanggaran kode etik oleh media, masyarakat berhak melaporkannya kepada kami,” ungkapnya.

Sebagai konteks nasional, sepanjang tahun 2025 Dewan Pers mencatat lebih dari 1600 pengaduan terkait dugaan pelanggaran kode etik jurnalistik, dengan sekitar 70% laporan berasal dari masyarakat umum. Data ini menunjukkan bahwa literasi media menjadi kebutuhan mendesak agar masyarakat, termasuk aparatur desa, memahami hak dan mekanisme pengaduan secara tepat.

Sebagai bagian dari MIND ID, PT Vale berkomitmen untuk terus mendukung agenda pembangunan berkelanjutan melalui program-program pemberdayaan masyarakat dan peningkatan kualitas sumber daya manusia. Kolaborasi literasi media ini menegaskan peran PT Vale sebagai mitra strategis pemerintah daerah dalam memperkuat tata kelola desa, membangun kepercayaan publik, dan menciptakan masyarakat Kolaka yang tangguh, cerdas informasi, dan siap menghadapi tantangan masa depan.

en.title: Uniting Regions, Shaping the Future: PT Vale Strengthens Strategic Infrastructure in South Sulawesi for Inclusive, Climate-Resilient Growth
en.subtitle: Infrastructure development today is more than just physical connectivity; it is the foundation for equitable economic growth, regional resilience, and improved quality of life for communities. With this understanding, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, part of the MIND ID Group, reaffirms its commitment to actively contribute to South Sulawesi’s sustainable development agenda through the construction of the Matano Belt Road and initiatives to strengthen climate resilience against hydrometeorological risks.
en.body:
