en.title: 8th Organic Rice Harvest by PT Vale’s Morowali Farmers: A Strong Synergy for National Food Security
en.subtitle: Farmers supported by PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) through the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali successfully completed their eighth organic rice harvest on Monday, December 1, 2025, in Ululere Village, Bungku Timur District, Morowali. This milestone reflects the continuity and success of the organic farming program that has been running for several years.
en.body:
Farmers supported by PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) through the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali successfully completed their eighth organic rice harvest on Monday, December 1, 2025, in Ululere Village, Bungku Timur District, Morowali. This milestone reflects the continuity and success of the organic farming program that has been running for several years.

The harvest event was attended by representatives from the Indonesian Navy (Danlanal Palu), Ululere Village Head, and PT Vale’s team—underscoring the strong collaboration between the company, local communities, and government institutions in advancing food security aligned with sustainable development goals.

Captain Djito, representing the Indonesian Navy, expressed admiration for the farmers’ achievements:
“We came here to see the farmers’ progress, and this organic rice harvest is truly remarkable. We hope that farmers, the military, and PT Vale will continue to strengthen their partnership. Any gaps farmers face can be supported through PT Vale’s programs. Communities around PT Vale should grow and enjoy the benefits they aspire to,” he said.

Ululere Village Head, Arman, emphasized the importance of multi-stakeholder synergy to expand the program’s impact:
“We hope this collaboration will empower more farmers in the future. The military can assist through the national food security program, such as opening new farmland. Our community is ready to plant,” he stated.

This achievement aligns with the government’s Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMD) 2025–2029, which targets food self-sufficiency as part of the President’s Asta Cita vision. The program promotes reduced dependency on chemical inputs and encourages environmentally friendly practices.

PT Vale’s management welcomed the success as a tangible commitment to community development:
“This eighth harvest is the result of farmers’ hard work and collective support. We believe food security is a key pillar of sustainability. PT Vale will continue to support organic farming through technical assistance and capacity building. Our hope is that this collaboration not only improves farmers’ welfare but also serves as a model for synergy between companies, communities, and government,” said Endra Kusuma, Head External Relations Regional and Growth PT Vale. 

Beyond economic benefits, the program supports national food security and reduces reliance on chemical agriculture. By prioritizing eco-friendly principles, PT Vale contributes to creating a sustainable agricultural ecosystem.

id.title: Panen Padi Organik ke Delapan, Petani Binaan PT Vale IGP Morowali: Sinergi untuk Ketahanan Pangan Nasional
id.subtitle: Petani binaan organik PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. (PT Vale) Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali sukses melaksanakan panen padi organik musim ke delapan di Desa Ululere, Kecamatan Bungku Timur, Morowali, Senin (1/12/2025). Panen ini menjadi bukti nyata keberlanjutan program pertanian organik yang telah berjalan sejak beberapa tahun terakhir.
id.body:
Petani binaan organik PT Vale Indonesia Tbk. (PT Vale) Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Morowali sukses melaksanakan panen padi organik musim ke delapan di Desa Ululere, Kecamatan Bungku Timur, Morowali, Senin (1/12/2025). Panen ini menjadi bukti nyata keberlanjutan program pertanian organik yang telah berjalan sejak beberapa tahun terakhir. 

Acara panen turut dihadiri oleh perwakilan Danlanal Palu, Kepala Desa Ululere, dan tim PT Vale. Kehadiran berbagai pihak ini mencerminkan kuatnya kolaborasi antara perusahaan, masyarakat, dan institusi pemerintah dalam mewujudkan program ketahanan pangan yang selaras dengan visi pembangunan berkelanjutan.

Danpos Angkatan Laut Morowali, Kapten Marinir Djito, mewakili Danlanal Palu menyampaikan rasa kagum atas keberhasilan petani binaan PT Vale. “Tujuan kami datang adalah melihat situasi petani di sini. Kami melihat sangat luar biasa, panen padi organik ini. Harapan kami ke depan agar petani, TNI, dan PT Vale semakin solid saling mendukung. Kekurangan petani bisa kita support melalui program PT Vale juga tentunya. Masyarakat yang ada di sekitar PT Vale dapat berkembang dan menikmati apa yang mereka harapkan,” ujarnya. 

Sementara itu, Kepala Desa Ululere, Arman, juga menekankan pentingnya sinergi lintas pihak untuk memperluas dampak program ini. “Kami berharap melalui kolaborasi ini ke depannya petani kami lebih banyak diberdayakan. TNI bisa membantu kami melalui program nasional ketahanan pangan presiden untuk petani agar lebih berdaya, seperti dengan pembukaan lahan baru. Masyarakat siap melakukan penanaman,” ungkapnya.

Keberhasilan panen ini sejalan dengan program prioritas pemerintah dalam RPJMD (Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Daerah) 2025–2029, yang menargetkan swasembada pangan sebagai bagian dari Asta Cita Presiden. Program ini mendukung pengurangan ketergantungan terhadap bahan kimia pertanian dan mendorong praktik ramah lingkungan.

Manajemen PT Vale Indonesia menyambut baik keberhasilan panen ini sebagai bukti nyata komitmen perusahaan terhadap pengembangan masyarakat. 

“Panen ke delapan ini adalah hasil kerja keras petani binaan dan dukungan semua pihak. Kami percaya bahwa ketahanan pangan adalah bagian penting dari keberlanjutan. PT Vale akan terus mendukung program pertanian organik, baik melalui pendampingan teknis maupun pengembangan kapasitas petani. Harapan kami, kolaborasi ini tidak hanya meningkatkan kesejahteraan petani, tetapi juga menjadi contoh sinergi antara perusahaan, masyarakat, dan pemerintah,” ujar Endra Kusuma, Head External Relations Regional and Growth PT Vale. 

Program ini tidak hanya berdampak pada peningkatan ekonomi masyarakat, tetapi juga mendukung agenda nasional ketahanan pangan dan pengurangan ketergantungan terhadap bahan kimia pertanian. Dengan mengedepankan prinsip ramah lingkungan, PT Vale berkontribusi pada terciptanya ekosistem pertanian yang berkelanjutan.

en.title: Breaking Bias and Preventing Harassment: PT Vale Advances DEI Implementation
en.subtitle: On November 28–29, 2025, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) conducted a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Training Program focused on Unconscious Bias and Harassment Prevention. PT Vale’s commitment to DEI is reflected in its top ranking for gender equality in the mining sector according to the Katadata ESG Index 2025, scoring 88.33.
en.body:
On November 28–29, 2025, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) conducted a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Training Program focused on Unconscious Bias and Harassment Prevention.

The sessions were held across multiple venues—CO Wekoila Meeting Room, Almek Padamarang Meeting Room, and Ground Training Classroom at IGP Pomala—using a blended approach of online and offline learning. Facilitators included Moh. Rendra Gunawan N., Wilson Tandi Rapa, Yunita Rosalyn P., and Afiat Delasari, with participants comprising PT Vale employees, seconded staff, and Pomala contractors.

The training aimed to deepen employees’ understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion, while helping them identify unconscious biases that can influence decision-making and workplace behavior. It also emphasized preventing discrimination based on gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, and disability—creating a fair and respectful work environment.

 
 

PT Vale’s commitment to DEI is reflected in its top ranking for gender equality in the mining sector according to the Katadata ESG Index 2025, scoring 88.33. The company targets increasing female representation to 18% by 2030, while maintaining a 1:1 pay ratio for equal roles. Currently, women make up 11.6% of the workforce, with 17 in managerial positions, and PT Vale employs 70 people with disabilities across various organizational levels.

During the sessions, facilitators stressed that diversity is not just a policy but a daily practice. 
Through interactive discussions, case studies, and role-playing, participants learned to recognize unconscious bias, understand its impact on workplace interactions, and apply mechanisms to prevent harassment. These efforts reinforce PT Vale’s commitment to building an inclusive culture that supports long-term sustainability.

id.title: Mengikis Bias dan Mencegah Pelecehan: Implementasi DEI di PT Vale
id.subtitle: Pada tanggal 28–29 November 2025, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menyelenggarakan Program Pelatihan Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) dengan fokus pada Unconscious Bias & Harassment (Bias Tak Sadar dan Pelecehan). Komitmen PTVI terhadap DEI tercermin dari pencapaian perusahaan yang meraih peringkat tertinggi kesetaraan gender di sektor pertambangan menurut Katadata ESG Index 2025, dengan skor 88,33.
id.body:
Pada tanggal 28–29 November 2025, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menyelenggarakan Program Pelatihan Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) dengan fokus pada Unconscious Bias & Harassment (Bias Tak Sadar dan Pelecehan). 

Kegiatan ini berlangsung di Meeting Room CO Wekoila, Meeting Room Almek Padamarang, dan Ground Training Classroom di IGP Pomala, dengan metode kombinasi online dan offline. Pelatihan ini difasilitasi oleh Moh. Rendra Gunawan N, Wilson Tandi Rapa, Yunita Rosalyn P., dan Afiat Delasari, serta diikuti oleh karyawan PT Vale, seconded, dan kontraktor Pomala.

Pelatihan ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pemahaman karyawan mengenai keberagaman, keadilan, dan inklusi, serta mengidentifikasi bias tidak sadar (unconscious bias) yang dapat memengaruhi pengambilan keputusan dan perilaku di tempat kerja. Selain itu, pelatihan ini menekankan pencegahan diskriminasi berbasis gender, ras, etnis, agama, orientasi seksual, dan disabilitas, guna menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang adil dan saling menghargai.

 
 

Komitmen PTVI terhadap DEI tercermin dari pencapaian perusahaan yang meraih peringkat tertinggi kesetaraan gender di sektor pertambangan menurut Katadata ESG Index 2025, dengan skor 88,33. Perusahaan menetapkan target peningkatan jumlah karyawan perempuan menjadi 18% pada tahun 2030, serta menjamin rasio gaji 1:1 untuk jabatan yang sama. Saat ini, jumlah karyawan perempuan mencapai 11,6%, dengan 17 di antaranya menduduki posisi manajerial. PT Vale juga mempekerjakan 70 penyandang disabilitas, yang berkontribusi di berbagai level organisasi.

Dalam sesi pelatihan, fasilitator menekankan bahwa keberagaman bukan sekadar kebijakan, melainkan praktik yang harus diterapkan setiap hari. Melalui diskusi interaktif, studi kasus, dan role play, peserta diajak mengenali bias yang tidak disadari, memahami dampaknya terhadap interaksi kerja, serta mempelajari mekanisme pencegahan pelecehan. Dengan langkah ini, PT Vale memperkuat komitmen untuk menciptakan budaya kerja yang inklusif dan mendukung keberlanjutan perusahaan.

en.title: Symbolizing Campus–Mining Industry Synergy for Sustainability: PT Vale and Unanda Launch Tree-Planting Initiative
en.subtitle: As part of its commitment to advancing sustainable development, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) partnered with students from Universitas Andi Djemma (Unanda) participating in the community service program (KKN) to carry out tree planting at their respective project sites. Tree seedlings were distributed to students at the Sawerigading Wallacea Biodiversity Park on Saturday, November 29, 2025.
en.body:
As part of its commitment to advancing sustainable development, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) partnered with students from Universitas Andi Djemma (Unanda) participating in the community service program (KKN) to carry out tree planting at their respective project sites. Tree seedlings were distributed to students at the Sawerigading Wallacea Biodiversity Park on Saturday, November 29, 2025.

This initiative also marked the celebration of Indonesia’s National Tree Planting Day on November 28, 2025. Far beyond a ceremonial environmental event, the collaboration represents a strategic step to strengthen ties between industry and academia in fostering environmental awareness and sustainability.

“We want to create real-world learning opportunities for students, allowing them to see firsthand how sustainability principles, land reclamation, and environmental conservation are implemented in responsible mining operations,” said Yusri Yunus, Head External Relations Sorowako and SOA PT Vale.

The partnership also aims to empower students as agents of change. Equipped with knowledge and field experience, KKN participants are expected to bring sustainability values to the communities they serve—promoting eco-friendly practices and building a culture of environmental responsibility.

 
 

Suardi, Head of LP2M at Universitas Andi Djemma Palopo and coordinator of the KKN program, emphasized the significance of this collaboration:
“For us in academia, PT Vale’s program not only provides practical experience but also demonstrates the company’s genuine commitment to sustainability. This approach enriches students’ learning and proves that campus–industry collaboration can be a powerful force in protecting and preserving the environment,” he stated.

The PTVI–Unanda partnership reflects a tangible contribution to creating positive impacts in areas surrounding mining operations. Beyond strengthening academic–industry relations, this initiative underscores a shared commitment to preparing a generation that is environmentally conscious, adaptive, and ready to tackle future sustainability challenges.

Through student involvement, this tree-planting effort is expected to deliver long-term benefits while supporting environmental restoration and transformation in operational areas.

id.title: Simbolisasi Sinergi Kampus–Industri Pertambangan untuk Keberlanjutan: PT Vale dan Unanda Lakukan Penanaman Pohon
id.subtitle: Bagian dari komitmen dalam mendorong pembangunan berkelanjutan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menggaet mahasiswa Kuliah Kerja Nyata (KKN) Universitas Andi Djemma (Unanda) untuk melakukan  penanaman pohon di lokasi KKN masing-masing. Bibit pohon dibagikan kepada para mahasiswa di Taman Kehati Sawerigading Wallacea, Sabtu (29/11/2025).
id.body:
Bagian dari komitmen dalam mendorong pembangunan berkelanjutan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menggaet mahasiswa Kuliah Kerja Nyata (KKN) Universitas Andi Djemma (Unanda) untuk melakukan  penanaman pohon di lokasi KKN masing-masing. Bibit pohon dibagikan kepada para mahasiswa di Taman Kehati Sawerigading Wallacea, Sabtu (29/11/2025). 

Pembagian bibit pohon ini juga menjadi momentum dalam memperingati Hari Menanam pohon Indonesia (HMPI) pada 28 November 2025. Bukan sekadar agenda seremonial lingkungan, kolaborasi ini sebagai langkah strategis untuk memperkuat kolaborasi antara industri dan dunia akademik dalam membangun kesadaran terkait lingkungan dan keberlanjutan.

“Kami ingin membuka ruang belajar di lapangan bagi para mahasiswa, agar mereka dapat melihat secara langsung bagaimana prinsip keberlanjutan, reklamasi, dan konservasi lingkungan dijalankan dalam industri pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab,” ungkap Yusri Yunus, Head External Relations Sorowako and SOA.

Kerja sama ini juga menjadi bagian dari upaya perusahaan untuk mendorong mahasiswa sebagai agen perubahan. Dengan bekal edukasi dan pengalaman lapangan, mahasiswa KKN diharapkan mampu membawa nilai-nilai keberlanjutan ke desa lokasi pengabdian, memperkuat praktik ramah lingkungan, serta membangun budaya sadar lingkungan.
 

 
 

Ketua LP2M Universitas Andi Djemma Palopo, Suardi yang juga menjadi penanggung jawab pelaksanaan KKN menyampaikan bahwa kolaborasi antara PTVI dan mahasiswa KKN Unanda ini menjadi momentum untuk memperkuat budaya keberlanjutan, “Bagi kami di lingkungan kampus, program yang dijalankan PT Vale bukan hanya memberikan pengalaman lapangan, tetapi juga menunjukkan keseriusan perusahaan dalam menerapkan prinsip keberlanjutan secara nyata. Pendekatan ini memperkaya proses belajar mahasiswa dan membuktikan bahwa kolaborasi antara kampus dan industri dapat menjadi kekuatan penting dalam menjaga dan melestarikan lingkungan,” Jelas Suardi.

Kolaborasi PTVI dan Unanda ini mencerminkan kontribusi nyata kedua institusi dalam menciptakan dampak positif bagi wilayah sekitar operasi. Selain memperkuat hubungan akademik dan industri, kegiatan ini menjadi bukti komitmen bersama untuk menyiapkan generasi muda yang peduli, adaptif, dan siap menghadapi tantangan pembangunan berkelanjutan di masa depan.

Melalui keterlibatan mahasiswa, aksi penanaman pohon ini diharapkan menjadi bentuk upaya PT Vale dalam menghadirkan program yang memberi manfaat berkelanjutan sekaligus mendukung transformasi dan pemulihan lingkungan yang lebih baik di wilayah operasi.

en.title: Strengthening Our Commitment to Sustainable Innovation: PT Vale Wins Seven Awards at TKMPN XXIX
en.subtitle: PT Vale proudly brought home seven prestigious awards from the 29th National Quality and Productivity Gathering (TKMPN XXIX), held at Harmoni One Hotel & Convention Centre, Batam, November 24–29, 2025. The Green Breaker team earned the coveted Diamond Award and Most Favorite, followed by Innovator Tim, Autopipe, Stock Master, and Slag Warrior with Platinum Awards, and The Energizer and Sarakaloka each receiving Gold Awards.
en.body:
PT Vale proudly brought home seven prestigious awards from the 29th National Quality and Productivity Gathering (TKMPN XXIX), held at Harmoni One Hotel & Convention Centre, Batam, November 24–29, 2025. The Green Breaker team earned the coveted Diamond Award and Most Favorite, followed by Innovator Tim, Autopipe, Stock Master, and Slag Warrior with Platinum Awards, and The Energizer and Sarakaloka each receiving Gold Awards.

With the theme “Building National Competitiveness Through Productive and Sustainable Innovation,” TKMPN XXIX set a participation record with over 2,500 attendees, 650 teams, and 222 companies. PT Vale fielded seven innovation teams—its largest delegation to date—comprising 28 participants and 12 observers.

These teams were selected from winners of PT Vale’s internal Kaizen Competition and QCC Obeya throughout 2025, presenting implemented innovations from operations in Sorowako across multiple streams.

Award-Winning Innovations:

Diamond Award & Most Favorite

  • Green Breaker: Reclaiming rocky areas using coconut belt waste.

Platinum Awards

  • Innovator: Improved slag launder watering method to reduce operational risk and cost.
  • Autopipe: Tool for opening difficult pipes in exploration projects, boosting efficiency.
  • Slag Warrior: Transforming nickel slag waste into eco-friendly infrastructure material.
  • Stock Master: Achieved 21% cost savings on new tuyere unit purchases.

Gold Awards

  • The Energizer: Cut troubleshooting time for mining power network issues by 71%.
  • Sarakaloka: Optimized reuse of lagoon water hyacinth waste.

 
 
 
 

Sharing Best Practices and Strengthening Innovation Culture
Over six days, participants engaged in management forums, innovation presentations, and industry benchmarking sessions. TKMPN is more than a competition—it’s a cross-sector collaboration platform fostering new ideas for quality and productivity improvement.

Beyond the awards, PT Vale joined management and facilitator forums on topics such as Enhancing Employee Productivity Through Innovation & Knowledge Management and Public Transportation Ecosystem. PT Vale also competed in the Quiz of Quality & Productivity, represented by Nella Yunita, Berni Dambo, and Charles Andrianto.

For PT Vale, participation in TKMPN XXIX is about more than recognition—it’s about sharing best practices and reinforcing a culture of innovation. As a nickel producer supporting the clean energy transition, PT Vale views innovation as key to boosting productivity while safeguarding environmental sustainability.

Every idea from our teams reflects our commitment to CARES values—Compassion, Accountability, Resilience, Excellence, and Sustainability. In line with this year’s theme, PT Vale reaffirms its role in building national competitiveness through impactful innovation. From operational efficiency to eco-friendly waste management, each step is a tangible contribution toward a greener, more productive industrial future.

id.title: Kukuhkan komitmen inovasi berkelanjutan, PT Vale raih tujuh penghargaan dalam TKMPN XXIX
id.subtitle: PT Vale memboyong tujuh penghargaan bergengsi dari Temu Karya Mutu dan Produktivitas Nasional (TKMPN) XXIX yang diselenggarakan di Harmoni One Hotel & Convention Centre, Batam, 24-29 November 2025. Tim Green Breaker meraih Diamond Award sekaligus Most Favorite, disusul Innovator Tim, Autopipe, Stock Master, dan Slag Warrior dengan Platinum Award, serta The Energizer dan Sarakaloka yang masing-masing meraih Gold Award.
id.body:
PT Vale memboyong tujuh penghargaan bergengsi dari Temu Karya Mutu dan Produktivitas Nasional (TKMPN) XXIX yang diselenggarakan di Harmoni One Hotel & Convention Centre, Batam, 24-29 November 2025. Tim Green Breaker meraih Diamond Award sekaligus Most Favorite, disusul Innovator Tim, Autopipe, Stock Master, dan Slag Warrior dengan Platinum Award, serta The Energizer dan Sarakaloka yang masing-masing meraih Gold Award.

Dengan tema “Membangun Daya Saing Bangsa Melalui Inovasi yang Produktif dan Berkelanjutan,” TKMPN XXIX mencatat rekor partisipasi dengan lebih dari 2.500 peserta, 650 tim, dan 222 perusahaan. PT Vale mengirimkan tujuh tim inovasi yang terdiri atas 28 peserta dan 12 observer—jumlah terbanyak sepanjang keikutsertaan perusahaan. 

Tim-tim yang mewakili PT Vale dipilih dari para pemenang Kaizen Competition dan QCC Obeya di sepanjang 2025, tampil di berbagai stream presentasi untuk memaparkan inovasi yang telah diimplementasikan di area operasi Sorowako. 

Inovasi-inovasi unggulan yang ditampilkan:

Diamond Award & Most Favorite

  • Green Breaker: Inovasi reklamasi area berbatu dengan memanfaatkan limbah sabuk kelapa

Platinum Award

  • Innovator Tim: Perbaikan metode penyiraman slag launder untuk menurunkan risiko kerja dan biaya operasional.
  • Autopipe: Alat pembuka pipa yang sulit dibuka pada proyek eksplorasi, meningkatkan efisiensi kerja.
  • Slag Warrior: Pemanfaatan limbah slag nikel menjadi material infrastruktur ramah lingkungan.
  • Stock Master: Efisiensi biaya pembelian unit tuyere baru sebesar 21%.

Gold Award

  • The Energizer: Solusi menurunkan waktu pencarian gangguan jaringan listrik tambang hingga 71%.
  • Sarakaloka: Optimalisasi pemanfaatan sampah apu-apu di area lagoon.

 
 
 
 

Berbagi praktik terbaik dan memperkuat budaya inovasi

Selama enam hari, peserta mengikuti rangkaian kegiatan mulai dari forum manajemen, presentasi inovasi, hingga sesi benchmarking industri. TKMPN bukan sekadar kompetisi, tetapi forum kolaborasi lintas sektor yang mendorong terciptanya ide-ide baru untuk peningkatan mutu dan produktivitas.

Selain kompetisi, TKMPN menghadirkan forum manajemen dan fasilitator dengan topik seperti Enhancing Employee Productivity Through Innovation & Knowledge Management dan Ekosistem Transportasi Publik. PT Vale juga berpartisipasi dalam Quiz of Quality & Productivity, diwakili oleh Nella Yunita, Berni Dambo, dan Charles Andrianto.

Keikutsertaan PTVI di TKMPN XXIX 2025 bukan hanya tentang penghargaan, tetapi juga tentang berbagi praktik terbaik dan memperkuat budaya inovasi. Sebagai produsen nikel yang mendukung transisi energi bersih, PTVI memandang inovasi sebagai kunci untuk meningkatkan produktivitas sekaligus menjaga keberlanjutan lingkungan.

Setiap ide yang lahir dari tim internal mencerminkan komitmen perusahaan terhadap nilai CARES—Compassion, Accountability, Resilience, Excellence, dan Sustainability. Sejalan dengan tema besar TKMPN tahun ini, PTVI menegaskan perannya dalam membangun daya saing bangsa melalui inovasi yang berdampak positif. Dari efisiensi operasional hingga pengelolaan limbah yang ramah lingkungan, setiap langkah adalah kontribusi nyata untuk masa depan industri yang lebih hijau dan produktif.

en.title: Vale updates its Climate Change Policy
en.subtitle: The review reflects the continuous evolution of Vale’s strategy, fostering stronger alignment with international best practices.
en.body:
Vale announces the publication of the revised Climate Change Policy, approved by the Board of Directors on October 30th, 2025, reaffirming the company’s commitment to decarbonization and collaboration across its value chain. The updated policy emphasizes the strategic anda essential role of minerals in the energy transition and addresses key issues related to the company's climate change initiatives, including:

 

  • Just energy transition
  • Nature-based solutions, circular mining, and technological removals
  • Climate adaptation
  • Climate-related disclosure requirements, in accordance with applicable financial reporting standards

The review reflects the continuous evolution of Vale’s strategy, fostering stronger alignment with international best practices. It also enhances corporate transparency and broadens the company’s engagement with society and key opinion leaders.

For more information, read the full policy available here.

en.title: Vale lança campanha solidária para contribuir com a inclusão de pessoas com deficiência
en.subtitle: Iniciativa “Incluir Juntos” busca arrecadar R$ 1,1 milhão para aquisição de equipamentos assistivos, com doações multiplicadas pela empresa
en.body:
Com o propósito de fortalecer ações voltadas a ampliar a autonomia e a inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, a Vale lança a campanha Incluir Juntos. A iniciativa arrecadará recursos para aquisição de equipamentos assistivos — como andadores, cadeiras de rodas, óculos e aparelhos auditivos — destinados às famílias que integram o programa Juntos Contra a Pobreza, uma iniciativa articulada pela Vale que já reúne mais de 52.000 pessoas. A campanha está aberta a voluntários de todo o Brasil até o dia 14 de dezembro por meio do site da Rede Voluntária Vale (www.redevoluntariavale.com.br).

A iniciativa convida cada participante a fazer parte de uma corrente de solidariedade neste fim de ano, em que cada doação se multiplica. A cada R$ 1 doado, a Vale fará uma contribuição de R$ 10, totalizando até R$ 1 milhão em apoio da empresa e fortalecendo o impacto coletivo.

“Pessoas com deficiência enfrentam diversas barreiras que dificultam seu acesso à saúde, educação, trabalho e participação social. Quando somada à pobreza, essa realidade se torna ainda mais desafiadora, limitando o acesso a serviços especializados, tecnologias assistivas, transporte e ambientes inclusivos. A campanha nasceu desse contexto buscando engajar voluntários para levantar recursos que permitam promover mobilidade, conforto e bem-estar”, afirma Flavia Constant, diretora de Investimento Social Privado da Vale.


As doações poderão ser realizadas por meio de boleto bancário, transferência, PIX ou cartão de crédito no site da Rede Voluntária Vale (www.redevoluntariavale.com.br). Com uma mobilização conjunta em prol da inclusão e do enfrentamento à extrema pobreza, a arrecadação pode chegar em R$ 1,1 milhão para compra de equipamentos, beneficiando diretamente centenas de pessoas com deficiência e em situação de pobreza extrema.

A gestão do valor arrecadado será feita pelo Centro de Promoção da Saúde (CEDAPS), instituição referência em ações para o fortalecimento da Atenção Básica de Saúde e da Assistência Social. O CEDAPS também ficará responsável pela aquisição e distribuição de equipamentos assistivos aos beneficiários da campanha.

As pessoas beneficiadas integram o programa Juntos Contra a Pobreza, uma iniciativa articulada pela Vale e composta por mais de 30 parceiros, entre empresas e organizações sociais, que tem o objetivo de apoiar a saída de 500 mil pessoas da situação de extrema pobreza . Serviço Campanha Incluir Juntos Quando: 10 de novembro a 14 de dezembro Onde doar: www.redevoluntariavale.com.br

Sobre a Vale
A Vale é uma mineradora global que existe para melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro juntos. Uma das maiores produtoras mundiais de minério de ferro e níquel e importante produtora de cobre, a Vale tem sede no Brasil e atuação global. Suas operações compreendem sistemas logísticos integrados, incluindo aproximadamente 2.000 quilômetros de ferrovias, terminais marítimos e 10 portos distribuídos pelo mundo. A Vale tem as ambições de ser reconhecida pela sociedade como referência em segurança, a melhor operadora e a mais confiável, uma organização orientada aos talentos, líder em mineração sustentável, e referência em criação e compartilhamento de valor.

Sobre a Rede Voluntária Vale
Em 21 anos de existência, a Rede Voluntária Vale impactou cerca de 1,7 milhão de pessoas em mais de 2,5 mil ações. A Rede Voluntária Vale é composta por pessoas que se movem pela solidariedade e empatia, dispostas a doar e compartilhar seu tempo, talentos, afeto e recursos para contribuir com a melhoria na qualidade de vida das pessoas que mais precisam. Ao estimular a participação voluntária e a mobilização coletiva, a Vale reforça seu compromisso com os territórios onde está presente, contribuindo para ações que geram impacto social e deixam um legado positivo nas comunidades. Mais informações em www.redevoluntariavale.com.br

Sobre o Centro de Promoção da Saúde - CEDAPS
Fundada em 1993 e com sede no Rio de Janeiro, o Centro de Promoção da Saúde - CEDAPS é uma organização da sociedade civil que trabalha pela promoção da saúde, garantia de direitos e fortalecimento de comunidades em territórios populares. Com uma abordagem centrada na equidade, participação social e desenvolvimento local, o CEDAPS busca contribuir para a construção e o fortalecimento de políticas públicas inclusivas e sustentáveis, especialmente voltadas para populações em situação de vulnerabilidade. Mais informações em https://cedaps.org.br/

Sobre o Juntos Contra a Pobreza
O programa Juntos Contra a Pobreza é uma iniciativa que reúne empresas, organizações da sociedade civil e governos em uma atuação conjunta para enfrentar a pobreza extrema no Brasil. Mais informações em https://vale.com/pt/juntoscontraapobreza

en.title: Engaging Stakeholders: PT Vale Outlines Strategic Plan to Update Post-Mining Document for Sustainability
en.subtitle: As part of its strategic commitment to responsible mine closure and long-term environmental sustainability, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID Group, is preparing to update its post-mining plan for the Sorowako Block. The process began with a stakeholder consultation in Luwu Timur, held at the Sasana Praja Hall, Regent’s Office, on Tuesday, November 25, 2025. This initial dialogue marks a key step toward transparency and collaboration in revising the post-mining document.
en.body:
Malili, November 25, 2025 – As part of its strategic commitment to responsible mine closure and long-term environmental sustainability, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID Group, is preparing to update its post-mining plan for the Sorowako Block.

The process began with a stakeholder consultation in Luwu Timur, held at the Sasana Praja Hall, Regent’s Office, on Tuesday, November 25, 2025. This initial dialogue marks a key step toward transparency and collaboration in revising the post-mining document.

The session was attended by Acting Regional Secretary of Luwu Timur, Ramadhan Pirade, PT Vale’s management team, sub-district heads from Nuha, Towuti, Wasuponda, and Malili, village representatives, community members, and technical stakeholders.

Andri Ardiansyah, Specialist for Biodiversity and Mine Closure at PT Vale, explained that the update aligns with the company’s strategic plan to reinforce its sustainability commitments.

“The previous document was based on permits valid until 2025. PT Vale has now secured an extension until 2035 under a new Special Mining Business License (IUPK), which requires the post-mining plan to be revised accordingly,” he said.

The extended license means mining operations will continue until 2035, impacting land development projections, reclamation processes, and remaining open areas. The post-mining plan goes beyond ceasing operations—it includes land rehabilitation, environmental management, dismantling unnecessary facilities, and ongoing monitoring.

“This is an initial consultation. The document is yet to be drafted, and we want to capture input from government and communities before moving forward,” Andri emphasized.

Stakeholders used the forum to voice aspirations, including strengthening CSR programs, ensuring environmental data transparency, ecosystem restoration, and creating post-mining economic opportunities for local communities.

In line with PT Vale’s values, all feedback will be documented and incorporated into the revised post-mining plan, which will be submitted to Indonesia’s Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources.

Responding to the consultation, Acting Regional Secretary Ramadhan Pirade encouraged collective support for PT Vale’s agenda: “PT Vale is part of our community and contributes significantly to Luwu Timur’s development. We must safeguard this partnership,” he said, drawing applause from attendees.

The transition from a Contract of Work to an IUPK license on May 3, 2024, introduced new obligations, including tax schemes, revenue sharing, and profit-sharing mechanisms. “The IUPK framework ensures that regional governments receive a share of PT Vale’s net profits. This is an important point for all stakeholders to understand,” Ramadhan added.

This initial consultation underscores PT Vale’s commitment to ensuring that every stage of its mining operations delivers long-term benefits for the environment and surrounding communities—even after mining activities conclude.

id.title: Libatkan Pemangku Kepentingan, PT Vale Paparkan Rencana Strategis Perbaharui Dokumen Pasca Tambang untuk Keberlanjutan
id.subtitle: Sebagai bagian dari langkah strategis untuk memastikan penutupan lahan bekas tambang dilakukan dengan bertanggung jawab dan memperhatikan keberlanjutan lingkungan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), anggota grup MIND ID akan melakukan pembaharuan dokumen pasca tambang Blok Sorowako.  Langkah awal yang dilakukan dengan berkonsultasi melibatkan pemangku kepentingan Luwu Timur, di Aula Sasana Praja Kantor Bupati, Selasa (25/11/2025). Upaya transparansi tersebut sebagai alah satu tahapan penting dalam penyusunan pembaharuan dokumen pasca tambang.
id.body:
Malili, 25 November 2025 - Sebagai bagian dari langkah strategis untuk memastikan penutupan lahan bekas tambang dilakukan dengan bertanggung jawab dan memperhatikan keberlanjutan lingkungan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), anggota grup MIND ID akan melakukan pembaharuan dokumen pasca tambang Blok Sorowako.

Langkah awal yang dilakukan dengan berkonsultasi melibatkan pemangku kepentingan Luwu Timur, di Aula Sasana Praja Kantor Bupati, Selasa (25/11/2025). Upaya transparansi tersebut sebagai alah satu tahapan penting dalam penyusunan pembaharuan dokumen pasca tambang.

Kegiatan dihadiri Plt. Sekda Luwu Timur Ramadhan Pirade, jajaran manajemen PT Vale, empat camat dari Kecamatan Nuha, Towuti, Wasuponda, dan Malili, perwakilan desa wilayah pemberdayaan, unsur masyarakat, hingga stakeholder teknis lainnya.

Specialist Biodiversity and Mine Closure PT Vale Indonesia, Andri Ardiansyah memaparkan pembaharuan dokumen pasca tambang Blok Sorowako menjadi bagian dari rencana strategis perusahaan untuk melanjutkan komitmennya terhadap praktik keberlanjutan.

“Dokumen sebelumnya disusun berdasarkan izin yang berlaku sampai 2025. Kini PT Vale sudah mendapatkan perpanjangan izin sampai 2035, dan bentuk perizinannya berubah menjadi IUPK. Otomatis dokumen pascatambang harus ikut diperpanjang,” jelasnya.

Perpanjangan izin ini menambah masa operasi tambang berlangsung hingga 2035, sehingga proyeksi pembukaan lahan, proses reklamasi, hingga sisa area terbuka juga mengalami perubahan. Rencana pasca tambang bukan hanya soal operasi yang berhenti, tetapi mencakup rehabilitasi lahan, pengelolaan lingkungan, pembongkaran fasilitas yang tidak lagi diperlukan dan pemantauan.

“Ini baru konsultasi awal, dokumennya baru akan disusun. Kami ingin menangkap aspirasi pemerintah dan masyarakat sebelum penyusunan dilakukan,” tegas Andri.

Para pemangku kepentingan seperti Camat, Kepala Desa, dan perwakilan masyarakat memanfaatkan forum untuk menyampaikan aspirasi, mulai dari, penguatan program CSR, transparansi data lingkungan, kepastian pemulihan ekosistem, hingga peluang ekonomi pasca tambang bagi masyarakat.

Sejalan dengan nilai perusahaan, seluruh masukan yang disampaikan melalui forum tersebut dicatat dan didokumentasikan untuk menjadi masukan dalam penyempurnaan dokumen pasca tambang yang akan disusun dan diserahkan ke Kementerian ESDM.

Menanggapi konsultasi awal pembaharuan dokumen pasca tambang PT Vale, Plt Sekda Luwu Timur, Ramadhan Pirade mengajak seluruh pihak untuk mendukung agenda perusahaan: "Alhamdulillah hanya Luwu Timur tidak berutang. Itu karena PT Vale ada di sini. Makanya saya bilang PT Vale adalah milik kita, sehingga perlu dijaga,” ujar Ramadhan, yang langsung disambut tepuk tangan peserta.

Perubahan status dari Kontrak Karya menjadi Izin Usaha Pertambangan Khusus (IUPK) sejak 3 Mei 2024 membawa sejumlah konsekuensi baru, termasuk skema pajak, bagi hasil, hingga mekanisme sharing profit dari laba bersih perusahaan. “Di IUPK sudah diatur bahwa pemerintah daerah akan mendapatkan bagi hasil dari laba bersih. Itu yang harus dipahami bersama,” tambahnya.

Konsultasi awal ini menjadi penanda komitmen PT Vale dalam memastikan bahwa seluruh tahapan operasi tambang akan memberikan manfaat jangka panjang bagi lingkungan dan masyarakat sekitar Blok Sorowako, bahkan setelah aktivitas tambang berakhir.

en.title: Strengthening Stability, Accelerating Growth: PT Vale Delivers Robust Performance and Advances Indonesia’s Sustainable Nickel Future
en.subtitle: Amid a year shaped by global market volatility, regulatory changes, and operational challenges, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”), ticker symbol INCO, part of Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID), has demonstrated resilience, discipline, and a maturing transformation.
en.body:
Jakarta, November 24, 2025 — Amid a year shaped by global market volatility, regulatory changes, and operational challenges, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”), ticker symbol INCO, part of Mining Industry Indonesia (MIND ID), has demonstrated resilience, discipline, and a maturing transformation. At today’s Analyst Gathering, the company shared a compelling story of how strategic execution and responsible operational leadership continue to create long-term value for Indonesia and the global market.

Operational Performance: Strong and Reliable
Stable operations throughout Q3 2025 reinforced year-to-date performance. Nickel matte production reached 19,391 tons, up 4% quarter-on-quarter, bringing total 9M25 output to 54,975 tons. These results reflect disciplined maintenance planning, early technical interventions, and relentless teamwork at the Sorowako site.

This operational momentum translated into solid financial results:

Revenue: US$705 million
EBITDA: US$166 million
Net Income: US$52 million (up 3%)

Procurement efficiencies and energy optimization reduced nickel matte cash costs by 5%, strengthening resilience against external pressures.

Business Diversification Through Nickel Ore Sales
Agility in business strategy was evident in saprolite nickel ore sales, totaling 896,263 WMT through September 2025. This initiative unlocked new revenue streams, improved margins, and provided commercial flexibility amid challenging global price conditions.

“Financial resilience doesn’t happen by chance—it’s built through hard work and discipline,” said Rizky Andhika Putra, Chief Financial Officer. “By restructuring costs, strengthening working capital, and diversifying income sources, we’ve safeguarded margins and liquidity. As we enter 2026, financial prudence remains our foundation.”

Turning Challenges into Forward Momentum
The first half of 2025 brought its share of hurdles—from furnace disruptions to rising regulatory costs. Rather than slowing down, PT Vale accelerated execution: advancing maintenance schedules to 1H25, expediting EF3 rebuilding preparations, and tightening cost controls. These measures laid a stronger foundation for 2H25 and beyond.

Safety and Community: Non-Negotiable Commitments
Nothing matters more than safety. With zero fatalities year-to-date, TRIFR reduced to 0.43, and over 200 critical risk controls verified daily, PT Vale’s safety culture reflects discipline and strong leadership.

Sustainability Performance Reinforcing Indonesia’s Global Credibility
National and international recognitions—including ENSIA Award, Lestari Award, ESG Business Award, Investortrust ESG Award, and Subroto Award—underscore PT Vale’s strength in environmental stewardship and social development.

A major milestone: Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating improved to 23.7, placing PT Vale among the Top 15 lowest-risk mining companies globally. Progress toward IRMA-50 certification continues, now in the critical requirement improvement phase—affirming commitment to world-class responsible mining standards.

Historic Progress in the US$9 Billion Growth Program
Four major growth engines—Pomalaa, Bahodopi, Sorowako Limonite, and Tanamalia—are advancing significantly, representing one of Indonesia’s largest clean-energy-oriented investments:

  • Pomalaa (Ford & Huayou): Mine progress 43.71%, HPAL 33.04%
  • Bahodopi (GEI): Mine progress 89.7%, HPAL 16.72%
  • Sorowako Limonite: Construction progress 25.37%
  • Tanamalia: Feasibility study and technical partner selection underway

These projects will deliver “the right nickel”—Class 1, low-carbon, essential for global EV battery supply chains.
“This growth program is more than an investment—it’s a national contribution,” said Muhammad Asril, Chief of Projects. “Every milestone achieved and every ton of new capacity is part of our shared ambition to build an integrated clean-energy nickel ecosystem in Indonesia.”

Exploring the Future: Doubling Reserves
Long-term exploration plans aim to unlock up to 2.5 times current reserves, covering over 118,000 hectares across South, Central, and Southeast Sulawesi. Starting in 2026, intensive drilling—up to 6,500 holes annually—will secure Indonesia’s strategic nickel supply for decades.

2026 Outlook: Efficiency, Reliability, and Sustainable Transformation
The coming year will be pivotal as PT Vale establishes a new cost baseline, enhances operational reliability, and strengthens discipline across its three core operations: Sorowako, Bahodopi, and Pomalaa.

With market uncertainty and rising regulatory expectations, PT Vale’s focus for 2026 is clear: improve production reliability, uphold the highest sustainability standards, accelerate project execution, and create shared value for Indonesia.

For further information, please contact:
Rizky Andhika Putra, Chief Financial Officer

id.title: Mengukuhkan Stabilitas, Mempercepat Pertumbuhan: PT Vale Memperkuat Kinerja dan Mendorong Masa Depan Nikel Berkelanjutan Indonesia
id.subtitle: Di tengah tahun yang penuh tekanan pasar global, perubahan regulasi, dan tantangan operasional, perjalanan PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”), Kode Saham (“INCO”) bagian dari Mining Industry (MIND ID) justru menunjukkan ketahanan, kedisiplinan, dan transformasi yang semakin matang.
id.body:
Jakarta, 24 November 2025 — Di tengah tahun yang penuh tekanan pasar global, perubahan regulasi, dan tantangan operasional, perjalanan PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”), Kode Saham (“INCO”) bagian dari Mining Industry (MIND ID) justru menunjukkan ketahanan, kedisiplinan, dan transformasi yang semakin matang. Pada Analyst Gathering hari ini, perusahaan memaparkan kisah kuat tentang bagaimana eksekusi strategis dan kepemimpinan operasional yang bertanggung jawab terus menciptakan nilai jangka panjang bagi Indonesia dan dunia.

Kinerja Operasional yang Menguat dan Semakin Andal
Stabilitas operasi selama 3Q25 memperkokoh performa sepanjang tahun. Produksi nikel matte mencapai 19.391 ton, naik 4% dibanding triwulan sebelumnya, mendorong total produksi 9M25 menjadi 54.975 ton. Di balik angka ini terdapat perencanaan pemeliharaan yang lebih disiplin, intervensi teknis lebih awal, dan kerja tim yang tak mengenal lelah di site Sorowako.

Momentum tersebut tercermin dalam hasil keuangan yang solid. Pendapatan mencapai US$705 juta, EBITDA berada pada US$166 juta, dan laba bersih meningkat 3% menjadi US$52 juta. Efisiensi di sisi pengadaan dan optimasi energi berhasil menurunkan cash cost nikel matte sebesar 5%, memperkuat daya tahan perusahaan terhadap tekanan eksternal.

Diversifikasi Bisnis Melalui Penjualan Bijih Nikel
Bisnis perusahaan semakin lincah melalui penjualan bijih nikel saprolit, yang mencapai 896.263 WMT hingga September 2025. Langkah ini membuka sumber pendapatan baru, menguatkan margin, dan memberikan fleksibilitas komersial pada kondisi harga global yang menantang.

“Ketahanan finansial itu tidak datang begitu saja, melainkan dihasilkan dari kerja keras dan disiplin,” jelas Rizky Andhika Putra, Chief Financial Officer. “Dengan menata ulang struktur biaya, memperkuat modal kerja, dan membuka sumber pendapatan baru, kami mampu menjaga margin dan likuiditas. Memasuki 2026, prinsip kehati-hatian finansial akan tetap menjadi fondasi kami.”

Tantangan yang Diubah Menjadi Gerak Maju
Paruh pertama 2025 bukan tanpa tantangan—mulai dari gangguan furnace hingga tekanan kenaikan biaya regulasi. Namun alih-alih memperlambat langkah, perusahaan justru mempercepat eksekusi. Jadwal pemeliharaan dipercepat ke 1H25, persiapan rebuilding EF3 dimajukan, dan kontrol biaya diperketat. Semua ini menyiapkan pijakan yang lebih kuat untuk 2H25 dan tahun 2026.

Keselamatan dan Komunitas: Komitmen yang Tidak Pernah Ditawar
Tidak ada capaian yang lebih penting dari keselamatan. Dengan zero fatality year-to-date, penurunan TRIFR menjadi 0,43 dan lebih dari 200 kontrol risiko kritis diverifikasi setiap hari, budaya keselamatan menjadi bukti kedisiplinan dan kepemimpinan yang kuat.

Kinerja Keberlanjutan yang Menguatkan Kredibilitas Indonesia
Serangkaian pengakuan nasional dan internasional—seperti ENSIA Award, Lestari Award, ESG Business Award, Investortrust ESG Award, dan Subroto Award—menggambarkan kekuatan perusahaan dalam pengelolaan lingkungan dan pembangunan sosial.

Pencapaian besar lainnya adalah peningkatan Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating menjadi 23,7, menjadikan perusahaan masuk dalam Top 15 perusahaan pertambangan berisiko ESG terendah di dunia. Upaya menuju sertifikasi IRMA-50 juga terus berlanjut dan memasuki fase critical requirement improvement—penanda keseriusan dalam mematuhi standar pertambangan bertanggung jawab kelas dunia.

Kemajuan Bersejarah dalam Program Pertumbuhan US$9 Miliar
Empat mesin pertumbuhan besar—Pomalaa, Bahodopi, Sorowako Limonite, dan Tanamalia—mencatat progres signifikan dan menjadikan ini salah satu investasi berorientasi energi bersih terbesar di Indonesia:

•  Pomalaa (Ford & Huayou): Progres tambang 43,71%, HPAL 33,04%
•  Bahodopi (GEI): Progres tambang 89,7%, HPAL 16,72%
•  Sorowako Limonite: Progres konstruksi 25,37%
•  Tanamalia: Studi kelayakan dan pemilihan mitra teknis berjalan baik

Proyek-proyek ini akan menghasilkan “nikel yang tepat”—kelas 1, rendah karbon, dan dibutuhkan oleh industri baterai kendaraan listrik global.

“Rangkaian proyek pertumbuhan ini bukan hanya investasi, tetapi kontribusi besar bagi negeri,” tutur Muhammad Asril, Chief of Projects. “Setiap persen progres, setiap milestones yang tercapai, dan setiap ton kapasitas baru adalah bagian dari ambisi bersama untuk membangun ekosistem nikel energi bersih yang terintegrasi di Indonesia.”

Eksplorasi Masa Depan untuk Menggandakan Cadangan
Rencana eksplorasi jangka panjang tengah disiapkan untuk membuka potensi mineral hingga 2,5 kali cadangan saat ini, mencakup lebih dari 118.000 hektare di Sulawesi Selatan, Tengah, dan Tenggara. Mulai 2026, program pengeboran intensif—hingga 6.500 hole per tahun—akan memastikan keberlanjutan pasokan nikel strategis Indonesia di masa depan.

Arah 2026: Efisiensi, Keandalan, dan Transformasi Berkelanjutan
Tahun mendatang akan menjadi fase penting ketika perusahaan membentuk baseline biaya baru, meningkatkan keandalan operasi, dan memperkuat disiplin di tiga area operasi utama: Sorowako, Bahodopi, dan Pomalaa.

Dengan ketidakpastian pasar yang masih terasa dan ekspektasi regulasi yang meningkat, fokus perusahaan memasuki 2026 sangat jelas: meningkatkan keandalan produksi, menjaga standar keberlanjutan tertinggi, mempercepat eksekusi proyek, dan menciptakan nilai bersama bagi Indonesia.

en.title: From Kolaka’s Fields to Indonesia’s Food Security: PT Vale’s Sustainable Rice Collaboration Driving Agricultural Transformation
en.subtitle: Kolaka holds significant agricultural potential, yet farmers have long faced persistent challenges: limited access to high-yield varieties, suboptimal cultivation practices, and uneven adoption of precision farming technologies. Through a strategic partnership between the Kolaka Government and PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (Mind ID), these challenges are being addressed with research-driven, technology-based solutions.
en.body:
Kolaka, November 23, 2025 – As Indonesia advances its national food security agenda in line with the President’s Asta Cita vision, Kolaka Regency has become the stage for a strategic collaboration uniting central government, local authorities, and industry. Today marks the launch of sustainable rice demonstration plots in Puubunga Village (Baula), Lemedai Village (Tanggetada), and Pubenua Village (Baula)—an initiative that goes beyond planting rice. It is about sowing hope, knowledge, and the seeds of future food independence for Kolaka.

Kolaka holds significant agricultural potential, yet farmers have long faced persistent challenges: limited access to high-yield varieties, suboptimal cultivation practices, and uneven adoption of precision farming technologies.

Through a strategic partnership between the Kolaka Government and PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), part of the Mining Industry Indonesia (Mind ID), these challenges are being addressed with research-driven, technology-based solutions. The demonstration plots will test superior rice varieties (PR25, PR107, Bujang Marantau, Trisakti, Menthik Wangi, and Menthik Susu) alongside precision farming systems such as Perennial Rice and Salibu, enabling multiple harvests without replanting.

This initiative does more than align with national priorities—it accelerates them: strengthening food sovereignty from the village level, boosting productivity at the grassroots, and ensuring farmer welfare as the foundation of Kolaka’s resilient development.

“We Are Planting Kolaka’s Future”

Bernardus Irmanto, President Director of PT Vale Indonesia, emphasized the company’s commitment to supporting community empowerment:
“Every seed planted today is more than a crop—it is a symbol of our commitment to Kolaka’s future. Food security is the cornerstone of regional independence, and we believe agricultural innovation can thrive alongside industrial development. Through this partnership, we aim to ensure Kolaka’s communities grow, progress, and prosper with us.”

For the Kolaka Regency Government, this collaboration represents a tangible step toward its Kolaka Food Independence agenda. Agriculture is no longer a supporting sector—it is the backbone of rural economic resilience. Research on rice varieties and precision farming technologies within these plots is expected to create a replicable model for other villages.

Widiastuti, Deputy for Food and Agribusiness at the Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs, stated:
“The President has emphasized that national welfare begins with nutritional security. Superior seeds are available, but distribution remains uneven. Villages must be developed based on local strengths. Initiatives like these demonstration plots are not only relevant—they are strategic for reinforcing national food security.”

This program builds on foundations laid since 2021 through PT Vale’s organic farming initiatives in the Pomalaa Block. To date, 55 farmers—including nine women—have participated. One organic variety, Menthik Susu, is already being marketed and consumed locally.

The new demonstration plots will be expanded gradually. In the upcoming harvest season, the best-performing varieties will be replicated, marketed locally, and used to provide high-quality food for Kolaka’s communities.

Budiawansyah, Director and CSCAO of PT Vale Indonesia, highlighted the sustainability philosophy behind the initiative:
“For us, sustainability is how we operate. We aim to ensure economic growth goes hand in hand with community empowerment. Through these plots, we are not only increasing productivity but creating a resilient, environmentally friendly agricultural ecosystem that delivers added value for Kolaka’s farmers.”

This movement demonstrates how industry, government, and communities can work together to address increasingly complex food challenges. With scientific approaches, farmer capacity building, and government support, these demonstration plots are projected to deliver long-term impacts on regional food security, rural economic growth, improved nutrition, and Kolaka’s position as a hub for sustainable agriculture in Southeast Sulawesi.

In Kolaka, today’s seeds are tomorrow’s future—a future where agriculture, industry, and communities grow together, strengthen each other, and contribute meaningfully to Indonesia.

id.title: Dari Lahan Kolaka untuk Ketahanan Pangan Indonesia: PT Vale Kolaborasi Padi Berkelanjutan untuk Hadirkan Transformasi Pertanian Berbasis Inovasi
id.subtitle: Kabupaten Kolaka memiliki potensi pangan yang besar, namun selama bertahun-tahun petani masih menghadapi tantangan klasik: ketersediaan varietas unggul yang terbatas, teknik budidaya yang belum optimal, hingga akses terhadap teknologi pertanian presisi yang belum merata.Melalui kemitraan strategis antara Pemerintah Kolaka dan PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) bagian dari Mining Industry (MindID) melihat tantangan tersebut mulai dijawab lewat pendekatan riset dan inovasi berbasis teknologi.
id.body:
Kolaka, 23 November 2025 – Di tengah upaya bangsa memperkuat ketahanan pangan nasional sesuai Asta Cita Presiden, Kabupaten Kolaka menjadi panggung kolaborasi penting yang menyatukan pemerintah pusat, pemerintah daerah, dan dunia usaha. Hari ini, melalui penanaman perdana demplot padi berkelanjutan di Desa Puubunga (Baula), Desa Lemedai (Tanggetada), dan Desa Pubenua (Baula), lahir sebuah inisiatif yang bukan hanya menanam benih padi—tetapi menanam harapan, pengetahuan, dan masa depan kemandirian pangan Kolaka.

Kabupaten Kolaka memiliki potensi pangan yang besar, namun selama bertahun-tahun petani masih menghadapi tantangan klasik: ketersediaan varietas unggul yang terbatas, teknik budidaya yang belum optimal, hingga akses terhadap teknologi pertanian presisi yang belum merata.

Melalui kemitraan strategis antara Pemerintah Kolaka dan PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) bagian dari Mining Industry (MindID) melihat tantangan tersebut mulai dijawab lewat pendekatan riset dan inovasi berbasis teknologi. Demplot ini menguji varietas unggul (PR25, PR107, Bujang Marantau, Trisakti, Menthik Wangi, dan Menthik Susu) serta sistem budidaya presisi seperti Perennial Rice dan Salibu, yang memungkinkan panen berulang tanpa penanaman ulang.

Inisiatif ini bukan hanya mengikuti agenda nasional, tetapi mengakselerasinya: memperkuat kedaulatan pangan dari desa, menaikkan produktivitas dari tapak, dan memastikan kesejahteraan petani sebagai fondasi pembangunan Kolaka yang tangguh.

“Kami Hadir untuk Menanam Masa Depan Kolaka”
Direktur Utama PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, menegaskan bahwa program ini merupakan bagian dari misi perusahaan untuk menjadi mitra strategis pemerintah dalam membangun masyarakat yang berdaya:

“Setiap benih yang ditanam hari ini bukan sekadar tanaman, tetapi simbol komitmen kami untuk menanam masa depan Kolaka. Ketahanan pangan adalah fondasi kemandirian sebuah daerah, dan kami percaya inovasi pertanian dapat berjalan berdampingan dengan pembangunan industri. Melalui kemitraan ini, kami ingin memastikan masyarakat Kolaka tumbuh, maju, dan sejahtera bersama kami.”

Bagi Pemerintah Kabupaten Kolaka, kolaborasi ini menjadi langkah nyata menuju agenda Kolaka Mandiri Pangan. Pertanian bukan lagi sektor pendukung, tetapi tulang punggung kemandirian ekonomi desa. Penelitian varietas dan teknologi pertanian presisi dalam demplot ini diproyeksikan menjadi model yang dapat direplikasi di desa lain.

Deputi Bidang Pangan dan Agribisnis Kemenko Perekonomian RI, Widiastuti, menyampaikan:
“Presiden menegaskan bahwa kesejahteraan bangsa dimulai dari pemenuhan gizi masyarakat. Benih unggul sudah tersedia, tetapi distribusinya belum merata. Karena itu, desa harus dikembangkan sesuai keunggulan lokal. Inisiatif seperti demplot ini bukan hanya relevan, tetapi strategis untuk memperkuat ketahanan pangan nasional.”

Inisiatif ini melanjutkan fondasi yang dibangun sejak 2021 melalui pertanian organik SRI yang dikembangkan PT Vale di Blok Pomalaa. Hingga kini, 55 petani, termasuk 9 perempuan telah ikut serta. Salah satu varietas organik, Menthik Susu, sudah mulai dipasarkan dan dikonsumsi masyarakat Kolaka.

Demplot baru ini akan dikembangkan bertahap. Pada musim panen mendatang, varietas dengan hasil terbaik akan direplikasi, dipasarkan secara lokal, dan digunakan sebagai pangan berkualitas untuk masyarakat Kolaka.

Direktur dan CSCAO PT Vale Indonesia, Budiawansyah, menegaskan bahwa inisiatif ini mencerminkan filosofi keberlanjutan perusahaan:
“Bagi kami, keberlanjutan adalah cara kami bekerja. Kami ingin memastikan bahwa pertumbuhan ekonomi hadir bersamaan dengan pemberdayaan masyarakat. Melalui demplot ini, kami tidak hanya meningkatkan produktivitas, tetapi menciptakan ekosistem pertanian yang resilient, ramah lingkungan, dan memberikan nilai tambah bagi petani Kolaka.”

Gerakan ini menunjukkan bagaimana industri, pemerintah, dan masyarakat dapat berjalan seiring untuk menjawab tantangan pangan yang semakin kompleks. Dengan pendekatan ilmiah, penguatan kapasitas petani, dan dukungan pemerintah, demplot ini diproyeksikan memberi dampak jangka panjang bagi ketahanan pangan daerah, pertumbuhan ekonomi desa, peningkatan gizi masyarakat, serta kemandirian Kolaka sebagai pusat pangan berkelanjutan di Sulawesi Tenggara.

Di Kolaka, benih hari ini adalah masa depan yang sedang ditumbuhkan, masa depan di mana pertanian, industri, dan masyarakat dapat berkembang bersama, saling menguatkan, dan memberi kontribusi nyata bagi Indonesia.

en.title: Reinforcing Its Role as a Pioneer in Community-Based Sustainable Development, PT Vale Indonesia Wins Community Empowerment Award at ESG Appreciation 2025
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale”) reaffirms its commitment to inclusive, long-term social development. The Company has officially received the Community Empowerment Award at the ESG Appreciation 2025 event organized by B-Universe in Jakarta. This award recognizes PT Vale’s consistency and success in delivering measurable, innovative community empowerment programs that create tangible impacts across its operational areas—Sorowako in East Luwu and Kolaka in Southeast Sulawesi.
en.body:
Jakarta, November 20, 2025 — As part of MIND ID and a strategic partner of the Indonesian government in advancing downstream development and sustainability within the energy and mineral resources sector, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” or “the Company”) reaffirms its commitment to inclusive, long-term social development. The Company has officially received the Community Empowerment Award at the ESG Appreciation 2025 event organized by B-Universe in Jakarta.

This award recognizes PT Vale’s consistency and success in delivering measurable, innovative community empowerment programs that create tangible impacts across its operational areas—Sorowako in East Luwu and Kolaka in Southeast Sulawesi.

The award was accepted by Vinicius Mendes Ferreira, Executive Advisor of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, on behalf of the Company. In his remarks, Vinicius stated: “Community empowerment is the essence of sustainability itself. For us, every program must open opportunities, strengthen capacities, and deliver long-term progress for the communities surrounding our operations.”

Recognizing Community-Based Development Models in Mining
The award highlights PT Vale’s flagship programs that have become benchmarks for community-driven social development in the mining sector. Three standout initiatives include Matano Iniaku, Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, Berdaya, and PPM SDGs Desa.

“Matano Iniaku” — Transforming a Remote Hamlet into a Resilient Community
Located in Dusun Matano on the shores of Lake Matano, East Luwu, the Matano Iniaku program was born from a participatory approach and community dialogue. Previously, this isolated hamlet was only accessible by raft, lacked healthcare facilities, and had no clean water network.

Through this program, PT Vale has delivered:

  • A piped clean water system directly to households.
  • Rehabilitation of 200 hectares of watershed, increasing Laa Waa River flow and reducing emissions by 22,538 tons CO₂eq.
  • A speedboat ambulance, telecommunications network, and improved basic infrastructure.
  • Formation of four local institutions (tourism group, farmers’ group, women’s group, and disaster response team) to ensure social sustainability.

The program achieved a Social Return on Investment (SROI) of 1:1.08 and was recognized as the best Community Development Program nationally through the Subroto Award 2025.

“Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, Berdaya” — Building Empowerment Foundations in Pomalaa Block
In Southeast Sulawesi, PT Vale launched Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, Berdaya, a community development framework aligned with the industrial development of the Pomalaa Block in partnership with Huayou.

The program focuses on three pillars:

  • Kolaka Sehat — improving healthcare, nutrition, and clean water access.
  • Kolaka Bersih — integrated waste management and environmental restoration.
  • Kolaka Berdaya — strengthening MSMEs, empowering women, youth vocational training, and household economic growth.

To prepare a skilled local workforce, PT Vale and Huayou also introduced the Bridge Program, equipping Kolaka’s youth with competencies in hydrometallurgy and electric vehicle battery industries.

PPM SDGs Desa — Strengthening Independence in 38 Villages Around Operations
Since 2023, PT Vale has implemented the Community Development Program Supporting Village SDGs, covering 38 villages across four districts near Sorowako: Malili, Wasuponda, Nuha, and Towuti.

The program supports:

  • Local economic growth through MSMEs and cooperatives.
  • Improved basic services such as clean water, irrigation, healthcare, and education.
  • Community-driven infrastructure development.
  • Youth capacity building through vocational training and financial literacy.

A participatory approach—where communities act as primary planners, the company as technical facilitator, and government as governance steward—has been key to success. Early impacts include improved public services and accelerated village-level economic growth.

Commitment to an Inclusive Future
These achievements reflect PT Vale’s shared value philosophy: sustainability is not merely about compliance but about delivering real benefits to communities.

Vinicius Mendes Ferreira emphasized: “Sustainability does not end with compliance. It must manifest as tangible change, open opportunities, and a future that grows together with communities.”

By receiving the Community Empowerment Award at ESG Appreciation 2025, PT Vale continues its role as a pioneer in social development within the mining sector—fostering resilient, inclusive, and empowered communities from South to Southeast Sulawesi.

id.title: Perkuat Peran sebagai Pelopor Pembangunan Berkelanjutan Berbasis Komunitas, PT Vale Raih Penghargaan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat di ESG Appreciation 2025
id.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk kembali menegaskan komitmennya terhadap pembangunan sosial yang inklusif dan berjangka panjang. Perseroan resmi meraih penghargaan Community Empowerment pada ajang ESG Appreciation 2025 yang diselenggarakan oleh B-Universe di Jakarta. Penghargaan ini diberikan kepada PT Vale atas konsistensi dan keberhasilan Perseroan menghadirkan program pemberdayaan masyarakat yang terukur, inovatif, dan memberikan dampak langsung bagi komunitas di wilayah operasionalnya—baik di Sorowako, Luwu Timur, maupun di Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara.
id.body:
Jakarta, 20 November 2025 — Sebagai bagian dari MIND ID dan mitra strategis pemerintah dalam mendorong hilirisasi serta pembangunan berkelanjutan di sektor energi dan sumber daya mineral, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (“PT Vale” atau “Perseroan”) kembali menegaskan komitmennya terhadap pembangunan sosial yang inklusif dan berjangka panjang. Perseroan resmi meraih penghargaan Community Empowerment pada ajang ESG Appreciation 2025 yang diselenggarakan oleh B-Universe di Jakarta.

Penghargaan ini diberikan kepada PT Vale atas konsistensi dan keberhasilan Perseroan menghadirkan program pemberdayaan masyarakat yang terukur, inovatif, dan memberikan dampak langsung bagi komunitas di wilayah operasionalnya—baik di Sorowako, Luwu Timur, maupun di Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara.

Penghargaan diterima oleh Vinicius Mendes Ferreira, Executive Advisor PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, mewakili Perseroan. Dalam keterangannya, Vinicius menyampaikan,” Pemberdayaan masyarakat adalah esensi dari keberlanjutan itu sendiri. Bagi kami, setiap program harus membuka peluang, memperkuat kapasitas, dan menghadirkan kemajuan jangka panjang bagi masyarakat di sekitar operasi kami.”

Penghargaan ini mengakui berbagai program utama PT Vale yang selama beberapa tahun terakhir menjadi model pembangunan sosial berbasis komunitas di sektor pertambangan. Tiga inisiatif yang menonjol adalah Matano Iniaku, Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, Berdaya, dan PPM SDGs Desa.

“Matano Iniaku” — Transformasi Desa Terpencil Menjadi Komunitas Tangguh

Program Matano Iniaku di Dusun Matano, tepian Danau Matano, Luwu Timur, lahir dari pendekatan dialog dan partisipasi masyarakat. Sebelumnya, dusun terpencil ini hanya dapat diakses via rakit, minim fasilitas kesehatan, dan tanpa jaringan air bersih.

Melalui program ini, Perseroan menghadirkan:

 

  •  Sistem pipanisasi air bersih langsung ke rumah-rumah warga.
  • Rehabilitasi 200 hektare DAS, meningkatkan debit air Sungai Laa Waa dan menurunkan emisi 22.538 ton CO₂eq.
  • Ambulans speedboat, jaringan telekomunikasi, serta perbaikan infrastruktur dasar.
  • Pembentukan empat kelembagaan lokal (Pokdarwis, kelompok tani, KWT, dan Redkar) untuk memastikan keberlanjutan sosial.

Program ini mencatat Social Return on Investment (SROI) 1:1,08 dan dinobatkan sebagai PPM terbaik tingkat nasional melalui Penghargaan Subroto 2025.

“Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, Berdaya” — Fondasi Pemberdayaan di Blok Pomalaa

Di Sulawesi Tenggara, PT Vale meluncurkan program Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, dan Berdaya, sebuah kerangka pembangunan masyarakat yang disejajarkan dengan pembangunan kawasan industri Blok Pomalaa bersama mitra strategis, Huayou.

Program ini berfokus pada tiga pilar utama:

  1. Kolaka Sehat — peningkatan layanan kesehatan, gizi, dan air bersih.
  2. Kolaka Bersih — pengelolaan sampah terpadu dan restorasi lingkungan.
  3. Kolaka Berdaya — penguatan UMKM, pemberdayaan perempuan, vokasi pemuda, dan peningkatan ekonomi rumah tangga.

Untuk mendorong kesiapan tenaga kerja lokal, PT Vale dan Huayou juga meluncurkan Bridge Program, yang membekali pemuda Kolaka dengan kompetensi hydrometallurgy dan industri baterai kendaraan listrik.

PPM SDGs Desa — Penguatan Kemandirian 38 Desa Sekitar Operasi

Sejak 2023, Perseroan  menjalankan Program PPM Dukungan SDGs Desa yang mencakup 38 desa di empat kecamatan di sekitar Sorowako: Malili, Wasuponda, Nuha, dan Towuti.

Program ini mendukung:

 

  •   Peningkatan ekonomi lokal melalui UMKM dan koperasi.
  •   Perbaikan layanan dasar seperti air bersih, irigasi, kesehatan, dan pendidikan.
  •   Pembangunan infrastruktur desa berbasis kebutuhan masyarakat.
  •   Pengembangan kapasitas generasi muda melalui pelatihan vokasi dan literasi keuangan.

Pendekatan partisipatif—masyarakat sebagai perencana utama, perusahaan sebagai pendamping teknis, dan pemerintah sebagai penjaga tata kelola—menjadi kunci keberhasilan program ini. Dampak awal terlihat pada meningkatnya kualitas layanan publik dan pertumbuhan ekonomi desa-desa binaan.

Komitmen untuk Masa Depan yang Inklusif

Keberhasilan berbagai inisiatif ini menunjukkan filosofi shared value perusahaan: bahwa keberlanjutan tidak hanya tentang kepatuhan terhadap standar, tetapi tentang menghadirkan manfaat yang dirasakan nyata oleh masyarakat.

Vinicius Mendes Ferreira menegaskan: “Keberlanjutan tidak berhenti pada kepatuhan. Ia harus hadir sebagai perubahan yang dirasakan, peluang yang terbuka, dan masa depan yang tumbuh bersama masyarakat.”

Dengan diraihnya penghargaan Community Empowerment pada ESG Appreciation 2025 ini, Perseroan melanjutkan perannya sebagai pelopor pembangunan sosial di sektor pertambangan—mendorong komunitas yang lebih tangguh, inklusif, dan berdaya dari Sulawesi Selatan hingga Sulawesi Tenggara.

en.title: The Holiday Train will begin operating in 2026 along the Vitória-Minas Railway
en.subtitle: Check out the schedule for the special trips
en.body:
Special trips will take place in January, July, and December, during nighttime hours, as part of Vale’s commitments under the renewal of the railway concession.

Starting in January 2026, passengers on the Vitória-Minas Railway will enjoy a new feature: the Holiday Train, which will run in January, July, and December, at night. This initiative reinforces the railway’s role in regional integration and stems from one of Vale’s commitments under the renewed concession agreement, developed in partnership with the National Land Transport Agency (ANTT).

Tickets for the special January schedule will go on sale starting November 20. For safety reasons, tickets will not be sold at stations during nighttime hours. Purchases must be made during regular ticket office hours or online at vale.com/tremdepassageiros, available 24/7.

“The Holiday Train is a direct response to the public’s desire for a safe and comfortable rail transport option at night, especially during peak travel months. Choosing nighttime service goes beyond the commitment established with the regulatory agency, which does not mandate this format. The initiative reflects our ongoing effort to enhance the passenger experience,” says João Falcão, Director of the Vitória-Minas Railway.

The new fleet, already operating alternately on daytime trips, offers features that ensure comfort and safety for passengers and crew. The trains include executive and economy classes, wheelchair-accessible elevators, and dedicated spaces for passengers with reduced mobility. Stations serving the Holiday Train are equipped with appropriate infrastructure, including enhanced lighting.

During the Holiday Train journey, passengers will be able to purchase food, such as snacks and meals, at the onboard snack bar. Ticket prices will remain the same as daytime trips. Stops for January have been defined based on current passenger demand, including the connection between Itabira and Nova Era.
“The first month of Holiday Train operations will be essential to assess the best way to serve passengers and make any necessary adjustments,” says João Falcão.

Infrastructure

All stations where the Holiday Train will stop will receive additional lighting.
In addition to passenger transport, Vale invests in projects that improve mobility and safety along the Vitória-Minas Railway, considered one of the safest in the country by ANTT.

About the Passenger Train

The Vitória-Minas Railway is the only railway in Brazil to operate a long-distance passenger train daily, connecting the states of Minas Gerais and Espírito Santo along a 664 km route.

Throughout the journey, passengers enjoy beautiful landscapes, history, comfort, and safety.

Every day at 7:00 a.m., a train departs from Cariacica, in the Greater Vitória region (ES), bound for Belo Horizonte (MG), arriving around 8:30 p.m. At the same time, another train departs from the capital of Minas Gerais at 7:00 a.m. and arrives in Cariacica at approximately 8:30 p.m.

The fleet includes executive and economy cars, as well as restaurant, snack bar, generator, and wheelchair-accessible cars. Each executive car accommodates 57 passengers, while economy cars have 75 seats. Both classes feature air conditioning and power outlets for charging electronic devices such as laptops and mobile phones.

The entire train is equipped with smoke detectors, enhancing passenger safety. Cars also feature video monitors to provide entertainment during the trip.
Tickets can be purchased at sales points, online (www.vale.com/tremdepassageiros), or via the mobile app “Trem de Passageiros,” available for free on Android and iOS platforms.
