en.title: Synergy for Asta Cita: PT Vale Participates in South Sulawesi’s 356th Anniversary through ‘Sulsel Expo Andalan Hati’
en.subtitle: Aligned with the President’s Asta Cita vision, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening MSMEs—key drivers of the national economy—by actively collaborating with the South Sulawesi Government during the province’s 356th anniversary to boost the real sector.
en.body:
Makassar, October 15, 2025 — In line with the spirit of Asta Cita as envisioned by the President, support for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)—a vital pillar of the national economy—must be continuously strengthened. As part of the 356th Anniversary celebrations of South Sulawesi Province, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) actively participated and collaborated with the local government to invigorate the real sector.

As a manifestation of this commitment, PT Vale took part in the UMKM Expo “Andalan Hati”, themed “Sulsel Maju dan Berkarakter 2025” (South Sulawesi: Progressive and Character-Driven 2025), held over five days from October 15 to 19, 2025, at the Mandala Monument, Jenderal Sudirman Street, Makassar.

During the opening ceremony on Wednesday, October 15, 2025, Governor Andi Sudirman Sulaiman expressed his hopes for enhancing the capacity of MSME players. He also acknowledged the contributions of supporting companies, including PT Vale, by presenting a certificate of appreciation for their role in achieving a record-breaking feat: the largest serving of vegetarian dishes and coffee beverages, a highlight of the Expo’s opening festivities.

Empowering Local MSMEs

Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations at PT Vale Indonesia, emphasized that the company’s presence at the Sulsel Expo reflects its core values of transforming natural resources into sustainable prosperity.

“Today, PT Vale is proud to participate in the UMKM Expo, part of the 356th South Sulawesi Anniversary celebration. We are showcasing a variety of MSME products nurtured through our community development programs, including keripik pangkilang (fish chips), Kopi Matano, banana snacks, red ginger sarabba, teng-teng (traditional peanut snacks), and many more,” he stated.

These products are not merely household creations but the result of ongoing capacity-building efforts by PT Vale in collaboration with communities surrounding its operational areas. For Endra, this participation is a strategic move to expand market access for Vale-supported MSMEs.

“This is our effort to ensure that Vale’s MSME products gain broader recognition—not only in East Luwu but across South Sulawesi,” he added. “We aim to maximize sales and generate tangible economic impact for the community.”

On the first day of the Expo, 150 cups of Kopi Matano were served to visitors, with plans to distribute 50–100 cups daily throughout the event. Coinciding with World Coffee Day and World Vegetarian Day, PT Vale distributed approximately 200 cups of Kopi Matano to attendees.

The coffee originates from farmers in Nuha Village, near Lake Matano, an area adjacent to PT Vale’s nickel mining operations. The beans are processed and served by MSME partners under PT Vale’s guidance.

Government and Private Sector SynergyPT Vale’s support for the 2025 UMKM Expo was warmly received by the South Sulawesi Provincial Government.

“This event is truly remarkable,” said Governor Andi Sudirman after visiting several booths. “The products are impressive. We hope events like this continue and that companies like PT Vale remain committed to supporting them.”

The Governor also highlighted the importance of collaboration between government and private enterprises in strengthening MSME capacity—through training, financial assistance, and product packaging support, especially for MSMEs in rural areas.

Echoing this sentiment, Iqbal Suhaeb, Chair of the South Sulawesi Anniversary Committee, stated that the UMKM Expo is set to become an annual agenda. This year, nearly 100 local MSMEs participated.

“PT Vale is one of the companies supporting this event, and we hope this contribution continues in line with the Governor’s direction,” said Iqbal. “As we know, PT Vale has extensive experience in MSME development—providing capital support, improving business management, marketing, and helping entrepreneurs enhance their competitiveness,” he added.

In addition to showcasing local products and Kopi Matano, PT Vale also demonstrated its commitment to environmental sustainability and healthy living. During the event, which set a record for the largest serving of vegetarian dishes and coffee beverages, PT Vale was honored with an award from the Indonesian World Achievement Institute (LEPRID). The award was presented directly by Paulus Pangka, Founder and Chairman of LEPRID, in recognition of PT Vale’s support in achieving this milestone.

Future Participation in South Sulawesi’s MSME Mall
Looking ahead, PT Vale will also take part in the South Sulawesi Provincial Government’s upcoming MSME Mall initiative—a dedicated space for promoting and marketing local products. “PT Vale will contribute to the MSME Mall by showcasing products from our partner communities,” said Endra Kusuma.

id.title: Sinergi untuk Asta Cita, PT Vale Turut Memeriahkan Hari Jadi Ke-356 Sulsel Melalui 'Sulsel Expo Andalan Hati'
id.subtitle: Sejalan dengan visi Asta Cita Presiden, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk menegaskan komitmennya dalam memperkuat UMKM—penggerak utama ekonomi nasional—dengan berkolaborasi aktif bersama Pemerintah Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan pada perayaan Hari Jadi ke-356 untuk mendorong sektor riil.
id.body:
Makassar, 15 Oktober 2025 — Sejalan dengan semangat Asta Cita Presiden, dukungan untuk para pelaku Usaha Mikro, Kecil dan Menengah (UMKM) sebagai salah satu sektor penopang ekonomi nasional harus terus digalakkan. Melalui rangkaian perayaan Hari Jadi Ke-356 Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) turut terlibat dan berkolaborasi dengan pemerintah daerah mengerakkan sektor riil.

Sebagai bagian dari semangat tersebut, PT Vale turut berpartisipasi dalam gelaran bertajuk UMKM Expo 'Andalan Hati' yang mengusung tema “Sulsel Maju dan Berkarakter 2025”, berlangsung selama lima hari, yakni 15 hingga 19 Oktober 2025 di Halaman Monumen Mandala, Jalan Jenderal Sudirman Makassar.

Pada seremonial pembukaan event, Rabu 15 Oktober 2025, Gubernur Andi Sudirman Sulaiman menyampaikan harapannya untuk peningkatan kapasitas para pelaku UMKM.

Tidak lupa, Gubernur juga memanggil para pimpinan perusahaan pendukung, termasuk PT Vale, lalu menyerahkan piagam penghargaan atas kontribusi perusahaan berkelanjutan itu mendukung pencapaian rekor penyajian makanan vegetarian dan minuman kopi terbanyak, salah satu kegiatan yang memeriahkan event pembukaan ekspo .

Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations PT Vale Indonesia mengungkapkan, kehadiran perusahaan tersebut dalam event Expo Sulsel, tidak terlepas dari nilai-nilai yang dipegang perusahaan, yakni mentransformasi sumber kekayaan alam menjadi kemakmuran yang berkelanjutan.

“Hari ini, PT Vale ikut memeriahkan dan berpartisipasi dalam UMKM Expo yang merupakan rangkaian HUT Sulsel ke-356. Kami membawa berbagai produk UMKM binaan, seperti keripik pangkilang, kopi Matano, camilan pisang, sarabba jahe merah, teng-teng, dan banyak lagi,” ungkapnya.

Produk-produk itu bukan sekadar hasil olahan rumah tangga, tapi buah dari pembinaan berkelanjutan yang dilakukan PT Vale bersama masyarakat di sekitar area operasionalnya. Bagi Endra, keterlibatan ini adalah cara untuk membuka pasar yang lebih luas bagi UMKM binaan Vale.

“Ini upaya kami agar produk binaan Vale dikenal lebih luas, tidak hanya di Luwu Timur, tapi di seluruh Sulawesi Selatan,” lanjutnya. “Kami ingin penjualannya semakin maksimal dan memberikan dampak ekonomi yang nyata bagi masyarakat.”katanya.

Dalam momen yang bertepatan dengan Hari Kopi Sedunia dan Hari Vegetarian Sedunia itu, PT Vale menyajikankan 150 gelas kopi Matano pada hari pertama, dan rencananya pada periode hari berikutnya selama pameran akan diberikan ke pengunjung sebanyak 50-100 gelas kopi.

Kopi Matano berasal dari petani di Desa Nuha, sekitar Danau Matano, wilayah yang berada di dekat operasi tambang nikel PT Vale. Kopi itu kemudian diolah, dan disajikan oleh pelaku UMKM mitra binaan PT Vale Indonesia.

Sinergi Pemerintah dan Dunia Usaha

Dukungan PT Vale dalam UMKM Expo 2025 mendapat apresiasi dari Pemerintah Provinsi Sulsel.

“Kegiatan ini sudah luar biasa,” ungkapnya usai meninjau sejumlah booth. “Saya rasa sudah bagus-bagus produknya. Kita ingin event seperti ini terus berlanjut, dan perusahaan seperti PT Vale terus memberi dukungan,” ungkapnya lagi.

Gubernur Andi Sudirman juga menekankan pentingnya kolaborasi antara pemerintah dan perusahaan swasta dalam memperkuat kapasitas UMKM. Bentuknya bisa berupa pelatihan, bantuan permodalan, hingga pendampingan dalam pengemasan produk. Khususnya bagi pelaku UMKM di daerah.

Senada dengan itu, Ketua Panitia Hari Jadi Sulsel, Iqbal Suhaeb, menjelaskan bahwa event UMKM Expo ini akan menjadi agenda tahunan. Tahun ini, hampir 100 UMKM lokal ikut ambil bagian.

“PT Vale menjadi salah satu perusahaan ikut mendukung event ini, dan kita harap kontribusi ini terus berlanjut sesuai arahan pak Gubernur,” ujar Iqbal. “Seperti kita tahu, PT Vale sudah berpengalaman dalam melakukan pembinaan UMKM, membantu permodalan, membenahi manajemen UMKM, pemasaran dan bisa memfasilitasi pelaku usaha ini untuk punya daya saing tinggi," tuturnya.

Selain menghadirkan produk dan kopi khas Matano, PT Vale juga menunjukkan kepeduliannya terhadap lingkungan dan gaya hidup sehat. Dalam acara yang juga mencatatkan rekor penyajian makanan vegetarian dan minuman kopi terbanyak, PT Vale menjadi salah satu perusahaan yang menerima penghargaan dari Lembaga Prestasi Indonesia Dunia (LEPRID).

Penghargaan tersebut diserahkan langsung oleh Paulus Pangka, Pendiri dan Ketua Umum LEPRID, sebagai bentuk apresiasi atas dukungan PT Vale dalam penyelenggaraan rekor tersebut.

Partisipasi PT Vale untuk Mall UMKM Pemprov Sulsel

Ke depan, PT Vale juga akan berpartisipasi dalam program Pemerintah Provinsi Sulsel yang akan meluncurkan Mall UMKM, sebagai ruang khusus bagi produk lokal untuk dipasarkan lebih luas. "PT Vale akan mengisi mall UMKM dengan produk-produk mitra binaan perusahaan," ungkap Endra Kusuma.

en.title: PT Vale urges nickel producers pivot toward "the right nickel" during LME Week 2025
en.subtitle: As the world’s metals leaders gather for LME Week 2025, PT Vale Indonesia (PTVI) delivers a clear message to the global mining and investment community: the future will not be defined by how much nickel the world produces, but by how responsibly it is produced. At a time when the global nickel market faces a paradox,  oversupply pressures on one side and insatiable demand for clean-energy minerals on the other — PT Vale urges the industry to pivot toward what it calls “the right nickel”: nickel that is low-carbon, ethically mined, and transparently sourced from communities that grow alongside it.
en.body:
London, 14 October, 2025 — As the world’s metals leaders gather for LME Week 2025, PT Vale Indonesia (PTVI) delivers a clear message to the global mining and investment community: the future will not be defined by how much nickel the world produces, but by how responsibly it is produced.

At a time when the global nickel market faces a paradox,  oversupply pressures on one side and insatiable demand for clean-energy minerals on the other — PT Vale urges the industry to pivot toward what it calls “the right nickel”: nickel that is low-carbon, ethically mined, and transparently sourced from communities that grow alongside it. “We cannot power the green revolution with dirty energy,” said Bernardus Irmanto,  President Director & CEO of PT Vale Indonesia. “The world doesn’t need just more nickel. It needs the right nickel, one produced with integrity, decarbonized at its source, and grounded in respect for people and the planet.”

Across the metals sector, a new reality is taking shape. The climate crisis is accelerating. Financing is shifting toward ESG-compliant operations. Communities are demanding accountability. Yet, global demand for critical minerals — particularly nickel for electric vehicle batteries and renewable storage — continues to rise.

For PT Vale, this convergence represents not a burden but a call to leadership. For over five decades, the company has operated in Indonesia’s rich nickel belt, balancing industrial progress with environmental care. Now, as the conversation at LME Week turns to the role of metals in achieving net-zero, PTVI steps forward with a vision that blends responsibility with opportunity. “Our goal is not only to supply the world with nickel, but to redefine what responsible supply looks like,” Anto added. “That means traceable operations, transparent governance, and tangible community partnerships that endure beyond mine life.”

 
One if this deliberate evolution comes from PT Vale’s story. In 2017, long before “green nickel” entered global vocabulary, the company pledged to cut one-third of its carbon intensity by 2030. At the time, the solutions did not yet exist, but the conviction did.

That conviction has since sparked a wave of innovation: the installation of electric boilers to replace fossil-fuel combustion, waste-heat recovery systems that convert energy losses into power, and ore-dewatering initiatives that optimize water use while improving efficiency. Each investment, while technical in nature, serves a singular purpose — proving that decarbonization and profitability can coexist.

In parallel, PT Vale is reinforcing governance through rigorous global standards. Its flagship operation in Sorowako is now undergoing independent verification under the Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance (IRMA) — among the most stringent mining standards in the world. Audits for its upcoming projects in Bahodopi and Pomalaa will follow.

These actions, combined with over fifty years of community partnerships and recognized performance — including multiple Green PROPER awards and Gold from Indonesia’s Ministry of Environment and a Sustainalytics ESG Risk Rating of 27.5 — position PT Vale among the world’s most trusted nickel producers.

This week in London, as global conversations at LME Week revolve around market volatility, geopolitical realignment, and the decarbonization of metals, PT Vale offers a simple yet powerful idea: trust is the new currency of mining.

In an era when every supply chain is scrutinized, when every tonne of ore carries a carbon footprint, and when communities demand participation, the right nickel is more than a product, it is a promise.

“We believe sustainability is not a cost,” said Anto, “It is who we are — our identity, our advantage, and our contribution to a future where industry and nature can coexist. Our legacy will not be measured by how much we produce, but by the impact we leave behind.”

As the global metals market recalibrates, PT Vale invites partners, investors, and policymakers to collaborate in shaping a resilient and ethical nickel industry, one that powers not only batteries, but hope, resilience, and progress.

id.title: PT Vale Serukan Produsen Nikel Beralih ke “Nikel yang Tepat” dalam LME Week 2025
id.subtitle: Dalam perhelatan LME Week 2025 yang mempertemukan para pemimpin industri logam dunia, PT Vale Indonesia (PTVI) menyampaikan pesan tegas kepada komunitas pertambangan dan investor global: masa depan industri nikel tidak ditentukan oleh seberapa banyak nikel yang diproduksi, melainkan oleh bagaimana nikel tersebut diproduksi secara bertanggung jawab. Di tengah paradoks pasar nikel global — tekanan kelebihan pasokan di satu sisi dan permintaan tinggi terhadap mineral energi bersih di sisi lain — PT Vale mengajak industri untuk beralih ke apa yang disebut sebagai “nikel yang tepat” (the right nickel): yakni nikel rendah karbon, ditambang secara etis, dan bersumber secara transparan dari komunitas yang turut berkembang bersama operasionalnya.
id.body:
London, 14 Oktober 2025 — Dalam perhelatan LME Week 2025 yang mempertemukan para pemimpin industri logam dunia, PT Vale Indonesia (PTVI) menyampaikan pesan tegas kepada komunitas pertambangan dan investor global: masa depan industri nikel tidak ditentukan oleh seberapa banyak nikel yang diproduksi, melainkan oleh bagaimana nikel tersebut diproduksi secara bertanggung jawab.

Di tengah paradoks pasar nikel global — tekanan kelebihan pasokan di satu sisi dan permintaan tinggi terhadap mineral energi bersih di sisi lain — PT Vale mengajak industri untuk beralih ke apa yang disebut sebagai “nikel yang tepat” (the right nickel): yakni nikel rendah karbon, ditambang secara etis, dan bersumber secara transparan dari komunitas yang turut berkembang bersama operasionalnya.

“Kita tidak bisa mendukung revolusi hijau dengan energi yang kotor,” ujar Bernardus Irmanto, Presiden Direktur & CEO PT Vale Indonesia. “Dunia tidak hanya membutuhkan lebih banyak nikel. Dunia membutuhkan nikel yang tepat — yang diproduksi dengan integritas, didekarbonisasi sejak dari sumbernya, dan berlandaskan pada penghormatan terhadap manusia dan lingkungan.”

Di seluruh sektor logam, realitas baru tengah terbentuk. Krisis iklim semakin mendesak. Pendanaan global mulai beralih ke operasi yang sesuai prinsip ESG. Komunitas menuntut akuntabilitas. Namun, permintaan global terhadap mineral kritis — khususnya nikel untuk baterai kendaraan listrik dan penyimpanan energi terbarukan — terus meningkat.

Bagi PT Vale, konvergensi ini bukanlah beban, melainkan panggilan untuk memimpin. Selama lebih dari lima dekade, perusahaan telah beroperasi di kawasan nikel Indonesia dengan menyeimbangkan kemajuan industri dan kepedulian lingkungan. Kini, saat diskusi di LME Week berfokus pada peran logam dalam mencapai target net-zero, PTVI hadir dengan visi yang memadukan tanggung jawab dan peluang.

“Tujuan kami bukan sekadar memasok nikel ke dunia, tetapi mendefinisikan ulang seperti apa pasokan yang bertanggung jawab,” tambah Anto. “Itu berarti operasi yang dapat ditelusuri, tata kelola yang transparan, dan kemitraan komunitas yang berkelanjutan bahkan setelah tambang berhenti beroperasi.”

 

Evolusi ini bukan hal baru bagi PT Vale. Pada 2017, jauh sebelum istilah “green nickel” populer secara global, perusahaan telah berkomitmen mengurangi sepertiga intensitas karbonnya pada 2030. Saat itu, solusi teknisnya belum tersedia, namun keyakinan sudah ada.

Keyakinan tersebut kini melahirkan berbagai inovasi: pemasangan boiler listrik untuk menggantikan pembakaran bahan bakar fosil, sistem pemulihan panas buangan untuk menghasilkan energi, serta inisiatif dewatering bijih yang mengoptimalkan penggunaan air sekaligus meningkatkan efisiensi. Setiap investasi ini, meski bersifat teknis, memiliki satu tujuan utama — membuktikan bahwa dekarbonisasi dan profitabilitas dapat berjalan beriringan.

Secara paralel, PT Vale memperkuat tata kelola melalui standar global yang ketat. Operasi utama di Sorowako kini tengah menjalani verifikasi independen di bawah Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance (IRMA) — salah satu standar pertambangan paling ketat di dunia. Audit untuk proyek Bahodopi dan Pomalaa akan menyusul.

Langkah-langkah ini, ditambah dengan lebih dari lima dekade kemitraan komunitas dan rekam jejak kinerja yang diakui — termasuk berbagai penghargaan PROPER Hijau dan Emas dari Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup serta ESG Risk Rating 27,5 dari Sustainalytics — menempatkan PT Vale sebagai salah satu produsen nikel paling tepercaya di dunia.

Minggu ini di London, saat diskusi global di LME Week berkisar pada volatilitas pasar, pergeseran geopolitik, dan dekarbonisasi logam, PT Vale menawarkan satu gagasan sederhana namun kuat: kepercayaan adalah mata uang baru dalam industri pertambangan.
Di era ketika setiap rantai pasok diawasi, setiap ton bijih membawa jejak karbon, dan komunitas menuntut keterlibatan, “the right nickel” bukan sekadar produk — melainkan janji. “Kami percaya bahwa keberlanjutan bukanlah biaya,” tutup Anto. “Keberlanjutan adalah jati diri kami — keunggulan kami, dan kontribusi kami untuk masa depan di mana industri dan alam dapat hidup berdampingan. Warisan kami tidak akan diukur dari seberapa banyak kami memproduksi, tetapi dari dampak yang kami tinggalkan.”

Saat pasar logam global melakukan rekalibrasi, PT Vale mengundang mitra, investor, dan pembuat kebijakan untuk bersama-sama membentuk industri nikel yang tangguh dan etis — industri yang tidak hanya menjadi penggerak baterai, tetapi juga harapan, ketahanan, dan kemajuan.

en.title: Vale and Wabtec sign agreement to test the use of ethanol in locomotives on the Vitória-Minas Railway, in Brazil
en.body:
• The goal is to develop studies on ethanol engines as an alternative to diesel
  • Tests at Wabtec will be conducted until 2027 to evaluate future use in the EFVM fleet
  • It could become the first locomotive in the world to run on ethanol in the mixture
  • Partnership advances in the decarbonization of Vale's railway operations
     

Vale and locomotive manufacturer Wabtec Corporation announced on Monday, 13, a partnership to develop studies on a dual-fuel engine that can use both diesel and a mixture of diesel and ethanol. The studies will initially be conducted in the laboratory to validate the concept and evaluate performance, emissions reduction, and the ethanol/diesel substitution rate. The studies and tests are expected to take place by 2027, for evaluation of future use in the Vitória-Minas Railway (EFVM) fleet, in Southeastern Brazil.

The agreement to use ethanol, a renewable fuel that replaces fossil diesel, is part of a series of joint initiatives with Wabtec to advance Vale's railway operations decarbonization program. Last March, the companies announced an agreement to purchase 50 locomotives equipped with Evolution Series engines, prepared to operate with up to 25% biodiesel mixed with diesel. In the coming years, Vale and Wabtec will conduct a series of tests in an attempt to further increase this percentage. 

“Innovative initiatives such as these, for the adoption of alternative fuels in our locomotives, are part of Vale's commitment to accelerate the decarbonization of our rail network,” said Carlos Medeiros, Executive Vice President of Operations at Vale. “In 2024, Vale's rail network accounted for 14% of the company's carbon emissions.”

“For the first time, Wabtec will use ethanol as an energy source in a locomotive, a milestone in the global rail industry. We are committed to developing technological solutions that accelerate the transition to more efficient and sustainable transportation,” says Danilo Miyasato, President and Regional Leader of Wabtec LATAM.

Net-Zero

In 2020, Vale announced its goal of reducing its absolute emissions (scopes 1 and 2) by 33% by 2030. This is another step toward achieving the goal of net-zero carbon emissions by 2050, in line with the Paris Agreement's ambition to limit global warming to below 2°C by the end of the century. The company has also committed to reducing net emissions from its value chain (scope 3) by 15% by 2035.

About Vale

Vale is a global mining company that exists to improve lives and transform the future together. One of the world's largest producers of iron ore and nickel and a major producer of copper, Vale is headquartered in Brazil and operates globally. Its operations comprise integrated logistics systems, including approximately 2,000 kilometers of railways, maritime terminals, and 10 ports distributed around the world. Vale's ambitions are to be recognized by society as a benchmark in safety, the best and most reliable operator, a talent-oriented organization, a leader in sustainable mining, and a benchmark in value creation and sharing.

About Wabtec

Wabtec Corporation (NYSE: WAB) is revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations. The company is a global leader in providing equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services to the freight and passenger rail, mining, marine, and industrial markets. Wabtec has been a leader in the rail industry for more than 155 years and has a vision of achieving a sustainable rail system. Visit Wabtec at www.wabteccorp.com.

en.title: Indonesia at the Epicenter of Critical Minerals: Forging the Future of Sustainable Energy
en.subtitle: Indonesia took center stage at the Indonesia International Sustainability Forum (IISF) with a landmark dialogue highlighting the nation’s defining role in the global energy transition. The 90-minute session, hosted by PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) and titled “Indonesia at the Epicenter of Critical Minerals: Nickel, Copper, and the Global Energy Transition,” convened leading voices from government, industry, and sustainability institutions.
en.body:
Jakarta, 10 October 2025 — Indonesia took center stage at the Indonesia International Sustainability Forum (IISF) with a landmark dialogue highlighting the nation’s defining role in the global energy transition.

The 90-minute session, hosted by PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) and titled “Indonesia at the Epicenter of Critical Minerals: Nickel, Copper, and the Global Energy Transition,” convened leading voices from government, industry, and sustainability institutions. Together, they explored how Indonesia can balance its vast resource potential with environmental stewardship, social inclusion, and long-term economic resilience.

Moderated by Rajat Agarwal, Partner at McKinsey & Company, the session featured Bernardus Irmanto (President Director & CEO, PT Vale Indonesia), Dr. Ing. Tri Winarno (Director General of Mineral and Coal, Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources), David Wei (General Manager, Huayou Indonesia), and Rebecca Burton (Deputy Director, Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance – IRMA).

Global demand for nickel and copper; two essential minerals for electric vehicles, renewable energy, and electrification is expected to double or triple by 2040. Indonesia, home to the world’s largest nickel reserves and fast-growing copper operations, stands at the center of this transformation. “Critical minerals are the foundation of the global energy transition, and Indonesia sits at its epicenter,” said Bernardus Irmanto, CEO of PT Vale Indonesia. “Our mission is not only to meet global demand but to meet it responsibly, ensuring that sustainability, transparency, and community empowerment define how Indonesia contributes to the world’s net-zero future.”

Representing the government’s strategic direction, Dr. Ing. Tri Winarno, Director General of Mineral and Coal, Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (KESDM), emphasized the importance of integrating sustainability into Indonesia’s downstream and decarbonization strategy. “Indonesia’s commitment to responsible mineral development is clear, we must pursue industrial growth without compromising environmental balance,” Dr. Winarno stated. “Through innovation, collaboration, and adherence to international standards, Indonesia will continue to strengthen its leadership in the global energy transition while delivering value to its people.”

From the perspective of the global mining industry, David Wei, General Manager of Huayou Indonesia, underscored the significance of building long-term, responsible partnerships that prioritize both innovation and sustainability.“Sustainability is no longer optional , it defines global credibility,” said Wei.“Our collaboration with PT Vale shows how industry partnerships can drive responsible sourcing, carbon reduction, and shared prosperity. The future of critical minerals depends on how we grow together, with integrity and impact.”

Providing the global ESG lens, Rebecca Burton, Deputy Director of the Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance (IRMA), shared that international standards can act as a bridge between Indonesia’s industrial leadership and the expectations of global markets. “Investors and manufacturers worldwide increasingly demand verified proof of responsible practices,” Burton said. “IRMA serves as that bridge, connecting Indonesia’s mining sector to global trust by ensuring transparency, independent assurance, and respect for both people and nature. This alignment can set a new global benchmark for emerging economies.”

The session concluded with a shared commitment: that Indonesia’s mineral leadership must go beyond production metrics, it must represent a values-driven approach to growth. “We believe Indonesia’s true potential lies in leading not only by scale, but by standards,” Bernardus concluded. “By embedding sustainability into the core of our operations, we are commited to ensure that every ton of nickel mined in Indonesia contributes to the world’s cleaner, fairer, and more sustainable future.”

id.title: Indonesia di Pusat Mineral Kritis: Menempa Masa Depan Energi Berkelanjutan
id.subtitle: Indonesia menjadi sorotan utama dalam ajang Indonesia International Sustainability Forum (IISF) melalui sesi dialog strategis yang menegaskan peran penting bangsa ini dalam transisi energi global. Sesi berdurasi 90 menit yang diselenggarakan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) dengan tajuk “Indonesia at the Epicenter of Critical Minerals: Nickel, Copper, and the Global Energy Transition” ini menghadirkan para pemimpin dari kalangan pemerintah, industri, dan lembaga keberlanjutan.
id.body:
Jakarta, 10 Oktober 2025 — Indonesia menjadi sorotan utama dalam ajang Indonesia International Sustainability Forum (IISF) melalui sesi dialog strategis yang menegaskan peran penting bangsa ini dalam transisi energi global.

Sesi berdurasi 90 menit yang diselenggarakan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) dengan tajuk “Indonesia at the Epicenter of Critical Minerals: Nickel, Copper, and the Global Energy Transition” ini menghadirkan para pemimpin dari kalangan pemerintah, industri, dan lembaga keberlanjutan. Bersama-sama, mereka membahas bagaimana Indonesia dapat menyeimbangkan potensi sumber daya alamnya yang besar dengan tanggung jawab lingkungan, inklusi sosial, serta ketahanan ekonomi jangka panjang.

Sesi ini dimoderatori oleh Rajat Agarwal, Partner di McKinsey & Company, dan menampilkan pembicara Bernardus Irmanto (President Director & CEO PT Vale Indonesia), Dr. Ing. Tri Winarno (Direktur Jenderal Mineral dan Batubara, Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral), David Wei (General Manager, Huayou Indonesia), serta Rebecca Burton (Deputy Director, Initiative for Responsible Mining Assurance – IRMA).

Permintaan global terhadap nikel dan tembaga—dua mineral penting bagi kendaraan listrik, energi terbarukan, dan elektrifikasi—diproyeksikan meningkat dua hingga tiga kali lipat pada tahun 2040. Indonesia, yang memiliki cadangan nikel terbesar di dunia dan tengah mengembangkan sektor tembaganya dengan pesat, berada di pusat transformasi ini. “Mineral kritis merupakan fondasi dari transisi energi global, dan Indonesia berada tepat di episentrumnya,” ujar Bernardus Irmanto, CEO PT Vale Indonesia. “Misi kami bukan sekadar memenuhi permintaan dunia, tetapi memenuhinya secara bertanggung jawab—dengan menjadikan keberlanjutan, transparansi, dan pemberdayaan masyarakat sebagai landasan kontribusi Indonesia menuju masa depan net-zero dunia.”

Mewakili arah strategis pemerintah, Dr. Ing. Tri Winarno, Direktur Jenderal Mineral dan Batubara Kementerian ESDM, menekankan pentingnya integrasi aspek keberlanjutan dalam strategi hilirisasi dan dekarbonisasi nasional. “Komitmen Indonesia terhadap pengelolaan mineral yang bertanggung jawab sangat jelas. Kita harus mengejar pertumbuhan industri tanpa mengorbankan keseimbangan lingkungan,” tegas Dr. Winarno. “Melalui inovasi, kolaborasi, dan penerapan standar internasional, Indonesia akan terus memperkuat kepemimpinannya dalam transisi energi global sekaligus memberikan manfaat nyata bagi rakyatnya.”

Dari perspektif industri pertambangan global, David Wei, General Manager Huayou Indonesia, menyoroti pentingnya membangun kemitraan jangka panjang yang bertanggung jawab dan menyeimbangkan inovasi dengan keberlanjutan. “Keberlanjutan kini bukan lagi pilihan, melainkan penentu kredibilitas global,” kata Wei. “Kolaborasi kami dengan PT Vale menunjukkan bagaimana kemitraan industri dapat mendorong praktik penambangan yang bertanggung jawab, pengurangan karbon, serta kesejahteraan bersama. Masa depan mineral kritis akan bergantung pada kemampuan kita untuk tumbuh bersama dengan integritas dan dampak positif.”

Dari perspektif tata kelola global, Rebecca Burton, Deputy Director IRMA, menjelaskan bahwa standar internasional dapat menjadi jembatan antara kepemimpinan industri Indonesia dan ekspektasi pasar global. “Investor dan produsen di seluruh dunia kini semakin menuntut bukti nyata praktik yang bertanggung jawab,” ujar Burton. “IRMA hadir sebagai jembatan yang menghubungkan sektor pertambangan Indonesia dengan kepercayaan global melalui transparansi, verifikasi independen, dan penghormatan terhadap manusia serta alam. Penyelarasan ini dapat menjadi tolok ukur baru bagi negara-negara berkembang lainnya.”

Sesi ini ditutup dengan komitmen bersama bahwa kepemimpinan Indonesia dalam mineral kritis harus melampaui ukuran produksi semata—namun mencerminkan pertumbuhan yang berlandaskan nilai. “Kami percaya potensi sejati Indonesia tidak hanya diukur dari skala produksi, tetapi dari standar yang kami junjung,” pungkas Bernardus. “Dengan menanamkan keberlanjutan ke dalam inti operasi kami, kami berkomitmen memastikan setiap ton nikel yang ditambang di Indonesia berkontribusi bagi masa depan yang lebih bersih, adil, dan berkelanjutan bagi dunia.”

en.title: PT Vale Indonesia Earns EDGE Advance Green Building Certification for Main Office
en.subtitle: PT Vale has once again demonstrated its commitment to sustainability and energy efficiency. On October 8, 2025, PT Vale officially received the EDGE Advance – Green Building Certification for its Main Office located at the Sorowako Plant Site, following a comprehensive audit conducted on September 26, 2025.
en.body:
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) has once again demonstrated its commitment to sustainability and energy efficiency. On October 8, 2025, PT Vale officially received the EDGE Advance – Green Building Certification for its Main Office located at the Sorowako Plant Site, following a comprehensive audit conducted on September 26, 2025.

EDGE (Excellence in Design for Greater Efficiencies) is a globally recognized green building certification developed by the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group. The certification is verified by independent third parties, including the Green Building Council and Bureau Veritas Indonesia, and evaluates buildings based on three key criteria: energy efficiency, water savings, and the use of environmentally friendly materials.

Achieving 100% Energy Efficiency
The audit, conducted by Sustainhaus and verified by Bureau Veritas Indonesia, confirmed that PT Vale’s Main Office achieved 100% energy efficiency, surpassing the minimum EDGE Advance requirement of a 40% reduction in energy consumption compared to conventional buildings. This milestone reflects the building’s full adoption of renewable energy principles and high-efficiency operational standards.

In addition to energy performance, the building also met the minimum 20% reduction targets for water consumption and embodied carbon—the carbon footprint associated with construction materials—qualifying it as an environmentally responsible facility.

Rigorous and Transparent Audit Process
The EDGE Advance certification process involved multiple stages, including initial document reviews, on-site inspections, and final reporting. PT Vale’s Environment Strategic and Utilities Maintenance Engineering teams collaborated closely with the assessors to ensure full compliance with EDGE standards.

The on-site audit on September 26, 2025, was a pivotal moment, allowing auditors to directly evaluate the building’s energy systems, water usage, and material selections. The results confirmed that the Main Office not only met but exceeded the required benchmarks.

Strategic Benefits for PT Vale
This achievement brings several strategic advantages to PT Vale:

  • Reduced operational costs through improved energy and water efficiency
  • Access to green financing, increasingly favored by global investors
  • Progress toward corporate ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) goals
  • International recognition as a leader in sustainable building practices

Aiming for EDGE Zero Carbon
Building on this success, PT Vale is now targeting the EDGE Zero Carbon Certification—the highest level within the EDGE framework—for the coming year. This certification requires 100% renewable energy usage, either on-site, off-site, or through carbon offsets, and mandates one full year of operational data with at least 75% occupancy.

This milestone is part of PT Vale’s broader #KitaCARES initiative, reflecting its deep commitment to environmental sustainability and social responsibility. Through tangible actions like green building certification, PT Vale reinforces that sustainability is not just a concept, but a core element of its business and operational strategy.

About EDGE
EDGE is a global green building certification system developed by the IFC, part of the World Bank Group. It combines free software tools with third-party verification to promote sustainable building design. EDGE sets minimum targets of 20% savings in energy, water, and embodied carbon, with three certification levels: EDGE Certified, EDGE Advanced, and EDGE Zero Carbon, each representing increasing levels of efficiency and sustainability compliance.

id.title: Main Office PT Vale Raih Sertifikasi Bangunan Hijau EDGE Advance
id.subtitle: Komitmen PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) terhadap keberlanjutan dan efisiensi energi kembali mendapat pengakuan. Pada tanggal 8 Oktober 2025, PTVI resmi memperoleh sertifikasi EDGE Advance – Green Building untuk bangunan Main Office yang berlokasi di Plant Site Sorowako, setelah melalui proses audit yang dilakukan pada 26 September 2025.
id.body:
Komitmen PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) terhadap keberlanjutan dan efisiensi energi kembali mendapat pengakuan. Pada tanggal 8 Oktober 2025, PT Vale resmi memperoleh sertifikasi EDGE Advance – Green Building untuk bangunan Main Office yang berlokasi di Plant Site Sorowako, setelah melalui proses audit yang dilakukan pada 26 September 2025.

Sertifikasi EDGE (Excellence in Design for Greater Efficiencies) merupakan standar internasional yang dikembangkan oleh International Finance Corporation (IFC), bagian dari World Bank Group, dan diverifikasi oleh Green Building Council serta Bureau Veritas Indonesia sebagai pihak ketiga independen. Sertifikasi ini menilai bangunan berdasarkan tiga aspek utama: efisiensi energi, penghematan air, dan penggunaan material ramah lingkungan.

100% Efisiensi Energi
Dalam audit yang dilakukan oleh Sustainhaus sebagai assessor dan diverifikasi oleh Bureau Veritas Indonesia, bangunan Main Office PT Vale berhasil mencapai 100% efisiensi energi—melampaui standar minimum EDGE Advance, yaitu pengurangan energi sebesar 40% dibandingkan bangunan konvensional. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa desain dan operasional bangunan telah sepenuhnya mengadopsi prinsip energi terbarukan dan efisiensi tinggi.

Selain aspek energi, bangunan ini juga memenuhi syarat pengurangan konsumsi air dan pengurangan karbon yang terkandung dalam material konstruksi (embodied carbon), masing-masing minimal 20%. Dengan pencapaian ini, bangunan Main Office PT Vale dinyatakan sebagai bangunan ramah lingkungan.

Audit ketat dan transparan
Audit EDGE Advance terdiri dari beberapa tahapan, dimulai dari review dokumen awal, kunjungan lapangan, hingga penyusunan laporan akhir. Tim dari Environment Strategic dan Utilities Maintenance Engineering PT Vale bekerja sama erat dengan pihak assessor untuk memastikan bahwa seluruh dokumentasi dan implementasi di lapangan sesuai dengan standar EDGE.

Kunjungan lapangan oleh auditor pada 26 September 2025 menjadi momen penting dalam proses verifikasi, di mana mereka menilai langsung kondisi bangunan, sistem energi, penggunaan air, dan jenis material yang digunakan. Hasil audit menunjukkan bahwa bangunan Main Office tidak hanya memenuhi, tetapi melampaui standar yang ditetapkan.

Pencapaian ini membawa berbagai manfaat strategis bagi PT Vale, antara lain:

  • Pengurangan biaya operasional melalui efisiensi energi dan air.
  • Akses ke pembiayaan hijau, yang semakin diminati oleh investor global.
  • Kontribusi terhadap target ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) perusahaan.
  • Pengakuan global sebagai pelopor dalam pembangunan berkelanjutan.

Menuju EDGE Zero Carbon
Tak berhenti di EDGE Advance, PT Vale telah menetapkan target untuk meraih sertifikasi EDGE Zero Carbon pada tahun mendatang. Sertifikasi ini merupakan level tertinggi dalam standar EDGE, yang mensyaratkan penggunaan 100% energi terbarukan, baik dari sumber on-site maupun off-site, atau melalui pembelian carbon offsets untuk menutupi seluruh emisi karbon. Selain itu, bangunan harus menunjukkan data operasional selama satu tahun penuh dengan tingkat hunian minimal 75%.

Pencapaian ini merupakan bagian dari inisiatif #KitaCARES, yang mencerminkan komitmen PT Vale terhadap keberlanjutan lingkungan dan tanggung jawab sosial. Melalui langkah nyata seperti sertifikasi bangunan hijau, PT Vale menunjukkan bahwa keberlanjutan bukan sekadar wacana, melainkan bagian integral dari strategi bisnis dan operasional perusahaan.

Tentang EDGE 
EDGE (Excellence in Design for Greater Efficiencies) adalah sistem sertifikasi bangunan hijau global yang dikembangkan oleh IFC, anggota Grup Bank Dunia. EDGE menggabungkan perangkat lunak gratis dan verifikasi pihak ketiga untuk mendorong desain berkelanjutan, dengan target penghematan minimal 20% untuk energi, air, dan karbon terwujud dalam bangunan. Terdapat tiga tingkat sertifikasi: EDGE Certified, EDGE Advanced, dan EDGE Zero Carbon, masing-masing dengan standar efisiensi dan kepatuhan yang berbeda.

en.title: Supporting the “Healthy, Clean, and Empowered Kolaka” Program, PT Vale Signs Strategic MoUs with Kolaka Regency Government and Huayou
en.subtitle: As a nickel mining company committed to sustainability and community empowerment, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID group, reaffirmed its dedication to regional development through the signing of two strategic Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) in Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi
en.body:
Kolaka, October 8, 2025 — As a nickel mining company committed to sustainability and community empowerment, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID group, reaffirmed its dedication to regional development through the signing of two strategic Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) in Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi.

The MoUs were signed in collaboration with the Kolaka Regency Government and Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt Co., Ltd (Huayou), coinciding with the First Digging Ceremony of the Pomalaa Block — a significant milestone in the advancement of the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa — on Wednesday, October 8, 2025.

The first MoU pertains to the Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiative titled “Healthy, Clean, and Empowered Kolaka”, signed between PT Vale and the Kolaka Regency Government. This collaborative program reflects PT Vale’s commitment to delivering sustainable benefits to communities surrounding its operational areas.

The ESG program focuses on three key pillars:

1. Healthy Kolaka — Enhancing public health services, improving maternal and child nutrition, and expanding access to sanitation and clean water;

2. Clean Kolaka — Implementing integrated waste management, tree planting initiatives, and educational campaigns promoting clean and green living;

3. Empowered Kolaka — Strengthening the local economy through MSME development, skills training, and empowering women and youth to become more independent and productive.

President Director of PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, emphasized that this program is not merely a social initiative, but a core principle guiding the company’s commitment to responsible and sustainable operations.

“With a strong focus on environmental, social, and governance principles, PT Vale actively addresses global and industry challenges by continuously developing sustainable innovations, ensuring our ESG dedication is consistently embedded across all aspects of our operations,” he stated.

Irmanto further explained that the company strives not only to fulfill its responsibilities in sustainable operations but also to maximize benefits for stakeholders and the broader community.

“We believe that economic growth and environmental sustainability must go hand in hand, with the community at the heart of every development step,” he added.

The second MoU concerns the Bridge Program, signed between PT Vale and Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt Co., Ltd. This strategic partnership aims to develop the competencies and capabilities of the local workforce, particularly in the hydrometallurgy sector — a vital part of Indonesia’s green nickel supply chain.

Through the Bridge Program, PT Vale and Huayou are committed to building a knowledge and skills bridge for the people of Kolaka, enabling them to compete at both national and global levels. The program will include technical training, managerial development, and internship opportunities, allowing local talent to directly contribute to the transformation of the nickel industry toward added value and clean energy.

“We are proud to present a transformative journey into sustainable nickel mining with a trusted partner, PT Vale. We are also dedicated to upholding compliance standards in our operations in Pomalaa, shaping the future of responsible and sustainable mining practices,” said Mr. Wei Linkui, General Manager of Huayou Indonesia.

On the same occasion, Kolaka Regent Amri expressed his appreciation for PT Vale and its partners’ strategic efforts in placing the community as a central partner in regional development.

“This MoU is not just a cooperation document, but a tangible form of collaboration to improve the quality of life for the people of Kolaka. We welcome PT Vale and its partners’ consistent efforts in prioritizing synergy and sustainability in every program,” said Regent Amri.

These two MoUs strengthen the foundation of cross-sector collaboration between local government, industry, and communities to build an inclusive and sustainable development ecosystem.

For PT Vale, ESG principles are not optional — they are a responsibility. Sustainability policies serve as the guiding compass toward a future where operations align harmoniously with both the environment and society.

With this spirit, PT Vale and its strategic partners are committed to delivering real transformation for Kolaka — a region with healthy communities, a clean environment, empowered local economies, and a competitive presence in the global nickel industry.

For context, PT Vale, Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt, and Ford Motor Company are collaborating in the Pomalaa Block, Southeast Sulawesi, to process nickel ore into battery-grade materials for electric vehicles using High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) technology. PT Vale will supply the nickel ore, while Huayou will lead the processing operations at a facility operated by PT Kolaka Nikel Indonesia — a joint venture between PT Vale, Huayou, and Ford Motor Company.

id.title: PT Vale menandatangani dua Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) strategis di Kabupaten Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara bersama  Pemkab Kolaka dan Huayou
id.subtitle: Sebagai perusahaan tambang nikel yang berkomitmen pada prinsip keberlanjutan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, kembali menegaskan dedikasinya terhadap pembangunan daerah melalui penandatanganan dua Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) atau nota kesepahaman  strategis di Kabupaten Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara.
id.body:
Kolaka, 8 Oktober 2025 — Sebagai perusahaan tambang nikel yang berkomitmen pada prinsip keberlanjutan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), bagian dari grup MIND ID, kembali menegaskan dedikasinya terhadap pembangunan daerah melalui penandatanganan dua Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) atau nota kesepahaman  strategis di Kabupaten Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara. 

Mou diteken bersama Pemerintah Kabupaten (Pemkab) Kolaka dan Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt Co., Ltd (Huayou), bertepatan dengan pelaksanaan First Digging Ceremony Blok Pomalaa, yang menjadi tonggak penting bagi kemajuan Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, Rabu (8/10/2025).

Komitmen  pertama terkait program Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG)  yang bertajuk “Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, dan Berdaya”  yang ditandatangani antara PT Vale dan Pemerintah Daerah Kabupaten Kolaka. Program kolaboratif ini menjadi wujud nyata komitmen perusahaan untuk menghadirkan manfaat berkelanjutan bagi masyarakat sekitar wilayah operasi.

Program ESG “Kolaka Sehat, Bersih, dan Berdaya” tersebut berfokus pada tiga pilar utama yaitu: 

1. Kolaka Sehat — peningkatan layanan kesehatan masyarakat, gizi anak dan ibu, serta perbaikan akses sanitasi dan air bersih;

2. Kolaka Bersih — pengelolaan sampah terpadu, penanaman pohon, serta kampanye edukatif tentang perilaku hidup bersih dan hijau;

3. Kolaka Berdaya — penguatan ekonomi lokal melalui pengembangan UMKM, pelatihan keterampilan, serta pemberdayaan perempuan dan pemuda agar lebih mandiri dan produktif.

Presiden Direktur  PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, menekankan bahwa program ini bukan sekadar inisiatif sosial, melainkan prinsip utama perusahaan dalam memandu komitmen terhadap operasi yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan. 

”Dengan fokus pada prinsip-prinsip lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola, PT Vale secara aktif menghadapi tantangan global dan industri dengan terus mengembangkan inovasi berkelanjutan, memastikan bahwa dedikasi kami terhadap ESG diterapkan secara konsisten dalam semua aspek operasi kami,” katanya.

Bernardus Irmanto  menjelaskan, perseroan tidak hanya berusaha memenuhi kewajiban terhadap operasi yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan, tetapi juga berupaya mengoptimalkan manfaat bagi pemangku kepentingan dan masyarakat luas. 

“Kami percaya bahwa pertumbuhan ekonomi dan keberlanjutan lingkungan harus berjalan seiring, dan masyarakat harus menjadi pusat dari setiap langkah pembangunan,” jelasnya.

Kemudian, untuk komitmen kedua  terkait Bridge Program, yang ditandatangani antara PT Vale dan Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt Co., Ltd (Huayou). Kerja sama strategis ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan kompetensi dan kapabilitas tenaga kerja lokal, khususnya dalam bidang industri hidrometalurgi, yang merupakan bagian penting dari rantai pasok nikel hijau Indonesia.

Melalui Bridge Program, PT Vale dan Huayou berkomitmen menciptakan jembatan pengetahuan dan keterampilan bagi masyarakat Kolaka agar dapat bersaing di tingkat nasional dan global. Program ini akan mencakup pelatihan teknis, pengembangan manajerial, dan kesempatan magang, sehingga tenaga kerja lokal dapat menjadi bagian langsung dari transformasi industri nikel yang berorientasi pada nilai tambah dan energi bersih.

”Kami ingin mempersembahkan sebuah program yang merupakan sebuah perjalanan transformatif menuju dunia pertambangan nikel berkelanjutan dengan mitra yang andal yaitu PT Vale,  kami juga akan berdedikasi untuk menerapkan standar kepatuhan dalam operasi kami di Pomalaa dalam membentuk masa depan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan,” papar Mr. Wei Linkui sebagai General Manager Huayou Indonesia.

Dalam kesempatan yang sama, Bupati Kolaka, Amri menyampaikan apresiasinya terhadap langkah strategis PT Vale dan mitranya yang menempatkan masyarakat sebagai mitra utama pembangunan daerah.

“MoU ini bukan hanya sekadar dokumen kerja sama, tetapi wujud nyata kolaborasi untuk meningkatkan kualitas hidup masyarakat Kolaka. Kami menyambut baik upaya PT Vale dan mitra-mitranya yang selalu mengedepankan sinergi dan keberlanjutan dalam setiap programnya,” ungkap Bupati Kolaka.

Kedua MoU ini memperkuat fondasi kolaborasi lintas sektor antara pemerintah daerah, dunia usaha, dan masyarakat, untuk membangun ekosistem pembangunan yang inklusif dan berkelanjutan.

Prinsip-prinsip Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola dalam operasi PT Vale bukan sekadar suatu pilihan, melainkan sebuah tanggung jawab. Kebijakan keberlanjutan menjadi pemandu utama yang mendorong langkah-langkah menuju masa depan di mana perusahaan beroperasi selaras dengan lingkungan dan masyarakat.

Dengan semangat tersebut, perusahaan  bersama para mitra strategisnya bertekad menghadirkan transformasi nyata untuk Kolaka yang masyarakatnya sehat, bersih lingkungannya, berdaya ekonominya, serta maju dan berdaya saing di panggung industri nikel global.

Untuk diketahui PT Vale dan Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt dan Ford Motor Company bekerja sama di Blok Pomalaa, Sulawesi Tenggara, untuk mengolah bijih nikel menjadi bahan baku baterai kendaraan listrik menggunakan teknologi High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL). PT Vale akan memasok bijih nikel, sementara Huayou fokus pada pengolahan nikel di pabrik yang akan di operasikan oleh PT Kolaka Nikel Indonesia (Perusahaan Joint Venture PT Vale, Huayou dan Ford Motor).

en.title: Reaffirming Commitment to Transparency and Collaboration, PT Vale Indonesia Holds Community Outreach in Timampu
en.subtitle: As part of its long-term commitment to recovery following the oil pipeline leak incident in Lioka Village, Towuti District, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) continues to prioritize transparency, scientific approaches, and open dialogue with the community. Through a community outreach event held in Timampu Village, the company reinforced its responsible and measured efforts in social and environmental recovery.
en.body:
Towuti, October 8, 2025 — As part of its long-term commitment to recovery following the oil pipeline leak incident in Lioka Village, Towuti District, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) continues to prioritize transparency, scientific approaches, and open dialogue with the community. Through a community outreach event held in Timampu Village, the company reinforced its responsible and measured efforts in social and environmental recovery.

Since the incident occurred on August 23, 2025, PT Vale has adopted a science-based response strategy aligned with global standards and sound environmental governance principles. The emergency response period, which lasted until September 12, 2025, focused on oil spill mitigation, containment of affected areas, and social mapping to ensure fair and verified handling for all impacted residents.

Joint mapping conducted with local government and stakeholders identified social impacts across six villages — Lioka, Langkea Raya, Baruga, Wawondula, Matompi, and Timampu — covering rice fields, fish ponds, gardens, livestock, and wells. The recovery scheme and compensation disbursement plan were agreed upon by the East Luwu Regency Government and village heads, and communicated to residents starting in early September.

This commitment was further solidified through a symbolic handover of compensation funds on October 2, 2025, at the Towuti District Office, witnessed by East Luwu Regent Irwan Bachri Syam and various stakeholders. The compensation process is now underway in stages, accompanied by field verification to ensure all decisions are data-driven and accountable.

Although the emergency phase has concluded, PT Vale emphasizes that recovery is not merely a reactive phase, but a long-term commitment that will continue until all community rights are fulfilled. To ensure clarity and transparency, the company held follow-up outreach sessions in Matompi and Timampu Villages, inviting residents to receive comprehensive information on mechanisms, verification stages, and compensation entitlements.

 
Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations of PT Vale, stated that the company fully understands the concerns of the community and remains present on the ground to listen to their aspirations.

“We are here not only to explain, but also to listen. This outreach is part of our responsibility to ensure every affected resident understands their rights and actively participates in the recovery process. We want every step to be honest, transparent, and fair,” he said following the outreach event in Timampu Village (October 8).

Endra added that PT Vale is expanding its public communication efforts by combining face-to-face forums with targeted engagement of specific groups, such as farmers and fishers, to ensure messages and data are comprehensively received.
“We welcome feedback and criticism, as long as it aims to accelerate recovery. The support of the local government, especially the East Luwu Regent and his team, is a crucial foundation for the success of this process,” he added.

Timampu Village Head, Samsul, welcomed PT Vale’s efforts to ensure community involvement at every stage of the recovery.
“This outreach is a concrete step to accelerate verification and compensation disbursement. The sooner the community understands the mechanism, the sooner recovery can be fully implemented,” he said.

For PT Vale, the success of recovery is not measured by the end of the emergency phase alone, but by the restoration of trust, community welfare, and environmental sustainability in Towuti. All processes are carried out in collaboration with the community, academic institutions, and government, ensuring that every policy and decision is based on scientific data, social empathy, and sound governance principles.

With this spirit of collaboration, PT Vale reiterates its core message: “Sustainable recovery can only be achieved together — through honesty, openness, and a shared sense of responsibility to both people and the environment.”

id.title: Tegaskan Komitmen Transparansi dan Kolaborasi, PT Vale Indonesia Sosialisasi Bersama Warga Timampu
id.subtitle: Sebagai bagian dari komitmen jangka panjang dalam pemulihan pasca insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Desa Lioka, Kecamatan Towuti, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) terus mengedepankan transparansi, pendekatan ilmiah, dan dialog terbuka dengan masyarakat. Melalui kegiatan sosialisasi di Desa Timampu, perusahaan memperkuat upaya pemulihan sosial dan lingkungan yang dilakukan secara bertanggung jawab dan terukur.
id.body:
Towuti, 8 Oktober 2025* — Sebagai bagian dari komitmen jangka panjang dalam pemulihan pasca insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Desa Lioka, Kecamatan Towuti, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) terus mengedepankan transparansi, pendekatan ilmiah, dan dialog terbuka dengan masyarakat. Melalui kegiatan sosialisasi di Desa Timampu, perusahaan memperkuat upaya pemulihan sosial dan lingkungan yang dilakukan secara bertanggung jawab dan terukur.

Sejak hari pertama insiden terjadi, yaitu pada tanggal 23 Agustus 2025, PT Vale telah menetapkan pendekatan penanggulangan berbasis sains yang selaras dengan standar global dan prinsip tata kelola lingkungan yang baik. Masa tanggap darurat yang berlangsung hingga 12 September 2025 difokuskan pada mitigasi tumpahan minyak, pengendalian area terdampak, serta pemetaan sosial untuk memastikan penanganan yang adil dan terverifikasi bagi seluruh masyarakat yang terdampak.

Hasil pemetaan bersama pemerintah daerah dan pemangku kepentingan menghasilkan klasifikasi dampak sosial yang meliputi sawah, empang, kebun, ternak, dan sumur di enam desa: Lioka, Langkea Raya, Baruga, Wawondula, Matompi, dan Timampu. Skema pemulihan dan penyaluran biaya penanganan dampak telah disepakati bersama oleh Pemerintah Kabupaten Luwu Timur dan para kepala desa, serta telah dikomunikasikan kepada warga sejak awal September.

Momentum komitmen ini dipertegas dengan penyerahan simbolis biaya penanganan dampak yang dilaksanakan pada 2 Oktober 2025 di Kantor Camat Towuti, disaksikan oleh Bupati Luwu Timur, Irwan Bachri Syam, dan berbagai pemangku kepentingan. Proses penyaluran kompensasi kini berjalan secara bertahap, disertai verifikasi lapangan untuk memastikan setiap keputusan berbasis data dan akuntabilitas.

Meski masa tanggap darurat telah berakhir, PT Vale menegaskan bahwa pemulihan bukanlah sekadar fase reaktif, melainkan komitmen jangka panjang yang terus dijalankan hingga seluruh hak masyarakat terpenuhi. Dalam rangka memastikan kejelasan dan transparansi proses, perusahaan mengadakan sosialisasi lanjutan di Desa Matompi dan Desa Timampu, menghadirkan masyarakat secara langsung untuk mendapatkan informasi lengkap mengenai mekanisme, tahapan verifikasi, dan hak kompensasi.

 

Head of External Relations PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, Endra Kusuma, menyampaikan bahwa perusahaan memahami sepenuhnya keresahan masyarakat dan terus hadir di lapangan untuk mendengarkan aspirasi mereka.

“Kami hadir bukan hanya untuk menjelaskan, tapi juga untuk mendengarkan. Sosialisasi ini adalah bagian dari tanggung jawab kami memastikan setiap warga terdampak memahami haknya dan terlibat aktif dalam proses pemulihan. Kami ingin setiap langkah berlangsung dengan jujur, transparan, dan berkeadilan,” ungkapnya usai kegiatan sosialisasi di Desa Timampu (8/10).

Endra menambahkan bahwa PT Vale kini memperluas bentuk komunikasi publik dengan mengombinasikan forum tatap muka dan pendekatan ke masing-masing kelompok seperti kelompok tani hingga kelompok nelayan, agar setiap pesan dan data yang disampaikan dapat diterima secara menyeluruh.

“Kami terbuka terhadap masukan dan kritik selama tujuannya untuk mempercepat pemulihan. Dukungan pemerintah daerah, khususnya Bupati Luwu Timur dan seluruh jajarannya, menjadi fondasi penting bagi keberhasilan proses ini,” tambahnya.

Kepala Desa Timampu, Samsul, menyambut baik langkah PT Vale dalam memastikan keterlibatan warga di setiap tahap pemulihan. “Sosialisasi ini menjadi langkah konkret untuk mempercepat proses verifikasi dan penyaluran kompensasi. Semakin cepat masyarakat memahami mekanisme, semakin cepat pula pemulihan bisa dijalankan secara menyeluruh,” ujarnya.

Bagi PT Vale, keberhasilan pemulihan tidak hanya diukur dari berakhirnya masa tanggap darurat, melainkan dari pemulihan kepercayaan, kesejahteraan, dan keberlanjutan lingkungan di Towuti. Seluruh proses dilakukan dengan melibatkan masyarakat, lembaga akademik, dan pemerintah, agar setiap kebijakan dan keputusan berdasar pada data ilmiah, empati sosial, dan prinsip tata kelola yang baik.

Dengan semangat kolaborasi ini, PT Vale menegaskan kembali pesan utamanya: “Pemulihan yang berkelanjutan hanya bisa terwujud bila dilakukan bersama—dengan kejujuran, keterbukaan, dan rasa tanggung jawab kepada masyarakat dan alam.”

en.title: Reaffirming Sustainability Commitment in Pomalaa, PT Vale and PAMA Host First Digging Ceremony
en.subtitle: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID (Mining Industry Indonesia) group, has once again reaffirmed its commitment to building a sustainable future for Indonesia’s nickel industry through the First Digging Ceremony held at the Pomalaa Block, Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi.  This milestone event marks the commencement of mining activities at the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, in collaboration with strategic partner PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA), signaling readiness for operational phase in 2026
en.body:
Kolaka, October 8, 2025 — PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), a member of the MIND ID (Mining Industry Indonesia) group, has once again reaffirmed its commitment to building a sustainable future for Indonesia’s nickel industry through the First Digging Ceremony held at the Pomalaa Block, Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi.

This milestone event marks the commencement of mining activities at the Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, in collaboration with strategic partner PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA), signaling readiness for operational phase in 2026.

The historic moment was attended by the Regent of Kolaka, local government and security officials, as well as senior management from PT Vale and PAMA. Their presence underscores the strong synergy between regional government, industry, and local communities in driving inclusive, competitive, and sustainable regional development.

In his remarks, PT Vale Indonesia President Director Bernardus Irmanto emphasized that the ceremony represents more than a symbolic gesture—it is a tangible manifestation of the company’s commitment and responsibility to ensure the successful execution of the IGP Pomalaa national strategic project.

“There’s a phrase I often hear, not only here but also in Morowali: ‘We are merely the caretakers of PT Vale’s garden.’ Today, that ‘garden’ is beginning to take shape—not just as a garden, but as an active mining site. We hope that soon, its counterpart—the High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) plant being developed jointly by PT Vale and Huayou—will also come to life,” said Bernardus.

He further highlighted the unique nature of the Pomalaa project, which symbolizes a collaboration among three major nations united in their commitment to sustainable nickel resource management.

“Pomalaa is special. If the world has the United Nations, then Pomalaa is what I call the ‘United of Nickels’—a partnership between Indonesia’s PT Vale Indonesia, China’s Huayou, and the United States’ Ford Motor Company. These three companies are working together to manage nickel resources sustainably, from Pomalaa to the world,” he added.

Bernardus also emphasized that PT Vale’s operations are grounded in the core values of CARES: Compassion, Accountability, Resilience, Excellence, and Sustainability. Every aspect of construction and operations will prioritize safety and environmental protection.

 
 

The collaboration with partners such as PAMA, Huayou, and Ford Motor Company reflects a shared commitment to responsible and sustainable mining practices.

“We extend our sincere appreciation to PAMA for partnering with us. This project is not only about resource management, but also about ensuring its sustainability—bringing the best of Pomalaa’s nickel to the world. Most importantly, safety remains our top priority,” Bernardus concluded.

He also noted that Huayou has committed to completing the HPAL plant construction, which is targeted to begin operations in the fourth quarter of 2026.

Meanwhile, PT Pamapersada Nusantara’s Director of Operations and HSE, Roberto Dwi Handoko, expressed his company’s strong alignment with PT Vale’s sustainability standards.

“We are proud to partner with PT Vale and are fully committed to delivering clean, safe, and responsible mining. We are ready to collaborate in creating added value for local communities and supporting Indonesia’s national nickel downstreaming agenda,” he said.

Through the First Digging Ceremony, PT Vale reaffirms that the IGP Pomalaa project will generate positive economic impacts for local communities—ranging from job creation and capacity building for regional contractors and MSMEs, to community empowerment programs focused on education, environmental stewardship, and economic resilience.

Driven by a spirit of collaboration, responsibility, and sustainability, PT Vale Indonesia—together with its partners and the support of local government—is determined to make the Pomalaa Block a model for the transformation of Indonesia’s nickel industry toward a greener, more inclusive, and globally competitive future.

id.title: Teguhkan Komitmen Keberlanjutan di Pomalaa, PT Vale dan PAMA Gelar First Digging Ceremony
id.subtitle: PT Vale, anggota grup MIND ID (Mining Industry Indonesia), kembali menegaskan komitmennya untuk membangun masa depan industri nikel Indonesia yang berkelanjutan melalui penyelenggaraan First Digging Ceremony di Blok Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara. Acara ini menandai dimulainya aktivitas penambangan pada proyek Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, yang dilaksanakan bersama mitra strategis PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA), serta menjadi penanda kesiapan menuju tahap operasional pada tahun 2026.
id.body:
Kolaka, 8 Oktober 2025 — Komitmen untuk membangun masa depan industri nikel Indonesia yang berkelanjutan kembali ditegaskan oleh PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), anggota grup MIND ID (Mining Industry Indonesia), melalui penyelenggaraan First Digging Ceremony di Blok Pomalaa, Kabupaten Kolaka, Sulawesi Tenggara.

Acara ini menjadi tonggak awal dimulainya aktivitas penambangan di area Indonesia Growth Project (IGP) Pomalaa, bersama mitra strategis PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA), yang menandai kesiapan menuju tahap operasional pada tahun 2026.

Momentum bersejarah ini dihadiri oleh Bupati Kolaka, jajaran Forkopimda Kabupaten Kolaka, serta manajemen PT Vale dan PAMA. Kehadiran para pemangku kepentingan mencerminkan kuatnya sinergi antara pemerintah daerah, dunia usaha, dan masyarakat dalam mendorong pembangunan daerah yang inklusif, berdaya saing, dan berkelanjutan.

Dalam sambutannya, President Director PT Vale Indonesia, Bernardus Irmanto, menegaskan bahwa kegiatan ini bukan sekadar seremoni, melainkan manifestasi nyata dari komitmen dan tanggung jawab perusahaan dalam memastikan proyek strategis nasional IGP Pomalaa berjalan sesuai rencana.

“Ada kalimat yang sering saya dengar, bukan hanya di sini tetapi juga di Morowali, yaitu: kami ini hanya penjaga kebunnya PT Vale. Alhamdulillah, hari ini ‘kebun’ itu sudah mulai terlihat bentuknya. Bukan lagi kebun, melainkan telah ada kegiatan pertambangan. Semoga dalam waktu dekat akan hadir pula padanannya, yaitu pabrik High Pressure Acid Leach (HPAL) yang dibangun bersama PT Vale dan Huayou,” ungkap Bernardus.

Bernardus menjelaskan bahwa proyek di Pomalaa memiliki keistimewaan tersendiri, karena menjadi simbol kolaborasi tiga negara besar yang bersatu untuk mengelola sumber daya nikel secara berkelanjutan.

“Di Pomalaa ini istimewa. Kalau di dunia ada United Nations (PBB), maka di Pomalaa saya menyebutnya ‘United of Nickels’ — karena ada perusahaan dari Indonesia yaitu PT Vale Indonesia, dari Tiongkok yaitu Huayou, dan dari Amerika Serikat yaitu Ford Motor Company. Tiga perusahaan ini bersatu mengelola sumber daya nikel secara berkelanjutan, dari Pomalaa untuk dunia,” ujarnya.

Bernardus menambahkan, nilai-nilai CARES (Compassion, Accountability, Resilience, Excellence, Sustainability) menjadifondasi dalam setiap aktivitas PT Vale, termasuk di proyekPomalaa. Seluruh proses konstruksi dan operasi akan dijalankan dengan menempatkan aspek keselamatan dan perlindungan lingkungan sebagai prioritas utama.

Kolaborasi dengan mitra seperti PAMA, Huayou, dan Ford Motor Company menjadi wujud sinergi nyata dalam menghadirkan praktik pertambangan yang bertanggung jawab dan berkelanjutan.
“Kami mengucapkan terima kasih kepada PAMA yang telah bersedia menjadi mitra. Proyek ini bukan hanya tentang bagaimana mengelola sumber daya yang ada, tetapi juga bagaimana memastikan keberlanjutannya untuk membawa nikel terbaik dari Pomalaa ke dunia. Dan yang paling penting, keselamatan adalah prioritas utama,” tambah Bernardus.

Ia juga mengungkapkan bahwa Huayou telah berkomitmen untuk menyelesaikan pembangunan pabrik HPAL yang ditargetkan beroperasi pada kuartal keempat tahun 2026.

Sementara itu, Operation and HSE Director PT Pamapersada Nusantara, Roberto Dwi Handoko, menyampaikan komitmen kuat pihaknya untuk sejalan dengan standar keberlanjutan PT Vale.
“Kami sangat bangga bisa bermitra dengan PT Vale, dan kami berkomitmen untuk seirama dalam menghadirkan pertambangan yang bersih, aman, dan bertanggung jawab. Kami siap berkolaborasi menghadirkan nilai tambah bagi masyarakat serta mendukung agenda hilirisasi nikel nasional,” ujarnya.

Melalui First Digging Ceremony ini, PT Vale menegaskan bahwa proyek IGP Pomalaa akan memberikan dampak ekonomi positif bagi masyarakat lokal — mulai dari penciptaan lapangan kerja, peningkatan kapasitas kontraktor dan UMKM daerah, hingga pengembangan program pemberdayaan masyarakat yang berfokus pada pendidikan, lingkungan, dan ketahanan ekonomi.

Dengan semangat kolaborasi, tanggung jawab, dan keberlanjutan, PT Vale Indonesia bersama seluruh mitra kerja dan dukungan pemerintah daerah bertekad menjadikan Blok Pomalaa sebagai contoh nyata transformasi industri nikel Indonesia menuju masa depan yang lebih hijau, inklusif, dan berdaya saing global.

en.title: Investor Guidelines – Vale launches Optional Acquisition Offer for Participating Debentures
en.subtitle: Deadline for Adherence: until 7:20 p.m. (Brasília time) on October 31, 2025.
en.body:
On October 6, 2025, Vale S.A. announced the commencement of an Optional Acquisition Offer for up to the totality of the participating debentures of its 6th issuance (CVRDA6).

Deadline for Adherence: Debenture holders may express their intention to sell their debentures until 7:20 p.m. (Brasília time) on October 31, 2025.

Step-by-step instructions to adhere to the Optional Acquisition Offer:

Step 1: Complete the Intention to Sell Form in digital format (Exhibit I to the Notice Of Intent).

Step 2: Send the completed form to Vale, the Fiduciary Agent, and Citi via the following emails: adesao.oferta@vale.com; gdc@gdcdtvm.com.br; bernardo.novaes@citi.com; bookbuilding.br@citi.com.  

Step 3: Ensure that all debentures are custodied at B3/CETIP by October 31, 2025. For debentures currently custodied by the bookkeeper Banco Bradesco, follow these steps.
1. Fill out the Order for Transfer of Book-Entry Assets (OTA) (only in Portuese) and prepare the required documentation for transfer to CETIP (as detailed below). 
2. Submit the form to your custodian agent / brokerage firm for signature.
3. The selected brokerage will forward the signed OTA and documents to Bradesco.
4. For assistance, contact: bcsf.analiseprocesso@bradesco.com.br.
Transfer timeline: 4 business days from receipt of documentation.

Step 4: The debenture holder must also submit the Intention to Sell Form via the B3 NoMe System, through their contracted custodian. Important: Submission of the form alone is not sufficient. The manifestation in the NoMe System is mandatory for participation.

  • For the purposes of filling in the system, the Company's code with B3 is CVRDA6, account number 3961940-0. 
  • The entry in the NoMe System is made through the following sequence of options: Securities > Registration of Operations > Repurchase by the Issuer > Manifestation of sale to the Issuer. 
  • Between the entry of the declaration of sale of Debentures to the Company in the NoMe system and the respective Optional Acquisition Date, the quantity of Debentures indicated in the system will remain blocked for movement by the Debenture Holder, and will be displayed in the Custody Position Module.
  • Refer to the NoMe System – Operating Manual (only in Portuguese) for further guidance.

Documentation Required for Transfer to CETIP
iii.    For Individuals: Notarized copies of official ID with photo and CPF (or of duly authorized legal representative) and recent proof of residence.
iv.    For Legal Entities: for OTA, segregated by types of legal entities, all documents of the company and its representatives must be notarized:

Corporation (S.A.):
•    CNPJ Certificate from Receita Federal
•    Updated Bylaws with Commercial Registry seal
•    Current Board of Directors election minutes with Commercial Registry seal
•    Simplified Certificate from the Commercial Registry (dated within 30 days)
•    Public Power of Attorney or Certificate of Power of Attorney (dated within 12 months, if applicable)
•    Notarized documents of signatories (ID, CPF, proof of residence)

Limited Liability Company (LTDA):
•    CNPJ Certificate from Receita Federal
•    Articles of Incorporation with Commercial Registry seal
•    All amendment minutes with seals (for partner changes, address, or corporate name)
•    Specific Certificate from the Commercial Registry (dated within 30 days)
•    Public Power of Attorney or Certificate of Power of Attorney (dated within 12 months, if applicable)
•    Notarized documents of signatories (ID, CPF, proof of residence)

Investment Funds:
•    CNPJ Certificate from Receita Federal
•    Fund Regulation
•    Corporate documents of the Fund’s Administrator or Manager (Bylaws, election minutes, etc.)
•    Public Power of Attorney or Certificate of Power of Attorney (dated within 12 months, if applicable)
•    Notarized documents of signatories (ID, CPF, proof of residence)

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I adhere to the offer if my registration with the bookkeeper (Bradesco) is pending?
To accept the offer, the debenture holder's Registration Form (only in Portuguese) must be in good standing. If you have any outstanding registration issues, please request assistance at any Banco Bradesco branch.

Do I need to hire a financial advisor to update my registration?
No. The registration update must be requested directly by the debenture holder to Banco Bradesco, through any branch, with personal identification documents (ID and CPF) and proof of residence. For more information, contact Banco Bradesco's Investor Guidance Channel at 0800-701-1616.

Is there any fee for updating registration or obtaining information?
No. Neither Vale nor Bradesco charge fees for these services.

How can I understand the premium offered in the repurchase?
Please contact Citi via: bernardo.novaes@citi.com; bookbuilding.br@citi.com. 

Can I cancel or amend my submitted Intention to Sell Form? 
Yes. You may cancel or amend your submission, including the number of debentures, until 7:20 p.m. on October 31, 2025. After this deadline, if no cancellation is indicated, the sale will be automatically processed via the NoMe System. 

How will the transaction be taxed? 
Withholding income tax will be calculated based on capital gains. Debenture holders who are not resident or domiciled in Brazil and who:
(iii) fail to submit the letter of intent to sell during the period for expressing interest, filling in the purchase price, quantity, and date of purchase of the debentures to be sold, will have the purchase cost of such debentures considered to be zero; or 
(iv)    submit the letter of intent to sell during the declaration period with incorrect information regarding the acquisition value, quantity, and/or acquisition date of the debentures to be sold may, as the case may be, have the withholding income tax calculated at a higher or lower rate. 
The debenture holder is fully responsible for providing this information correctly, exempting the paying source from any liability for any overpayment or underpayment resulting from the absence or inaccuracy of the data provided.


Additional information

The proposal complies with all the rules of the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) and is also in line with international standards, ensuring security and transparency for investors.
We suggest that you carefully and thoroughly read the documents disclosed by the Company, which contain all the information about the Offering and the actions necessary to express your intention to sell: Notice to Debenture Holders and Press Release.
