en.title: PT Vale’s Proactive and Structured Response to Environmental and Community Impacts: Demonstrating Tangible Progress
en.subtitle: On the eighteenth day following the oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District, East Luwu Regency, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) continues to demonstrate significant progress in its recovery efforts. The Company’s steadfast commitment to prompt, transparent, and accountable action is now reflected in both the resolution of community grievances and the restoration of environmental conditions.
en.body:
Towuti, 9 September 2025 — On the eighteenth day following the oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District, East Luwu Regency, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) continues to demonstrate significant progress in its recovery efforts. The Company’s steadfast commitment to prompt, transparent, and accountable action is now reflected in both the resolution of community grievances and the restoration of environmental conditions.

Recovery operations are being executed in a comprehensive and integrated manner, encompassing upstream to downstream areas. The joint response team has conducted thorough inspections and clean-up activities along the riverbanks, ensuring that no affected zones are overlooked. These measures are critical to preventing the spread of contamination to ecologically sensitive areas.

The scope of intervention has been extended to downstream regions, particularly the lake area. Preventive actions have been implemented to mitigate the risk of oil reaching the lake, with routine inspections carried out to maintain waterway integrity and safeguard the lake’s ecosystem from potential pollutants.

To date, a total of 190 formal complaints have been registered from six impacted villages, with 48% of these cases successfully resolved. This outcome underscores PT Vale’s dedication to ensuring that every concern raised by the community is addressed in a timely and effective manner.

Grievance resolution is being conducted proactively by PT Vale’s dedicated Grievance Team, which engages directly with affected residents. One such case involves Mrs. Agustina, a resident of Langkea Raya, who reported concerns regarding water quality in her area. As a precautionary measure, the team advised her to temporarily refrain from consuming the water pending the release of official laboratory test results.

“PT Vale’s team approached us directly. The presence of the complaint post has made it easier for us to seek information and express our concerns,” stated Mrs. Agustina.

In addition to grievance handling, the joint team has intensified environmental recovery efforts through a data-driven scientific approach. Air quality monitoring has been conducted at several locations based on community reports submitted to the Complaint & Information Post.

These assessments are being carried out by environmental experts from HAS Environmental, led by Tri Wisnu Febrianto, utilizing a Portable Environmental Quality Monitor (EQM). This device enables real-time detection of airborne pollutants, including hazardous gases associated with Marine Fuel Oil (MFO) such as Sulfur Dioxide (SO₂) and Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs), which pose risks to respiratory health. These proactive inspections are essential to ensuring that ambient air quality remains safe for residents.

As of the eighteenth day, it has been confirmed that odor complaints from households located near the river have ceased, indicating the effectiveness of the clean-up operations and mitigation strategies implemented thus far.

Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations at PT Vale, expressed his appreciation for the collaborative efforts that have contributed to the recovery process.

“The progress achieved to date is a testament to the trust and continuous collaboration among all stakeholders. With 48% of grievances resolved and odor-related concerns in residential areas addressed, it is evident that our integrated approach is both structured and on track,” Endra stated.

Through the leadership of the government, the expertise of environmental professionals, and the active participation of local communities, each step of the recovery process is being undertaken with diligence and transparency—ensuring that Towuti’s environment and the well-being of its residents are restored in a sustainable and comprehensive manner.

id.title: Pendekatan Proaktif PT Vale Tangani Dampak: Dari Aduan hingga Lingkungan, Semua Berjalan Progresif
id.subtitle: Memasuki hari ke-18, upaya pemulihan pasca-insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti, Kabupaten Luwu Timur, terus menunjukkan hasil yang signifikan. Komitmen untuk bertindak cepat dan transparan kini mulai membuahkan hasil, baik dalam penanganan aduan masyarakat maupun perbaikan kondisi lingkungan.
id.body:
Towuti, 9 September 2025 — Memasuki hari ke-18, upaya pemulihan pasca-insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti, Kabupaten Luwu Timur, terus menunjukkan hasil yang signifikan. Komitmen untuk bertindak cepat dan transparan kini mulai membuahkan hasil, baik dalam penanganan aduan masyarakat maupun perbaikan kondisi lingkungan.

Upaya pemulihan dilakukan secara menyeluruh dan terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir. Tim gabungan terus melakukan penyisiran intensif di sepanjang aliran sungai, memastikan tidak ada area yang luput dari pembersihan. Prosedur ini sangat penting untuk mencegah meluasnya dampak ke area yang lebih sensitif.

Fokus penanganan pun diperluas hingga ke area hilir, khususnya di danau. Berbagai langkah antisipatif telah diambil agar tumpahan minyak tidak sampai ke danau. Penyisiran secara berkala terus dilakukan untuk memastikan kebersihan di seluruh jalur air, menjaga ekosistem danau agar tetap terlindungi dari kontaminasi.

Hingga hari ini, dari total 190 aduan yang tercatat dari enam desa terdampak, 48% di antaranya telah berhasil diselesaikan. Data ini menjadi bukti nyata komitmen PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) dalam memastikan setiap keluhan ditangani dengan baik.

Penanganan aduan dilakukan secara proaktif oleh Tim Grievance yang mendatangi langsung masyarakat. Salah satunya adalah Ibu Agustina, warga Langkea Raya, yang menyampaikan keluhan terkait air di wilayahnya. Sebagai langkah cepat, Tim Grievance menyarankan Ibu Agustina untuk sementara tidak mengkonsumsi air hingga hasil uji laboratorium resmi keluar.

"Tim PT Vale telah proaktif mendatangi kami. Dengan adanya posko ini, kami merasa lebih mudah untuk menanyakan kondisi dan menyampaikan keluhan,” ujar Ibu Agustina.

Selain penanganan aduan, tim gabungan juga memperkuat upaya pemulihan lingkungan dengan pendekatan berbasis data ilmiah. Pemantauan kualitas udara telah dilakukan di beberapa lokasi berdasarkan aduan warga yang disampaikan ke Posko Pengaduan dan Informasi.

Pemantauan dan pengukuran ini dilaksanakan oleh ahli dari HAS Environmental, yaitu Tri Wisnu Febrianto, dengan menggunakan Portable Environmental Quality Monitor (EQM). Alat ini mampu mendeteksi polutan secara real-time, termasuk gas berbahaya yang dihasilkan dari Marine Fuel Oil (MFO) seperti Sulfur Dioxide (SO2) dan Volatile Organic Compound (VOC), yang berisiko terhadap kesehatan pernapasan. Pemeriksaan ini menjadi langkah proaktif untuk memastikan udara di lingkungan warga tetap aman.

Pada hari ke-18 ini, dipastikan bahwa keluhan bau di rumah-rumah warga yang dekat dari aliran sungai sudah tidak ada lagi. Hal ini menunjukkan efektivitas dari upaya pembersihan dan penanganan yang telah dilakukan secara menyeluruh.

Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations PT Vale, menyampaikan apresiasi atas sinergi yang telah terjalin. Hasil pemantauan kualitas udara membuktikan bahwa dalam mengukur dan mengatasi dampak ini demi mengembalikan rasa aman dan normal bagi masyarakat.

"Progres yang kita capai hari ini adalah hasil dari kepercayaan dan kolaborasi tanpa henti. Dengan 48% aduan telah terselesaikan dan keluhan bau di sekitar pemukiman warga telah masuk ke dalam perhatian kita juga, ini membuktikan bahwa pendekatan terpadu kita berjalan dengan terstruktur dan on track," ungkap Endra.

Melalui kepemimpinan pemerintah, dukungan dari para ahli, serta keterlibatan aktif warga, setiap langkah dijalankan dengan kepedulian dan transparansi, memastikan Towuti pulih dan kehidupan masyarakat kembali normal secara menyeluruh.

en.title: First Cut Marks BB1 Operational Launch: PT Vale Indonesia Reinforces Sustainability, Collaboration, and Contribution to Advancing Indonesia
en.subtitle: PT Vale is developing Bahodopi Block 1 (BB1) to strengthen its position in supporting the expansion of national nickel production to meet global demand, while upholding sustainability principles. PT Vale is collaborating with strategic business partner PT Antareja Mahada Makmur (AMM) for stripping, mining, ore transportation, and infrastructure development activities at BB1. The First Cut Ceremony held at Pit Myara on Monday (8/9/2025) marked a significant milestone, signaling the commencement of operational activities at Bahodopi Block 1.
en.body:
Morowali, September 8, 2025 — As a sustainable nickel company, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) reaffirms its commitment to supporting the national development agenda outlined in Asta Cita, with a focus on sustainability, green energy transition, and improving community welfare in its operational areas.

As part of this commitment, PT Vale is developing Bahodopi Block 1 (BB1) to strengthen its position in supporting the expansion of national nickel production to meet global demand, while upholding sustainability principles. PT Vale is collaborating with strategic business partner PT Antareja Mahada Makmur (AMM) for stripping, mining, ore transportation, and infrastructure development activities at BB1.

The First Cut Ceremony held at Pit Myara on Monday (8/9/2025) marked a significant milestone, signaling the commencement of operational activities at Bahodopi Block 1. The event was attended by key stakeholders from Central Sulawesi, Morowali, East Luwu, PT Vale Indonesia’s President Commissioner F.S. Multhazar, and Director and Chief of Project PT Vale Indonesia, Muhammad Asril.

Bahodopi Block 1 is a strategic project expected to have a substantial impact on Indonesia’s economy. It not only contributes to state revenue but also creates employment opportunities and enhances the welfare of surrounding communities.

Although still in the early stages of development, Bahodopi Block 1 has already delivered tangible benefits to the region. To date, hundreds of local workers have been employed in strategic roles. Of the 503 individuals involved in the development of Bahodopi Block 1, 63 percent are local residents from Morowali and East Luwu, each playing a vital role in the project’s success.

Currently, several supporting mining facilities at Bahodopi Block 1 are under construction, including disposal areas, settling ponds, stockpiles, camps, workshops, Mining Hauling Roads (MHR), and power lines, all aimed at ensuring smooth future operations.

In addition, PT Vale and its strategic partner PT Antareja Mahada Makmur (AMM) have initiated various community development and empowerment programs. These include collaborations with Morowali’s Village-Owned Enterprises (BUMDes) for workforce supply, vehicle rentals, sacrificial animal donations, and event sponsorships.

In Morowali, partnerships with local entrepreneurs have been established to provide labor, vehicle rentals, and sponsorships for village, sub-district, and anniversary events. Moving forward, PT AMM plans to launch a scholarship program to develop skilled workers in operations and mechanics from vocational school graduates.

From a sustainability perspective, PT Vale Indonesia’s Director and Chief Sustainability & Corporate Affairs Officer, Budiawansyah, emphasized the importance of cross-sector collaboration in implementing responsible mining practices, both environmentally and socially. PT Vale’s 57-year commitment in the Sorowako Block will be adapted to all mining activities in the Bahodopi Block.

"We are currently in Bahodopi Block 1, which is part of our strategic plan to support nickel downstreaming. God willing, Bahodopi Block 1 will add value, and the good mining practices we’ve implemented in Sorowako will be applied here as well," said Budiawansyah during the First Cut Ceremony on Monday (8/9/2025).

In the midst of efforts to contribute to the nickel industry, environmental and social aspects are often overlooked. PT Vale’s consistent commitment to sustainability brings optimism to the region, ensuring environmental preservation and maximizing contributions to regional revenue.

Central Sulawesi Governor, Dr. H. Anwar Hafid, M.Si., views the downstreaming strategy—transporting nickel ore from Morowali to be processed in Sorowako, East Luwu—as highly beneficial for both provincial and district governments. This includes not only ore from Bahodopi Block 1 but also Blocks 2 and 3.

"This is a new hope for us in Central Sulawesi and Morowali through profit-sharing from nickel matte. Mr. Police Chief, Mr. Military Commander, let’s safeguard this well because PT Vale is our future hope, and our revenue will surely increase through profit-sharing for both Morowali and Central Sulawesi," said the Governor.

Morowali Regent, Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf, represented by Expert Staff for Social Welfare Abdul Malik, expressed appreciation for PT Vale’s role in Morowali, particularly in various social initiatives.

"We often accompany PT Vale’s activities in Morowali, especially in health and education. PT Vale’s presence greatly supports the Regional Government in jointly fostering village development and improving healthcare facilities," he said.

Meanwhile, East Luwu Regent, Ir. H. Irwan Bachri Syam, ST, IPM, emphasized the importance of synergy between local governments and companies. The development of Bahodopi Block 1 will bring significant benefits, especially in increasing regional revenue through taxes and royalties—not only for Central Sulawesi Province but also for South Sulawesi Province.

"Why do we support PT Vale? Because we’ve partnered for 57 years in East Luwu, and during this partnership with the Government and Community, PT Vale has made extraordinary contributions, especially by implementing green mining practices. PT Vale’s operations are exceptional, and we are grateful for its presence. We gain a green environment and revenue from it," said the Regent.

 

Governor Urges Mining Companies to Emulate PT Vale’s Sustainability Commitment

Central Sulawesi Governor, Dr. H. Anwar Hafid, M.Si., commended PT Vale’s consistency in operating without neglecting environmental and social aspects, which he believes should serve as a model for other mining companies.

Amid the expansive growth of mining companies in Morowali Regency, commitment to social and environmental aspects is often tested and overlooked. PT Vale’s presence, with its sustainable and responsible principles, brings a breath of fresh air.

"I thank PT Vale for consistently protecting the environment. Hopefully, PT AMM, under PT Vale’s supervision, will implement proper and responsible mining practices and become a role model," said Anwar Hafid.

The Governor also stressed the importance of actualizing community empowerment programs. He called on companies and all stakeholders—including Regents, Sub-district Heads, and Village Heads—to jointly oversee corporate commitments to social and environmental aspects.

"My hope for entrepreneurs, under my leadership, is that Regents, Sub-district Heads, and Village Heads safeguard this properly, especially paying close attention to local community empowerment," he concluded.

id.title: First Cut Tandai Operasional BB1, PT Vale Indonesia Perkuat Keberlanjutan, Kolaborasi, dan Kontribusi bagi Indonesia Maju
id.subtitle: PT Vale menggarap Bahodopi Block 1 (BB1) dalam rangka mempertegas posisi perseroan dalam mendukung ekspansi produksi nikel nasional untuk memenuhi permintaan global dengan tetap mengedepankan prinsip keberlanjutan. PT Vale menggandeng mitra bisnis strategis, yaitu PT Antareja Mahada Makmur (AMM) dalam aktivitas pengupasan, penambangan, pengangkutan bijih, hingga pengembangan infrastruktur pendukung di BB1.  Kegiatan Ceremony First Cut yang berlangsung di Pit Myara, Senin (8/9/2025), menjadi momentum penting sebagai tanda dimulainya tahapan operasional BB1.
id.body:
Morowali, 8 September, 2025 — Sebagai perusahaan nikel berkelanjutan, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) menegaskan komitmennya untuk terus mendukung agenda pembangunan nasional sebagaimana tertuang dalam Asta Cita, dengan fokus pada keberlanjutan, transisi energi hijau, serta peningkatan kesejahteraan masyarakat di daerah operasi perusahaan.

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen tersebut, PT Vale menggarap Bahodopi Block 1 (BB1) dalam rangka mempertegas posisi perseroan dalam mendukung ekspansi produksi nikel nasional untuk memenuhi permintaan global dengan tetap mengedepankan prinsip keberlanjutan. PT Vale menggandeng mitra bisnis strategis, yaitu PT Antareja Mahada Makmur (AMM) dalam aktivitas pengupasan, penambangan, pengangkutan bijih, hingga pengembangan infrastruktur pendukung di BB1.

Kegiatan Ceremony First Cut yang berlangsung di Pit Myara, Senin (8/9/2025), menjadi momentum penting sebagai tanda dimulainya tahapan operasional Bahodopi Block 1 yang turut disaksikan oleh para stakeholder kunci Sulawesi Tengah, Morowali, Luwu Timur, Komisaris Utama PT Vale Indonesia, F.S. Multhazar, serta Direktur dan Chief of Project PT Vale Indonesia, Muhammad Asril.

First Cut Bahodopi Block 1 menjadi salah satu proyek yang strategis yang akan berdampak besar bagi perekonomian Indonesia. Proyek ini tidak hanya meningkatkan pendapatan negara, tetapi juga menciptakan lapangan kerja dan meningkatkan kesejahteraan masyarakat sekitar.

Meskipun masih di awal pengembangan, Bahodopi Block 1 telah membawa manfaat nyata bagi daerah. Hingga saat ini, tercatat sudah menyerap ratusan tenaga kerja lokal yang menempati posisi strategis. Dari total 503 orang yang terlibat pada pengambangan Bahodopi Block 1, 63 persen diantaranya merupakan masyarakat lokal dari Morowali dan Luwu Timur yang masing-masing memiliki tupoksi penting terhadap kelancaran proyek. 

Hingga saat ini, sejumlah fasilitas pendukung penambangan di Bahodopi Block 1 sedang dalam tahap konstruksi, mulai dari area disposal, settling pond, stockpile, camp, workshop, Mining Hauling Road (MHR), serta Power Line, yang harapannya menjadi penunjang kelancaran operasional di masa mendatang.

Selain itu, sejumlah program pengembangan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat juga sudah dilakukan PT Vale bersama PT Antareja Mahada Makmur (AMM) yang menjadi mitra strategis dalam pengembangan Bahodopi Block 1. Diantaranya, berkolaborasi dengan BUMDes Morowali untuk suplai tenaga kerja, rental kendaraan, bantuan hewan kurban, hingga sponsorship lomba. 

Selanjutnya, di Morowali, terdapat program Kerjasama dengan pengusaha lokal untuk suplai tenaga kerja, penyediaan rental kendaraan, sponsorship pada acara desa, kecamatan, hingga ulang tahun desa. Ke depan, PT AMM akan membuka program beasiswa yang diharapkan mencetak tenaga kerja kompeten di bidang operator dan mekanik dari lulusan SMK.

Dari perspektif keberlanjutan, Direktur dan Chief Sustainability & Corporate Affairs Officer PT Vale Indonesia, Budiawansyah, menegaskan pentingnya kolaborasi lintas sektor dalam mewujudkan praktik pertambangan yang baik dan bertanggung jawab, baik dari sisi lingkungan maupun sosial. Komitmen PT Vale yang sudah berjalan selama 57 tahun di Blok Sorowako akan diadaptasi dalam setiap aktivitas pertambangan di Blok Bahodopi. 

“Saat ini kita berada di Blok Bahodopi 1 yang merupakan bagian dari rencana strategis untuk mendukung hilirisasi nikel. Blok Bahodopi 1 ini insya allah bisa memberikan nilai tambah dan tentunya praktik tambang yang baik kami lakukan di Sorowako bisa kami terapkan di sini,” sambung Budiawansyah, dalam sambutannya, pada saat Ceremony First Cut Bahodopi Block 1, Senin (8/9/2025).

Di tengah upaya untuk berkontribusi terhadap industri nikel, lingkungan dan sosial kadang terabaikan. Konsistensi PT Vale terhadap nilai keberlanjutan menjadi harapan yang membawa optimisme bagi daerah, tidak hanya memastikan lingkungan terjaga tapi juga optimalisasi kontribusi ke pendapatan daerah.

Gubernur Sulawesi Tengah, Dr. H. Anwar Hafid, M.Si., menilai langkah hilirisasi melalui pengangkutan bijih nikel dari Morowali yang akan diolah di Sorowako, Luwu Timur, menjadi strategi yang akan sangat menguntungkan bagi daerah, baik provinsi maupun kabupaten. Bukan hanya bijih nikel dari Bahodopi Block 1, tapi juga dari Bahodopi Block 2 dan 3.

“Ini harapan baru bagi kita, Sulawesi Tengah dan Morowali melalui bagi hasil dari nikel matte. Pak Kapolres, Pak Dandim, kita jaga baik-baik betul ini karena PT Vale adalah harapan masa depan kita, pasti akan bertambah pendapatan kita baik bagi hasil Morowali maupun Sulawesi Tengah,” kata Gubernur.

Bupati Morowali, Iksan Baharudin Abdul Rauf, yang diwakili oleh Staf Ahli Bidang Kesra, Abdul Malik, menyampaikan apresiasi atas peran PT Vale di Morowali, utamanya dalam berbagai inisiatif sosial.

“Kegiatan PT Vale di Morowali sering kami dampingi, di bidang kesehatan dan pendidikan. Keberadaan PT Vale sangat membantu Pemerintah Daerah, secara bersama-sama melakukan pembinaan di desa-desa serta pembenahan fasilitas kesehatan,” 

Sementara itu, Bupati Luwu Timur, Ir. H. Irwan Bachri Syam, ST, IPM, menekankan sinergi penting antara pemerintah daerah dan perusahaan. Pengembangan Bahodopi Block 1 akan membawa banyak manfaat, utamanya bagi peningkatan pendapatan daerah melalui pembayaran pajak dan royalty, tidak hanya bagi Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah saja, tapi juga Provinsi Sulawesi Selatan. 

“Kenapa kami mendorong PT Vale? Karena sudah 57 tahun bermitra dengan kami di Luwu Timur dan selama bermitra dengan Pemerintah dan Masyarakat di Luwu Timur, luar biasa kontribusi PT Vale apalagi menerapkan sistem pertambangan hijau. PT Vale dalam melaksanakan kegiatan sangat luar biasa, maka kami berterima kasih dengan kehadiran PT Vale. Jadi kami mendapatkan lingkungan yang hijau, dan kami juga memperoleh pendapatan dari situ,” ungkap Bupati.

 

Gubernur Minta Perusahaan Tambang Contoh Komitmen Keberlanjutan PT Vale

Gubernur Sulawesi Tengah, Dr. H. Anwar Hafid, M.Si., memberikan apresiasi atas konsistensi PT Vale dalam menjalankan operasional dengan tidak mengesampingkan aspek lingkungan dan sosial yang dinilai dapat menjadi contoh bagi perusahaan tambang lainnya.

Di tengah masifnya langkah ekspansif perusahaan tambang di Kabupaten Morowali, komitmen terhadap aspek sosial dan lingkungan kerap diuji dan terabaikan. Hadirnya PT Vale dengan prinsip keberlanjutan dan bertanggung jawab membawa angin segar.

“Saya berterima kasih kepada PT Vale yang konsisten menjaga lingkungan, mudah-mudahan PT AMM, di bawah supervisi PT Vale akan menerapkan pertambangan yang baik dan benar sehingga akan menjadi contoh,” ungkap Anwar Hafid.

Selain itu, Gubernur juga menekankan pentingnya aktualisasi program pemberdayaan masyarakat. Dia mengajak perusahaan serta seluruh pemangku kepentingan, baik Bupati, Camat, hingga Kepala Desa untuk secara bersama-sama mengawal komitmen perusahaan terhadap aspek sosial dan lingkungan.

“Harapan saya kepada pengusaha, di bawah kepemimpinan saya, Bupati, Camat, dan Kepala Desa menjaga ini dengan sebaik-baiknya, terutama pemberdayaan masyarakat lokal tolong diperhatikan betul.

en.title: Leadership and Compassion in Action: PT Vale, Government, and MIND ID Coordinate Swift and Collaborative Response to Oil Pipeline Incident
en.subtitle: Seventeen days following the oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District, East Luwu Regency, recovery efforts have continued to demonstrate substantial progress. At the heart of each milestone lies a spirit of collaboration and strong synergy among PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), the local government, MIND ID, and the surrounding communities.
en.body:
Towuti, 8 September 2025 — Seventeen days following the oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District, East Luwu Regency, recovery efforts have continued to demonstrate substantial progress. At the heart of each milestone lies a spirit of collaboration and strong synergy among PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), the local government, MIND ID, and the surrounding communities.

In an official statement delivered on Monday (8 September 2025), East Luwu Regent Irwan Bachri Syam indicated that the incident was likely triggered by land movement resulting from seismic activity. He emphasized that the coordinated response has been effective due to the active involvement of all stakeholders.

“The concerns raised by the community have been addressed appropriately. All costs associated with impact mitigation, as expected by the public and facilitated through the local government, have been managed effectively,” stated the Regent.

This affirmation underscores the principle that post-incident recovery is not solely the responsibility of the company, but a collective endeavor led by government authorities to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability for all affected parties.

As of the seventeenth day, 191 formal complaints have been received through the Complaint & Information Post at the Towuti Subdistrict Office and the 24-hour hotline. Each report is being addressed systematically, reflecting the commitment to an open and accountable recovery process.

Community participation has also played a pivotal role. One notable example is Munir, a 60-year-old retired PT Vale contractor, who has led a team of local residents over the past nine days. Together, they have cleaned a 2.1-kilometer stretch of river from Post 7 to Post 9, ensuring thorough restoration of the affected areas. Munir’s initiative exemplifies the shared responsibility and intergenerational solidarity that underpin Towuti’s recovery.

On the same day, MIND ID President Director Maroef Sjamsoeddin conducted a site visit to Lioka Village to observe the recovery efforts firsthand. He commended the collaboration between PT Vale, the government, and the community for effectively minimizing the impact and establishing a participatory and adaptive response model.

“This is a natural occurrence with far-reaching consequences, yet it offers valuable insights into how we can better anticipate and manage such events. With integrated preparedness, mitigation efforts can be more strategic and controlled,” Maroef remarked.

PT Vale’s core response team has remained actively engaged on the ground for sixteen consecutive days. Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations at PT Vale, highlighted the importance of multi-stakeholder collaboration in achieving meaningful recovery outcomes.

“Our commitment is to ensure that this recovery becomes more than a reactive measure—it is a momentum to reinforce solidarity and transparency. We will continue to work closely with all relevant parties to ensure that every recovery initiative is effective, equitable, and well-targeted,” Endra stated.

The synergy among the government, MIND ID, PT Vale, and the community illustrates that Towuti’s recovery is a shared journey. Guided by government leadership, supported by expert knowledge, and strengthened by active citizen engagement, each step is undertaken with care and transparency—ensuring that Towuti’s environment and community life are restored in a sustainable and resilient manner.

id.title: Kepemimpinan dan Kepedulian: Respons Cepat PT Vale bersama Pemerintah dan MIND ID Tangani Insiden Pipa Minyak
id.subtitle: Tujuh belas hari pasca-insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti, Kabupaten Luwu Timur, upaya pemulihan terus menunjukkan hasil yang signifikan. Di balik setiap progres, terdapat semangat gotong royong dan sinergi erat antara PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), Pemerintah Daerah, MIND ID, dan masyarakat setempat.
id.body:
Towuti, 8 September 2025 — Tujuh belas hari pasca-insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti, Kabupaten Luwu Timur, upaya pemulihan terus menunjukkan hasil yang signifikan. Di balik setiap progres, terdapat semangat gotong royong dan sinergi erat antara PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale), Pemerintah Daerah, MIND ID, dan masyarakat setempat.

Dalam sambutannya pada hari Senin (8/9/2025), Bupati Luwu Timur, Irwan Bachri Syam, menegaskan bahwa penyebab insiden diduga kuat akibat pergeseran tanah karena gempa. Ia menekankan bahwa proses penanganan berjalan dengan baik berkat keterlibatan semua pihak. “Sehingga apa yang menjadi tuntutan masyarakat, alhamdulillah sudah tertangani dengan baik. Seluruh bentuk biaya penanganan dampak yang diharapkan oleh masyarakat, melalui pemerintah daerah, sudah tertangani dengan baik,” ujar Bupati.

Pernyataan ini memperkuat pesan bahwa penanganan pasca-insiden bukan hanya tugas perusahaan, tetapi sebuah gerakan kolektif yang dipandu oleh kepemimpinan pemerintah untuk menjamin keadilan dan transparansi bagi seluruh pihak terdampak.

Hingga hari ke-17, tercatat 191 aduan resmi telah diterima melalui Posko Pengaduan & Informasi di Kantor Camat Towuti serta hotline 24 jam. Setiap aduan ditangani secara terukur, menjadi bukti keterbukaan dan akuntabilitas dalam proses pemulihan yang berkelanjutan.

Komitmen juga lahir dari masyarakat. Salah satunya, Munir, seorang pensiunan kontraktor PT Vale berusia 60 tahun, yang selama sembilan hari terakhir memimpin tim warga lokal dari berbagai usia. Bersama-sama mereka menyisir aliran sungai sepanjang 2,1 km dari Pos 7 hingga Pos 9, memastikan area terdampak benar-benar bersih. Kisah Munir mencerminkan semangat bahwa pemulihan Towuti adalah kerja bersama, lintas generasi dan lintas sektor.

Di hari yang sama, Direktur Utama MIND ID, Maroef Sjamsoeddin, meninjau langsung penanganan di Desa Lioka. Ia menilai kolaborasi PT Vale, pemerintah, dan masyarakat berhasil meminimalisir dampak serta menciptakan model penanganan yang partisipatif dan adaptif.

“Ini adalah kehendak alam dengan dampak yang meluas, tapi bisa menjadi pelajaran untuk mengantisipasi bagaimana menghadapi kondisi seperti ini. Dengan antisipasi terpadu, mitigasi bisa lebih terencana dan terkendali,” ungkap Maroef.

Selama enam belas hari penuh, tim inti PT Vale terus berada di garis depan. Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations PT Vale, menyampaikan bahwa dukungan relawan, masyarakat, dan pemerintah menjadi fondasi penting keberhasilan pemulihan.

“Komitmen kami adalah menjadikan pemulihan ini lebih dari sekadar reaksi, tetapi momentum untuk memperkuat solidaritas dan transparansi. Kami akan terus bekerja sama dengan seluruh pihak terkait agar setiap langkah penanganan berjalan efektif, adil, dan tepat sasaran,” ujar Endra.

Sinergi pemerintah, MIND ID, PT Vale, dan masyarakat menunjukkan bahwa pemulihan Towuti adalah perjalanan bersama. Melalui kepemimpinan pemerintah, dukungan para ahli, serta keterlibatan aktif warga, setiap langkah dijalankan dengan kepedulian dan transparansi — memastikan Towuti pulih dan kehidupan masyarakat kembali pulih secara menyeluruh dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: Towuti’s Collaborative Recovery: PT Vale and Communities Strengthen Recovery Through Science-Based Data and Collective Action
en.subtitle: On the 15th day of response efforts following an oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) reaffirmed its commitment to a recovery process that is transparent, sustainable, and participatory. The recovery strategy is being implemented through two main pillars: scientifically rigorous data integrity and collective community action in partnership with PT Vale.
en.body:
Towuti, 7 September 2025 – On the 15th day of response efforts following an oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) reaffirmed its commitment to a recovery process that is transparent, sustainable, and participatory. The recovery strategy is being implemented through two main pillars: scientifically rigorous data integrity and collective community action in partnership with PT Vale.

As of day 15, a joint task force comprising the East Luwu Regency Government, the Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD), village authorities, and PT Vale has received and formally recorded 126 verified complaints through the Information & Complaint Command Post and a 24‑hour public hotline.

The reported impacts include 42 rice fields, 28 plantations, 19 fish ponds, and 37 cases related to access to clean water and livestock. This dataset serves as the foundation for a science-based mapping of compensation and ecological recovery measures.

“The comprehensive database we have compiled does more than document losses. It functions as a critical tool for designing long-term solutions that are measurable, fair, accountable, and grounded in scientific evidence,” said Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relations, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk.

Beyond technical assessments, the recovery process has been strengthened by strong community involvement. Over the past five days, 60 local residents from Lioka and Baruga villages have worked alongside PT Vale in rotating teams, each consisting of 30 people, to remove residual oil contamination along the riverbanks.

Ali Bastian, a farmer from Molindowe Hamlet, shared his perspective: “PT Vale did not come only to clean up; they invited us to be part of the effort. We feel respected because we are directly involved in restoring the land and water we depend on every day.”

Similar sentiments were expressed by Asrul Akhmad, a resident of Matompi Village: “The data collection process has been very helpful. Our affected rice fields are officially recorded, giving us confidence that our concerns are not being overlooked. We are patient with the process because we see the seriousness of PT Vale and the government in addressing this situation.”

PT Vale emphasizes that this integrated approach—combining science, data, and community solidarity—forms the foundation for a more resilient recovery. Looking ahead, the company’s focus is on restoring the Towuti ecosystem while also reinforcing the social resilience of local communities.

“Our commitment is to ensure that this recovery is more than a short-term response to a crisis. It is an opportunity to strengthen solidarity, transparency, and the long-term sustainability of life in Towuti,”
Endra concluded.

id.title: Towuti Bergerak Bersama: PT Vale dan Warga Perkuat Pemulihan dengan Data Ilmiah dan Gotong Royong
id.subtitle: Memasuki hari ke-15 penanganan insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) kembali menegaskan komitmennya terhadap proses pemulihan yang transparan, berkelanjutan dan berbasis partisipasi . Strategi pemulihan ini dilakukan melalui dua pendekatan utama: integritas data ilmiah yang komprehensif dan aksi gotong royong masyarakat bersama PT Vale.
id.body:
Towuti, 7 September 2025 – Memasuki hari ke-15 penanganan insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) kembali menegaskan komitmennya terhadap proses pemulihan yang transparan, berkelanjutan dan berbasis partisipasi . Strategi pemulihan ini dilakukan melalui dua pendekatan utama: integritas data ilmiah yang komprehensif dan aksi gotong royong masyarakat bersama PT Vale.

Hingga hari ke-15, tim gabungan Pemda Luwu Timur, BPBD, aparat desa, dan PT Vale telah menerima dan mencatat 126 laporan aduan resmi  melalui di Posko Pengaduan & Informasi serta layanan hotline 24 jam.

Klasifikasi dampak meliputi 42 lahan sawah, 28 kebun, 19 empang, serta 37 kasus berkaitan dengan akses air bersih dan peternakan. Semua data ini menjadi dasar untuk pemetaan kompensasi dan pemulihan berbasis ilmiah.

“Basis data yang komprehensif yang kami himpun ini tidak sekedar mencatat kerugian, tetapi juga menjadi instrumen untuk merancang solusi jangka panjang yang bisa dijalankan terukur adil, akuntabel dan berbasis ilmiah,” jelas Endra Kusuma, Head of External Relation PT Vale Indonesia Tbk.

Selain asesmen, semangat kebersamaan masyarakat menjadi kekuatan pemulihan. Selama lima hari terakhir, 60 warga dari Desa Lioka dan Desa Baruga bergabung dalam dua kelompok kerja bergiliran (shift), masing-masing terdiri dari 30 orang, untuk membersihkan sisa minyak di sepanjang sungai.

Ali Bastian, petani Dusun Molindowe, menyampaikan: “PT Vale tidak hanya datang untuk membersihkan, tapi juga mengajak kami bergabung. Kami merasa dihargai karena dilibatkan langsung dalam memulihkan lahan dan air yang kami gunakan sehari-hari.”

Hal serupa disampaikan Asrul Akhmad, warga Desa Matompi: “Pendataan yang dilakukan sangat membantu, karena sawah kami yang terdampak bisa tercatat resmi. Ada kepastian bahwa masalah kami tidak diabaikan. Kami bersabar menunggu proses, karena melihat keseriusan PT Vale dan pemerintah.”

Pendekatan terpadu antara sains, data, dan gotong royong akan menjadi fondasi pemulihan yang lebih kuat oleh PT Vale. Fokus ke depan adalah mengembalikan ekosistem Towuti sekaligus memperkuat ketahanan sosial masyarakat. 


“Komitmen kami adalah menjadikan pemulihan ini lebih dari sekadar reaksi terhadap krisis, tapi sebagai momentum memperkuat solidaritas, transparansi, dan keberlanjutan kehidupan warga Towuti,” tutup Endra.

The Company’s strategy is anchored on two fundamental pillars: the integrity of comprehensive scientific data and the strength of community collaboration.

Over the past five days, 60 residents from Lioka and Baruga Villages have participated in two rotating work groups, each consisting of 30 individuals, to assist in cleaning residual oil along the riverbanks.

Ali Bastian, a farmer from Molindowe Hamlet, shared his experience:

“PT Vale did not simply come to clean up—they invited us to be part of the process. We feel respected and valued for being directly involved in restoring the land and water we depend on daily.”

“The data collection has been very helpful. Our affected rice fields are now officially recorded, giving us confidence that our concerns are being taken seriously. We are patiently awaiting the process, recognizing the seriousness shown by PT Vale and the government.”

This integrated approach—merging scientific precision with community engagement—will serve as the cornerstone of a resilient and inclusive recovery led by PT Vale. The next phase will focus on restoring Towuti’s ecosystem while reinforcing the social resilience of its communities.

“Our commitment is to ensure that this recovery becomes more than a reactive measure—it is a momentum to strengthen solidarity, transparency, and the long-term sustainability of life in Towuti,” Endra concluded.

en.title: East Luwu Government and PT Vale Collaborate to Ensure Fair and Transparent Solutions for Affected Communities
en.subtitle: Recovery efforts following the oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District on August 23, 2025, continue to prioritize transparency, fairness, and collaboration. On the 14th day of the emergency response, the East Luwu Regency Government and PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) presented a comprehensive solution framework to affected residents, covering impact classification, compensation schemes, and an extension of the emergency response period.
en.body:
East Luwu, September 6, 2025 — Recovery efforts following the oil pipeline leak incident in Towuti District on August 23, 2025, continue to prioritize transparency, fairness, and collaboration. On the 14th day of the emergency response, the East Luwu Regency Government and PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) presented a comprehensive solution framework to affected residents, covering impact classification, compensation schemes, and an extension of the emergency response period.

The public briefing was held in two sessions: the first with residents of Lioka Village at the Towuti Subdistrict Office, and the second with representatives from Langkea Raya, Baruga, Wawondula, Matompi, and Timampu Villages at the East Luwu Regent’s Office on Friday, September 5.

East Luwu Regent Irwan Bachri Syam explained that a joint assessment team—comprising technical agencies, the Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD), subdistrict officials, and PT Vale—had been deployed since day one. The assessment identified impact categories including rice fields, plantations, fish ponds, poultry, livestock, fishing activities, and water wells, with severity levels ranging from low to high. A compensation mechanism was formulated to ensure fairness and certainty for affected residents.

As part of the comprehensive recovery effort, the Regent also announced an official extension of the emergency response period until September 12, 2025, to allow for the completion of oil residue cleanup in the field. “God willing, we will see this through to completion. PT Vale has reaffirmed its commitment, and we will continue striving to meet the community’s expectations with the best possible solutions,” he stated.

Lioka Village Head Yuliana expressed optimism about the proposed compensation scheme. “This is a wise decision by the Regent and PT Vale. Our community feels reassured knowing there is clarity and continuity for their livelihoods. We hope the follow-up actions will be carried out cleanly and transparently,” she said.

Timampu Village Head Samsul echoed similar sentiments. “Many farmers delayed harvesting due to concerns over contamination. Now, with this clarification, they have the confidence to proceed. I’ve advised residents to harvest and store their crops with peace of mind,” he explained.

PT Vale’s Director and Chief of Sustainability & Corporate Affairs Officer, Budiawansyah, emphasized the company’s support for the agreed-upon mechanisms. “We are committed to strengthening collaboration with the East Luwu Government and all stakeholders to implement the proposed solutions. Our guiding principles are clear: fairness, transparency, and responsiveness to community needs,” he affirmed. Budiawansyah added that the company’s actions go beyond corporate responsibility, forming part of a long-term, safe, and sustainable solution. PT Vale is also prioritizing a science-based approach to resolution and recovery.

PT Vale’s Head of External Relations, Endra Kusuma, noted that recovery efforts extend beyond compensation. “Our commitment has remained unchanged since day one: to address community concerns with the best possible solutions. In addition to compensation, we’ve engaged independent experts to conduct regular assessments to ensure no lingering social, health, or environmental impacts,” he concluded.

The collaboration between the East Luwu Government, PT Vale, the Regional House of Representatives (DPRD), police, military, and local communities has been instrumental in ensuring a fair and comprehensive recovery process. The extension of the emergency response period until September 12, 2025, underscores the collective commitment to seeing the recovery through, enabling Towuti to heal and its residents to resume their lives with confidence.

id.title: Kolaborasi Pemda Luwu Timur dan PT Vale Pastikan Solusi Berkeadilan dan Transparan untuk Warga Terdampak
id.subtitle: Upaya pemulihan pasca insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti pada 23 Agustus 2025 terus berlanjut dengan mengedepankan prinsip transparansi, keadilan, dan kolaborasi. Memasuki hari ke-14, Pemerintah Daerah (Pemda) Luwu Timur bersama PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) memaparkan mekanisme solusi kepada masyarakat terdampak yang mencakup klasifikasi dampak, skema kompensasi, serta perpanjangan periode tanggap darurat.
id.body:
Luwu Timur, 6 September 2025 — Upaya pemulihan pasca insiden kebocoran pipa minyak di Kecamatan Towuti pada 23 Agustus 2025 terus berlanjut dengan mengedepankan prinsip transparansi, keadilan, dan kolaborasi. Memasuki hari ke-14, Pemerintah Daerah (Pemda) Luwu Timur bersama PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) memaparkan mekanisme solusi kepada masyarakat terdampak yang mencakup klasifikasi dampak, skema kompensasi, serta perpanjangan periode tanggap darurat.

Forum pemaparan dilakukan dalam dua sesi: pertama bersama warga Desa Lioka di Kantor Camat Towuti, dan kedua dengan perwakilan dari Desa Langkea Raya, Baruga, Wawondula, Matompi, serta Timampu di Kantor Bupati Luwu Timur, Jumat (5/9/2025).

Bupati Luwu Timur, Irwan Bachri Syam, menjelaskan bahwa tim gabungan yang terdiri dari dinas teknis terkait, BPBD, camat, dan PT Vale telah melakukan asesmen sejak hari pertama. Asesmen tersebut menghasilkan klasifikasi dampak; sawah, kebun, empang, ternak unggas, ternak besar, nelayan, dan sumur air, dengan tingkat keparahan rendah, sedang, hingga tinggi. Mekanisme kompensasi dirumuskan untuk memastikan keadilan dan kepastian bagi warga terdampak.

Sebagai bagian dari upaya pemulihan menyeluruh, Bupati juga menegaskan bahwa periode tanggap darurat resmi diperpanjang hingga 12 September 2025, untuk memberikan ruang bagi penyelesaian pembersihan sisa minyak di lapangan. “Insya Allah kami kawal sampai tuntas. PT Vale sudah menyatakan komitmennya, dan apa yang menjadi harapan masyarakat akan terus diupayakan agar terjawab dengan solusi terbaik,” ujarnya.

Kepala Desa Lioka, Yuliana, menyebut skema kompensasi yang disampaikan memberi harapan baru bagi warganya. “Ini keputusan yang sangat bijaksana dari Pak Bupati dan PT Vale. Masyarakat merasa lebih tenang karena ada kepastian, perekonomian mereka tetap bisa berlanjut, dan kami berharap tindak lanjutnya nanti betul-betul clear and clean di lapangan,” katanya.

Kepala Desa Timampu, Samsul, juga menyampaikan hal serupa. “Banyak petani menunda panen karena khawatir sawahnya terdampak. Kini, dengan adanya penjelasan ini, mereka mendapat kepastian. Saya sudah sampaikan agar warga bisa panen dan menyimpan hasilnya dengan tenang,” jelasnya.

Direktur dan Chief of Sustainability & Corporate Affairs Officer PT Vale, Budiawansyah, menegaskan dukungan perusahaan terhadap mekanisme yang disepakati. “Kami berkomitmen memperkuat kolaborasi dengan Pemda Luwu Timur dan seluruh pemangku kepentingan untuk merealisasikan solusi yang dirumuskan. Prinsip kami jelas: adil, transparan, dan sesuai kebutuhan masyarakat,” tegasnya. Budiawansyah menegaskan bahwa langkah yang diambil Perusahaan bukan semata memenuhi tanggungjawab korporasi, melainkan bagian solusi jangka panjang yang aman dan berkelanjutan. Sejalan dengan itu, PT Vale mengedepankan penyelesaian dan pemulihan berbasis pendekatan ilmiah (scientific). 

Head of External Relations PT Vale, Endra Kusuma, menambahkan bahwa pemulihan tidak berhenti pada kompensasi. “Komitmen kami tetap sama sejak hari pertama: menjawab keresahan masyarakat dengan solusi terbaik. Selain kompensasi, kami melibatkan tim ahli independen untuk melakukan asesmen berkala agar tidak ada dampak sosial, kesehatan, maupun lingkungan yang tersisa,” pungkasnya.

Kolaborasi Pemda Luwu Timur, PT Vale, DPRD, aparat kepolisian, TNI, serta masyarakat menjadi kunci dalam memastikan pemulihan berjalan secara adil dan menyeluruh. Perpanjangan masa tanggap darurat hingga 12 September 2025 menunjukkan keseriusan semua pihak untuk mengawal pemulihan sampai tuntas, sehingga Towuti dapat kembali pulih dan kehidupan warga berjalan dengan baik.

en.title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk Earns Great Place To Work® Certification for 2025
en.subtitle: PT Vale has officially earned the Great Place To Work® Certification for 2025, a prestigious recognition awarded by an independent global authority based entirely on direct feedback from employees about their workplace experience. In 2025, a total of 947 employees participated in the Great Place To Work® survey. The results revealed that 88% of respondents consider PTVI a great place to work, a figure that stands 59% above the global average.
en.body:
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PT Vale) is proud to announce a significant milestone in its ongoing cultural transformation journey. The company has officially earned the Great Place To Work® Certification for 2025, a prestigious recognition awarded by an independent global authority based entirely on direct feedback from employees about their workplace experience.

In 2025, a total of 947 employees participated in the Great Place To Work® survey. The results revealed that 88% of respondents consider PTVI a great place to work, a figure that stands 59% above the global average. This achievement positions PTVI among organizations with exceptionally high levels of employee satisfaction.

Great Place To Work® is a globally recognized institution specializing in workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership practices that drive innovation, retention, and business performance. The certification is granted to companies that successfully foster a work environment built on trust, collaboration, and appreciation for individual contributions.

According to Great Place To Work®, this certification reflects the company’s consistent dedication and commitment to creating a positive employee experience. It also affirms PTVI’s position as one of the best companies to work for—where employees feel valued and actively engaged.

Internally, this achievement is viewed as a result of PTVI’s ongoing efforts to cultivate a workplace culture that supports growth and employee engagement. The company has created an environment where individuals feel supported, trusted, and inspired to develop professionally. This aligns with PTVI’s core CARES values and reflects its commitment to building a workplace where every employee can thrive, contribute meaningfully, and take pride in being part of the organization.

About Great Place To Work® Certification
The Great Place To Work® Certification is the most definitive recognition of employer excellence, highly sought after by organizations worldwide. What makes it unique is that it is based entirely on real employee experiences—particularly how consistently they perceive a culture of trust and respect in the workplace.

Each year, more than 10,000 companies across 60 countries apply for this certification. PTVI’s achievement not only marks a significant internal milestone but also places the company on the global map as a workplace of choice.

id.title: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk Resmi Meraih Sertifikasi Great Place To Work® 2025
id.subtitle: PTVI secara resmi meraih Sertifikasi Great Place To Work® 2025, sebuah pengakuan bergengsi yang diberikan oleh lembaga independen internasional berdasarkan umpan balik langsung dari karyawan mengenai pengalaman mereka bekerja di perusahaan. Pada tahun ini, sebanyak 947 karyawan PTVI berpartisipasi dalam survei Great Place To Work®. Hasil survei menunjukkan bahwa 88% karyawan menyatakan PTVI adalah tempat yang hebat untuk bekerja, angka yang tercatat 59% lebih tinggi dibandingkan rata-rata perusahaan global.
id.body:
PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI) dengan bangga mengumumkan pencapaian penting dalam perjalanan transformasi budaya kerja perusahaan. PTVI secara resmi meraih Sertifikasi Great Place To Work® 2025, sebuah pengakuan bergengsi yang diberikan oleh lembaga independen internasional berdasarkan umpan balik langsung dari karyawan mengenai pengalaman mereka bekerja di perusahaan.

Pada tahun ini, sebanyak 947 karyawan PTVI berpartisipasi dalam survei Great Place To Work®. Hasil survei menunjukkan bahwa 88% karyawan menyatakan PTVI adalah tempat yang hebat untuk bekerja, angka yang tercatat 59% lebih tinggi dibandingkan rata-rata perusahaan global. Capaian ini menempatkan PTVI sebagai salah satu organisasi dengan tingkat kepuasan kerja yang sangat tinggi di tingkat internasional.

Great Place To Work® merupakan otoritas global dalam bidang budaya kerja, pengalaman karyawan, dan kepemimpinan yang berdampak langsung terhadap inovasi, retensi, dan kinerja bisnis. Sertifikasi ini diberikan kepada perusahaan yang berhasil menciptakan lingkungan kerja berbasis kepercayaan, kolaborasi, dan penghargaan terhadap kontribusi individu.

Pihak Great Place To Work® menyampaikan bahwa pencapaian sertifikasi ini mencerminkan dedikasi dan komitmen perusahaan dalam menciptakan pengalaman kerja terbaik bagi karyawan. Sertifikasi ini juga menegaskan posisi PTVI sebagai salah satu perusahaan terbaik untuk bekerja, di mana karyawan merasa dihargai dan terlibat secara aktif dalam proses kerja.

Dari perspektif internal, pencapaian ini dipandang sebagai hasil dari upaya berkelanjutan perusahaan dalam membangun budaya kerja yang mendukung pertumbuhan dan keterlibatan karyawan. Lingkungan kerja di PTVI dinilai telah memberikan ruang bagi karyawan untuk merasa didukung, dipercaya, dan terinspirasi untuk terus berkembang. Hal ini sejalan dengan nilai-nilai CARES yang menjadi fondasi budaya perusahaan, serta mencerminkan komitmen PTVI untuk menciptakan tempat kerja yang memungkinkan setiap individu berkembang, berkontribusi secara bermakna, dan merasa bangga menjadi bagian dari perusahaan.

Tentang Sertifikasi Great Place To Work®
Sertifikasi Great Place To Work® merupakan pengakuan paling definitif sebagai “employer of choice” yang diidamkan oleh banyak perusahaan di seluruh dunia. Penilaian dilakukan sepenuhnya berdasarkan pengalaman nyata karyawan, khususnya terkait rasa percaya, rasa aman, dan kenyamanan dalam bekerja.

Setiap tahunnya, lebih dari 10.000 perusahaan di 60 negara mengajukan diri untuk mendapatkan sertifikasi ini. Pencapaian PTVI tidak hanya menjadi kebanggaan internal, tetapi juga menempatkan perusahaan dalam jajaran organisasi global yang unggul dalam membangun pengalaman kerja yang positif dan berkelanjutan.

en.title: Vale inaugurates Capanema mine and invests R$ 67 billion in a new phase of mining in Minas Gerais
en.subtitle: Investments through 2030 in the state will ensure production with fewer tailings dams, greater sustainability, and innovation
en.body:
Vale inaugurated the Capanema mine this Thursday (September 4) in Ouro Preto (MG), during a ceremony attended by Governor Romeu Zema and other authorities. The resumption of operations marks the beginning of a new phase for Vale in the state, with investments totaling R$ 67 billion through 2030.

The resources will be applied to safer, more innovative, and sustainable production processes, prioritizing the reduction in the use of tailings dams, lower carbon emissions, and the expansion of circular mining, supported by new technologies across the company’s five operational complexes in Minas Gerais.

Capanema will operate using natural moisture, without water in mineral processing and without generating tailings, eliminating the need for a dam. The new model also includes five autonomous off-road trucks and circularity solutions, such as the reprocessing of iron ore contained in an old waste pile. The mine will add approximately 15 million tons per year (Mtpa) to Vale’s iron ore production, contributing to the company’s guidance of 340–360 Mtpa in 2026.

Around R$ 5.2 billion was invested in reactivating the unit, which had been inactive for 22 years, including modernization of facilities and integration with other mines in the region to optimize processes and reduce environmental impacts. The construction lasted five years, involved around 40 companies and more than 6,000 workers at peak activity, with a focus on hiring local labor. The operation employs 800 people.

“Minas Gerais is at the center of Vale’s transformation. We have a long history of learning, deep cultural evolution, and above all, partnership with the people of Minas. We continue together on this journey, confident in our legacy for the sustainable development of the state. Capanema exemplifies the new phase of mining in Minas Gerais and reinforces our commitment to a more responsible production process, minimally invasive and with technology and innovation applied to better utilize mineral resources and support decarbonization initiatives,” says Gustavo Pimenta, Vale’s CEO.

 
New Investments

The R$ 67 billion investment in Minas Gerais is part of Vale’s 2030 strategy, which aims to offer a more flexible iron ore portfolio, driven by improvements in operational performance. These investments are expected to generate around R$ 440 million in annual royalties and BRL 3 billion in annual salaries for approximately 60,000 professionals, including direct and contracted workers.

Most of the investments will be directed toward solutions to expand tailings filtering and dry stacking, with the goal of reducing the use of dams in the company’s operations in the state from 30% to 20%.

“These projects will offer greater safety in the production of the high-quality portfolio, which requires ore concentration stages, especially high-grade pellet feed, essential for direct reduction steelmaking routes with lower greenhouse gas emissions. Minas Gerais is strategic in supplying this product, directly contributing to the decarbonization of the steel industry,” explains Rogério Nogueira, Vale’s Executive Vice President of Commercial and Development.

There will be investments in modernizing the company’s five operational complexes, as well as improvements in the management of geotechnical structures at the mines, including connectivity, fleet renewal, instrumentation, and monitoring—among other processes that ensure safety, sustainability, and innovation in iron ore production in the state.

Resources will also support the elimination of dams and dikes under the Upstream Structure Decharacterization Program. Since 2019, about 60% of the program has been completed. Of the 13 remaining structures, eight are under works. All are inactive and monitored 24/7 by Vale’s Geotechnical Monitoring Centers.

“We continue to advance in the management of our geotechnical structures, improving controls and technical studies and developing cutting-edge technology in partnership with our suppliers to eliminate our upstream dams, with an absolute focus on the safety of our employees, neighboring communities, and environmental protection. This is an essential step toward safer mining aligned with society’s expectations,” emphasizes Rafael Bittar, Vale’s Executive Vice President and Chief Technical Officer.

The company has been intensifying circular mining practices in the state since 2020, with the reprocessing of iron ore from geotechnical structures, such as the waste piles at the Serrinha mine, and those undergoing decharacterization, such as the Vargem Grande dam at the mine of the same name. Reuse eliminates risks associated with these structures and brings environmental benefits, such as reducing the area needed for material disposal.

In the first half of 2025, around 9 million tons (Mt) were produced through these programs, a 14% increase compared to the same period in 2024. Last year, production from circular sources totaled 12.7 Mt, and the company has the potential to reach 10% of its total production from these sources by 2030. Minas Gerais accounts for about 80% of this volume.

Co-product initiatives are also highlights in the state, such as the production of Sustainable Sand—with over 3 million tons sold in the last two years—and the Block Factory in Itabirito, which transforms tailings into materials for civil construction, returning to the production chain materials that would previously have been discarded in dams and piles.

Presence in Minas Gerais

With 63,000 employees, including direct and contracted workers, Vale’s activities represented 3.5% of the state’s GDP in 2023, according to a study by the Institute of Economic Research Foundation (Fipe). In the last two years, Minas Gerais accounted for about 45% of the company’s total iron ore production.

Vale also supports artistic expressions and cultural assets in the state. From 2020 to 2024, it invested around BRL 370 million in 335 projects, democratizing access to art and culture for more than one million people in 45 municipalities in Minas Gerais.

By combining mining with environmental preservation, Vale protects 73,000 hectares of green areas in the state—more than twice the size of the capital Belo Horizonte—through its own areas and partnerships with ICMBio. Of this total, it maintains 13 Private Natural Heritage Reserves (RPPNs) in municipalities where it operates. Additionally, the company conserves another 41,000 hectares, including legal reserves, environmental compensation areas, and areas designated for the creation of new RPPNs, currently under review by the relevant authorities.

en.title: Vale celebra aniversário de Vitória com música e história
en.subtitle: No mês do aniversário da cidade, empresa oferece atividades gratuitas, como concertos do Vale Música em parceria com a Prefeitura de Vitória
en.body:
Em homenagem ao aniversário de 474 anos de Vitória, a Vale preparou uma programação especial entre os dias 5 e 08 de setembro, com atividades gratuitas que valorizam a cultura local e promovem experiências únicas para moradores e visitantes.

Na Praia de Camburi, será montado um estande interativo com dinâmicas, conteúdos sobre a atuação da empresa, espaço instagramável e fotos ao vivo.
“A Vale tem uma relação próxima com os moradores de Vitória, especialmente com as comunidades vizinhas às nossas operações. Participar das comemorações do aniversário da cidade é uma oportunidade de fortalecer esse vínculo, oferecendo experiências que refletem nosso compromisso com o diálogo, a escuta ativa e a convivência respeitosa”, diz Marcelo Klein, diretor de Relações Institucionais da Vale.

Apresentações do Vale Música

Como parte da celebração, a Orquestra Jovem Vale Música, grupo de referência do Projeto Vale Música Espírito Santo, integrante do Programa Vale Música, apresenta o concerto “Festa Brasileira”, em diferentes pontos da cidade, em parceria com a Prefeitura de Vitória.

 

Com regência da maestra Ludhymila Bruzzi, as apresentações vão acontecer no dia 05 de setembro, às 19h, em Jardim da Penha; e no dia 08 de setembro, data da fundação de Vitória, às 16h, em Jardim Camburi. A programação tem patrocínio do Instituto Cultural Vale, por meio da Lei Federal de Incentivo à Cultura.

O repertório reúne a diversidade de ritmos brasileiros, com sucessos do samba, pagode, forró, frevo, baião e da black music nacional, em arranjos para orquestra assinados por Calvin Sucena, Danilo Aguiar e Fabio Diamante.

O espetáculo traz 16 canções que prometem botar o público para dançar, com hits consagrados nas vozes de Zeca Pagodinho (“Deixa a vida me levar” e “Faixa amarela”), Jorge Aragão (“Vou festejar”, “Coisinha do pai”), Zé Ramalho (“Frevo mulher”), Luiz Gonzaga (“Pagode russo”) e Tim Maia (“Descobridor dos sete mares”), entre outros artistas.

Para a maestra Ludhymila Bruzzi, a proposta do concerto “Festa Brasileira” é celebrar o aniversário da cidade de Vitória por meio da música, reunindo grandes sucessos da cultura popular em arranjos sinfônicos. “O programa valoriza ritmos brasileiros como samba, pagode, axé e frevo, traduzindo para a linguagem orquestral músicas que fazem parte da memória afetiva e coletiva do povo, em uma grande festa musical, por isso o nome Festa Brasileira”, explica Ludhymila.
Para esta apresentação, a Orquestra Jovem Vale Música vai contar com a participação de 27 integrantes com faixa etária entre 12 a 25 anos, com instrumentos de cordas, percussão e sopros.

Um dos grupos mais tradicionais do Projeto Vale Música Espírito Santo, a Orquestra Jovem já realizou concertos em homenagem aos 50 anos de carreira de Milton Nascimento (2013), a homenagem a Ivan Lins, com a participação do cantor e do pianista Gilson Peranzzetta (2015), e o concerto dedicado aos 80 anos de Roberto Menescal (2016). Anualmente participa de Festivais de Música, como o Festival de Música Erudita do Espírito Santo e o Festival de Inverno de Domingos Martins.

Desde 2022, o grupo conta com a orientação da renomada professora e violinista Carla Rincón, que faz a consultoria pedagógica do núcleo de cordas do Projeto Vale Música Espírito Santo.

Participe!

Concerto “Festa Brasileira” com Orquestra Jovem Vale Música
Data: 05/09 (sexta-feira), 19h
Local: Praça Regina Frigeri Furno, Jardim da Penha (próximo ao Supermercado BH).

Estande Vale na Orla de Camburi
Data: 08/09 (segunda-feira), das 8h às 15h
Local: Praia de Camburi, Jardim da Penha (Bolsão da praia, em frente a Farmácia Pague Menos).

Concerto “Festa Brasileira” com Orquestra Jovem Vale Música
Data: 08/09 (segunda-feira), 16h
Local: Praça Nilze Mendes, bairro Jardim Camburi.

en.title: Vale leva a Amazônia ao The Town para reforçar movimento de preservação da floresta
en.subtitle: Com experiência imersiva e sensorial, empresa apresenta estande com referências à região, que celebra a cultura e o povo amazônicos e antecipa o movimento Amazônia Live – Hoje e Sempre
en.body:
A Amazônia estará presente no festival The Town, nos fins de semana de 6, 7, 12, 13 e 14 de setembro no Autódromo de Interlagos, em São Paulo, numa iniciativa inédita promovida pela Vale. No ano da COP30 em Belém, a companhia vai oferecer aos fãs do evento musical a chance de atravessar um portal para a maior floresta tropical do mundo, onde a mineradora atua de forma sustentável há 40 anos. 

A experiência no festival está inteiramente conectada ao Amazônia Live – Hoje e Sempre, movimento do Rock in Rio e pelo The Town a favor da floresta. Como parte do projeto, um especial de TV transmitido diretamente do Rio Guamá, em Belém, no Pará, contará com a participação da popstar americana Mariah Carey e de quatro divas paraenses: Dona Onete, Joelma, Gaby Amarantos e Zaynara. Elas cantarão, no dia 17 de setembro, em um palco no formato de vitória-régia, que inspirou o desenho do estande da Vale no The Town. O Amazônia Live tem a Vale como patrocinadora principal.

Em um espaço imersivo, o estande da empresa no festival terá dez metros de diâmetro e cinco de altura. Nele, o público viverá uma experiência sensorial que o transportará à floresta por meio de imagens, folhagens, sons, aromas autênticos e representações da biodiversidade da Amazônia - tudo isso impulsionado por tecnologia e inovação. À noite, a estrutura ganha ainda mais destaque, com uma iluminação dinâmica nas pétalas da flor da vitória-régia explorando as cores branco, rosa, amarelo e verde.

A experiência tem previsão de duração de 2 minutos, convidando a todos a refletir sobre a importância da preservação e conservação desse bioma essencial. O visitante que postar uma foto na experiência de imersão dentro do estande da Vale ganhará uma “bag charm” com cara de onça-pintada, suçuarana ou macaco zogue-zogue – todos animais que habitam o BioParque Vale Amazônia, área mantida pela empresa no Sudeste do Pará. Quem postar uma foto do estande com a hashtag #valenaamazonia também vai ganhar bottons com referência à Amazônia.

“Se queremos engajar as pessoas na causa de preservação da Amazônia, precisamos aproximá-las do bioma. É isso que queremos com o estande no The Town: aproximar os brasileiros de um lugar sobre qual todos falam, mas a maioria não conhece”, afirma o diretor de Comunicação e Marca da Vale, Leandro Modé. “Só é possível preservar a floresta por meio da união de esforços. Por isso, nos juntamos ao Rock In Rio e The Town no Amazônia Live e no próprio festival em São Paulo”, completa. 

Para o executivo, a presença da Vale no The Town é um momento único para mostrar ao público a mineração comprometida com a conservação da floresta e o bem-estar das comunidades. Atualmente, a Vale produz 60% de seu minério de ferro no Pará e ajuda a preservar 800 mil hectares de floresta, o equivalente a cinco vezes a cidade de São Paulo, em parceria com o ICMBio.

Palco flutuante, show gratuito e patrocínio à cultura paraense 

Com patrocínio principal da Vale, o movimento Amazônia Live - Hoje e Sempre é promovido pelo Rock in Rio e pelo The Town com objetivo de chamar atenção para a necessidade de manter a floresta em pé, protegendo seus povos originários e contribuindo para o desafio global de reduzir as emissões de carbono. O especial será transmitido pela TV (Globo e Multishow) para todo o Brasil. 

Além disso, no sábado, 20 de setembro, o Grande Encontro Por Um Mundo Melhor ocupará o Estádio Mangueirão, na capital paraense, com apresentações gratuitas de Ivete Sangalo, Viviane Batidão e o baile da Lambateria convida Lia Sophia. 

O público que for ao Mangueirão acompanhará a abertura da noite com apresentação dos jovens talentos da Orquestra Vale Música Belém, projeto patrocinado pelo Instituto Cultural Vale. O repertório trará uma experiência sinfônica destacando a força da cultura brasileira, em arranjos inéditos que refletem a identidade amazônica e dialogam com os objetivos da COP30 — conferência global que também será realizada na capital paraense em torno de uma agenda em prol de um mundo mais sustentável. 

O movimento Amazônia Live – Hoje e Sempre contempla ainda um edital de patrocínio no valor de R$ 2 milhões que já está beneficiando seis iniciativas da Região Metropolitana de Belém nas áreas de bioeconomia, povos da floresta e empreendedorismo, e um documentário que vai registrar os bastidores dos espetáculos icônicos na região.

id.title: Vale leva a Amazônia ao The Town para reforçar movimento de preservação da floresta
id.subtitle: Com experiência imersiva e sensorial, empresa apresenta estande com referências à região, que celebra a cultura e o povo amazônicos e antecipa o movimento Amazônia Live – Hoje e Sempre
id.body:
A Amazônia estará presente no festival The Town, nos fins de semana de 6, 7, 12, 13 e 14 de setembro no Autódromo de Interlagos, em São Paulo, numa iniciativa inédita promovida pela Vale. No ano da COP30 em Belém, a companhia vai oferecer aos fãs do evento musical a chance de atravessar um portal para a maior floresta tropical do mundo, onde a mineradora atua de forma sustentável há 40 anos. 

A experiência no festival está inteiramente conectada ao Amazônia Live – Hoje e Sempre, movimento do Rock in Rio e pelo The Town a favor da floresta. Como parte do projeto, um especial de TV transmitido diretamente do Rio Guamá, em Belém, no Pará, contará com a participação da popstar americana Mariah Carey e de quatro divas paraenses: Dona Onete, Joelma, Gaby Amarantos e Zaynara. Elas cantarão, no dia 17 de setembro, em um palco no formato de vitória-régia, que inspirou o desenho do estande da Vale no The Town. O Amazônia Live tem a Vale como patrocinadora principal.

Em um espaço imersivo, o estande da empresa no festival terá dez metros de diâmetro e cinco de altura. Nele, o público viverá uma experiência sensorial que o transportará à floresta por meio de imagens, folhagens, sons, aromas autênticos e representações da biodiversidade da Amazônia - tudo isso impulsionado por tecnologia e inovação. À noite, a estrutura ganha ainda mais destaque, com uma iluminação dinâmica nas pétalas da flor da vitória-régia explorando as cores branco, rosa, amarelo e verde.

A experiência tem previsão de duração de 2 minutos, convidando a todos a refletir sobre a importância da preservação e conservação desse bioma essencial. O visitante que postar uma foto na experiência de imersão dentro do estande da Vale ganhará uma “bag charm” com cara de onça-pintada, suçuarana ou macaco zogue-zogue – todos animais que habitam o BioParque Vale Amazônia, área mantida pela empresa no Sudeste do Pará. Quem postar uma foto do estande com a hashtag #valenaamazonia também vai ganhar bottons com referência à Amazônia.

“Se queremos engajar as pessoas na causa de preservação da Amazônia, precisamos aproximá-las do bioma. É isso que queremos com o estande no The Town: aproximar os brasileiros de um lugar sobre qual todos falam, mas a maioria não conhece”, afirma o diretor de Comunicação e Marca da Vale, Leandro Modé. “Só é possível preservar a floresta por meio da união de esforços. Por isso, nos juntamos ao Rock In Rio e The Town no Amazônia Live e no próprio festival em São Paulo”, completa. 

Para o executivo, a presença da Vale no The Town é um momento único para mostrar ao público a mineração comprometida com a conservação da floresta e o bem-estar das comunidades. Atualmente, a Vale produz 60% de seu minério de ferro no Pará e ajuda a preservar 800 mil hectares de floresta, o equivalente a cinco vezes a cidade de São Paulo, em parceria com o ICMBio.
